text.body: <1> <1.1> || sūtrārtharatnāvalī || || atha prathamādhyāyaḥ || || atha prathamaḥ pādaḥ || prāyeṇānyatra prasiddhānāṃ nāmātmakaśabdānāṃ paramātmani samanvayaḥ pradarśyate'sminpāde| <1-1-1> atra brahmajijñāsā kartavyeti samarthyate| || athāto brahmajijñāsā || || nanu śāstramidamanāraṃbhaṇīyaṃ| nyāyānusaṃdhānarūpavicārasyaivākartavyatvāt| tadakartavyaṃ ca nirviṣayatvādihetubhyaḥ| tathāhi| viṣayābhimataṃ brahma na jīvacaitanyādbhidyate| mānābhāvāt| mānaṃ bhavatpratyakṣaṃ vā'numānaṃ vā''gamo vā| nādyaḥ| ghaṭapaṭavajjīveśvarayorbhedānupalaṃbhāt| na dvitīyaḥ| kāmagāmitvāt| na tṛtīyaḥ| parasparāśrayatvāt| upakramādibhirnirṇītatātparyakasya bhedāgamasya yajamānaprastara ityādyāgamasya pratītārthāprāmāṇyaprasaṃgena bhede prāmāṇyāyogāt| upakramādibhirnirṇītatātparyasyāgamasya bhede prāmāṇyaṃ vācyaṃ| tathā ca śāstreṇopakramādyanusaṃdhānarūpavicārapravṛttau nirṇītatātparyeṇa vedena bhedasiddhiḥ| tatsiddhau jīvabhinnasya brahmaṇaḥ saṃdhigdhatvāpattyā śāstreṇa pravṛttiriti| jīvātmakatve ca sprakāśatvena nityasiddhatvānna viṣayatvaṃ| nāpi paraprayojanaṃ| paraprayojanaṃ bhavatsvargādyabhyudayo vā mokṣo vā syāt| nādyaḥ| laghūpāyena tatsiddheḥ| nā pi mokṣaḥ| jijñāsānaṃtaraṃ mokṣānupalaṃbhāt| astu vā jīvavyatiriktaṃ brahma| tathā'pi nāparokṣadvārā vicārasya taddhetutvaṃ| sākṣātkṛtabrahmaṇāmapi vasiṣṭhādīnāṃ tadanupalaṃbhāt| viṣayaprayojanābhāvāt| atha śabdoktādhikāriviśeṣāsaṃbhavena brahmajijñāsāyāmadhikārī na vidyate| ata eva na saṃbaṃdho'pīti prāpte parākurvatsūtramāha || athāto brahmajijñāseti || asyārthaḥ || atha adhyayanaśamadamādirūpādhikārasaṃpattyanaṃtaraṃ| ataḥ svajanyajñānajanyamokṣākhyaphalayuktatvāt| guṇapūrṇasya brahmaṇo viṣṇoḥ jijñāsā śravaṇādirūpo vicāraḥ kartavya ityarthaḥ || evaṃca kartavyaiva brahmajijñāsā| saprayojanatvāt| na ca nirviṣayatvena satpratipakṣatā| jīvabhinnasya brahmaṇa eva viṣayatvasaṃbhavena nirviṣayatvāsiddheḥ| na ca bhede mānābhāvaḥ| tadvijijñāsasveti śrutisiddhapūrṇatvasyaiva mānatvāt| na ca jaḍe'sādhāraṇyaṃ| jīvāsaṃbhāvitaguṇapūrṇatvasyaiva hetutvena vivakṣitatvāt| na cānumānasya kāmagāmitvaṃ| bhinno'ciṃtya iti śrutimūlatvāt| na copakramādyanusaṃdhānarūpavicārapravṛttau bhinno'ciṃtya ityādyāgamānāṃ bhede tātparyanirṇayaḥ| tasminsati prakṛtānumānasya pramāṇatvena jīvabhannaviṣayatvasiddhiḥ| tatsiddhau ca vicārapravṛttirityanyonyāśraya iti vācyaṃ| tātparyasaṃdehe satyeva vicārāpekṣaṇāt| anyathopakramādīnāmapi svārthe tātparyanirṇayāyopakramādyaṃtaramanveṣaṇīyaṃ syādityanavasthā| tathā ca jīvabhinnasya brahmaṇaḥ saṃdigdhatvena na nirviṣayatvena satpratipakṣaḥ| vyāpyasya prayojanasya sadbhāvena vyāpakasyādhikāriṇo'pi siddheḥ| na tadabhāvenāpi satpratipakṣaḥ| nanu sākṣātkṛta brahmaṇāmapi vasiṣṭhādīnāṃ mokṣānupalaṃbhena satprayojanatvamasiddhamiti cenna| anupalaṃbhaḥ kiṃ pratyakṣeṇa| uta pratyakṣamātreṇa| nādyaḥ| paramāṇvādīnāmapyabhāvaprasaṃgāt| dvitīye'pi vartamānakāle sattvānupalaṃbhaḥ| uta kadā'pi| nādyaḥ| jyotiṣṭomādyanuṣṭhānabhāvaprasaṃgāt| nātyaḥ| brahmapralayānaṃtaraṃ vasiṣṭhādīnāṃ mokṣopalaṃbhaśravaṇāt| ata eva saṃbaṃdhābhāvaśca parāstaḥ| tadabhāvenāpi satpratipakṣaḥ| tasmādvicāraḥ kartavya eveti śāstramāraṃbhaṇīyamiti siddhaṃ || || iti jijñāsādhikaraṇaṃ || <1-1-2> atra brahmalakṣaṇamucyate || || janmādyasya yataḥ || || nanu jīvedaṃ brahma na viṣṇuḥ| jīvaprāpakarūḍhisadbhāvāt| na ca viṣṇuprāpakayogasadbhāvādviṣṇureva brahma yogādrūḍhermukhyatvādbādhakaṃ vinā mukhyārthatyāgāyogāt| na ca jijñāsyatvameva bādhakaṃ| jijñāsāpadasya jñānecchāvācakatvena vicārārthakatvābhāvāt| tataśca jīvasya brahmapada mukhyārthatvādasya brahmaṇojīvatve siddhe tasya ca svaprakāśatvena saṃdigdhasyāvicāryatvātprakṛtānuguṇameva jijñāsāpadena lakṣaṇīyamiti jijñāsāyā avihitatvānna brahmajijñāsā saṃbhavatīti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati| || || janmādyasya yata iti || asyārthaḥ || asya pramitajīvajaḍātmakaprapaṃcasya| yataḥ yasmāt| janmādi sṛṣṭisthitisaṃhāraniyamanajñānājñānabaṃdhamokṣarūpāṣṭakaṃ| bhavatīti śrutaṃ tadeva brahma nānyadityarthaḥ || evaṃca brahmaśabdasya viṣṇau yogarūḍhatvādviṣṇurevedaṃ brahma| brahmaśabdasya jīve rūḍhatve'pi rūḍhamātrādvidvadrūḍheḥ prābalyena nirṇayopapatteḥ| astu vā jīva evarūḍhistathā'pi yatoveti pūrvavākyoktakāraṇatvapālakatvasaṃhārakatvamuktaprāpyatvānāmayogaprasaṃgena mukhyārthasyāpi tyājyatvāt| na ca teṣāṃ jīve saṃbhavaḥ| ya utridhā tvityādinā teṣāṃ viṣṇvaikaniṣṭhatvasya siddhatvājjijñāsāśabdo vicāre rūḍhaḥ| yadi vā lākṣaṇikaḥ| ubhayathā'pyātmā vā're iti śrutisamākhyānādvicāra eveti tadvirodhena na jī'votra vivakṣitaḥ| tataśca jīvātiriktasya brāhmaṇaḥ prāguktaṃ jijñāsyatvaṃ siddhaṃ || || iti janmādhikaraṇaṃ || <1-1-3> atra pūrvoktajagajjanmādikāraṇatvarūpabrahmalakṣaṇasya rudrādiṣvativyāptiparihārāya jagatkāraṇe pramāṇamucyate| || śāstrayonitvāt || || nanu rudrāderātmāśrayaprasaṃgena rudrādikāraṇatvāyogānnātivyāptiḥ| siddhāṃtyabhimatalakṣaṇasya tatrābhāvāt siddhāṃtyanabhimatarudravyatiriktajagatkāraṇatvopapādanenātivyāptidānasyānucitatvāt| kiṃca sūtrakārābhimataṃ viṣṇujanyabaṃdhādiyogitvaṃ rudrādāvaṃgīkriyate na vā| ādye na tasya kāraṇatvasaṃbhavaḥ| baddhasya devadattāditulyatvāt| dvitīye'saṃbhava eva vaktavyaḥ| siddhāṃtyabhimatasya rudrājaganniṣṭhajñānābaṃdhādikartṛtvasya viṣṇāvabhāvāditi cet| syādayaṃ doṣaḥ| yadi sūtrakṛdabhimatalakṣaṇasyātivyāptirucyeta| na caivaṃ| kiṃ nāma mayo veti śrutyukta lakṣaṇasyaiva| naca rudrādiniṣṭhabaṃdhādi kāraṇatvaṃ śrutyabhipretaṃ| rudrasya viṣṇusamānatvena baṃdhājñānādiśūnyatvāt| avidyamānarudrādiniṣṭhabaṃdhādikartṛtvasya śrutyarthatve ghaṭasya baṃdhādikartṛtvamapi śrutyarthaḥ syāt| tataśca mahadākartṛtvameva śrutyarthaḥ| na sūtrakāroktaḥ| tasya rudrādāvanumānena siddhatvādityativyāptireva| ata eva na chalaprasaṃgo'pi| pramāṇaṃ tu śivo jagatkartā tadicchutve sati tatkartṛviṣṇusamānatvāt| iti mānaṃ| asya ca sakalalokasiddhatvena nāsidhyādikṣudropadrabaḥ| tataśca tadvijijñāsasveti vākye rudrādigrahaṇe bādhakābhāvāt| rūḍhisadbhāvācca| ato rudra eva vivakṣito na viṣṇuriti prāpte sūtramāha || || || śastrayonitvāditi || asyārthaḥ || śivo jagatkartā tadicchutve sati tatkartṛviṣṇusamānatvādityādyanumānairna rudrāderjagatkāraṇatvaṃ kalpyaṃ| kutaḥ| śāstrayonitvāt| śāstraṃ ṛgādirūpaṃ| yoniḥ jñaptikāraṇaṃ yasya tacchāstrayonitvaṃ| tasmājjagatkāraṇaṃ brahma| śāstrekasamadhigamyatvādityarthaḥ| evaṃca viṣṇoreva jagatkāraṇatvaṃ na rudrādīnāṃ| rudrādibaṃdhakāraṇatvāderudrādāvasaṃbhavāt| na ca rudrādikāraṇatvādi na yato veti śrutyartha iti vācyaṃ| imānītyanenotpattyādimattayā pramāṇapramitasarvapadārthagrahaṇāt| rudrasya cotpattyādimattayā pramāṇapramitatvāt| astu vā mahadādikartṛtvameva yato veti śrutyarthaḥ| tathā'pi na rudrādāvativyāptiḥ| kāraṇatvasya śāstraikasamadhigamyatvenānumānaprasattmyabhāvāt| vādyuktānumānasya pratipakṣāsidhyādidoṣagrastatvenāsādhakatvāt| na ca sakalalokasiddhatvānnāsiddhiḥ| asmadādīnāmasaṃmatatvena sakalalokaprasidhyabhāvāt| pāmarapratīteścātiprasaṃgenāsādhakatvāt| tathā ca śivādigrahaṇe śrutyuktalakṣaṇāsaṃbhavarūpabādhakasadbhāvāt| tadvijijñāsasveti viṣṇureva vivakṣita iti sa eva jijñāsya iti siddhaṃ || || iti śāstrayonitvādhikaraṇaṃ || <1-1-4> atra viṣṇoreva jagatkāraṇatvena śāstragamyatvaṃ netareṣāmapīti samarthyate| || tattu samanvayāt || || nanu viṣṇorivānyeṣāmapi jagatkāraṇatvena śāstrayonitvasaṃgīkāryaṃ| vedavyākhyānarūpapañcarātrādyāgamādviṣṇau tātparyāvadhāraṇavatsarvajñavādipraṇītavedavyākhyānarūpapāśupatādyāgamācchivādiṣvapi| kāraṇatvābhidhāyakavedaikadeśatātparyāvadhāraṇāt| sarvavedavyākhyānaprāmāṇyasaṃbhave pañcarātrādiprāmāṇyamaṃgākṛtya śaivādyāgamaprāmāṇyanagaṃkīkāre kāraṇābhāvāt| bhāgaviśeṣe viṣṇupratipādakatvasya spaṣṭopalambhavadbhāgāviśeṣe śivādiparatvasya spaṣṭamupalambhena pratītisadhrīcīnatvasyobhayatrasābhyāt| na ca bahūnāṃ kāraṇatvāsambhavaḥ| gurutarabhāroddharaṇādau pratyekamasamarthānāṃ bahūnāṃ kartṛtvasya sarvānubhavasiddhatvāt| na ca sarve vedā ityādiśrutivarodhaḥ| viṣṇuprasiddhaśabdaliṃgādyupetāḥ sarve vedā ityarthatvāttasyāḥ| na caiko nārāyaṇa ityādirudrādikāraṇatāniṣedhakavākyavirodhaḥ| teṣāṃ viṣṇukāraṇatāprāśastyaparatvenoditānuditahomaniṃdāvākyavacchivādikāraṇatāniṣedhe tātparyābhāvāt| na copakramādivirodhaḥ| upakramādito vyākhyānasya sarvajñapraṇītatvena balavattvāt| tasmādviṣṇuvacchivādīnāmapi kāraṇatvena śāstrayonitvādativyāptaṃ jagatkāraṇatvamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || tattu samanvayāditi || asyārthaḥ || tu śabda evārthe| tadeva viṣṇvākhyaṃ brahmaiva| saṃ mukhyataḥ śāstrayoni| na rudrādiḥ| kutaḥ| samanvayāt samīcīnopakramāditātparyaliṃgādityarthaḥ || evaṃ ca śivādīnāṃ pramāṇābhāvena jagatkāraṇatvābhāvānnātivyāptiḥ| na ca śevādyāgamanirṇītatātparyaka vedastatra mānaṃ| upakramādiviruddhasya śivādau vede tātparyagrāhakasya śaivādyāgamasyāmānatvāt| na ca vaiparītyaṃ| teṣāmaṃtaraṃgatvena balavatttvāt| śaivādyāgamasya tātparyāvadhāraṇāya copakramādīnāmanusartavyatvena nopajīvyatvācca| na ca pratītisadhrīcīnatvenāgamasya prāmāṇyaṃ| upakramādyanusaṃdhānapūrvakapratītisadhrīcīnatvasyābhāvāt| āpātataḥ pratītisadhrīcīnatvasyāprayojakatvāt| uditahomādiniṃdāyā uditahomādervihitatvena niṃdāyāṃ tātparyābhāve'pi śivādikāraṇatvasyāprāmāṇikatvena tanniṣedhakavākyānāṃ svārthe tātparyasadbhāvācca tasmādanītavyāptaṃ janmādikāraṇatvaṃ brahmalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ || || iti samanvayādhikaraṇaṃ || <1-1-5> atra saṃśabdoktaṃ vācyatvaṃ kārtsnyaṃ cākṣipya samādhīyate| || īkṣaternāśabdaṃ || || nanu pūrvasūtre tacchabdoktaṃ brahma śabdagocaraṃ śāstroktakāraṇaṃ na śāstramukhyārthatvaṃ na| kutaḥ| avācyatvāt| mukhyārthatvasya ca yato vāco nivartatetyādi śrutisiddhatvāt| na hyavācyasya mukhyārthatā saṃbhavatīti na śāstroktaṃ jagatkāraṇatvaṃ tasyeti prāpte sūtramāha || || īkṣaternāśabdamiti || asyārthaḥ || tat brahma| aśabdaṃ na aśabdavācyaṃ na kiṃtu vācyameva| kutaḥ | īkṣateḥ īkṣatirjñānaṃ | tadviṣayatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃcekṣaṇīyatvā'nyathā'nupapattyā vācyatvasyaiva siddhatvenāvācyatvasyāsiddheḥ| nacekṣaṇīyatvamasiddhamiti vācyaṃ| sa etasmāditi śrutisiddhatvāt| na ca vācyatvānumānasya yato vāca ityādi śrutibādhaḥ| yato vāca iti śruteḥ prasiddhatvābhidhāyakatvenāvācyatvānabhidhāyakatvāt| aprasiddheravācyamiti smṛteḥ| tataścāvācyatvarūpabādhakābhāvātkāraṇatvaṃ viṣṇoreveti siddhaṃ || <1-1-6> || || gauṇaścennātmaśabdāt || || nanvīkṣaṇīyatvahetorvyadhikaraṇāsiddhatvāt| ātmanyevāmātmānaṃ paśyedityādiśrutyukta ātmā gauṇo nāma sattvādiguṇabaddho jīva eva| atastadanyathā'nupapattyā vācyo'pi sa eva syānna nirguṇaḥ paramātmeti prāpte sūtramāha || gauṇaścennātmaśabdāditi || asyārthaḥ || gauṇaḥ sattvādiguṇabaddho jīva eva| sa etasmāditi īkṣātiśrutyukta iti cenna| kutaḥ| ātmaśabdāt īkṣaṇīyavastuni ātmānaṃ paśyedityātmaśabdaśravaṇādityarthaḥ || || evaṃca yo guṇaiḥ sarvata iti dve vāva brahmaṇā ityādivākyeṣvātmaśabdaśravaṇāt| tasya satvādiguṇaśūnyatvenoktatvāt| sa etasmāditi śrutestatparatvasyaiva vaktavyatvāt| samākhyālabdhasyaiva śrutyarthatvāt| ātmapara mukhyārtheai nirguṇe dṛśyatayekṣatiśrutipratipādye saṃbhavati satyamukhyārthasya gauṇasya grahaṇāyogāt| nirguṇabrahmaivoditaṃ| ataḥ sa eva vācyo na jīva iti siddhaṃ || <1-1-7> || || tanniṣṭhasya mokṣopadeśāt || || nanvātmaśabdo mukhyata eva gauṇātmaparaḥsyāt| uktaśrutismṛtiṣvātmaśabdasya nirguṇe viṣṇau mukhyatvena jīveṣvamukhyatvenetyanuktenātmānātmaśabdayoścetanācetanaviṣayatvasaṃbhavāt| tacchabdayoḥ prasiddhacetanācetanaparatve śruterārjavaṃ syāt| prasiddhārthāparityāgādrūpaśabdasyānekārthākalpanācca| duḥkhādidoṣasyaupādhikatvena jīvasyāpi svabhāvato nirdoṣatayā śruteḥ svabhāvaviṣayatvopapatterityāśaṃkāṃ parihartuṃ sūtraṃ paṭhati || || tanniṣṭhasya mokṣopadeśāditi || asyārthaḥ || tanniṣṭhasya paramātmajñāninaḥ| mokṣopadeśāt yasyānuvitta ityādau mokṣasya śrutatvāt| ātmaśabdamukhyavācyo na jīva ityarthaḥ| evaṃca guṇabaddhajīvajñāninastatjñānāṅguṇabaṃdhanivṛttirūpo mokṣo na saṃbhavati| yasyānuvitta iti śrutau brahmajñānino mokṣopadeśasya śravaṇāt| ayamātmā brahmeti śrutyā''tmaśabdasya viṣṇāveva mukhyatvāt| na gauṇa ātmā kiṃtu nirguṇabrahma eveti siddhaṃ| <1-1-8> || || heyatvāvacanācca || || yuktmyaṃtareṇātmaśabdodito na gauṇa ityāha sūtrakṛt || || heyatvāvacanācceti || asyārthaḥ || heyatvāvacanāt brahmaṇo mokṣārthaṃ prādhānyenājñeyatvarūpaheyatvasyāpratipādanāt pratyuta jānatheti ahetvavacanācca| na gauṇa ātmaśabdavācyaḥ || kiṃtu nirguṇaviṣṇurevetyarthaḥ || evaṃca na kevalaṃ tanniṣṭhasya mokṣopadeśātkiṃtu tamevaikamiti śrutāvātmano heyatvāvacanāt| anyāvāco vimuṃcatheti mumukṣubhirheyatvavacanācca| gauṇa ātmaśabdavācyo na kiṃtu nirguṇo viṣṇurevetyāśayaḥ| tathā cātmaśabdādīkṣatiśrutyukto'pi nirguṇa eveti siddhaṃ| tasyekṣatyanyathā'nupapattyā vācyatvamiti siddhaṃ || <1-1-9> || svāpyayāt || || yuktyaṃtareṇāpi nirguṇasya viṣṇorvācyatvamupapādayatsūtramupanyasyati || || svāpyayāditi || asyārthaḥ || svasya svasmin apyayāt apyayapadokta layavacanāt| ātmānaṃ vilāpayatīti śrutyukto nirguṇa eva na gauṇaḥ| ata eva cāsau śabdavācya ityarthaḥ| || evaṃca pūrṇamada iti śrutau svāpyayapadopalakṣitapūrṇatvasya vacanāt| svasya svasminnevāpyayavacanācca| sa deva iti spaṣṭasmṛtāvācmanyeva vilāpayatīti svasya svasminnevāpyayavacanāt| tasya ca hariguṇaniṣṭhatāyāḥ smṛtau vacanāt| gauṇa ātmani nirdoṣasya layābhāvācca| aṃya nirguṇa eva na gauṇa iti siddha || <1-1-10> || gatisāmānyāt || || nanvastu nirguṇasya viṣṇorvācyatvopapattau satyāṃ kāraṇatvena śāstrgagyatvaṃ| tathā copakramādibalātprasiddhaśākhāsveva kāraṇatvena pratipādyatvaṃ paryavasitaṃ| aprasiddhaśākhāsu punaranyo'pi kāraṇatvenocyatāṃ| na ca tā na saṃti| tāsāmānaṃtyeneyattā'niścayāditi prāpte sūtrakṛdāha || || gatisāmānyaditi || asyārthaḥ || gateḥ nānāśākhajanyajñānasya| sāmānyāt ekarūpatvaśravaṇāt| na viṣṇoranyaḥ kāraṇatvena śākhāṃtarapratipādya ityarthaḥ || || evaṃca sarve vedā iti paiṃgiśrutyā sarve vedā itihāsāśca viṣayakṛto vā prakārakṛto vā virodhābhāvena jñānarūpamekameva brahmasvarūpaṃ jñāpayaṃti| evaṃ sarvaśākhotpādyajñānasyaikavidhatvokterna kāsucicchākhāsvanyathokteśca viṣṇureva kāraṇatvena sarvaśākhāsu pratipādya iti phalitaṃ || <1-1-11> || śrutatvācca || || itaśca nirguṇaṃ brahma vācyamiti siṃhāvalokananyāyenāha sūtrakṛt || || || śrutatvācceti || asyārthaḥ || eko deva iti śrutyuktatvācca nāśābdavācyaṃ brahmetyarthaḥ || || evaṃcaiko devaḥ sarvabhūteṣviti śvetāśvataśrutau sattvādiguṇabaṃdhavidhurasya nirguṇasya vācyatvokteḥ| avācyasya padārthasya na śrutipadenoktatvāt| avācyasya brahmaṇo lakṣyatvakalpanasyānyāyyatvāt| tasya sarvaśabdavācyatayaiva pareṇāṃgīkṛtatvāt| tataścāvācyatvarūpabādhakābhāvādupakramādiliṃgairvicāre kriyamāṇe tasyaiva kāraṇatvāvagatergatisāmānyācca kāraṇatvaṃ tasyaiveti siddhaṃ || || iti īkṣatyadhikaraṇaṃ || atra lokato'nyatraprasiddhānaṃdamayaśabdopalakṣitaguṇivāciśabdānāṃ ca brahmaṇi samanvayaḥ kriyate| <1-1-12> || ānaṃdamayo'bhyāsāt || || nanvānaṃdamayaścaturmukhāvabhinnau| nāmasāṃkaryāt| vidyate khalu caturmukhaniṣṭho brahmaśabada ānaṃdamaye| ānaṃdamayamadhikṛtyāsti brahmeti brahmaśabda śravaṇāt| ānaṃdamayasamānārthakaśatānaṃdanāma ca hiraṇyagarbhe vartate| rudro vā''naṃdamayaḥ| yaścāsāvāditya ityānaṃdamayasya sūrye proktatvena sūryāṃtargatatvasya ca rudraliṃgatvāt| sūryādhiṣṭhātṛtvendraliṃgatvādindrovā| brṛhaspatiliṃgatvād‌bṛhaspatirvā| so'kāmayateti svābhimanyamānasya bahubhāvakāmitvāccitprakṛtirvā| bahubhāvādacitprakṛtirvā| tattaddehagatasarvajīvā vā| annarasamaya ityuktajīvaprāyapāṭhāt| annamayādīnāmannādivikārābhimānitvena jīvatvasya vaktavyatvāt| na ca brahmaśabdo bādhakaḥ| brahmāṇī jīvāḥ sarve'pīti jīve'pi brahmaśabdaśravaṇāt| iti prāpte samādadhatsūtramāha| || || ānaṃdamayo'bhyāsaditi || asyārthaḥ || ānaṃdamayādiśabdavācyo viṣṇureva na prakṛtyādiḥ| kutaḥ| abhyāsāt pratiprakāraṇamānaṃdamayādau brahmaśabdaśravaṇādityarthaḥ || || evaṃcāsannaiva sa bhavati| asad‌brahmoti cedveda| astibrahmoti cedvede tyādiśrutismṛtiṣu brahmaśabdasya viṣṇāveva paramamukhyatvasyoktatvāt| ānaṃdamayaśabdavācyo'pi viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-1-13> || vikāraśabdānneti cenna prācuryāt || || nanvatra vikārārthaka mayaṭ śabdaprayogāt| japrakṛtervikārātmakatvāccetanaprakṛtyādīnāṃ ca vikārābhimānitvāt| prakṛtyādīnāmevānaṃdamayādiśabdavācyatvaṃ syānnatu paramātmanaḥ| tasyāvikāritvādanabhimānitvāditi prāpte tannirāsārthamuktamākṣipya samādadhatsūtramāha || || vikāraśabdānneti cenna prācuryāditi || asyārthaḥ || vikāraśabdāt vikārārthakamayaṭ‌śabdāt| ānaṃdamayādirviṣṇurneti cenna| kutaḥ| prācuryāt mayaṭ‌śabdasya prājuryapadoktapūrṇatvābhidhāyakatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca mayaṭ‌śabdasya pracurānaṃdatvāt| annamayādīnāmapi brahmatvena tadgatamayaṭo vikārārthakatvābhāvāt| na cānnamayādiśabdānāmannamayādiprāṭacuyārthakatve'lpārthatā| adyate'ttice tyādinā sarvabhūtopajīvyatvasarvāttṛtvayorevānnamayaśabdārthatvāt| upajīvyatvamevādyatvamityāśayāt| prāyapaṭhitamayaṭāmarthadvayakalpanānaucityāt ānaṃdādisvarūpe harau pracuraprakāśo raviritivadviśeṣeṇa tathā vyavahārasyopapatterānaṃdamayādirviṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-1-14> || taddhetuvyapadeśācca || || ānaṃdamayamātrasya viṣṇutve hetvaṃtararūpaṃ prācuryameva mayartha ityatra ca hetuṃ pratipādayatsūtramupanyasyati|| || taddhetuvyapadeśācceti || asyārthaḥ || caḥsanamuccaye| tasya ānaṃdamayasya| viṣṇutve lokaceṣṭakatvākhyahetoḥ| vyapadeśāt kohyevānyāditi śrutāvuktatvācca ānaṃdamayo viṣṇurevetyarthaḥ || || evaṃca na kevalaṃ brahmaśabdābhyāsāt kiṃtvānaṃdamayaprakaraṇe viṣṇorānaṃdapūrṇatvenānaṃdamayatve prācuyaṃsyaiva mayaḍarthatve ca lokaceṣṭakatvākhya hetūkteścānaṃdapūrṇatvenaivānaṃdamayaśabdavācyo viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-1-15> || māṃkavarṇikameva ca gīyate || || nanu brahmaśabdasyāparabrahmāṇi jīve'pyupapatteḥ| tasya parabrahmāṇi mukhyatve'pi viṣṇorānaṃdamayāvayavatvoktyādinā bādhakenāmukhyārthasyaiva grahaṇopapatteriti prāpte sūtramāha || || || māṃtravarṇikameva ca gīyata iti || asyārthaḥ || yataḥ māṃtravarṇikaṃ sasyaṃ jñānamanaṃtaṃ brahmeti maṃtravarṇoktaṃ brahma| gīyate ānaṃdamayādiśabdaiḥ pratipādyate| ata ānaṃdamayādiśabdavācyaṃ brahmaivetyarthaḥ || || evaṃca satyajñānādiśabdānāmannamayādiśabdānāṃ cānusaṃdhāne satyekārthatvapratīteḥ| na cānaṃdamayasyaiva brahmteva brahmaṇastatpucchatvoktivirodhaḥ| sa śiraḥ sa dakṣiṇa iti śratyā'vayavina evāvayatvokteḥ ānaṃdamayādiśabdavācyaṃ brahmaiveti siddhaṃ || <1-1-16> || || netaro'nupapatteḥ || || nanu brahmaśabdasya sādhāraṇatvāt| taddhetuvyapadeśasya viṣṇuniṣṭhatayā spaṣṭamapratibhānāt| maṃtravarṇasamākhyāyāścānyaliṃgādibhyo durbalatvena sāvakāśatvāt| ananyathāsiddhahetvaṃtarasya cābhāvāt| ānaṃdamayādayo viriṃcādaya eva syuriti prāpte sūtramavatārayati || || netaro'nupapatteriti || asyārthaḥ || itaraḥ caturmukhādiḥ na| kutaḥ| anupapatteḥ brahmavidāpnoti paramiti mokṣajanakajñānaviṣayatvāyogādityarthaḥ || evaṃca brahmaśabdaśatānaṃdatvāṣṭamūrtitvabahubhāvādirūpoktaprāpakenānnamayādiśabdairviriṃcādireva nocyate| viṣṇvanyaviriṃcādijñānānmokṣānupapatteḥ| brahmavidāpnoti paramiti śrutau ānaṃdamayādermuktihetujñānaviṣayatvokterānaṃdamayādiśabdavācyo viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-1-17> || || bhedavyapadeśācca || || hetvaṃtareṇa brahmādināmānaṃdamayatvaṃ parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || bhedavyapadeśācceti || asyārthaḥ || caturmukhāderānaṃdamayasya bhedakadharmokteśca| nānaṃdamaya itara ityarthaḥ || || evaṃca te ye śatamityatra viriṃcasya rudrācchataguṇānaṃdatvokterānaṃdamayasya ca yato vāca ityādinā'parimitānaṃdatvokteḥ| rudrasya viriṃcācchatāṃśonānaṃdatvokteḥ| bṛhaspatyādīnāmuttarottarāpekṣayā śatāṃśonānaṃdatvokteḥ| adṛśyatvādau prakṛtyādyayogyasvātaṃtryādibhedakadharmaśravaṇāt| brahmādijīvasamudāyasya sa yaścāyami tyatrāprakṛṣṭotkṛṣṭasarvajīvasthitirūpabhedakadharmokteḥ| tattvamasītyādi śrutīnāmarthotarakalpanācca| jīveśvarayorbhedasya sthāpitatvādānaṃdamayādirviṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-1-18> || || kāmācca nānumānāpekṣā || || nanu bhedokteḥ śrutivirodhābhāve'pi jīvo brahmābhinnaśetanatvādbrahmavat| bhedo mithyā bhedatvāccaṃdrabhedavat| vimatāni śarīrāṇi madbhogāyatanāni śarīratvānmaccharīravadityādyanumānavirodhaḥ syādeveti prāpte sūtramavatārayati || || || kāmācca nānumānāpekṣeti || asyārthaḥ || advaitaśrutyanukūlānumānasyābhāvāt| kevalānumānasya ca kāmāt| icchāmanusṛtya pravṛttatvāt| nānumānāpekṣā| atīṃdriyārthaviṣaye śuṣkānumānāpekṣā na kāryetyarthaḥ || evaṃca pratyakṣādi viruddhasya śrutisahāyyarahitasya cānumānasya tattvajñānaṃ prati kāraṇatvābhāvāt| īśvaro na svataṃtraścetanatvāddevadattādivadityapyanumātuṃ śakyatvāt| pratyakṣādiviruddhasyāpi pramāṇatve cetanatvāderapi prāmāṇyaṃsyādaviśeṣāditi vipakṣebādhakatarkasya saṃbhavāt| yathā kāmeti skāṃdavākye kevalānumānasya kāmagāmitvenoktatvāt| jīveśayorbhedasya siddhatvenānaṃdamayādi brahmaiveti siddhaṃ || <1-1-19> || || asminnasya ca tadyogaṃ śāsti || || nanvastvānaṃdamayena brahmaṇā hiraṇyagarbhādijīvānāṃ bhedaḥ| tathā'pi sa vyāvahāriko na pāramārthiko muktāvapi| udāhṛtaśrutīnāṃ sāṃsārikabhedaparatvopapatteriti prāpte sūtramāha| || asminnasya ca tadyogaṃ śāstīti || asyārthaḥ || yuktisamuccaye ca śabdaḥ| yataḥ asmin ānaṃdamayaprakaraṇe| mokṣe'pi asya jīvasya| tadyogaṃ ānaṃdamayādīnāṃ saṃbaṃdhaṃ| śāsti śrutiḥ pratipādayati| ato'pi ānaṃdamayādirbrahmaiva na dehādirityarthaḥ || || evaṃcānilayane'bhaya mityetamānaṃdamayami tyādiṣu brahmajñāninaḥ sarvajñena jñaitenaiva caturmukhena ca saha svayogyakāmānāṃ muktau prāpteḥ| dehādutkrāṃtajīvasya pūrṇānaṃdasya paramātmanaḥ samīpaprāpakatvokteśca| jīveśayorbhedaḥ pāramārthika iti sidhyā''naṃdamayādirabrahmaiveti siddhaṃ || || iti ānaṃdamayādhikaraṇaṃ || atrādhidaivagatānyatra prasiddheṃdrādināmasamanvayasidhyarthaṃ dehāṃtaḥsthatvarūpaliṃgasamanvayaḥ kriyate| <1-1-20> || aṃtastaddharmopadeśāt || || nanvaṃtaḥsthatvena śrutyocyamāna iṃdro bhavet| iṃdraśruteḥ || sūryo vā divaspatitvaliṃgātaṃ| varuṇaliṃgādvaruṇo vā| tvaṣṭṛśrutesvaṣṭā vā| agnibṛhaspatiśrutibhyāmagnibṛhaspatī vā na ceṃdrādiśabdā anyatra netuṃ śakyaṃte| teṣāṃ deveṣveva rūḍhatvāt| teṣāmaiśvaryādiśabdapravṛttinimittatvācca na cādṛśyatvādiliṃgādaṃtaḥśtho viṣṇuḥ| śrutyādibhyo liṃgamātrasya durbalatvāt| iti prāpte sūtramāha| || || aṃtastaddharmopadeśāditi || asyārthaḥ || aṃtaḥ aṃtaḥ praviṣṭamiti hṛdayāṃtaḥ śrutaṃ brahmaiva neṃdrādiḥ| kutaḥ| taddharmopadeśāt| tasmin aṃtaḥśruteḥ| kṣīrābdhimadhyavarttitvapralayodadhisthitatvabrahmāṃḍavīryatvādirūpaviṣṇudharmāṇāṃ aṃtaḥ samadra ityādau śratatvādityarthaḥ || || evaṃca niravakāśaliṃgaiḥ sāvakāśānyaprāpakaścatiliṃgānāṃ bādhopapatterayamaṃtaḥstho viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-1-21> || bhedavyapadeśācācanyaḥ || || nanu samudrasthatvādiliṃgādaṃtaḥstho viṣṇustarhi tenāṃtaḥsthena viṣṇuneṃdrādīnāmabhedo'stu| iṃdrādiprāpakaśrutyāderapi sadbhāvāt| śrutyādeśca svabhāvato liṃgasya niravakāśatayā balaktvenānyatarabādhenānyatarapakṣanirṇayāyogāt tataśca pūrvottarapakṣadvaye'nyonyaṃ bādhyabādhakabhāvaśūnye sati tadanyathā'nupattyāṃ'taḥsthena viṣṇuneṃdrādīnāmabhedaḥ prāpta ityāśaṃkāṃ pariharananmūtramupanyasyāti| || || bhedavyapadeśāccānya iti || asyārthaḥ || na kevalamaṃtaḥstho viṣṇuḥ kiṃtviṃdrādibhyo'nyaśca| kutaḥ| bhedavyapadeśāt| tasya tadaṃtaryāmitvatatprerakatvādirūpabhedakadharmaśravaṇādityarthaḥ || || evaṃca iṃdrasyātmā, vāyorātmānaṃ, aṃtarāditye, ityādi śrutiṣu bhedakadharmaśravaṇāt| na cobhayaprāpakānyathā'nupapattyaitatkalpyaṃ niravakāśena viṣṇuliṃgena sāvakāśānyaprāpakaśrutiliṃgānāṃ bādhopapatteḥ| tasmādayamaṃtaḥstho viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || || iti aṃtaḥsthatvādhikaraṇaṃ || atra bhagavati lokato'nyatraprasiddhākāśapadopalakṣitādhibhautikāśeṣaśabdasamanvayaḥ kriyate| <1-1-22> || ākāśastalliṃgāt || || nanvasya lokasyeti śrutyuktākāśo bhūtākāśa eva| ākāśaśabdasya tatra rūḍhatvāt| na cāthamākāśo viṣṇuḥ| ākāśaśabdasya tatra yaugikatvena satpratipakṣateti vācyaṃ| yogasya hīnabalatvenāpratipakṣatvāt| na cākāśaśabdapravṛttinimittasyāvakāśatvasya samavāyenākāśavṛttitvavatsvātaṃtryalakṣaṇena saṃbaṃdhena harāvapi sattvādubhayatrāpi rūḍheraviśiṣṭateti na rūḍhyā bhūtākāśatvanirṇaya iti vācyaṃ| ākāśasyācetanatvādbhagavadadhainatvābhāvenākāśatvasya svasvāmibhāvasaṃbaṃdhena tadvṛttitvābhāvāt| evaṃ chaṃdogaśrutyuktākāśe bhūtākāśe sati taittarīyaśrutyuktakāśo'pi rūḍhibalādeva bhūtākāśaḥ| sarvāṇi haveti tadākāśasya bhūtakāraṇatayoktatvāt| kāryagataceṣṭāyāḥ kāraṇādhīnatādarśanena ko hyevānyāditi śrutyuktajagacceṣṭakatvaliṃgasya sāvakāśatvenābādhakatvāt| ata ākāśo na viṣṇuriti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || ākāśastalliṃgāditi || asyārthaḥ || ākāśaḥ ākāśaśabdavācyo viṣṇureva| na prasiddhākāśaḥ| kutaḥ| talliṃgāt chaṃdoga śratyuktākāśe parovarīyastvādirūpaliṃgasya śravaṇādityarthaḥ || || evaṃca parovarīyastvādiniravakāśaviṣṇuliṃgāt| ākāśaśabdasya mahāyogavidvadrūḍhisadbhāvena tatraiva mukhyatvāt| tataśca chaṃdogaśrutyuktākāśasya viṣṇutve taittarīyokto'pi jagacceṣṭakatvaliṃgabalādeva viṣṇuḥ| ceṣṭakatvasya kartaryeva mukhyatvāt| mukhye saṃbhavatyamukhyagrahaṇāyogāt| sarvaceṣṭakatvasya sarvottamatvavyāptatvena bhūtākāśe sarvottamatvasyābhāvena sarvaceṣṭakatvābhāvāt| na cācetanasyāpi cetanānugraheṇānaṃdaḥ saṃbhavati| aprāmāṇikatvāt| tasmādākāśo viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || || iti ākāśādhikaraṇaṃ || atra lokato'nyatraprasidhyātmikāśeṣaśabdopalakṣakaprāṇaśabdasya brahmaṇi samanvayaḥ kriyate| <1-1-23> || ata eva prāṇaḥ || || nanvayaṃ prāṇo vāyureva| prāṇaśabdasya tatra rūḍhatvāt| viṣṇau rūḍherabhāvātprāṇaśrutestatra sāvakāśatvābhāvāt| yaugikārthasya jīvanakāraṇatvasyānvayavyatirekābhyāṃ vāyāveva darśanāt| tataśca prāṇo vāyureveti prāpte sūtramāha || || || ata eva prāṇa iti || asyārthaḥ || tadvaitvaṃ prāṇo'bhava ityuktaprāṇo viṣṇureva| nānyaḥ| kutaḥ| ata eva śrīścata iti śrīpatitvaliṃgādevetyarthaḥ || evaṃca niravakāśa śrīlakṣmīpatitvaliṃgāt| īśānaḥ prāṇadaḥ prāṇa iti vidvadrūḍhermahāyogasya ca viṣṇau sattvena śruteḥ sāvakāśatvāt| prāṇagatajīvanānvayavyātirakesyāpi na prāṇeneti śruterbhagavadadhīnatvāt| ataḥ prāṇaśabdavācyo viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || || iti prāṇādhikaraṇaṃ || atra tattatsūtragatāśeṣaśabdopalakṣakasya lokato'nyatraprasiddhasya jyotirnāmno brahmaṇi samanvayaḥ kriyate| <1-1-24> || || jyotiścaraṇābhidhānāt || || nanvāgnirevedaṃ jyotiḥ| tasya sūktasyāgni sūktatvāt| na ca liṃgātprakaraṇasya durbalatvena guhāhitatva liṃgātprakaraṇabādhaḥ| jyotiḥśruteragnaunirūḍhatvāt| viṣṇau tadabhāvāt| na ca liṃgasya niravakāśatvena śrutiprakaraṇabādhakatvamiti vācyaṃ| liṃgasyāpi jāṭharajātavedasi sāvakāśatvāt| liṃgasya niravakāśatve'pi tasyaividhameva prābalyaṃ| śrutiprakaraṇayostvanekaprayuktaprābalyāt| śruteśca svabhāvatvaprayuktaprābalyamapīti śrutiprakaraṇābhyāmeva liṃgasya bādho yuktaḥ| ato jyotiṣo'gnitvamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || || jyotiścaraṇābhidhānāditi || asyārthaḥ || jyotiḥ jyotiḥśabdavācyaṃ brahmaiva na tvanyat| kutaḥ| caraṇābhidhānāt karṇādīnāṃ vicaraṇābhidhānāt| jyotiṣaḥ sākalyena karṇādividūratva śravaṇādityarthaḥ || || evaṃca karṇādividūratvākhyaviṣṇuliṃgāt| bahutvasvabhāvabalavattvarūpobhayavidhaprābalyādapi niravakāśatvaprābalyasya balavattvena liṃgena śrutiprakaraṇabādhopapatteḥ| mahāyogavidvadrūḍhisadbhāvena śruterviṣṇāveva mukhyatvāt| ato viṣṇurevedaṃ jyotistasyaiva guhānihitatvaṃ ceti siddhaṃ || || iti jyotiradhikaraṇaṃ || atrādhivedagatagāyatryādyaśeṣaśabdasamanvayaḥkriyate| <1-1-25> || chaṃdobhidhānānneti cenna tathā cetorpaṇanigadāttathā hi darśanaṃ || || nanu gātratrī chaṃda eva| tacchabdasya tatraiva rūḍhatvāt| vāgvai gāyatrīti vākyavidhānāt| na ca gāyatryā bhagavadadhīnatvena gāyatrī śabdastatraiva mukhya iti vācyaṃ| gāyatryā vedaviśeṣatvānnityatvena parādhīnatvābhāvāt| ato gāyatrī chaṃdoviśeṣa eveti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati || || || chaṃdobhidhānānneti cenna tathā cetorpaṇanigadāttatāhi darśanamiti || asyārthaḥ || chaṃdobhidhānāt| nanu chaṃdogaśrutisthagāyatrīpadena caturviṃśatyakṣarātmakachaṃdasaḥ pratipādanādgāyatrīśabdavācyo viṣṇurneti cenna| kutaḥ| tathā hi darśanaṃ| hi yasmāt| tathā gānatrāṇakartṛtvanimittena| darśanaṃ viṣṇoḥ gāyatrīśabdavācyatvapratipādikā śrutirasti| tasmādvyārthaṃ gāyatrīpadena viṣṇorabidhānamityata uktaṃ| tathetyādi| tathā cetorpaṇanigadāt viṣṇostathā gāyatryādiśabdapravṛttinimittavattvena cetasi arpaṇāya upāsanāya| nigadāt śrutau pratipādanādityarthaḥ| tathā ca na vaiyarthyamiti bhāvaḥ || || evaṃca gānatrāṇakartṛtvaliṃgāt| naca liṃgasya niravakāśatvāyogena śrutibādhāyogaḥ| gāyatrīśruteḥ paurāṇikarūḍhyā śrutyuktayogena ca tatra mukhyatvāt| svabhāveti vacanāṅgāyatryā bhagavadadhīnatvāt| gāyatrīśabdavācyoviṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-1-26> || bhūtādipādavyapadeśopapatteścaivaṃ || || hetvaṃtareṇāpi gāyatryā viṣṇutvaṃ sādhayatsūtramupanyasyati || || || bhūtādipādavyapadeśopapatteścaivamiti || asyārthaḥ || evamityasyāvṛttiḥ| evaṃ gāyatrīśabdavācyaṃ brahmetyevamevayuktaṃ| kutaḥ| evaṃ bhūtādipādavyapadeśopapatteḥ| pādo'sya viśvābhūtāni tripādasyāmṛtaṃ divīti evaṃ rūpabhūtāmṛtāṃśavattvokteśca| tasya ca viṣṇāvevopapatteḥ anyatrānupapatteścetyarthaḥ || || evaṃca chāṃdogye saiṣāṃ catuṣpadetivākyena gāyatrīnāmakasya bhagavataḥ prāguktagāyatrībhūtavāk‌pṛthivīśarīrahṛdayalakṣaṇaṣaḍ‌vidhatvamanūdyāṃśacatuṣṭayarūpavattvarūpaṃ catuṣpādatvaṃ vidhāya svoktārtha eva puruṣasūktamaṃtraḥ samākhyārūpatvenodāhṛtaḥ| bhagavataścatuṣpādatvaṃ ṛṅ‌matreṇa spaṣṭamānukūlyenoktaṃ| na ca gāyatryāmiva bhūtabhinnatvena viṣṇāvapi bhūtapādatvoktiranupapannā| suvarṇakośamiti śruteḥ| na ca puruṣasūktaṃ na viṣṇuprakaraṇamitivācyaṃ| tasminkālai mahārājeti smṛtyā tatprakaraṇasya viṣṇutvaniścayāt| ato gāyatrīśabdavācyo viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-1-27> || upadeśabhedānneti cennobhayasminnapyavirodhāt || || nanu gāyatrījyotiprakaraṇayorupadeśabhedena bhinnārthatvādityādinoktamākṣipya samādadhatsūtramāha || || upadeśabhedānneti cennobhayasminnapyavirodhāditi || āsyārthaḥ || upadeśabhedāt gāyatrījyotiṣoḥ dyusthatva divaḥparatva rūpaviruddhadharmabodhakaśrutibhedānneti cettadvayaṃ viṣṇvākhyamekaṃ vastu na kiṃtu bhinnageveticenna| kutaḥ| ubhayasmin śrutivākye'pi ekasyapratipdāyatve'pi| avirodhāt trisaptalokavivakṣayā virodhābhāvādityarthaḥ || || evaṃca vivakṣābhedenaikasyaiva dyusthatvadivaḥ paratvayoḥ saṃbhavena bhinnārthatvābhāvāt| ato gāyatrī viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || || iti chaṃdobhidhānādhikaraṇaṃ || atra lokato'nyatraprasiddhaprāṇanāmno viṣṇau samanvayaḥ pratipādyate| <1-1-28> || prāṇastathā'nugamāt || || nanu tāvā etā ityukta prāṇo na viṣṇuḥ| iṃdriyagaṇe gaṇitatvāt| jīvo vā| eṣa ima lokamabhyārcaditi jīvaliṃgāt| mukhyaprāṇo vā| tā ahiṃsaṃteti talliṃgāt| iti prāpte sūtramupanyasyati || || || prāṇastathā'nugamāditi || asyārthaḥ || tathā tadvaitvamiti taittarīyoktaprāṇavat tā vā ityaitareyoktaprāṇo'pi viṣṇureva| kutaḥ| anugamāt devatopāsyādiviṣṇuliṃgabrahmaśabdānāṃ asakṛcchravaṇādityarthaḥ || evaṃ ca sa eṣo'surityatra duṣṭanirasanādasutvena prakṛṣṭānaṃdarūpatvātprāṇatvena devānāṃ jñānādyaiśvaryapradatvādasurāṇāmajñānādyaiśvaryahetutvācca bhūtyabhūtitvena ca tā vā etā ityatra sarvavedoktatvena tadayaṃ prāṇa ityatra deharathitvena taṃ devāḥ prāmayaṃta ityatra sarvadevatopāsyatvena coktatvāt| na ca pūrvapakṣiliṃgasya niravakāśatvenāpi prābalyaṃ| brāṇayaṃta ityatra sarvadevatopāsyatvena coktatvāt| na ca pūrvapakṣiliṃgasya niravakāśatvenāpi prābalyaṃ| prāṇaiḥ saha gaṇitatvasyāṃtaryāminiṣṭhatāsaṃbhavāt| prābalye'pyekaprakāreṇa prabalātpūrvapakṣiliṃgātprakāradvayenāpi prabalasya saiddhāṃtika liṃgasyādhikyena nirṇayopapatteḥ| asminprakaraṇe etadbrahma, brahmaṇo lokaḥ, brahmemaṃ puruṣaṃ, udaraṃ brahmetyācakṣate, a itibrahma, ityādiniravakāśabrahmaśabdābhyāsāt| ato'yaṃ prāṇo viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-1-29> || na vakturātmopadeśāditi cedadhyātmasaṃbaṃdhabhūmā hyasmin || || nanu nāyaṃ prāṇo viṣṇuḥ| kiṃtviṃdra eva| prāṇo vā'hamiti vākyena bṛhatīsahasravakturviśvāmitrasyeṃdreṇa prāṇatayā''tmanaḥ svasyaivopadeśādityākṣipya samādadhatsūtramāha || || || na vakturātmopadeśāditi cedadhyātmasaṃbaṃdhabhūmā hyasminniti || asyārthaḥ || dvitīyārthe ṣaṣṭhī| vaktuḥ bṛhatīsahasravaktāraṃ| viśvāmitraṃ pratīṃdreṇa| ātmopadeśāt ātmanaḥ svasya prāṇatayopadeśāt| iṃdra evāyaṃ prāṇaḥ na viṣṇuriti cet netiśeṣaḥ| tasyāvṛttiḥ anugamādityanuvartate| tathā ca prāguktānugamahetorneṃdraḥ prāṇaḥ| tathā sati upadeśavirodha ityapi na| kutaḥ| yasyāt asminprakaraṇe bhagavataḥ adhyātmasaṃbaṃdhabhūmā iṃdraviśvāmitrādirūpabahudehasaṃbaṃdhaḥ ukto'sti| tasmādityarthaḥ || yadvā || hi yasmāt| asmin iṃdre| adhyātmasaṃbaṃdhabhūmā| adhi adhikasya| ātmanaḥ| saṃbaṃdhasya āveśasya| bhūmā bāhulyaṃ vidyate| tasmādityarthaḥ || || evaṃca prāṇo viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-1-30> || śāstradṛṣṭyā tūpadeśo vāmadevavat || || nanu yādi prāṇaśabdeneṃdreṇāpi viṣṇureva svātmādisarvagatatayocyate tarhi mayi prāṇa iti nirdeśaḥ syāt| na tvahamiti| viṣṇāvahamityādirūpopadeśāyāgoditi prāpte pariharatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || || śāstradṛṣṭyā tūpadeśo vāmadevavaditi || asyārthaḥ || tu śabda evārthe| vāmadevavat yathāṃ'taryāmivivakṣayā vāmadevarṣiḥ| ahaṃ manurabhavamiti svasya manusūryādyaikyamāha| tadvat śāstradṛṣṭyā śāsti sarvamiti śāstraṃ aṃtaryāmi taddṛṣṭayā tadvivakṣayaivopadeśaḥ prāṇo'hamiti vyapadeśaḥ| natvaikyenetyarthaḥ || || evaṃceṃdrasya prāṇatayā''tmopadeśasyāṃtaryāmivivakṣayā pravṛttatvāt| anyathā tvaṃ prāṇa iti vyapadeśānupapatteḥ| īśvarapakṣe tvahamādiśabdānāṃ śāstradṛṃṣṭyā pravṛttatvena bādhakābhāvāt| tattannāmnocyate viṣṇuriti vacanāt| prāṇo'yaṃ viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-1-31> || jīvamukhyaprāṇaliṃgānneti cennopāsātraividhyādāśritatvādidda tadyogāt || || punaruktamākṣipya samādadhatsūtramupanyasyati || || || jīvamukhyaprāṇaliṃgānneti cennopāsātraividhyādāśritatvādadiha tadyogāditi || asyārthaḥ || jīvamukhyaprāṇaliṃgāt śatāyuṣṭ‌vādijīvaliṃgānāṃ iṃdriyadevaiḥ saṃvādādirūpamukhyaprāṇaliṃgānāṃ ca śravaṇāt || prāṇo'nya eva na viṣṇuriti cenna| kutaḥ| anugamāt| na ca liṃgavirodhaḥ| talliṃgānāmaṃtaryāmivaṣayatvenopapatterityādikamadhyāhāryaṃ| kimarthamaṃtaryāmikathanamityata uktaṃ| upāsātraividhyāditi| aṃtarbahiḥsarvagatabhedena brahmopāsanasya trividhatvāt| iha prakaraṇe| tattraividhyasyāśritatvāt| uktatvāt| tadyogāt teṣāmadhikāriṇāṃ trividhopāsanāyogyatvādityarthaḥ || || evaṃca tattacchabdaistattadadhikāribhedanopāsanārthaṃ aṃtaryāmikathanaṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ| tasmādayaṃ prāṇo viṣṇureveti prāguktaḥ prāṇa ānaṃdamayaśca sa eveti yuktā tajjijñāseti siddhaṃ || || iti pādāṃtyaprāṇādhikaraṇaṃ || || iti prathamādhyāyasya prathamaḥ pādaḥ || <1.2> || hariḥ || || atha prathamādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ || liṃgātmakānāṃ śabdānāṃ viṣṇau pravṛttiḥ pradarśyate'sminpāde prādhānyena| <1-2-1> atrānyatra prasiddhasarvagatatvarūpabhāvaliṃge brahmaṇi samanvīyate| || || sarvatra prasiddhopadeśāt || || nanvāditya evāyaṃ sarvagato bhavet| tasyaitasyāsāvāditya ityādi bavhādityacaśruteḥ| sūrya ātmeti sauramaṃtrodāharaṇācca| etamasyāmetamiti kṣityādiṣūktvāditye'nuktatvaliṃgācca || yadvā || sarvajīvānāmetatsarvagatatvaṃ| cakṣurmayatvādiliṃgāt| na ca cakṣurmayatvādiliṃgamaṃtaryāmiviṣayaṃ| tasyāparicchinnatvena sarveṣu bhūto'ṣvityuktālpaukastvāyogāt| tasmādviṣṇvanyasyaiva sarvagatatvena tasyaiva prāguktaṃ prāṇatvamānaṃdamayatvaṃ ceti prāpte sūtramāha || || || sarvatra prasiddhopadeśāditi || asyārthaḥ || tattviti vartate| sarvatra pṛthivyādiṣu| ucyamānaṃ vastu tattu nārāyaṇākhyaṃ brahmaiva natvanyat| kutaḥ| prasiddhopadeśāt etameva brahmeti sarvagate vastuni nārāyaṇavācitvena śrutyādiprasiddhabrahmaśabdaśravaṇādityarthaḥ || || evaṃcaitameveti sarvabhūtagate vastuni nārāyaṇaikaniṣṭhatvena sa yascāyamiti śrutiprasiddhabrahmaśabdopadeśātsarveṣu bhuteṣvaṃtargatatayocyamāno nārāyaṇa eveti siddhaṃ || <1-2-2> || vivikṣitaguṇopapatteśca || || yuttmyaṃtareṇa viṣṇorevātroktasarvagatatvaṃ pratipādayatsūtramavatārayati || || || vivakṣitaguṇopapatteśceti || asyārthaḥ || caḥ samuccaye'vadhāraṇe vā| sarvagate śrutyeti śeṣaḥ| tataśca vivakṣitānāmitaḥ paraṃ sarvagate śrutyā tanniṣṭhatayā vaktuṃ yogyānāṃ vakṣyamāṇānāṃ vā'śrutatvādiguṇānāṃ viṣṇoreva yogyatvena tasminnevopapatteranyatrānupapatteśca viṣṇureva sarvagata ityarthaḥ |tha| || evaṃca sa yo'to'śrutaḥ, na te viṣṇo, sa savitā, ityādiśrutibhiḥ sarvatragataniṣṭhatayā vaktuṃ yogyānāṃ vakṣyamāṇānāmaśrutatvādiguṇānāṃ viṣṇoreva yogyatvena sarvatrocyamāno nārāyaṇa eveti siddhaṃ || <1-2-3> || anupapattestu na śārīraḥ || || nanu yathā brahmaśabdādaśrutatvādiliṃgaiśca viṣṇuḥ sarvagata ityucyate tathā''dityo rasa ityādityaśabdāccakṣurmaya iti śrutau jñānakaraṇātmakadehābhimānitvena jīve prasiddhacakṣurmayatvādiliṃgaiścādityaḥ sarvajīva vā bhaveyuriti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || anupapattestu na śārīra iti || asyārthaḥ || tu śabda evārthe| śārīraḥ jīvaḥ| ādityo vā| na sarvagataḥ| kutaḥ| anupapatteḥ ekasya jīvasya sarvaśarīrasthatvāyogādevetyarthaḥ || || evaṃca sarvajīvasya samānabhogarūpopapattiviruddhatvāt| ekaikasya jīvasya sarvaśarīrasthatvānupapatteḥ ekasya jīvasyādityasya vā sarvaśarīrasthatve sarvasukhaduḥkhādibhogaprāptyā sarvagatatvāyogena śruterbādhitaviṣayatvaprasaṃgāt| tasmātsarvabhūteṣvaṃtargatatayocyamāno nārāyaṇa eveti siddhaṃ || <1-2-4> || karmakartṛvyapadeśācca || || yuttmyaṃtareṇa śārīrasya sarvagatatvaṃ parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || karmakartṛvyapadeśācceti || asyārthaḥ || sarvagate vastuni ātmānamiti karmatvasya jīveca śaṃsatīti tadviruddhakartṛtvasya vyapadeśāt uktatvācca na jīvaḥ sarvagata utyarthaḥ || || evaṃca sarvatroktasya sarvagatasya prakṛtasyaitamātmānamityaitareyaśrutau śaṃsanakriyāyāṃ sa etamātmānamiti karmatvena śārīrasya ca tasyāmeva kartṛtvena vyapadeśāt| ekasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ tayorutsargato bhinnatvaniyamādapavādakāraṇābhāvācca sarvatrocyamāno viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-2-5> || śabdaviśeṣāt || || nanubrahmaśabdādviṣṇureva sarvagata iti na yujyate| tacchabdasya jīve'pi vṛtteḥ| na cāsau jīve'mukhya iti tadagrahaḥ| cakṣurmayatvādibādhakabalenāmukhyārthasyāpi grahaṇopapatteḥ| na cāśrutatvādiguṇaśūnyarūpabāṃdhakena na jīvaḥ| śrutvāpyenamiti gītayāṃ jīvasyādbhutatvādiśravaṇāt| nāpyekaśarīrasthatvānupapattirbādhikā| tasyā viṣṇāvapi sāmyāt| na ca cakṣurmayatvādibādhakānnajīvaḥ| ekasyaiva karmakartṛtvayorupapatteḥ| tataśca sarvagato jīva eveti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || śabdaviśeṣāditi || asyārthaḥ || etameva brahmeti vākye brahmaśabdasyāvadhāraṇārthaka evaśabdākhyaviśeṣaṇavattvāt| brahmaśabdo na jīvapara ityarthaḥ || evaṃca nirdiṣṭavākye hetutvena prakṛtabrahmaśabdasya sāvadhāraṇatvarūpaviśeṣavattvāt| evakāraśiraska brahmaśabdavācyatve jīvasya mukhyabrahmatvaprāptaṃ syāt| taccāyuktaṃ| tasyābrahmatvena prasiddhatvāt| ataḥ sarvagato viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-2-6> || smṛteśca || || śrutisamākhyayā'pi viṣṇoḥ sarvagatatvaṃ sādhayatsūtramupanyasyati || || || smṛteśceti || asyārthaḥ || samuccaye| na kevalaṃ śrutyuktatvād‌brahmaśabdo na jīvapara iti| kiṃtu ahamātmā guḍākeśa ityādismṛtisadbhāvācca brahmaśabdo na jīvapara ityarthaḥ || || evaṃca nirdiṣṭasmṛtivākyāt| jīveśayorbhedamithyātvakalpanasya sūtrakṛtā'vivakṣitatvāt| dvāsuparṇetyādi pramāṇaviruddhatvena ca tathā na kalpanīyatvātsarvagato viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-2-7> || arbhakaukastvāttadvapadeśācca neti cenna nicāyyatvādevaṃ vyomavacca || || nanu sarveṣu bhuteṣvityatpasthāne sākalyena sthitikathanāt| jīvadharmavyapadeśācca| sarvagato jīva eva na viṣṇuḥ aparicchinne jīvadharmarahite ca tasmiṃstadubhayavyapadeśāyogāditi prāpte samādadhatsūtramupanyasyati || || || arbhakaukastvāttadvyapadeśācca neti cenna nicāyyatvādevaṃ vyomavaccīti || asyārthaḥ || arbhakaukastvāt sarveṣu bhuteṣviti sarvagatavastunaḥ sarvaprāṇihṛdayākāśarūpālpasthānakatvakathanāt| tadvyapadeśāt tasya jīvasya tacchrutiliṃgādinā vyapadeśāt uktatvācca| neti cet brahmaiva sarvagatamityuktaṃ neti cet| na| kutaḥ| teṣāṃ viṣṇāvedhopapatteriti śeṣaḥ| na ca vaiyarthyaṃ| evaṃ nicāyyatvāt evamarbhakaukastvādirūpeṇa viṣṇorevopāsyatvāt| tathā ca navaiyarthyamiti bhāvaḥ| śrutiliṃgādināṃ brahmaparatvena na tadvirodha iti bhāvaḥ| vyāptasya viṣṇoḥ kathamalpasthānasthitirityata uktaṃ| vyomavacceti| yathā''kāśasya vyāptasyāpi gṛhādyekadeśāvasthitiḥ tadvadviṣṇorapītyarthaḥ || || evaṃcāparicchinnādirūpasyārbhakausvādikathanamaprayojanaṃ| utāyuktaṃ| nādyaḥ| tasya tena rūpeṇopāsyatvena vyapadeśasya saprayojanatvāt| na dvitīyaḥ| sarvagatasyāpi vyomnoṃ'śasya sākalyenālpaukastvadarśanena tadabhedādākāśasyālpaukastvavadbhagavataḥ sākalyenālpaukastvopapatteḥ| īśvarasya sarveṃdriyasvāmitvena cakṣurmayatvāderapyupapatteḥ| na cāditye'nuktatvaliṃgavirodhaḥ| yaścāsāvāditya iti pūrvavākya ādityasthatvasyoktatvenānuktatvasyāsiddhatvāt| ataḥ sarvagato viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-2-8> || saṃbhogaprāptiriti cenna vaiśeṣyāt || || punaruktamākṣipya samādadhatsūtramāha || || || saṃbhogaprāptiriti cenna vaiśeṣyāditi || asyārthaḥ || yato brahmaṇaḥ vyomavatsarvajīvaśarīrasthatve saṃbhogaprāptiḥ samānabhogaprāptirityato bādhakānna brahma sarvagatamiti cenna| kutaḥ| vaiśeṣyāt viṣṇoḥ sāmarthyaviśeṣavattvādityarthaḥ| tathā ca na tasya jīvasamānabhogaprāptiriti bhāvaḥ || || evaṃca sarvajñatā'lpajñatābhedāt| sāmarthyavaiśeṣyāccāgnistaṃbhanavato dāhābhāvavatsamānabhogāprāpteḥ sarvagatoviṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || || iti sarvagatatvādhikaraṇaṃ || atra lokato'nyatra prasiddhāditiśabdena sahoktāttṛtvaliṃgasya harau samanvayaḥ kriyate | <1-2-9> || attā carācaragrahaṇāt || || nanu janmādisūtroktasaṃhartṛtvāparaparyāyāttṛtvaṃ sa yadyadeveti vākyenāditerevāstu| adituśrute radititvamiti niravakāśaliṃgācca| na ca yogabalādaditiśrutirviṣṇuviṣayā| adititvaliṃgasya niravakāśatvāt| na ca sa iti pulliṃgānupapattiḥ| puṃśāktiyuktatvena kūṭastho'kṣaraucyata ityādivatpulliṃgopapatteśceti prāpte sītraṃ paṭhati || || || attā carācaragrahaṇāditi || asyārthaḥ || attā sarvaṃ vā'ttītyuktasarvāttā viṣṇureva| natvaditiḥ| kutaḥ| carācaragrahaṇāt carācarasya cetanācetanātmakaprapaṃcasya sarvamiti śrutāvadyatayoktatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃcādyatvena carācasya grahaṇāt| na cāditiśrutivirodhaḥ| aditiśruteryo devānāṃ nāmadheti śrutibalena viṣṇuparatvasya vaktuṃ śakyatvāt| na cādititvarūpākhaṃḍadharmavirodhaḥ| viṣṇorapi vidvadrūḍhiviṣayatvenādititvarūpākhaṃḍadharmasyāpi tatrāvarjanīyatvāt| ato viṣṇorevaitadvākyapratipādyatvenāttṛtvānna pūrvokta lakṣaṇasyātivyāptiriti siddhaṃ || <1-2-10> || prakaraṇācca || || yadā niravakāśasarvāttṛtvaliṃgamātrātsāvakāśāditiśrutyādititvaliṃgayorbādhenāttā viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ| tadā kimuvācyaṃ niravakāśaprakāraṇasamuccitaliṃgādityarthaṃ pratipādayatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || || prakāraṇācceti || asyārthaḥ || naiveha kiṃcaneti viṣṇuprakaraṇabalācca viṣṇurevāstā ityarthaḥ || || evaṃca nehāsītkiṃcane tyapsaṃvatsarasṛṣṭayādinā| niravakāśaviṣṇuprakaraṇabalādattā viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || || iti attṛtvādhikaraṇaṃ || atra lokato'nyatra prasiddhakarmaphalabhoktṛtvaliṃgasya viṣṇau samanvayaḥ pratipādyate| <1-2-11> || guhāṃ praviṣṭāvātmānau hi taddarśanāt || || nanu ṛtaṃ pibaṃtāviti vākyoktau jīvau na tvekaḥ parameśvaraḥ| dvivacanaśruteḥ ekasmindvivacanāyogāt| evaṃca harivajjīvasyāpi svātaṃtryeṇa pātṛtvena tadvadevasarvāttṛtvamapi| svataṃtrasya tadanagīkāre kāraṇābhāvāt| tataścātivyāptiḥ || yadvā || tadvākyoktau jīvaparau| dvivacanaśruteḥ| evamapi jīva eva pātā na vibhuḥ| karmabaṃdhavidhurasya karmaphalāttṛtvāyogāt| na ca sarvaṃ vā'ttīti sarvāttṛtvoktivirodhaḥ| anaśrannanya iti śrutivirodhena saṃkocasaṃbhavāt| na ca pibaṃtāviti dvayoḥ pātṛtvoktivirodhaḥ| channinyāyena pātṛtvopacārāṃgīkārāt| tathā'pi jīveśatve ko heturiti cet| ekasya pātṛtvānyathā'nupapattyā jīvatve siddhe dvitīyasya sajātīyasyaiva grāhyatvāt| na ca dvāvapi jīvau yuktau| ekasmin śarīre bhoktajīvadvayāyogāt| tasmājjīveśāveva grāhyau| tathā'pi jīvasyaiva pātṛtvena na tasya lakṣaṇatvābhimataṃ sarvāttṛtvamityasaṃbhavaḥ || yadvā || punarastudvāvapi jīvau| na caikasmin śarīre boktṛjīvadvayāyogāḥ| vrīhyādiśarīra utpatsyamānajīvasya pramāṇāṃtarasiddhatvānna tu tu na tasya bhoktṛtvamiti cenna| taccharīrāvacchedena pātṛtvābhāve'pi vastutaḥ pātṛtvasadbhāvāt| evaṃ ceśvarasya karmaphalāttṛtvābhāvenāsaṃbhava eveti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || guhāṃ praviṣṭāvātmānau hi taddarśanāditi || asyārthaḥ || tattviti vipariṇāmenānuvartate| ātmānau ādeyaṃ māteti vyutpattyā ṛtaṃ pibaṃtāviti śrutisthapibacchabdoditaśubhaphalakarmabhoktārau ātmāṃtarātmākhyau viṣṇurūpe eva| na tu jīveśvarau| kutaḥ| hi yasmāt| tau guhāṃ praviṣṭau| tasmādityarthaḥ| hi śabdena guhāsthitatvaliṃgasya yo vedeti śratiprasiddhiṃ sūcayati| dvirūpatayā śarīraguhāsthitatve pramāṇamāha| tarddaśanāditi| tasya hareḥ dvirūpatayā śarīrahṛdayaguhāsthitatvasya tasya gharmā samaṃteti śratāvuktatvādityarthaḥ || || evaṃcoktavākye yau pibaṃtau tau viṣṇurūpe eva| guhāpraviṣṭatvaliṃgāt| na caitalliṃgaṃ jīve'pyastīti na viṣṇutvanirṇāyakamiti vācyaṃ| yo vedanihitamiti guhyanihitatvasyeśvare prasiddhatvena prasiddhasyaiva grāhyatvāt| na ca dvivacanaśrutivirodhaḥ| rūpadvayābhiprāyeṇa sāvakāśatvāt| na caikaikenaiva rūpeṇa praveśena rūpadvayābhāvaḥ| dharmā samaṃtātrivṛtamiti pramāṇenaikasminnapi śarīre rūpadvayasyaiva siddhatvāt| na ca viṣṇoḥ pātṛtvāṃgīkāre'naśrannanya ityādiśrutivirodha| śubhaṃ pibatyasāviti pramāṇena viṣṇoḥ pātṛtvasya siddhatvena tasyā aśubhabhogābhāvaviṣayatvāt| na ca pūrṇasya karmabaṃdhavidhuratvena karmaphalabhogānupapattiḥ| niyogato bhogāsaṃbhave'pi svecchayā tatsaṃbhavāt| tataśca viṣṇoreva pātṛtvenāttṛtvalakṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <1-2-12> || viśeṣaṇācca || || yadā niravakāśaguhānihitatvaliṃgasya sāvakāśādvivacanaśrutito'pi prābalyādviṣṇoḥ prakṛtyarthabhoktṛtvasaṃbhavācca sa eva pāteti sidhyati| kiṃ punarniravakāśaśrutyā'pītyarthaṃ pratipādayatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || || viśeṣaṇācceti || asyārthaḥ || co yuktisamuccaye| yaḥ seturiti ekavacanena viśeṣaṇādeka eva pātā| sa ca setutvabrahmatvādinā viśeṣitatvādviṣṇureva na jīva ityarthaḥ || || evaṃca na kevalaṃ guhāpraviṣṭatvaliṃgabalādeva pibaṃtau viṣṇurūpe kiṃtu yaḥ seturījānānāmiti śrutau brahmaikavacanaśabdābhyāṃ viśeṣaṇādapi viṣṇureva pāteti siddhaṃ || || iti guhādhikaraṇaṃ || atra cakṣuraṃtaḥsthatvaliṃgaṃ brahmāṇi samanvīyate| <1-2-13> || aṃtara upapatteḥ || || nanu ya eṣoṃ'tarakṣiṇīti vākyokto'gnirevākṣistho bhavet| ya eṣa āditya ityagnerevādityasthatvābhidhānāt na cāgnerādityasthatve'pyakṣisthatvaṃ kuta iti vācyaṃ| ādityaścakṣurbhūtveti śruteḥ| akṣyādityayoraketvāt| ādityasthatvenāgnerakṣisthatvasiddheḥ| na ca so'hamasmī tyupadiṣṭaḥ kuto'gniriti| asminnupadeśe bavhagniśrutisadbhāvāt| na ca yaścāsāviti samākhyābalādviṣṇurevādityasthaḥ| so'hamasmītyabhyāsādabhyāsasya ca samākhyāto balavattvāt| na ca viṣṇugrahaṇe'pūrvatāyā abhyāsasyāpi bādhaḥ| sa ca evaṃ vidvānityarthavādāt| arthavādasya cāpūrvayāḥ prābalyāt| ata ādityastho'gnistato'kṣisthaśceti prāpte sūtramāha || || || aṃtara upapatteriti || asyārthaḥ || ya eṣoṃ'tarakṣiṇīti śrutyuktoṃ'taraḥ cakṣuraṃtasthito viṣṇureva na tvagniḥ| kutaḥ| upapatteḥ etadamṛtatvabrahmaśabdādīnāṃ aṃtare śravaṇāt| teṣāṃ ca viṣṇāvevopapatterityarthaḥ || || evaṃcaitadamṛtamabhayami tyamṛtatvābhayatvādiliṃgaśravaṇād‌brahmādiśabdaśruteśca viṣṇureva cakṣuraṃtara iti siddhaṃ || <1-2-14> || sthānādivyapadeśācca || || yuktyaṃtareṇa viṣṇoścakṣuraṃtaḥsthatvaṃ sādhayatsūtramupanyasyati || || || sthānādivyapadeśācceti || asyārthaḥ || brahmasthānabhūtākṣiśakteḥ tadadhiṣṭhātṛbrahmaśakteśca vyapadeśāt sarpirvodakaṃ vā siṃcatī tyuktatvāccakṣuraṃtaḥstho viṣṇurevetyarthaḥ || || evaṃca sarpirvodakamiti śrutau sthānaśaktervāmani rbhāmaniriti caturvedaśikhāyāṃsvarūpaśakteścoktatvāt| tayoścānyatrāsaṃbhavāt| cakṣuraṃtaḥstho viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-2-15> || sukhaviśiṣṭābhidhānādeva ca || || prakaraṇabalāccakṣuraṃtaḥsthatvaṃ viṣṇoḥ pratipādayatsūtramupanyasyati || || || sukhāviśiṣṭābhidhānādeva ceti || asyārthaḥ || caḥ samuccaye| sukhaviśiṣṭābhidhānāt kaṃ brahmetyādi prakaraṇe viśiṣṭasukhasya pūrmasukhasya abhidhānādeva cakṣuraṃtaro viṣṇureva| kimu khaṃ brahmeti pūrṇajñānādapītyarthaḥ || || evaṃcopakrame prāṇo brahma kaṃ brahmoti śravaṇenāsya prakaraṇa syavaiṣṇavatvāt tatra pūrṇasukhasya khaṃ brahmeti pūrṇajñānasya cābhidhānāt| pūrṇānaṃdatvasya niravadhika pūrṇānaṃdatvābhiprāyakatvāt| mukhye satyamukhyāyogāt ataścakṣuraṃtaro viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-2-16> || śrutopaniṣatkagatyabhidānācca || || nanvetadupakrame sukhajñānayorabhidhāne'pi nākṣisthaprakaraṇasya vaiṣṇavattvaṃ yuktaṃ| chāṃdogye prāṇo brahmeti vidyāṃ ya eṣa āditya iti vidyāṃ cokttvā'gnibhirupakosalaṃ prati `asmadvidyā cātmavidyā coktā' ityuktatvenādyāyā viṣṇuviṣayatvasya dvitīyāyāścāgniviṣayatvasyaiva yuktatvāt ya eṣoṃtarākṣiṇī tyakṣisthavidyāyā ādityavidyayaikārthatvāt| na copakramavirodhaḥ| vhayāgyagnimitivadupakramasyopapatteḥ| ātmavidyāyāḥ pṛthaguktatvenāsmadvidyāyā aṃtaryāmiparatvāyogāt| tasmādagniviṣayatvameva cakṣuṃrataḥsthavidyāyā iti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || śrutopaniṣatkagatyabhidhānācceti || asyārthaḥ || śrutopaniṣadāṃ śrutamatadhyātaitādvidyānāṃ puṃsāṃ| kena vāyunā| kayoḥ kāryaparabrahmaṇoḥ || gateḥ prāpteḥ| sa enānbrahmagamayatīti śrutāvābhidhānācca cakṣuraṃtaro viṣṇorevetyarthaḥ || || evaṃca sa enānityupasaṃhāre'bhidhānenākṣisthavidyāyā viṣṇuviṣayatvāt| anyavidyāyā anyaprāptyayogādasya prakaraṇasya vaiṣṇavattvaṃ siddhaṃ || <1-2-17> || anavasthiterasaṃbhavācca netaraḥ || || nanu so'hamasmī tyādyupadeśasyāṃtaryāmiviṣayatvakalpanayā viṣṇorakṣisthatvāgrahaṇe upadeśabalenaivāgnerakṣisthatvaṃ kiṃ na syādityato bādhakasadbhāvāditi samādadhatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || || anavasthiterasaṃbhavācca netara iti || āsyārthaḥ || itaraḥ agniḥ| cakṣuraṃtaro na kiṃtu viṣṇureva| kutaḥ| anavasthiteḥ jīvasyāgnerjīvāṃtaraniyāmakatve tasyāpi jīvatvāviśeṣāt tasyāpi niyāmakāṃtarābhyupagame tasyāpyevamevamityanavasthānāt agnyādijīvasya jīvāṃtaraniyāmakatvāsaṃbhavāccetyarthaḥ || || evaṃcāgnerapi jīvatvena niyāmakatvāsaṃbhavena cakṣurgatatvasaṃbhāvanāvirahāt| astu vā kathaṃcitsaṃbhāvanā| tathā'pi nāsau cakṣuraṃtaro'bhyupagaṃtavyaḥ| agnerapi jīvatvena tatpreraṇāya jīvāṃtarasya bhāvyatvāt| tasyāpyevaṃ tasyāpyevamityanavasthiteḥ| tasmādviṣṇurevākṣyādityastho dṛṣṭigocaro'taḥ sa evānaṃdamayastajjñānādeva mīkṣa iti siddhaṃ || || iti aṃtarādhikaraṇaṃ || atrāṃtaḥsthatvarūpabhāvasahitaṃ niyamanikriyātmakaṃ liṃgaṃ brahmaṇi samanvīyate| <1-2-18> || aṃtaryāmyadhidaivādiṣu taddharmavyapadeśāt || || nanu prakṛtirevāṃtaryāmī| yasya pṛthivītyādinā pṛthivyādiśarīratvavyapadeśāt| śarīraśabdasya svarūpe'pi prayogadarśanena tasya tatropapatteḥ| na ca yaḥ pṛthivyāmityādinā pṛthivyādisthatvoktivirodhaḥ| vyāptaṃ kāryeṣu kāraṇamiti vacanāt| tasya tatropapatteḥ| na ca prakṛteracetanatvena pṛthivyādiniyāmakatvāyogaḥ| kāryasya kāraṇādhīnatvena cetanaprakṛterapi niyāmakatvopacāropapatteḥ| na cāmṛtatvavirodhaḥ| tasya viṣṇāvivātrāpi yogenopapatteḥ| tattajīvānāṃ vaitadaṃtaryāmitvaṃ| pṛthivyādiśarīratvādestepvati sughaṭatvāt| tataśca pravṛtyāderevāṃtaryāmitvena tatra śrutamamṛtanvaṃ nākṣisthasya viṣṇutvasādhakamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || aṃtaryāmyadhidaivādiṣu taddharmavyapadeśāditi || asyārthaḥ || eṣata ātmāṃ'taryāmīti śrutyuktoṃ'taryāmī viṣṇureva na pradhānādi| kutaḥ| adhidaivādiṣu adhidaivādhyātmādhibhūtādiprakaraṇeṣu| taddharmavyapadeśāt tasmin aṃtaryāmiṇi tasya yaṃ pṛthivī na vedeti śrutau uktasyāviditatvādibrahmadharmasya vyapadeśāt uktatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca pṛthivyādidevatā'viditatvāṃtarākhyadharmavyapadeśādaṃtaryāmī viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-2-19> || na ca smārtamataddharmābhilāpāt || || evaṃ niravakāśaliṃgena viṣṇoraṃtaryāmitvaṃ samarthya prakṛtyāderaṃtaryāmitvaṃ tatprakṛtijīvasādhāraṇaṃ yuktyā parākurvatsūtramāha || || || na ca smārtamataddharmābhilāpāditi || asyārthaḥ || caḥ samuccaye| smārta kāpilasmṛtyuktaṃ| pradhānaṃ jīvaśca aṃtaryāmī na| kutaḥ| ataddharmābhilāpāt taddharmāṇāṃ pradhānajīvadharmāṇāṃ triguṇatvasaṃsāritvādīnāṃ| anabhilāpāt anuktatvādityarthaḥ || || evaṃca viṣṇvasādhāraṇapṛthivyādyaviditvādidharmopadeśavatkapilasmṛtyuktaprakṛtipradhānajīvāsādhāraṇopādānatvaḍatvatriguṇatvasaṃsāritvādidharmāṇāmanuktatvādaṃtaryāmī viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-2-20> || śārīraścobhayo'pi hi bhedenainamadīyate || || jīvasyāṃtaryāmitva tatsādhakābhāvena nirastamapi punarbādhakākhyaviśeṣayuktyā nirākurvatsūtramupanyasyāti || || || śārīraścobhaye'pi hi bhedenainamadhīyata iti || āsyārthaḥ || co naño'nukarṣaṇārthaḥ || hi yasmāt| ubhaye mādhyaṃdināḥ kāṇvāśca| ātmanoṃ'taraṃ vijñānādaṃtara iti| enaṃ jīvaṃ| aṃtaryāmiṇaḥ sakāśāt| bhedena bhinnatvena| adhīyate paṭhaṃti| tasmācchārīro jīvaśca nāṃtaryāmītyarthaḥ || || evaṃcobhayaśākhibhirātmānamaṃtara iti vijñānādaṃtara iti ca jīvasyabrahmaṇo bhedenopadeśādaṃtaryāmī viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || || iti aṃtaryābhyadhikaraṇaṃ || atrādṛśyatvādyabhāvākhyaliṃgaṃ brahmaṇi samanvīyate| <1-2-21> || adṛśyatvādiguṇako dharmokteḥ || || nanu yattadadreśyami tyuktādṛśyatvādiguṇako na viṣṇuḥ kiṃtu jaḍaprakṛtiḥ| akṣarātsaṃbhavatīheti araśabdaśravaṇāt| na cākṣaraśabdo viṣṇāvapi sāvakāśaḥ| tatparataḥ parābhidhānāt| na ca viṣṇoḥ paro'sti| pṛthivyādidṛṣṭāṃtenopādānatayā jagatkāraṇatvābhidhānācca| citprakṛterevaitadadṛśyatvādikaṃ| tasyāmakṣaraśabdasya kūṭastha iti smṛtisiddhatvāt| vikāritvena jagatkāraṇatvavacanaṃ vikārābhimānitvādyujyate| aśrarātparata ityetadapi parato'kṣarāditi sāmānādhikaraṇyenopapadyate| hiraṇyagarbhasya vetadadṛśyatvādikaṃ| sabrahmavidyāmityādi brahmaśabdāt| rudrasya vaitadadṛśyatvādikaṃ| kartāramīśami tīśaśabdaśravaṇāditi prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || adṛśyatvādiguṇako dharmokteriti || asyārthaḥ || adṛśyatvādiguṇakaḥ yattadadraśyamiti śrutyuktādṛśyatvādidharmaviśiṣṭākṣaraśabdavācyo viṣṇureva| na prakṛtyādiḥ| kutaḥ| dharmokte ṛgādiparavidyāviṣayatvarūpaviṣṇudharmasya yayeti śrutyuktatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃcātha parāyaye tyadṛśyatvādiguṇakasya paravidyāviṣayatvābhidhānādadṛśyatvādiguṇako viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-2-22> || viśeṣaṇabhedavyapadeśābhyāṃ ca netarau || || nanu viṣṇuprāpakaparavidyāviṣayatvavajjaḍaprakṛtiviriṃcarudraprāpakānāmapi bhāvātta evādṛśatvādiguṇakāḥ kiṃ na syurityato viśeṣayuktyā parākurvatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || || viśeṣaṇabhedavyapadeśābhyāṃ ca netarāviti || asyārthaḥ || caḥ samuccaye itarau prakṛtidvayaṃ viriṃcarudrau ca| nādṛśyatvādiguṇakau| kutaḥ| viśeṣaṇabhedavyapadeśābhyāṃ pratijñādvaye krameṇaikakaihetvanvayaḥ| yaḥ sarvajña iti sārvajñyādiviśeṣaṇāt| tasmādetaditi adṛśyatvādiguṇakākṣarādviriṃcarudrayerbhedokteścetyarthaḥ || || evaṃca jaḍaprakṛtitvavirodhisārvajñyādiviśeṣaṇasya tasmādetaditi viriṃcatvavirodhi juṣṭaṃ yadāpaśyatyanyamiti rudratvavirodhibhedavyapadeśasya cābhāvenāsaṃbhavāt| na ca parataḥparābhidhānānna viṣṇuriti vācyaṃ| aparaṃ tvakṣaramiti tryakṣarābhidhānena parato madhyamākṣarātparatvasaṃbhavenāvirodhādadṛśyatvādiguṇako viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-2-23> || || rūpopanyāsācca || || yutkyaṃtareṇa viṣṇorevādṛśyatvādiguṇakatvaṃ sādhayatsūtramavatārayati || || || rūpopanyāsācceti || asyārthaḥ || yadā paśyaḥpaśyata iti viṣṇvasādhāraṇasvarṇarūpa pratipādanāccādṛśyatvādiguṇako viṣṇurevetyarthaḥ || evaṃca viṣṇvasādhāraṇarukmarūpapratipādanāt| eko nārāyaṇa ityatra śuklādirūpāṇāṃ manuṣyādau miśrīkaraṇasyoktatvādadṛśyatvādiguṇako viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || || iti adṛśyatvādhikaraṇaṃ || atra pācakatvādyanekaliṃgasamanvayasidhyarthaṃ brahmaṇi vaiśvānaranāmasamanvayaḥ kriyate || <1-2-24> || vaiśvānaraḥ sādhāraṇaśabdaviśeṣāt || || nanu nāyaṃ vaiśvānaro viṣṇuḥ| sādhakaśūnyatvāt| sarvagatatvaliṃgasyānyavaprasiddhavaiśvānaraśrutyā bādhitatvāt| na ca liṃgasya niravakāśatvena tena śrutibādhaḥ| śruterapi| niravakāśatvāt| vaisvānaraśruternibādhasādhakaśūnyatvenāgniviṣṇvoḥ sādhāraṇanyena cānyaniścāyakatvābhāvāt| ato vaiśvānaro na viṣṇuriti prāpte sūtramā || || || vaiśvānaraḥ sādhāraṇaśabdaviśeṣāditi || arayārthaḥ || vaiśvānaraḥ yastvetamityādi vākyagatavaiśvānarādiśabdavācyo viṣṇureva natvagniḥ| kutaḥ| sādhāraṇaśabdaviśeṣāt| agniviṣṇvoḥ sādhāraṇasya vaiśvānaraśabdasya ātmānaṃ vaiśvānaramiti śrutāvātmaśabdena viśeṣitatvādityarthaḥ || || evaṃca sādhāraṇasyāpi vaiśvānaraśabdasya viṣṇvaikaniṣṭhatayā śrutyādisiddhenātmānaṃ vaiśvānaramityātmaśabdaviśeṣitatvādviṣṇuparatvasaṃbhavāt| prasiddhyāderanyathopapannatvena nirṇayakāraṇābhāvācchabdaviśeṣādātmaśabdādvaiśvānaro viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-2-25> || || smaryamāṇamanumānaṃ syāditi || || nanu nāyaṃ vaiśvānaro viṣṇureveti ghaṭate| sāmānādhikaraṇyavirodhāt| viṣṇutvaniścāyakavadagnitvaniścāyakasadbhāvāditi prāpte sūtramāha || || || smaryamāṇamanumānaṃ syāditīti || asyārthaḥ || iti smaryamāṇaṃ ahaṃ vaiśvānarobhūtve tyuktaṃ viṣṇorvaiśvānaratvaṃ| anumānaṃ vaiśvānaravidyāyāḥ gītoktabhagavatparatvasyānumāpakaṃ| syāt bhavedityarthaḥ || || evaṃca gītāsmṛtervaiśvānaravidyāsamānoktirūpatvādasyāstatsamākhyānānnirṇayakatvena vaiśvānaro viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-2-26> || śabdādibhyoṃ'taḥ pratiṣṭhānānneti cenna tathā dṛṣṭyupadeśādasaṃbhavātpuruṣavidhamapi cainamadhīyate || || nanu vaiśvānaramṛta ajātamagnimī tyagniśabdasya vaiśvānare tadhdutaṃ bhavati| hṛdayaṃ gārhapatya ityāgniliṃgasya yenedamannaṃ pacyata ityādinā pācakatvenāṃtaḥ pratiṣṭhānasya ca śravamāt| eteṣāṃ viṣṇāvanavakāśāt| ityādinā vaiśvānarasya viṣṇutvamākṣipya samādadhatsūtramāha || || || sabhdādibhyoṃ'taḥpratiṣṭhānānneti cenna tathā dṛṣṭyupadeśādasaṃbhavātpuruṣavidhamapi cainamadhīyata iti || asyārthaḥ || yuktisamuccaye ca śabdaḥ| śabdādibhyaḥ agniśabda homādhikaraṇatvaliṃgādityarthaḥ| aṃtaḥpratiṣṭhānāt pācakatvena śarīrāṃtarāvasthānācca| vaiśvānaro na viṣṇuḥ kiṃtu agnireveti cenna| kutaḥ| tathā dṛṣṭyupadeśāt| agnyādināmaliṃgakarmavattvena dṛṣṭyupadeśāt upāsanopadeśādityarthaḥ| tathā ca agnyādiśrutiliṃgānāṃ viṣṇau sāvakāśatvānna tadvirodha iti bhāvaḥ| kiṃcātroktātmatvabrahmatvādīnāṃ agnyādāvasaṃbhavācca vaiśvānaro viṣṇureva| api ca yataḥ chaṃdogāḥ enaṃ vaiśvānaraṃ| puruṣavidhaṃ puruṣasūktapratipādyanārāyaṇamānaguṇakameva| adhīyate abhidadhati| ato'pi viṣṇurevetyarthaḥ| ca śabdena puruṣasūktasya viṣṇuparatvaṃ bahupramāṇasiddhamiti sūcayati || || evaṃca sarvanāmā sarvakarmetyādinā mahopaniṣadi tattannāmaliṃgatvena dṛṣṭyupadeśāt| ko na ātmā kiṃ brahmoti viṣṇerevāraṃbhāt| caṃdramā manaso jāta ityādīnā vaiśvānarasya tadvidhatvābhidhānācca| tataśca vaiśvānaro viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-2-27> || ataeva na devatā bhūtaṃca || || nanu vaiśvānaraśabdasya tejasi bhūte'gnidevatāyāṃ ca prasiddhatvādatrāpyasau tatparaḥ syāditi prāpte tannirāsāya sūtramupanyasyati || || || ata eva na devatā bhūtaṃ ceti || asyārthaḥ || devatā agnyādirūpā| bhūtaṃ tadabhimanyamānatejobhūtaṃ ca| vaiśvānaraśabda vācyaṃ na| kutaḥ| ataeva niravakāśātmaśabdādi heterevetyarthaḥ || evaṃca niravakāśātmaśabdaśravaṇādvaiśvānaraśabdavācyo viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-2-28> || sākṣādapyavirodhaṃ jaiminiḥ || || nanu loke vede cāgnyādipadānāmīśādanyatra vyavahāraprasiddhidarśanāt| tasya ca kāraṇāṃtarābhāvāttadanyathā'nupapattyā'nyeṣāṃ vācyatvamaṃgīkāryaṃ| anyathā tadvirodhaḥ syāditi prāpte tannirāsāya sūtraṃ vyācaṣṭe || || || sākṣādapyāvirodhaṃ jaiminiriti || asyārthaḥ || sākṣāt mukhyavṛttyā| api brahmaṇo'gnyādiśabdavācyatve'pi| avirodhaṃ ajñānādinimittāṃtareṇa agnyādau tattacchabdavirodhābhāvaṃ| jaiminirācāryo vaktītyarthaḥ || || evaṃcāgnyādiśabdānāṃ brahmavadagnyādyavācitvepyagnyādijñānārthamabhijñairanyatra vyavahārāt| anabhijñaistu paramamukhyārthabhagavadajñānādeva mukhyārthe'gnyādāveva prayogeṇa prasidhyupapatteragnyādiśabdā viṣṇuvācakāḥ| na ca jaiminyādimatānāṃ vyāsamatena parasparaṃ virodhaḥ| vyāsacittasthitaṃ matāparaparyāyaṃ jñānākhyamahākāśamapekṣya gṛhādyavacchinnākāśatvaparimitaviṣayāṇi kānicidetānyūrīkṛtya jaiminyādyā vyavaharaṃti| vyāsacittasthitākāśāditi smṛteḥ| atasteṣāṃ matānāmavirodha iti siddhaṃ || <1-2-29> || abhivyakterityāśmarathyaḥ || || nanu laukikaprasiddherajñānādimūlatvenānyathopapattāvapi vaidikāgnyādisūktamaṃtrādiprasidhyanyathā'nupattyā'gnyādīnāṃ sūktādigatāgnyādiśabdavācyatvaṃ syāt| tatrājñānādimūlakatvakalpanā'yogenānyathopapattyabhāvāt| nāpi vyavahārārthatvenānyathopapattiḥ| anāditvāditi prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || abhivyakterityāśmarathya iti || asyārthaḥ || abhivyakteḥ agnyādiṣu brahmopāstau kṛtāyāṃ teṣu brahmaṇo'bhivyakteḥ| tannimitto'gnyādisūktaniyama iti āśmarathyācāryo manyata ityarthaḥ || || evaṃcāgnyādisūktairupāsakānāmagnyādau ca bhagavadabhivyaktyā sūktaniyamasaṃbhavādagnyādiśabdavācyo viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ| tataścāśmarathyācāryamatenāvirodha iti siddhaṃ || <1-2-30> || anusmṛterbādariḥ || || || prakārāṃtareṇa sūktādiniyamasyānyathopapattiṃ kathayatsūtramupanyasyati || || || anusmṛterbādaririti || asyārthaḥ || anusmṛteḥ tattasūktādyupāsakairagnyādiṣveva brahmaṇo'nusmṛteḥ anusaṃdhānāddhetoḥ| agnyādisūktavyavastheti bādarirvaktītyarthaḥ || || evaṃcāgnyādisūktairupāsakānāmagnyādau viṣṇoḥ smartavyatvātsūktaniyamasaṃbhavādagnyādiśabdavācyo viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ| tathāca badarātmajasya śukācāryasya matasyāvirodha iti sthitaṃ || <1-2-31> || saṃpatteriti jaiministathā hi darśayati || || rītyaṃtareṇa sūktaniyamasyānyathopapattiṃ pratipādayatsūtraṃ vyācaṣṭe || || || saṃpatteriti jaiministathā hi darśayatīti || asyārthaḥ || hi yasmāt| taṃ yatheti hi prasiddhāśrutiḥ tathā darśayati yathā jaiminimataṃ tathā pratipādayati| tasmājjaiminiḥ svoktyanukūlaśrutyanusārema saṃpatteḥ agnyādisūktopāsakānāmagnyādiprāptihetoḥ| tadvivakṣayā sūktādiniyama iti āhetyarthaḥ || || evaṃcāgnyādisūktādiṣu mukhyataḥ para brahmaṇa eva pratipādyatve'pi sūktādiniyamo yujyate| bhagavadupāsakānāmagnyādiprāptirbhavati| ato laukikavyavahārāvirodha iti jaiminirmanyate| ataḥ sūktaniyamo'bhyupagaṃtavya iti siddhaṃ || <1-2-32> || āmanaṃti cainamasmin || || nanvagnyādisūktādibhirbrahmopāsakasyāgnyādiprāptirbhavatīti vaktuṃ na yuktaṃ| madbhaktā yāṃtī tyāderanyopāsakasyānyaprāptyayogāt| śruteti sūtre tadanabhyupagamācceti prāpte sūtramāha || || || āmanaṃti cainamasminniti || asyārthaḥ || caḥ śaṃkānivartakaḥ| yasmāt enaṃ viṣṇuṃ| agnyādau āmanaṃti tatsthatayā yo'gnau tiṣṭhanni tyādyāḥ śrutayaḥ pratipādayaṃti| tasmātkathamagnyādiṣu viṣṇūpāstyā'gnyādi prāptirbhavatīti śaṃkā nivṛttā| kutaḥ| agnyādipadena tatsthabhagavatprāpterevābhipretatvādityarthaḥ || || evaṃca tattatsūktopāsakānāmagnyādipadena tadaṃtargataviṣṇuprāptervivakṣitatvāt| viṣṇūpāsakasyāgnyādiprāptyukterayogāt| na ca viṣṇoragnyādyaṃtargatatvāsiddhiḥ| yo'gnau tiṣṭhannityādiśruteḥ| ato'gnyādiśabdavācyo viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || || iti vaiśvānarādhikaraṇaṃ || || iti prathamādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ || <1.3> || śrīḥ || || hariḥ || || atha prathamādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ || tatra cānyatra ca prasiddhānāṃ śabdānāṃ viṣṇau samanvayaḥ prāyeṇāsminpāde kriyate| atrobhayatra prasiddhasarvādhāratvaliṃgaṃ brahmaṇi samanvīyate| <1-3-1> dyubhvādyāyatanaṃ svaśabdāt || || nanu rudrasyaiva dyubhvādyāyatanatvaṃ bhavet| atroktaprāṇādhāratvasya prāṇānāṃ graṃthirasītyādinā tasminpratīteḥ| mana otaṃcotyādinā mana āyatanatvasya tasminnaivoktatvāt| prāṇādhāratvaliṃgena prāṇeśvara ityādinā tasya pratīteḥ| jīvasya vā bhavet| sa eṣoṃ'taścarata ityādinā jīvaliṃgapratīteḥ| iti prāpte sūtramupanyasyati || || || dyubhvādyāyatanaṃ svaśabdāditi || asyārthaḥ || dyubhvādyāyatanaṃ yasminniti vākyoktasvarga bhūmyādi sarvāśrayo viṣṇureva| na tvanyaḥ| kutaḥ| svaśabdāt sveti śabdaḥ svaśabdaḥ svaśabdagṛhīta brahmavācakātmaśabdādityarthaḥ || || evaṃca tamevaikamātmānamityātmaśabdādviṣṇordyubhvādyāyatanatvamiti siddhaṃ || <1-3-2> || muktopasṛpyavyapadeśāt || || nanu viṣṇau mukhyo'pyātmaśabdo'rā iva rathanābhāvityatra bahudhājāyamānatvarūpajīvaliṃgāt| tasya jīvavādeva prāṇitvasiddheḥ| tataśca jīva eva dyubhvādyāyatanaṃ iti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati || || || muktopasṛpyavyapadeśāditi || asyārthaḥ || dyubhvādhyāyatanatvaṃ na viṣṇoranyasya| kiṃtu viṣṇoreva| kutaḥ| muktopasṛpyavyapadeśāt| bhāvapradhāno'yaṃ| dyubhvādyāyatanasya vastuno'mṛtasyaiṣaseturiti muktaprāpyatvavacanāttasya cānyatrāyogādityarthaḥ || || evaṃcāmṛtasyaiṣaseturbrahmavidāpnoti paramityādiṣu muktaprāpyatvavacanādviṣṇordyubhvādyāyatanatvamiti siddhaṃ || <1-3-3> || nānumānamatacchabdāt || || nanu viṣṇuprāpakavat rudraprakṛtyorapi prāpakasadbhāvāttayordyubhvādyāyatanatvaṃ syāditi prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati || || || nānumānamatacchabdāditi || asyārthaḥ || anumānaṃ anumānamiti vā| manumānasiddhaprāmāṇyayutapāśupatādyāgamaiḥ sarvāśrayatayā kalpitaṃ| rudrapradhānādikaṃ dyubhvādyāyatanaṃva| kṛtaḥ| atacchabdāt bhasmadharogratvāditacchutiliṃgādyabhāvādityarthaḥ || || evaṃca rudrādiśabdānāṃ sāvakāśatvena prāṇānāmityādivākyasya rudraparavānirṇayenāsādhakatvāt| niravakāśānāṃ ca bhasmadharogrādi śabdānāmabhāvāt| tataśca viṣṇordyubhvādyāyatanavamiti siddhaṃ || <1-3-4> || prāṇabhṛcca || || nanu sa eṣa ityatra jāyamānatvarūpajīvaliṃgaśravaṇātprāṇitvasiddheśca jīvasāmānyasya vāyunā vai gautamasūtreṇāyaṃ loka iti viṣayabhūtalokādhāratvasya vāyuniṣṭhatvena śravaṇādvāyorvā dyubhvādyāyatanatvaṃ syāditi prāpte sūtramupanyasyati || || || prāṇabhṛcceti || jīvo'pyata eva dyubhvādyāyatana ityarthaḥ || || evaṃca prāguktasāvakāśasādhakasadbhāve'pi niravakāśātmaśabdābhāvādeva tatprāpakatvenābhimatasya bahudhā janmāderajāyamāna iti śruterviṣṇāveva saṃbhavācca na jīvasya vāyorvā dyubhvādyāyatanatvamiti siddhaṃ || <1-3-5> || bhedavyapadeśāt || || nanu jīvaliṃgasya kiṃ viṣṇutvapratipādanāyāsena jīvasyaiva dyubhvādyāyatanatve viṣṇostallābhasaṃbhavāt| na coktahetuvirodhaḥ| jīveśābhedābhiprāyeṇa jīve'pyātmaśabdādyuktisaṃbhavājjīva eva dyubhvādyāyatanatvena pratipādyo bhavediti prāpte sūtramāha || || || bhedavyapadeśāditi || asyārthaḥ || anyamīśamiti jīveśayorbhedokterna tayoraikyamityarthaḥ| || evaṃca juṣṭhaṃ yadā paśyatītyatra darśanakartṛtvena prakṛtajīvasyeśapadokteśvarādbhedokte rviṣṇureva dyubhvādyāyatanatvena pratipādya iti siddhaṃ || <1-3-6> || || prakaraṇāt || || nanu jīvasya kasmāccidīśādanyatva mucyate na tu paramātmanaḥ| tataśca na tayorbheda iti prāpte parākurvatsūtramāha || || || prakaraṇāditi || asyārthaḥ || anyamityāderviṣṇuprakaraṇatvāt| atra jīvasya viṣṇubheda evocyate| na tvanyasmādbheda ityarthaḥ || || evaṃca dvevidyaityasya paravidyāviṣayavastuno'trādhītatvena viṣṇuprakaraṇatvātparamātmana eva bhedavyapadeśāvagaterviṣṇureva dyubhvādyāyatana iti siddhaṃ || <1-3-7> || sthityadanābhyāṃ ca || || evaṃ na kevalaṃ juṣṭamiti bhedaśruterjīveśabhedo'tra prakaraṇe vivakṣita iti jñāyate kiṃtu liṃgādapītyāha sūtrakṛt || || || sthityadanābhyāṃ ceti || asyārthaḥ || īśajīvayordvāsuparṇe tyādivākyoktaṃ karmaphalānupajīvanastititadupajīvanarūpahetubhyāṃ ca na tayoraikyaṃ vācyamityarthaḥ || || evaṃca nirdiṣṭaśrutyā jīveśayorbhedasya siddhatvānna jīvaḥ kiṃtu viṣṇureva dyubhvādyāyatana iti siddhaṃ || || iti dyubhvādhikaraṇaṃ || atra bhūmanāmno viṣṇau samanvayaḥ kriyate| <1-3-8> || bhumā saṃprasādādadhyupedaśāt || || nanu bhūmākhyaḥ prāṇo bhavet| prāṇo veti prāṇasyottamatvamuktvā taduttamamanukatvā bhūmna āmnātatvāt| utkrāṃta prāṇān śūlenetyanenoktramaṇaliṃgaśravaṇāt| na cedaṃ liṃge viṣṇāvavakāśamarhati| sarvagatatvāt| prāṇaśabdasya vāyuvācyatvāt| tataścānaṃdamayo'pi sa eveti prāpte sūtramupanyasyati || || || bhūmā saṃprasādādadhyupadeśāditi || asyārthaḥ || bhūmā yo vai bhūmeti śrutau bhūmaśabdoktapūrṇo| viṣṇureva| kutaḥ| saṃprasādāt bhūmnastatsukhamityanena saṃprasādaśabditapūrṇasukharūpatvābhidhānāt| kiṃca adhyupadeśāt nāmāderapi tadupari nāmādidevatottamatvena bhūm‌no'bhidānāccetyarthaḥ || || evaṃca viṣṇurevāyaṃ bhūmā| pūrṇasūkhatvāt| tasya cānyatra niravakāśatvāt| kiṃcāsya bhūmnaḥ sarveṣāmuparyupadeśaḥ śrūyate| na cāsyānyatrāvakāśaḥ| na copakrame prāṇaśabdaśravaṇena kathamasau viṣṇuriti vācyaṃ| prāṇaśabdenāpi viṣṇoruktatvāt| na cotkramaṇādi liṃgavirodhaḥ| tamutkraṃtamitiśrutisiddhatvena tasya viṣṇāveva mukhyatvāt| athavā'yaṃ prāṇo vāyureva| tathā'pi na tasya bhūmatvaprāptiḥ| eṣa tu vetyādinā sūcita praśnādyadhyāhāreṇa prāṇādviṣṇorbhūyastvamuktvā bhūmna āmnānāt| sarveṣāṃ nāmādīnāmupari viṣṇoḥ sarvottama tvenābhidhānāt| bhūmā viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-3-9> || dharmopapatteśca || || yuktyaṃtareṇa viṣṇorbhūmatvapratipādayatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || || dharmopapatteśceti || asyārthaḥ || sa evādhastādityādinā bhūmni sarvagatatvādidharmaśravaṇāt| tasya ca viṣṇorevopapatteḥ| viṣṇureva bhūmetyarthaḥ || || evaṃca prāṇapadena vāyyaṃtargatasya viṣṇorabhidhānāt| ātmana ākāśaityatra saṃbhūtapadena bhūtasya tadabhimānidehasya svarūpotpattyabhidhāne'pi tadabhimānino hareśca dehasaṃbaṃdhaprādurbhāvayoścābhidhānavat bhūmā vāva prāṇādityanena svarūpottamatvasya bhūmno'bhidhāne'pi vāyvaṃtargatādrūpātprasādonmukhatvarūpottamatvaviśiṣṭabhūmābhidhānasaṃbhavena praśnaprativacanasahiṣṇutvasaṃbhavāt| kiṃca sa evādhastādityādinā bhūmni sarvagatatvādayo dharmāḥ śrūyaṃte| naite'nyatrāvakāśā labhaṃte| tataśca niravakāśebhyaḥ sarvagatatvādibhyo bhūmā viṣṇureveti tasyaivānaṃdamayatvamiti siddhaṃ || || iti bhūmādhikaraṇaṃ || atrākṣara nāmasamanvayaḥ kriyate| <1-3-10> || akṣaramaṃbarāṃtadhṛteḥ || || nanvetadakṣaraṃ madhyamaṃ śrītatvameva| adṛṣṭamiti śruteḥ | ahaṃ somamityādinā taddharmatvenāvagatacaṃdrasūryādyādhāratvasya sūryācaṃdramasāvityādinā'kṣarapratīteśca| na ca śrītatvaliṃgatayā prasiddhacaṃdrasūryādyādhāratvabalādyadyakṣaraṃ śrītatvamucyate| tarhi viṣṇuliṃgatayā prasiddhādṛśyatvādibalādviṣṇureva kiṃ na syāditi vācyaṃ| adṛśyatvādīnāṃ yettvakṣaramanirdeśyami tyādinā sāvakāśatvāt| na cākṣaraśruteradṛśyatvādiliṃgānāṃ ca madhyamottamākṣarayoḥ sāmye'tra madhyamamevocyata iti nirbedhe ko heturiti vācyaṃ| na tadaśnāti kiṃcanetyakṣarasyānaśanokteḥ| tacca viṣṇorviruddhaṃ| attā carācara grahaṇādityuktatvāt| na ca madhyamākṣarasyānaśanāṃgīkāre virodhī'sti| ata etadakṣaraṃ madhyamaṃ śrītatvameveti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || akṣaramaṃbarāṃtadhṛteriti || asyārthaḥ || akṣaraṃ tadvā etadityakṣaraśabdavācyaṃ brahmaiva| na citprakṛtiḥ| kutaḥ aṃbarāntadhṛteḥ| sminnakṣare etasminkhalvakṣara iti ākāśāṃtapadārthadhārakatvaśravaṇādityarthaḥ || evaṃcākāśa eva tadotaṃca protaṃcetyākāśākhyaprakṛteḥ sarvādhāratvamuktvā etasminkhalvakṣara ityādinā'kṣarasya tadādhāratvaśravaṇādakṣaraśabdavācyo viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-3-11> || sā ca praśāsanāt || || yuktyaṃtareṇa viṣṇorevākṣaratvaṃ pratipādayatsūtraṃ vyācaṣṭe || || || sā ca praśāsanāditi || asyārthaḥ || co yataḥ| sā aṃbarāṃtadhṛtiḥ| praśāsanāt viṣṇorājñamātrādeva bhavatīti etasya veti śrutā uktā| ato'pi brahmaivākṣara śabdavācyaṃ| na cetanaprakṛtirityarthaḥ || evaṃcākṣarasyājñāmātreṇa sarvādhāratvaśravaṇāt| saptārdhagarbheti śruteḥ| ato'kṣaraśabdavācyo viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-3-12> || anyabhāvavyāvṛtteśca || || yuktyaṃtareṇa viṣṇorakṣatvaṃ pratipādayatsūtramāha || || || anyabhāvavyāvṛtteśceti || asyārthaḥ || anyabhāvānāṃ viṣṇvanyavastusvabhāvānāṃ sthūlatvādīnāṃ| asthūlamanaṇviti śrutāvakṣare vyāvṛterabhāvasya kathanācca brahmaivākṣaramityarthaḥ || evaṃcāsthūlamityādinā'nyavastusvabhāvānāṃ sthaulyādīnāṃ vyāvṛttyabhidhānādakṣaraśabdavācyo viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || || iti akṣarādhikaraṇaṃ || trānekaprakaraṇātmakaṃ `sadeva' ityādisthānaṃ samanvīyate| <1-3-13> || īkṣatikarmavyapadeśaśātsaḥ || || nanu sat pradhānameva bhavet| na viṣṇuḥ| sato bahu syāmiti bahudhābhāvākhyavikāritvaśravaṇāt| na ca vikārītvaṃ paramātmani saṃbhavati| avikāraḥ sadā śuddha ityādinā tasyāvikāritvāt| tataśca pradhānameva saditi tasyaiva jagatkartṛtvamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || || īkṣatikarmavyapadeśātsa iti|| asyārthaḥ || sadevetyādi prakaraṇasthitasadādiśabdavācyaḥ viṣṇureva na pradhānaṃ| kutaḥ| īkṣatikarmavyapadeśāt tadaikṣateti cetananiṣṭhaikṣateti śabdopalakṣitadarśanākhyakriyābhidhānādityarthaḥ || || evaṃca tadaikṣateti īkṣatyākhyavyāpāraśravaṇāttena prekṣāpūrvakāritvalābhāt| īkṣaṇasyācetane pradhāne kathamapyayogāt| mābhūttarhyacetanā prakṛtiḥ| cetanā prakṛtiḥ kiṃ na syāditi cet| cetanaprakṛteḥ strītvena svātaṃtryeṇa sarjakatvāyogāt| na ca bahubhāvākhyapradhānaliṃgaśravaṇena sa na viṣṇuriti vācyaṃ| ajāyamāno bahudhā vijāyata ityāvikārasyāpi bahubhāvaśravaṇena tasya sāvakāśatvāt| saditi viṣṇurevoktastasyaiva sraṣṭatvamiti siddhaṃ || || iti sadadhikaraṇaṃ || atra sarvādhāratayā'nveṣṭavyatayā ca sākṣādvā vyavadhānena vā sāmānyato hṛtpadmasthatvaliṃgasya brahmāṇi samanvayaḥ kriyate| <1-3-14> || dahara uttarebhyaḥ || || nanvākāśa eva hṛpadmastho bhavet| daharo'sminniti padmasthe daharākāśasthitiśravaṇāt| tasyāṃte suṣiramitivyākhyānācca| ākāśaśabdena yadi suṣiramevābhimataṃ tasmiṃśca yadaṃtariti hṛtpadmasthākāśagataḥ sarvādhāratayocyeta tarhi vākyānvayānupapatteḥ| tathāhi| tasminnityatra viṣṇutvābhiprāye kiṃ tatra vidyata iti praśnasya brahma vidyata iti parihāraṃ vinā yāvanvā ityādarebhiprāyāsaṃgatiḥ| ākāśapakṣe tvastyasyānvayaḥ| hṛdayākāśasthamupāsyamityukte kiṃ tatra sthitamiti praśne yāvānveti prāguktākāśasya viśiṣyobhe'sminnityādiparihārasaṃśloṣāt| na ca yāvānityādinā''kāśākhyo viṣṇuḥ sarvādhāratayā parihāre kabhyata ityanvayopapattiḥ| taminsarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitamiti sākṣātsuṣirasyaiva sarvādhāratvoktivirodhāt| ata ākāśasyaiva sarvādhāratayā hṛtpadmasthatvaṃ| ato bhagavaditaradeva caṃdrādityādhārākṣaramiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || dahara uttarebhya iti || asyārthaḥ || dahare daharaṃ puṇ‍rīkaṃ veśmeti vākyoktahṛtpadmasthālpākāśe sthito viṣṇureva jīvādiḥ| katuḥ| uttarebhyaḥ ya ātmā apahatapāpmetyādyuttaravākyoktanirgatapāpmatvādidharmyebhya ityarthaḥ || evaṃca daharapadmastho viṣṇureva bhavet| apahatapāpmetyādyuttaravākye hṛtpadmasthasyāpahatapāpmatvādiguṇaśravaṇāt| pāpādyabhavāsyānyatra kathaṃcidyoge'pi sarvathā satyakāmatvādikasyāyogāt| yo'śanayetiśruteḥ| nirapekṣaguṇānāmanyatrābhāvāt| nityatīrṇeti vacanat| sāpekṣanirapekṣayornirapekṣasya svīkāryatvāt| ato hṛtpadmastho viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-3-15> || gatiśabdābhyāṃ tathā hi dṛṣṭaṃ liṃgaṃ ca || || yuktyaṃntareṇa viṣṇorhṛtpadmasthatvaṃ pratipādayatsūtramupanyasyati || || || gatiśabdābhyāṃ tathā hi dṛṣṭaṃ liṃgaṃ ceti || asyārthaḥ || gatiśabdābhyāṃ aharahargacchantya etaṃ brahmalokamiti vākye śrutābhyāṃ suptaprāpyatvabrahmaśabdābhyāṃ hetubhyāṃ| daharahṛtapadmasthaṃ brahmaiva| kiṃca yataḥ araśceti śrutau tathā suptaprāpyatvavat| hi viṣṇuniṣṭhatvena prasiddhaṃ| liṃgaṃ araṇyākhyasudhāsamudrāśrayalokavattvarūpajñāpakaṃ| hṛtpadmasthe dṛṣṭaṃ uktaṃ| ato'pi daharahṛtpadmastho viṣṇurevatyarthaḥ || evaṃcāhararhagacchantya iti suptaprāpyatvābhidhānāt| suptaprāpyāvasya viṣṇuliṃgatvāt| satā sobhyeti śruteḥ| araṇyanāmāmṛtasamudradvayāśrayalokavattvarūpaliṃgasya hṛtpadmasthsya dṛṣṭāvācca| araśceti śruteḥ| tataśca viṣṇureva hṛtpadmastha iti siddhaṃ| <1-3-16> || dhṛteśca mahimno'syāsminnupalabdhe || || hetvaṃtareṇa viṣṇorhṛtpadmasthatvaṃ pratipādayatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || || dhṛteśca mahimno'syāsminnupalabdheriti || asyārthaḥ || dhṛteḥ sa eṣa seturvidhṛtiriti hṛtpadmasthasya sarvādhāratvaśravaṇācca viṣṇureva hṛtpadmasthaḥ| kiṃca chāṃdāgye hṛtpadmasthaniṣṭatayoktasya mahimnaḥ sarveśvaratvādeḥ| asmin eṣa sarveśvara iti vājasaneyavākye| upalabdheḥśravaṇāt| tatsamākhyānādapi viṣṇureva hṛtpadmasthaḥ| nanu samākhyānādapi kuto viṣṇurevetyata uktaṃ| asyetyādi| asya viṣṇumahimnaḥ| asmin vājasaneyakavākye| śravaṇādevetyarthaḥ || evaṃca vājasaneyake vākye ya eṣotarhṛdaya ityādyuktvaiṣa sarveśvara ityādinā hṛdaye viṣṇoruktatvena tatsāmākhyānāt| etasminkhalvakṣare, sahisarvādhipatiḥ, sarveśo viṣṇurevaikaḥ, ityādi śrutismṛtīṣūktaliṃgānāmanyatra sāvakāśatvābhāvāt| ato hṛtpadmastho viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-3-17> || prasiddheśca || || samākhyārūpayuktyaṃtareṇa viṣṇorhṛtpadmagatākāśasthatvaṃ sādhayatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || || prasiddheśceti || asyārthaḥ || daharaṃ vipāpmamiti śrutau viṣṇorhṛtpadmasthatvaprasiddheśca sa eva hṛtpadmastha ityarthaḥ || evaṃca daharaṃ vipāpmamiti samākhyārūpaśrutyaṃtare viṣṇorhṛtpadmasthatvaprasiddheḥ| na ca praśnottarayorasaṃgatiḥ| brahmapuraśabdenaiva hṛtpadmasthasya brahmatve siddhe svarūpamātre praśnāyogāt| kīdṛśaṃ taditi bhāvena kiṃ taditi praśne brahmasvarūpana irūpaṇāya yāvānityādiparihārasaṃśleṣāt| na ca sākṣātpadmagatasya viṣṇutvābhyupagame suṣiraśabdasyākāśavācitvena padmagatākāśasyaiva viṣṇutvāṃgīkāre vā daharapadmasyākāśatvaṃ viṣṇostvākāśagatatvamiti tasyaiva sarvādhāratvamityabhyupagame'pi vā sākṣātsuṣirasya sarvādhāratvokteḥ suṣiraśrutivi rodhaḥ| yathā maṃdirasthamaṃjūṣāṃtamapi vastu maṃdirasthamiti saṃgīyate tathehāpi suṣiraśruteḥ suṣirasyākāśasyaiva sākṣātsarvādhāratvapratipādikāyāstasyāṃta iti suṣirapadaghaṭitaśruteḥ padmagatasuṣirāṃtasthaparamātmānamapekṣya pravṛttatvāt| ato hṛtpadmastho viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-3-18> || itaraparāmarśātsa iti cennāsaṃbhavāt || || nanvākāśasya sarvādhāratayā hṛtpadmasthatvaṃ jīvasyaiva bhavet| uttaratra paraṃjyotirityukta hṛtpadmasthātmatayā parāmarśāt| daharasthatvaliṃgāt| na cānvayānupapattiḥ| viṣṇupakṣe vākyayojanāvajjīvapakṣe'pi yojayituṃ śakyatvādityādinā bhagavato hṛtpadmasthatvamākṣipya samādadhatsūtramāha| || || itarāparāmarśātsa iti cennāsaṃbhavāditi || asyārthaḥ || itaraparāmarśāt| svena rūpeṇābhiniṣpadyaka ityuktasya jīvasya hṛtpadmasthātmatayā eṣa ātme tyetacchabdena parāmarśāt grahaṇāt| jīva eva hṛtpadmastha iti cenna| kutaḥ| asaṃbhavāt hṛtpadmaniṣṭhatayā śrutānāmapahatapāpmatvādiguṇānāṃ jīve svātaṃtryeṇāsaṃbhavādityarthaḥ| evaṃ ca jīvasyāpahatapāpmatvādyasaṃbhavena viṣṇureva hṛtpadmastha iti siddhaṃ| <1-3-19> || uttarāccedāvirbhūtasvarūpamastu || || nanveṣa saṃprasāda ityuktajīvasya sa tatra paryetītyādinā satyakāmatvapratītestata eva viśokatvādisiddheruktagumasaṃbhavāditi jīva eva hṛtpadmastha iti prāpte samādadhatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || || uttarāccedāvirbhūtasvarūpastviti || asyārthaḥ || tu śabda evārthe| netiśe ṣaḥ| tathā ca uttarāt sa tatra paryetātyuttaravākyāt| jīvasya satyakāmatvādipratīteḥ| tata eva viśokatvādeḥ saṃbhavāt| sa eva hṛtpadmastha iti cenna| kutaḥ| yatastadvākye svenetyuttaravākyabalāt āvirbhūtasvarūpaḥ mukta eva pratipādyaḥ| na jīvamātraṃ| muktaśca na svoto'pahatapāpmatvādiguṇakaḥ| ato na tasyāpi hṛtpadmasthatvamityarthaḥ || evaṃcottaravākye muktajīvasyocyamānatvena hṛtpadmasthasya dehāṃtarvartitayā muktatvāyogāt| na caitadvākyasya muktaviṣayatve'pi muktasyāpi jīvatve'pahatapāpmatvādisaṃbhavābhāvena jīva eva tadguṇako hṛtpadmagatatayā bhāvibhāvinocyata iti vācyaṃ| muktasyāpīśvaraprasādādeva tadguṇāvirbhāvena svato'pahatapāpmatvādyasaṃbhavāt| hṛtpadmastho viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || <1-3-20> || anyārthaśca parāmarśaḥ || || nanu `eṣaḥ' itijīvaṃ parāmṛśya `ātmā' iti tasya hṛtpadmasthātmatvābhidhānādamukhyāpahatapāpmatvādiguṇo'pi jīva etacchabdaparāmarśabalāddhṛtpadmasthātmā syāditi prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || anyārthaśca parāmarśa iti || asyārthaḥ || caḥ evārthe| parāmarśaḥ eṣa ātmeti vākyagataitchabdaḥ| anyārthaḥ paraṃjyotirityuktaparamātmārtha eva na jīvārtha ityarthaḥ || evaṃcaiṣa ātmeti paramātmānamevaiṣa iti parāmṛśya tasyātmatvokterna jīvaḥ kiṃtu viṣṇureva hṛtpadmastha iti siddhaṃ || <1-3-21> || alpaśruteriti cettaduktaṃ || || nanu yathā jīve'saṃbhāvyamānāpahatapāpmatvādiguṇaśravaṇānnajīvastathā paramātmanyasaṃbhāvyamānajīvaliṃgasyāpyalpasthānasthitatvasya śravaṇāt| tataśca hṛtpadmastho jīva eveti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati || || || alpaśruteriti cettaduktamiti || asyārthaḥ || alpaśruteḥ dahara ityalpasthānasthitatvokteḥ| jīva eva hṛtpadmastha iti cet| neti śeṣaḥ| kutaḥ| yatastaduktaṃ| tattu alpasthānasthitatvaṃ| uktaṃ nicāyyatvādeva vyomavaccetyatra vyāptasyāpi viṣṇoḥ upāsanārthamucyata ityuktaṃ ātmāṃtarhṛdaya iti śrutyuktaṃ ca| ata ityarthaḥ || evaṃca nicāyyātvādevamityatra sarvagatasyāpi viṣṇorvyomavadalpasthānasthiteruktatvāt| eṣamaityatra sarvagatatayā śrutyuktatvācca hṛtpadmastho viṣṇureveti siddhaṃ || || iti daharādhikaraṇaṃ || atrānukūlyena gṛhyamāṇatvaṃ liṃgaṃ brahmaṇi samanvīyate| <1-3-22> || anukṛtestasya ca || || nanu jñānisukhasyaivānukūlyena gṛhyamāṇatvaṃ bhavet| paramaṃ sukhamiti sukhaśruteḥ| teṣāṃ sukhamiti jñānisukhasyaiva prakṛtatvāt| tasyaivatacchabdena parāmarśasya yuktatvāt| na ca vācyaṃ bhagavato'pi prakṛtatvāttatparāmarśo'yamiti| tasya napuṃsakaśabdenāprakṛtasya tadityādiparamārśāyogāt| saṃbhavatsamīpaparāmarśaṃ vihāya dūrasthaparāmarśagrahaṇe kāraṇābhāvāditi prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || anukṛtestasyaceti || asyārthaḥ || caḥ samuccaye| tasyeti śrutipratīkagrahaṇaṃ| anukṛtiḥ anukriyā| tathāca kathaṃ nu tadvijānīyāmiti jñānārthaṃ prārthitatvarūpānukūlyena gṛhyamāṇaṃ brahmaiva| kutaḥ| anukṛteḥ tameva bhāṃtamanubhāti sarvamiti vākyaśeṣe sūryādīnāṃ bhagavatkriyānusāriprakāśākhya kriyākartṛtvaśravaṇāt| tasya bhāsā sarvamidaṃ vibhātīti jagataḥ paramātmaprabhāprakāśatvaśruterityarthaḥ || evaṃca tameva bhāṃtamiti sūryāditejasāṃ viṣṇvadhīnatvaśravaṇāt| tasya bhāseti sarvajagatprakāśakatvokteśca| ahaṃ tatteja iti śrutyā yadādityagatamiti smṛtyāca talliṃgadvayasya viṣṇuliṃgatvāvagateḥ na ca sukhaśrutivirodhaḥ| paramaṃ sukhamiti sukhaśruterapi tatparatvāt| cetanaścetanānāmiti paramātmano'pi prakṛtatvāt| yadanirdeśyaṃ paramaṃ sukhaṃ kathaṃ nu tadvijānīyāmityānukūlyena gṛṇhaṃti| tadanirdeśyaṃ sukhametatprakṛtaparamātmano rūpamiti manyaṃta iti vākyayojanayā paramātmanaḥ parāmarśopapatteḥ| sūryādiprakāśaniyāmakatvādīnāṃ liṃgānāmanyatrānavakāśena dūrastha parāmarśasyaiva nyāyyatvāt| tataścānukūlyena gṛhyamāṇo viṣṇurevoti siddhaṃ || <1-3-23> || || api smaryate || || yadetālliṃgadvayasya viṣṇuniṣṭhatvamahamiti| śrutyopapāditaṃ tatsmṛtyā'pyupapādayatsūtramupanyasyati || || || api samaryata iti || asyārthaḥ || na kevalaṃ hetukṛtānukṛtvāderviṣṇudharmatvaṃ śrūyate| kiṃtu kṛṣṇādibhiryadādityagataṃ teja ityādismṛtyādiṣūcyata ityarthaḥ || evaṃca yadādityagatamityādismṛtyuktatvenāpi viṣṇudharmatvaśravaṇādānukūlyena gṛhyamāṇaṃ brahmaiveti siddhaṃ || || iti anukṛtyādhikaraṇaṃ || atreśānanāmasamanvayaḥ kriyate || <1-3-24> || || śabdādeva pramitaḥ || || nanvīśāno vāyureva bhavet| evamevaiṣa ityatra prāṇavyavasthāpakatvaṃ yo'yaṃ madhyameti madhyamatvaṃ kuvidaṃga iti sarvadevopāsyatvamevamādivāyudharmāṇāṃ śravaṇāt| na cedamāniṣṭaṃ| vāyorapi jījñāsyatā'bhyupagamāt| viṣṇujijñāsyatvasyābādhāt| tataśceśānapadoktagumasya vāyuniṣṭhatvānna viṣṇoḥ sarvaguṇapūrṇatvamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || śabdādeva pramita iti || asyārthaḥ || viṣṇureva īśāno bhūtabhavyasyeti īśānaśabdavācyatvena pramitaḥ tattvato niścitaḥ| na tu vāyuḥ| kutaḥ| śabdādeva madhye vāmanamiti niravakāśavāmanaśruterevetyarthaḥ || evaṃca vāmanaśrutisadbhāvāt| tasyāśca mahāyogarūḍhisiddhāyāstatpramāpakatvāt| liṃgāpekṣayā śruteḥ prābalyāt| teṣāmapi liṃgānāṃ tadvaitvaṃ prāṇa ityatra vaiṣṇavattvasya siddhatvāt| viṣṇureveśāna iti siddhaṃ || <1-3-25> || || hṛdyapekṣayā tu manuṣyādhikāratvāt || || nanu mābhūtprāṇavyavasthāpakatvādiliṃgeneśanasya vāyutvasiddhiḥ|
