neśvarapakṣa ityarthaḥ || evaṃca vicitraśaktīnamīśvara eva satvādanyeṣāṃ tadabhāvāt| eko vaśīti śruteḥ| śaktervicitratvaṃ tu bhinnāvayavaśūnyānāṃ jīvānāmīsvarasya caikadeśena pravṛttyādirūpādhaṭitavicitrakāryakāritvamiti vivekāt| ato yuktivirodhābhāvena yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-1-30> || svapakṣadoṣācca || || nanu viṣṇoḥ śabdamūlatvena vicitraśaktitvena ca yuktivirodhasyādoṣatvavajīve'pi tathā bhavet| cetanatvādiliṃgena yuktivirodhasyāvirodhatāsādhanasaṃbhavāditi prāpte samādadhatsūtramāha || || || svapakṣadoṣācceti || asyārthaḥ || co'vadhāraṇe| tathāca ye doṣā iti śrutau jīvapakṣe yuktivirodhasya doṣasyaivokteḥ nāsāvadoṣatāṃ netavyaḥ| kiṃtu īśvarapakṣa eva adoṣatāṃ netavya ityarthaḥ || evaṃca jīvasyāpi svātaṃtryeṇa kartṛtvaṃ vaktumaśakyaṃ| tasya doṣitvenaṃ kalpakābhāvena taddoṣasyādoṣatayā netumaśakyatvāt| atha yaḥ saḥ doṣa iti śruteḥ| kṛtsnaprasaktyādiyuktivirodhasya jīvapakṣe doṣasyaivoktatvāt| jīveśayoḥ sadoṣatvanirdoṣatvavacanavirodhākhyadoṣasadbhāvāt| tataśca virodhābhāvena yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-1-31> || sarvopetā ta taddarśanāt || || nanu vicitraśaktibalānneśvare virodha iti yuktaṃ| sā śaktiryadviṣayiṇī na bhavati yadā ca naśyati tadā tatra doṣāvaśaṃbhāvaniyamānna tayā tatparihāro yukta ityāśaṃkāṃ parākurvatsūtramāha || || || sarvopetā ca taddarśanāditi || asyārthaḥ || yataḥ paramātmākhyadevatā na kevalaṃ sāmānyato vicitraśaktimatī kiṃtu sarvopetā sarvaviṣayasārvakālikaśaktimatī ca| kutaḥ| taddarśanāt sarvairyukteti tathā śruteḥ| ato neśvare yuktivirodhaḥ śaṃkanīya ityarthaḥ || evaṃceśasya sadā sarvaviṣaye vicitraktitvāt| sarvairyuktā śaktibhiriti śrutau paramātmaśaktiḥ sarvadā sarvaviṣayiṇī sarvakālā ceti tasya sarvaśaktimattvenoktatvāttathā śaktyā yuktivirodhaparihāraucityāt| ato yuktivirodhābhāvena yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-1-32> || vikaraṇatvānneti cettaduktaṃ || || nanvathāpi vikaraṇatvānneśvarasya jagatkartṛtvaṃ yuktaṃ| api ca sarvopeteti sūtra eva vicitrāśeṣaśaktivalena nikhilavirodhānāṃ parihṛtatvācchaṃkānavakāśātprakṛtasūtravaiyarthyamityākṣipya samādadhatsūtramupanyasyati || || || vikaraṇatvānneti cettaduktamiti || asyārthaḥ || netyāvartate| virakaṇatvāt apāṇipādamiti śrutyā īśvarasya hastādīṃdriyaśūnyatvāvagamāt| neticet īśvarasya kartṛtvaṃ na yuktamiti cenna| kutaḥ| yasmāt taduktaṃ| tasminna tasyetyādyāgamena tatkaraṇarāhityasya prākṛteṃdriyaviṣayatvamuktaṃ| tasmādityarthaḥ || evaṃcāpāṇipāda iti śrutau pāṇyādirahitasyāpi harergrahakādikamuktvā na tasyā kāryamityādinā pāṇyādirahitatvasya prākṛtaviṣayatvena sarvottamatvena paramaśaktitvena copapāditatvāt| paroktahetoraprayojakatvādasiddheśca| api ca sādhāraṇyena sarvavirodhānāṃ parihāre kṛte'pi viśeṣato'syaiva codyasya parihārānukūlayuktibodhanecchayā punaḥ śaṃkāyā darśitatvena sūtravaiyarthyābhāvāt| ato viṣṇorjagatkatṛtve yuktivirodhābhāvena yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || || iti śrutestu śabdamūlatvādhikaraṇaṃ || <2-1-33> atreśvarasya jagatkartṛtve niṣphalattvādiyuktivirodhaḥ parihriyate| || na prayojanavakttvāt || || nanu na viṣṇoḥ sarvasarjakatvādi yuktaṃ| atra kiṃ viṣṇuḥ prayojanoddeśena sṛṣṭhyādikaṃ karotītyucyate tadanuddeśeneti vā| ādye'pūrṇatvāt| dvitīye pravṛtterevāyogena sarvakartṛtvasya sutarāmayogāt| vidhāṃtarasya cābhāve'nupapannameva sarvakartṛtvamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || || na prayojanavatvāditi || asyārthaḥ || īśvarasya sṛṣṭyādau pravṛttirna svaprayojanoddeśena| kutaḥ| prayojanavatvāt pūrṇānaṃdatvena prāptaprāptavyatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇoḥ sarvakartṛtvaṃ| tasya pūrṇānaṃdatvena prāptaprāptavyatayā phaloddeśena pravṛttyanaṃgīkārāt| athaiṣa eva parameti śruteḥ| tathā cāptakāmatvena dayāsādhyaphalābhāvena paraprayojanārthamapi tasya sṛṣṭyādipravṛttyayogāt| ato virodhābhāvena yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ| <2-1-34> || lokavattu līlākaivalyaṃ || || nanuneśvaraḥ phalānuddeśena pravṛttimān cetanatvāt yajñadattavadityupapattivirodhātkathamaśvirasya phalānuddeśena pravṛttirityāśaṃkāṃ parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || lokavattu līlākaivalyamiti || asyārthaḥ || tu śabda evārthe| lokavat loke mattādipravṛttiriveśvarapravṛtteḥ| līlākaivalyaṃ kevalalīlārūpatvameva na svaprayojanoddeśyatvamityarthaḥ || nanvevaṃ phalānuddeśena pravṛtteranupapattiriti cenna| lokavallīlayaiva pravṛttyupapatteḥ| na hi līlā prayojanāṃtarāya bhavati| mattasya nṛttagānādilīlāyāḥ prayojanābhāve'pi darśanāt| pūrvapakṣyuktānumānasyonmattādau vyabhicārāt| vyākhyānādikāle hastacālanādāviva prayojanavattvarāhityāt| īśvarapravṛtterlokānugrahārthatvāṃgīkārāt| ato virodhābhāvādyuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || || iti na prayojanādhikaraṇaṃ || <2-1-35> atra pūrvokta paraprayojanarūpaphalaviṣayayuktivirodhaḥ parihriyate || || vaiṣamyanairghṛṇye na sāpekṣatvāttathā hi darśayati || || nanu na viṣṇoḥ sarvakartṛtvaṃ yuktaṃ| vaiṣamyādidoṣavattvāt| atra pṛṣṭavyaṃ| īśvaraḥ suranaratiryagādinānāyoniṣu prāṇino janayitvā teṣāṃ vibhāgena yatsukhaduḥkhe dadati tatkiṃ teṣāṃ karmānusāreṇa| uta tannairapekṣyeṇa| ādye'svātaṃtryāpātāt| niyamena karmasāpekṣasyāsvātaṃtryaniyamāt| dvitīyetu vaiṣamyanaighṛṇye prāpnutaḥ| nirnimitta vibhāgena sukhaduḥkhadātṛtvāt| kiṃca neśvarasya kartṛtve mānaṃ| mānatvenābhimatasya vedasya jyotiṣṭomādipratipādakavedavadamānatvāt| jyotiṣṭomādivedāmānatvaṃ tu sukhaduḥkhasādhanatvena taduktānāṃ dharmādīnāṃ nairapekṣyeṇaiveśvareṇa sukhādipradatvāsiddhaṃ| ato hareḥ sarvakartṛtvāyogānna lakṣaṇasūtramiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || vaiṣamyanairghṛṇye na sāpekṣatvāttathā hi darśayatīti || asyārthaḥ || svātaṃtryasidhyarthamīśvarasya jīvebhyaḥ phaladāne karmāpekṣāṃgīkāre nirnimittaṃ vaiṣamyeṇa phaladātustasya vaiṣamyanairdhṛṇye viṣamatvānirdayatve ye prasakte te nastaḥ| kutaḥ| sāpekṣatvāt īśvarasya karmāpekṣāvattvābhyupagamāt| tatkutaḥ| hi yasmāt puṇyena puṇyamiti śrutiḥ tathā darśayati pratipādayati| tasmādityarthaḥ || evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇorjagatsraṣṭṛtvādikaṃ| tattatkarmānusāreṇa phaladātṛtvāṃgīkāreṇa veṣamyanairghṛṇyābhāvāt| ato lakṣaṇasūtraṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <2-1-36> || na karmāvibhāgāditi cennānāditvāt || || nanvapekṣayā karmaṇo'bhāvānna tadapekṣayā vaiṣamyādidoṣaparihāraḥ saṃbhavati| na cāsti pūrvakarmeti vācyaṃ| eṣa hyeveti śrutau tasyāpi bhagavadadhīnatvaśravaṇāt| svakāritāpekṣayā phaladāne vaiṣamyāderanistārāditi prāpte sūtramāha || || || na karmāvibhāgāditi cennānāditvāditi || asyārthaḥ || vaiṣamyanairghṛṇyādidoṣaparihārāya īśenāpekṣaṇīyaṃ yatkarma tannāstīti viśiṣṭaniṣedhaḥ| kutaḥ| avibhāgāt tasya karmaṇaḥ asvataṃtra vastubhyaḥ avibhaktatvāt| asvataṃtratvāditi yāvat| tathā ca svādhīna karmāpekṣayā vaiṣamyāderaparihāra iti cenna| kutaḥ| anāditvāt karmaparaṃparāyāḥ anāditvādityarthaḥ| tathā ceśvaraḥ pūrvapūrvamapekṣyottarottarakarma jīvena kārayatītyaṃgīkāreṇa karmaṇaḥ apekṣaṇayitvāpatteḥ noktadoṣa iti bhāvaḥ || evaṃca bhavedayaṃ doṣaḥ| yadi pūrvatanaṃ karmeśvareṇa nirapekṣeṇa kāritaṃ syāt| na caivaṃ| kiṃ tarhi prācīnakarmānusāreṇa kāritaṃ| yatraiva paryavasānaṃ tadārabhya doṣa iti karmaparaṃparāyā anāditvāt| puṇyapāpādikamiti vacanāt| ato virodhābhāvenoktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-1-37> || upapadyatecāpyupalabhyate ca || || nanvathā'pi neśvarasya karmāpekṣayā phaladātṛtvaṃ yuktaṃ| asvātaṃtryaprasaṃgādityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtramupanyasyati| || || upapadyate cāpyupalabhyate ceti || asyārthaḥ || īśvarasya karmāpekṣāyāmapyupapadyate svātaṃtryaṃ yujyata eva| karmaṇaḥ svādhīnatvāt| nanu punaḥ svādhīnakarmasāpekṣatvakṛtavaiṣamyāpāta ityata uktaṃ| upalabhyate ceti| sa kārayediti śrutyā tādṛśavaiṣamyaṃ adoṣatvena jñāyate cetyarthaḥ || evaṃcopapadyate khalvīśvarasya karmasāpekṣatve'pi svātaṃtryaṃ| svādhīnasāpekṣāyāḥ svātaṃtryāvirodhitvāt| na ca tathā sati punarvaiṣamyādikaṃ syādita vācyaṃ| iṣṭatvāt| vaiṣamyamiti vacanāt| ato hareḥ sarvakartṛtve virodhābhāvādyuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || || iti vaiṣamyanairghaṇyādhikaraṇaṃ || <2-1-38> atra viṣṇoḥ sarvagumapūrtau sarvadoṣarāhitye ca yuktyavirodha ucyate| || sarvadharmopapatteśca || || nanu na viṣṇuḥ sarvaguṇapūrṇaḥ| cetanatvāt| anyathā devadattādīnāmapi tathātvaṃ syāt| sarveṣāṃ yuktivirodhānāṃ parihṛtatvenottarasūtraveyarbhyācceti prāpte pariharatsūtramāha || || || sarvadharmopapatteśceti || asyārthaḥ || guṇadoṣābhāvavattvarūpāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ dharmāṇāṃ upapatteḥ svātaṃtryādinā brahmaṇi yuktatvācca na tasya guṇapūrṇatve yuktivirodhaḥ śaṃkanīya ityarthaḥ || evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇoḥ sarvaguṇapūrmatvaṃ| svātaṃtryāt| guṇāḥ śrutā iti śruteśca| pūrvādhikaraṇeṣu tasya pratyekamekaikaguṇaviṣaye doṣābhāve ca virodhaṃ parihṛtya samarthanaṃ kṛtaṃ| sarvaguṇapūrṇatvaviṣaye ca prāptayuktivirodhaparihāreṇa ca tatprakaraṇasyātra samāpitatvātsūtravaiyarthyābhāvāt| cenatvahetoraprayojakatvācchrutiviruddhatvācca| tatca viṣṇoḥ sarvaguṇapūrṇatve virodhābhāvenoktaṃ sarvamupapannamiti siddhaṃ || || iti sarvadharmopapattyadhikaraṇaṃ || || iti dvitīyādhyāyasya prathamaḥ pādaḥ || <2.2> || śrīḥ || || hariḥ || || atha dvitīyādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ || itareṣāṃ cānupalabdheriti naye sāmānyato nirākṛtasamayānāṃ viśeṣato nirākaraṇaṃ kriyate'sminpāde || atrācetanapravṛttimataṃ nirākriyate| <2-2-1> || racanānupapatteśca nānumānaṃ || || nanu na viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ| sāṃkhyasamaye mahadādikaṃ svasadṛśakāraṇajanyaṃ| kāryatvāt| ghaṭavadityanumānena prakṛteḥ kāraṇatvaṃ prasādhya tasyā ananyādhīnatayā kāryonmukhatvābhidhānāt| ataḥ prakṛterevānanyādhīnatayā'śeṣakāryonmukhatvena neśvarakartṛtvaṃ cāstīti na jagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktamiti prāpte parākurvatsūtramāha| || || racanānupapatteśca nānumānamiti || asyārthaḥ || anumīyata ityanumānaṃ| sāṃkhyānumānakalpitaṃ| pradhānaṃ na jagatkartṛ| kutaḥ racanānupapatteḥ| pradhānasya jaḍatvena svataḥ pravṛttyanupapatteḥ| acetanasya svataḥ pravṛtau pramāṇābhāvāccetyarthaḥ || evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇoḥ jagatkartṛtvaṃ| kāryaṃ svasadṛśakāraṇavadityanumānena kāraṇatayā parikalpitasya pradhānasyācetanatvena svataḥ kāryonmukhatvāyogāt| pradhānasya svataḥ pravṛttyabhāve'cetanatvākhyahetusūcanādasiddheḥ parihṛtatvāt| tadviruddhopapattereva tadabhāvasādhakatvāt| prāguktānumānasya kāraṇatvamātrasādhakatvena svataḥ kāryonmukhatvāsādhakatvāt| pramāṇāṃtarasya cābhāvāt| ato nirīśvarasāṃkhyamatasyāprāmāṇikatvena tadvirodhābhāvādyuktaṃ janmādikāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-2> || pravṛtteśca || || evaṃ pradhānasya svataḥ pravṛttikartṛtve'cetanatvasvataḥpravṛttiśūnyatvapramāṇābhāvairnirākṛtya yuktyaṃtareṇāpi tannirākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || pravṛtteśceti || asyārthaḥ || ahaṃ karomīti cetanasyaiva pravṛtterdarśanācca na pradhānaṃ jagatkartṛ ityarthaḥ || evaṃca kulālāderghaṭādisṛṣṭau vyāpārasyāhaṃ karomītyanabhavasiddhatvāt| kiṃca paṭādisṛṣṭeścetanecchānusāritvadarśanena mahadādisṛṣṭerapi tathā'bhyupagaṃtavyatvāt| mahadādisṛṣṭiścetanecchānusāriṇī sṛṣṭitvāddhaṭasṛṣṭivaditi mānāṃtaravirodhāt| cetanasya pravṛttiḥ kriyā| sā ca kṛtiṃ vinā nopapannā| sā ca necchāṃ vinā| sā ca na jñānaṃ vineti pravṛttyādikāryāṇāṃ svasvakāraṇāvinā bhūtatvena pravṛttyā icchāpūrvakatvasādhanasaṃbhavāt| ato jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-3> || payoṃ'buvaccettatrāpi || || nanvacetanayorapi payoṃ'bunoḥ svataḥ pravṛttirddṛśyate| atastatraivācetatvahetorvyabhicārāt| acetanasya svataḥ pravṛttau ca sa eva dṛṣṭāṃto bhaviṣyatīti prāpte parākurvatsūtramāha || || || payoṃ'buvaccettatrāpīti || asyārthaḥ || api śabdaścetanapravṛttyākarṣaṇārthaḥ| payoṃ'buvat yathā'cetanayoḥ payoṃ'bunoḥ pravṛttirdṛṣṭā tathā pradhānasyāpyastviti cenna| kutaḥ| yataḥ| tatrāpi payoṃ'bvādāvapi aṃtataḥ īśvarādeva pravṛttiḥ| na svataḥ pravṛttirityarthaḥ || evaṃcaitasya vā'kṣarasya praśāsana iti śrutyā tatrāpīśvaranimittapravṛttisadbhāvāvagamāt tathā ca pūrvavādyuktapratyanumānadṛṣṭāṃte payoṃ'bvādau siddhāṃtyabhimatasādhyasyaiva satvānna tadanumānasya satpratipakṣatā na vā vyabhicāraḥ| ato janmādikāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-4> || vyatirekānavasthiteścānapekṣatvāt || || nanu śrutisāmarthyena payoṃ'bunoḥ pravṛtterīśvaradhīnatayā tatra vyabhicārābhāve'pyayaskāṃtaśilādirūpācetanāṃtasya pravṛttau siddhāyāṃ bhaviṣyati tatra vyabhicāraḥ| setsyati ca pradhānasya svataḥ pravṛttau sādhyāyāmayaskāṃtādikmeva nidarśanaṃ| udāharaṇaniyamasyānāśrayaṇīyatvādityāśaṃkāmapākurvatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || || vyatirekānavasthiteścānapekṣatvāditi || asyārthaḥ || vyatirekānavasthiteḥ na ṛta iti śrutyā īśvaravyatirekeṇa kasyāpi karmaṇaḥ asattvāvagamāt| tata evācetanasyaiva svataḥ pravṛttiriti nirīśvarasāṃkhyamatasyāprāmāṇikatvāt| ataḥ evānapekṣatvātsadbhiranādaraṇīyatvānna tadvirodho viṣṇukartṛtvasyetyarthaḥ || evaṃca na ṛte tvatkriyata iti śrutyā sarvasyāpīśvarādhīnatvāvagamāt| īśvaravyatirekeṇa taṃ vinā kasyāpi karmaṇo'navasthitiśruteracetanatvahetoḥ kutrāpi vyabhicārābhāvāt| pūrvavādyuktānumāne dṛṣṭāṃtālābhāt| sāṃkhyaparikalpitānumānasyāprāmāṇikatvena pramāṇaviruddhatvena ca mahājanaparigṛhītatvābhāvānnānumānaparikalpitaṃ pradhānaṃ jagatkartṛ| ato nirīśvarasāṃkhyamatasyāprāmāṇikatvena tadvirodhābhāvādyuktaṃ jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ || || iti racanānupapattyādhikaraṇaṃ || <2-2-5> || anyatrābhāvācca na tṛṇādivat || || nanu neśvarasya svātaṃtryeṇa kartṛtvaṃ yuktaṃ| parameśvarānugṛhītapradhānādeva| parjanyānugṛhīta pṛthivyā aṃkurotpattivajjagadutpattisaṃbhavāt| ato neśvarasya svātaṃtryeṇa jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || || anyatrābhāvācca na tṛṇādivaditi || asyārthaḥ || tṛṇādivat yathā pṛthivījanyatṛṇādikārye parjanyaṃ sahakārimātraṃ tathā prakṛtijanyamahadādikārye'pīśvaraḥ anugrāhakaḥ| na svataṃtra iti seśvarasāṃkhyapakṣo'pi na| kutaḥ| anyatrābhāvāt| īśvarādanyatra tatpreraṇāṃ vinā jagato'bhāvādīśvarasya prakṛtisattādipradatvāccetyerthaḥ || evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ| svātaṃtryeṇa tatpreraṇāmaṃtareṇa kasyāpi vastuno'bhāvāt| mūlakāraṇabhūtāyāḥ prakṛterapi tadadhīnasattākatvācca| ataḥ seśvarasāṃkhyamatasyāprāmāṇikatvenāvirodhakatvādyuktaṃ jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ || || iti anyatrābhāvādhikaraṇaṃ || atra lokāyatikapakṣo nirākriyate| <2-2-6> || abhyupagame'pyarthābhāvāt || || nanu neśvarasya svātaṃtryeṇa kartṛtvaṃ yuktaṃ| aṃtareṇāpīśvaraṃ pūrvasmātpūrvasmāduttarottarotpattisaṃbhavāt| caitanyotpatterapi madirotpattivatsvabhāvadevopapatteḥ| na ca śrutyādibādhaḥ| tasyā apramāṇyāt| na ca tasyā aprāmāṇye dharmādyasiddhiprasaṃgaḥ| atīṃdriyavastuno'bhāveneṣṭatvāt| ata iśvarābhāvānneśvarasya jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati| || || abhyupagame'pyarthābhāvāditi || asyārthaḥ || netyanuvartate| anabhyupagame'pi cārvākaiḥ svaśāstrasya siddhāṃtatvānabhyupagame siddhamasmadiṣṭaṃ| abhyupagame'pi arthābhāvāt| siddhāṃtatvavyāpakayoḥ arthaśabditaviṣayaprayojanayoḥ asattvāṃgīkārāt svavyāghātaḥ syāditi na tatpakṣo'pi yukta ityarthaḥ || evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ| cārvākasamayasya viṣayaprayojanādiśūnyatvenāpramāṇatvena virodhābhāvāt| tathāhi| na tāvattatsamayasyātīṃdriyo viṣayaḥ| tadabhāvāt| nāpyaiṃdriyakaṃ| tasya pratyakṣasiddhatvena śāstrānapekṣaṇāt| nāpi svargāpavargādi śrotṛphalaṃ| tadalābhāt| nāpi dṛṣṭaṃ dhanādi| tasya kṛṣyādilaghūpāyasādhyatvāt| nāpi praṇetuḥ prayojanaṃ| na ca dharmādyabhāvapratipādanadvārā lokopakāraḥ prayojanamiti vācyaṃ| dharmādyabhāvajñāne parasparahiṃsādinā'pakārasyaiva prāpteḥ| nāpyupakāraḥ svataḥ prayojanaṃ| sukhaduḥkhāvāptihānirūpatvābhāvāt| na vā tenāpi kiṃcitsādhyaṃ prayojanaṃ| evaṃ vidhe'dhikārī dūrotsāritaḥ| tadabhāvādeva saṃbaṃdho'pi ataścārvākasamayasyāprāmāṇikatvādyuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || || iti abhyupagamādhikaraṇaṃ || || adhikaraṇaṃ || atra puruṣopasarjanaprakṛtikartṛvādo nirākriyate| <2-2-7> || puruṣāśmavaditi cettatrāpi || || nanu na harerjagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ| cetanopasarjanaśarīrasyāśmānayanādikartṛtvadarśanena puruṣopasarjanapradhānenaiva jagadutpattisaṃbhavāt| pradhānaṃ cetanasaṃnidhānātsvataḥ pravṛttimat acetanatvāt śarīravaditi mānasadbhāvāt| ata īśvarasyaivābhāvājjagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ tasyaivetyetad‌dūrotsāritamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || || puruṣāśmavaditi cettatrāpīti || asyārthaḥ || puruṣāśmavat yathā puruṣasaṃbaṃdhādacetanaṃ śarīraṃ aśmānayanādau pravartate tathā'cetanaprakṛtiḥ cetanasaṃbaṃdhātpravartata iti cenna| kutaḥ| yataḥ tatrāpi śarīrapravṛttāvapi cetanasya īśvarasyaiva kartṛtvena dṛṣṭāṃtābhāvaḥ ata ityarthaḥ || evaṃca yuktameva harerjagatkāraṇatvaṃ| puruṣopasarjanaprakṛterjagatkāraṇatvasādhane dṛṣṭāṃtābhāvāt| na ca śarīrameva dṛṣṭāṃta iti vācyaṃ| na ṛte tvatkriyata iti śrutyā śarīrapravṛttāvapi paramātmādhīnatvena dṛṣṭāṃtasya sādhyavikalatvāt| tataśca matāṃtaravirodhābhāvena yuktaṃ jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-8> || aṃgitvānupapatteḥ || || evaṃ śrutilakṣaṇahetunā dṛṣṭāṃte sādhyavaikalyamabhidhāya hetvaṃtareṇa dṛṣṭāṃte sādhyavaikalyopapādanāya sūtramupanyasyati || || || aṃgitvānupapatteriti || asyārthaḥ || puruṣāsyāṃgatveṃ'gīkṛte sati aṃgamaṃgīti vākye aṃgitvasya prādhānyasya ukttyanupapatteḥ| na puruṣopasarjanaprakṛtikartṛtvapakṣe dṛṣṭāṃto'stītyarthaḥ || evaṃca yadi puruṣopasarjanaṃ śarīrameva kartṛ syāttarhi puruṣom̐'gī śarīramaṃgamiti prāmāṇikalaukikavyavahāro na syāt| asti cāsau| ato nāyaṃ dṛṣṭāṃtaḥ| tasmātpuruṣasaṃvalitaśarīrasyaiva svataḥ pravṛttāvucyamānāyāṃ puruṣasyāṃgatvāpradhānatvāvaśyaṃ bhāvādaṃgamiti smṛtau puruṣasyāṃgitvavyavahāraḥ śarīraṃ prati prādhānyavyavahāropadeśo'nupapannaḥ syāt| evaṃ dārṣṭāṃtike'pi puruṣasya pradhānāṃgatvāpattyāṃ'gitvavyavahārānupapattiḥ| tathā ca dṛṣṭāṃtābhāvo bādhaśca darśite| ato matāṃtaravirodhābhāvena yuktaṃ jagatkāratṇavalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ || || iti puruṣāśmādhikaraṇaṃ || atra prakṛtyupasarjanapuruṣakṛrtṛvādo nirākriyeta| <2-2-9> || anyathā'numitau ca jñaśaktiviyogāt || || nanu na harerjagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ| pradhānopasarjanapuruṣādeva jagadutpattisaṃbhaveneśvaravaiyarthyāt| tathā ca prayogaḥ| vimatā pravṛttiḥ acetanopasarjanapuruṣādhīnā pravṛttitvāt aśmānayanādipravṛttivaditi| ato na jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || || anyathā'numitau ca jñaśaktiviyogāditi || asyārthaḥ || śabdenāṃgitvānupapatterityasya samākarṣaḥ| yathā prācīnapakṣānyaprakāreṇa prakṛtyupasarjanapuruṣakartṛtvasyānumitau sādhane'pi| jñaśaktiviyogāt| jñasya jīvasya śarīrasaṃbaṃdhārthaṃ pravṛttiśaktiviyogāt āṃgitvānupapatterevetyarthaḥ || evaṃca yuktameveśvarasya jagatkāraṇatvaṃ| prakṛtyupasarjanapuruṣasya kartṛtve mānābhāvāt| atha mataṃ| prācīnamatādanyathā'numitamiti| tathā sati dṛṣṭāṃte sādhyābhāvāt| kevalasya pravṛttiśakteraṃgīkāre śarīravaiyarbhyaṃ| noceccharīrasaṃbaṃdhābhāvaprasaṃgenāśmānayanādipravṛttirna syāt| asti cāsau| ataḥ puruṣasya śarīrasaṃbaṃdhaghaṭako'śmānayanādiśaktiprada īśvaroṃ'gīkārya iti kathaṃ na dṛṣṭāṃtaḥ sādhyavikalaḥ| ato jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-10> || vipratiṣedhāccāsamaṃjasaṃ || || evaṃ pratyekaṃ dūṣitānyanīśvaramatāni sāmānyadūṣaṇenāpi nirākurvatsūtra paṭhati || || || vipratiṣedhāccāsamaṃjasamiti || asyārthaḥ || vipratiṣedhāt sakalaśrutismṛtiyuktiviruddhatvādanīśvaramataṃ asamaṃjasaṃ ayuktamityarthaḥ || evaṃca dyāvābhūmī janayan | yato vā | ya sarvajña ityādiśrutīnāṃ utpattisthitisaṃhārāḥ| sraṣṭā pātā tathaivāttā| ityādi smṛtīnāṃ| vimataṃ sakartṛkaṃ kāryatvāt| ciccaittye kenacinniyete'svataṃtratvāt| ityādiyuktīnāṃ ca virodhena prakṛtisvātaṃtryādirūpamarthaṃ vadato'nyonīco nāstīti vacanāt| tataśca sakalaśrutismṛtiyuktiviruddhatvātsarvamapyanīśvaramatamapramāṇaṃ| ato na sāṃkhyādimatavirodhena na lakṣaṇāsaṃbhava iti siddhaṃ || || iti anyathā'numityadhikaraṇaṃ || atra paramāṇvāraṃbhavādo'pākriyate| <2-2-11> || mahaddīrghavadvā hrasvaparimaṃḍalābhyāṃ || || nanu dravyādipadārthāḥ saptaiva| tatra dravyāṇi pṛthivyādinavaiva| guṇāstu rūpādicaturviṃśatireva| karma cotkṣepaṇādipaṃcavidhaṃ| sāmānyamanekavidhaṃ| jātirūpamupādhirūpaṃ ca samavāyastveka eva| viśeṣāstvanaṃtāḥ| etattritayaṃ nityameva| tatrānityaṃ kāraṇatritayajanyaṃ| yatsamavetaṃ kāryamutpadyate tatsamavāyikāraṇaṃ| paramāṇvādidravyameva| tatra paramāṇavo dvyaṇukādikrameṇāvayavinamārabhaṃte| samavāyikāraṇapratyāsannamavadhṛtasāmarthyasamavāyikāraṇaṃ| tatra kāryadravyasyāvayavasaṃyoga eva kāryaikārthapratyāsattyā'samavāyikāraṇaṃ bhavati| kāraṇaguṇakarma ca kāryaguṇānāṃ kāryaikārthapratyāsattyā'samavāyikāraṇaṃ| karmaṇaśca kāraṇagataguṇakarmaṇi kāryaikārthapratyāsattyā'samavāyikāraṇaṃ| tatra parimāṇaṃ kāraṇagataṃ| kāryagataparimāṇasthāsamavayikāraṇaṃ bhavati| paramāṇud‌vyaṇukatūlagataṃ parimāṇaṃ na d‌vyaṇukatryaṇukatūlapiṃḍagatāḥ parimāṇāḥ asamavāyakāraṇaṃ| kiṃtu d‌vyaṇukatryaṇukagatasaṃkhyayaiva| tūlapiṃḍaparimāṇaṃ tu pracayena bhavati| etadanyatkāraṇaṃ nimittaṃ| īśvarādṛṣṭakālādi| tatreśvara ātmaviśeṣaḥ| ātmā ca saṃkhyādicaturdaśaguṇayuktaḥ| parameśvarastu saṃkhyādipaṃcaguṇakaḥ| kartṛtvopayogijñānecchā prayatnaśālī ca śiṣṭaṣaḍ‌guṇāyogya iti kathaṃ tasyānaṃtaguṇakttvaṃ yuktaṃ| ato vyartha eva pūrvādhyāya iti prāpte sūtritaṃ| || || mahaddīrghavadvā hrasvaparimaṃḍalābhyāmiti || asyārthaḥ || mahaddīrghavat vaiśeṣikamate tryaṇukādigatānmahattvāt dīrghatvācca caturaṇukādigataparimāṇamutpadyate| tathā hrasvaparimaṃḍalābhyāmapi dvyaṇukaparamāṇūbhayagata hrasvattvapārimāṃḍilyaparimāṇābhyāmapi tryaṇukadvyaṇukagataparimāṇotpattiḥ syādityarthaḥ || anyathā mahattvadīrghatvābhyāmapi kāryotpattirna syāditi vā śabdārthaḥ| tasmādvaiśeṣikamatamanupapannamiti bhāvaḥ || evaṃca yuktameva hareranaṃtaguṇaparipūrṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ| vaiśeṣikādīnāmanupapannabhāṣitvena tatsamayasyāprāmāṇikatvāt| yaccoktaṃ| hrasvāṇuparimāṇayornāsamavāyikāraṇatvamiti| tanna| tathāsati mahattvadīrghatvayorapi tadabhāvāpātāt| mahaddīrghaparimāṇayoḥ kāraṇatve'nayorapi tatsāmyāt| aviśeṣāt| tasmādutpattiviruddhatvānna tayorasamavāyikāraṇatvaṃ| kiṃtvetayoreveti vaiśeṣikādyuktamasamaṃjasasameveti na tadvirodha īśvarānaṃtaguṇatvasyeti yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-12> || ubhayathā'pi na karmātastadabhāvaḥ || || evaṃ vaiśeṣikādimate mahattvadīrghatvāderasamavāyikāraṇatvakhaṃḍanarītyāsamavāyikāraṇamātraṃ nirastaṃ bhavatītyamipretya nimittakāraṇamapyevaṃ nirākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || ubhayathā'pi na karmātastadabhāva iti || asyārthaḥ || ubhayathā'pi īśvarecchayā nityatvānityavarūpapakṣadvaye'pi| na paramāṇuṣu kriyotpattisaṃbhavaḥ| atastadabhāvaḥ tasmindvyaṇukādikāryābhāvaḥ syādityarthaḥ || evaṃceśvarecchā nimittakāraṇamiti cet| sā kiṃ nityā'nityā vā| ubhayathā'pi na paramāṇukarma saṃbhavati| yadīśvarecchā nityā tarhi pralaye satyāmapi tasyāṃ paramāṇuceṣṭābhāvenā'nyadā'pi tadabhāvaḥ| athānityā tatkāraṇābhāveneśvarecchānutpattyā paramāṇukarmābhāvaḥ| na ca vācyaṃ pūrvakalpīyecchā'nityā'pi yāgavannimittamiti| pramāṇābhāvāt| atha neśvarecchā kāraṇaṃ tadevāstu| tarhyanyatrāpi kāraṇaṃ na syāt| sa eva paramate paramāṇukarmābhāvena saṃyogābhāvād‌vyaṇukādikāryābhāvaḥ| vaidikeśvarapakṣe tu satyāmapīśvarecchāyāṃ sarvaṃ kāryānutpādikamīśvarāciṃtyaśaktita evopapadyate| na ca parapakṣe samametat| tasyānumānagamyeśvaratvena vedaikagamyeśvaratvābhāvāt| ato vaiśeṣikādyuktasyāsāmaṃjasyena yuktaṃ hareranaṃtaguṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-13> || samavāyābhyupagamācca sāmyādanavasthiteḥ || || evaṃ vaiśeṣikādipakṣe nimittakāraṇāsaṃbhavaṃ darśayitvā samavāyikāraṇamapi nirākurvatsūtramāha || || || samavāyābhyupagamācca sāmyādanavasthiteriti || asyārthaḥ || vaiśeṣikaiḥ avayavāvayavyādīnāṃ bhinnatvanimittena samavāyābhyupagamāt samavāyasaṃbaṃdhāṃgīkārāt| sāmyāt samavāyyasamavāyinorapi bhinnatvasāmyāt| tatrāpi samavāyābhyupagame anavasthiteḥ| anavasthānācca tanmatamayuktamityarthaḥ || evaṃca yadapi paramāṇvādidravyaṃ samavāyikāraṇamiti| tanna| avayavāvayavinorbhinnatvamaṃgīkṛtya viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvopapattaye samavāyābhyupagamāt| samavāyasyāpi bhinnatvasāmyena mṛddhaṭasamavāya ityādiviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvopapattaye samavāyāṃtarāpekṣā syāt| tatrāpyevamityanavasthānāt| mūlabhūtāvāyavāvayavyādisaṃbaṃdhasyaivāsidhyā tadasiddhiḥ| teṣāṃ prathamasaṃbaṃdhasidhyarthamabhyupagaṃtavyānāṃ saṃbaṃdhāṃtarāṇāṃ sutarāmasiddheḥ| samavāyasya svanirvāhakatve svasminsvayameva viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvabuddhijanakatveṃ'gīkṛte samavāyāsiddheḥ| guṇaguṇyādibhedaṃ tatsamavāyaṃ cāṃgīkṛtya tatsvanirvāhakatvakalpanāpekṣayā lāghavena guṇaguṇyāderabhedamaṃgīkṛtyaikasya dravyasyaiva svanirvāhakatvopapattau samavāyavaiyarthyāt| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-14> || nityameva ca bhāvāt || || evaṃ paramate kāraṇatrayanirāsena sṛṣṭiṃ nirasya pralayanirāsārthaṃ pravṛttaṃ sūtramupanyasyati || || || nityameva ca bhāvāditi || asyārthaḥ || doṣasamuccaye caḥ| īśecchāparamāṇvādikāraṇānāṃ sadātvāt| vaiśeṣikamate nityameva sarvadaiva| bhāvāt kāryotpattiḥ syāt| na tu kadācidityarthaḥ || evaṃca paramate layāsaṃbhavaḥ| samavāyikāraṇāsamavāyikāraṇanimittakāraṇānāṃ sadbhāvena kāryānutpāde kāraṇābhāvāt| samavāyikāraṇaparamāṇūnāṃ sadātanatve samavāyasyaiva janitvāṃgīkāre sarvaṃ kāryaṃ nityaṃ janimadeva syāt| samavāyikāraṇādisatve kāyotpattyuparame kadā'pi tasmātkāryotpattirna syāt| sati puṣkalakāraṇe kāryānutpāde tasya tatkāraṇatvāyogāt| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-15> || rūpādimattvācca viparyayo darśanāt || || evaṃ paramāṇūnāṃ nityatvamubhyupetya tadāraṃbhakavādo dūṣitaḥ| idānīṃ nityatvamapākurvatsūtramupanyasyāti || || || rūpādimattvācca viparyayo darśanāditi || asyārthaḥ || kiṃca vaiśeṣikamate pārthivāpyataijasaparamāṇūnāṃ rūpādimattvāt| viparyayaḥ nityatvaviparītānityatvaṃ syāt| kutaḥ| darśanāt yadrūpādimattadanityamiti vyāpteḥ ghaṭādau dṛṣṭatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca vastutastu na paramāṇūnāṃ nityatvamupapadyate| prākṛtarūpatvenāvaśyaṃ bhāvāt| dṛśyate khalu loke yatprākṛtarūpādimattadanityamiti| pārthivāpyataijasaparamāṇūnāṃ bhautikarūparasagaṃdhasparśavattvādanityatvaṃ| tataśca paramāṇūnāṃ nityatvābhāvenoktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-16> || ubhayathā ca doṣāt || || nanu yadrūpādimattadanityamiti sāmānyavyāptiḥ| yanniravayavaṃ dravyaṃ tannityamiti viśeṣavyāptirbalavatī| atastayā bādhitatvena rūpādimattvaṃ paramāṇūnāmanityatvaṃ na sādhayet| astu vā paramāṇūnāṃ sāditvaṃ| tathā'pi na dvyaṇukādikāryābhāvaḥ| pāramāṇūnāṃ kāraṇāṃtareṇotpattau tebhyo d‌vyaṇukādyutpattisaṃbhavāditi prāpte parākurvatsūtramāha || || || ubhayathāca doṣāditi || asyārthaḥ || vaiśeṣika ubhayathā ca maramāṇunityatvānityatvarūpapakṣadvaye'pi| doṣāt tadvatsarvanityatvakāraṇābhāvanimittakatadutpattibhāvasya doṣasattvāt na tatpakṣo yukta ityarthaḥ || evaṃca yaduktaṃ| yadrūpādimattadanityamiti sāmānyavyāptiriti| tanna| rūpādimatyanityatvāpavādakasya viśeṣapramāṇasyābhāvāt| na ca niravayavatvaṃ viśeṣapramāṇaṃ| rūpādimattvena paramāṇau tadabhāvasyāpi sādhayituṃ śakyatvāt| yadapyanityatve doṣābhāva iti| tanna| tvanmate paramāṇūnāṃ kāraṇāsaṃbhavenānutpattau d‌vyaṇukādikāryānutpattiprasaṃgalakṣaṇabādhakasadbhāvāt| evaṃ pakṣadvaye'pi doṣaduṣṭatvena yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-17> || || aparigrahāccātyaṃtamanapekṣā || || evaṃ prapaṃcena dūṣitaṃ paramāṇvāraṃbhavādamaprāmāṇikatvenāpi dūṣayatsūtramāha || || || aparigrahāccātyaṃtamanapekṣeti || asyārthaḥ || aparigrahāt vaiśeṣikamatasya śrutyādiparigrahaśūnyatvāt tadviruddhatvācca| tatrātyaṃtamanapekṣā anādaraḥ kārya ityarthaḥ || evaṃca vaiśeṣikamatasya sakalaśrutismṛtyādyaparigṛhītatvāttadviruddhatvācca| pradhānakāraṇatvavādāpekṣayā'tiśayenānādaraṇīyatvāt| ānvīkṣakīmiti mokṣadharmavacananiṃditatvācca| ataḥ paramāṇvāraṃbhavādasyānupapannatvenāvirodhādyuktaṃ pūrvādhyāyoktamīśvarasyānaṃtaguṇapūrṇatvamiti siddhaṃ || || iti vaiśeṣikādhikaraṇaṃ || atra paramāṇupuñjavādimatamapākriyate| <2-2-18> || sumudāya ubhayahetuke'pi tadaprāptiḥ || || nanu na viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ| vaibhāṣikasautrāṃtikamata viruddhatvāt| rūpavijñānavedanāsaṃjñāsaṃskārarūpeṇāvasthitaṃ khalu jagatparamārthasattadaśeṣaṃ paramāṇusamudāyātmakaṃ| natvavayavī nāma kaścidasti| paramāṇusamudāya eva ghaṭādibudhdyupapattau paramāṇuparimāṇasya tadārabdhasya vā'vayavino'bhyupagamasya vyarthatvāt| vidyamānaṃ ca sarvaṃ kṣaṇikameva| asattvasya kṣaṇikatvavyāptyabhāvāt| vyāpakābhāve vyāpyāyogāt| taccaitatkāryajātaṃ kālakarmarūpanimittenaiva bhavati| nopādānāpekṣā| tataḥ pūrva pūrva paramāṇūnāṃ vināśenopādānābhāvepyuttarottaraparamāṇūnāṃ sṛṣṭiḥ kālakarmādinaiva bhavatīti kimīśvareṇa kṛtyaṃ| naceśvare pramāṇamasti| vedāderapramāṇatvāt| ata īśvarasyaivābhāvena tasya janmādikāraṇatvamayuktamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || samudāya ubhayahetuke'pi tadaprāptiriti || asyārthaḥ || yataḥ samudāyai paramāṇusamudāye'nekatvasaṃkhyārūpe militānekaparamāṇunimittakeṃ'gīkṛte satyapi viralānekahetuke vāṃ'gīkṛte sati| tadaprāptiḥ tasya samudāyasya viralānekahetukasyāprāptiḥ anupapattiḥ| kutaḥ| anyonyāśrayādidoṣāditi śeṣaḥ| tadupapāditaṃ ṭīkāyāṃ| ataḥ paramāṇupuṃja eva ghaṭāvayavīti bauddhapakṣo'pi na kṣama ityarthaḥ || evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvābhidhānaṃ| vaibhāṣikasautrāṃtikayoranupapannabhāṣitvena tatsamayasyāprāmāṇyāt| yaduktaṃ| kālakarmādinimittena kṣaṇikaparamāṇunimittakaḥ samudāyo bhavati natvavayavī kaścidastīti| tanna| tatra kimayaṃ samudāya ekaparamāṇuhetuko vā'nekaparamāṇuhetuko veti| nādyaḥ| ekasmātsamudāya ityasya vyāhatatvāt| dvitīye'pi kiṃ militānekahetuko viralānekahetuko vā| nādyaḥ| melanasyaiva samudāyatvenātmāśrayāt| samudāyadvayasya kāryakāraṇabhāvāṃgīkāre'nyonyāśrayāt| vyaktibāhulyāṃgīkāre'navasthānāt| nottara| viralaparamāṇupravāhasya sadā sadbhāvena samudāyarūpakāryaviralātmakapralayābhāvaprasaṃgāt| ato samudāyasya prāptyabhāvena goghaṭādibuddhivedyo natvavayavī kaścidastīti pakṣasyāyuktatvena yuktaṃ jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-19> || itaretarapratyayatvāditi cennotpattimātranimittatvāt || || nanvastveva sadā samudāyotpattiḥ| tathā'pi na pralayābhāvaḥ| vittivyavahārābhāvādeva pralayopapattiriti prāpte sūtramāha || || || itaretarapratyayatvāditi cennoptatti mātranimitatvāditi || asyārthaḥ || nanu paramāṇupuṃjasya sadā sattve'pi nāsmatpakṣe pralayānupapattiḥ| kutaḥ| tadvyavahārāderitaretarapratyayatvāt| idamidaṃceti paramāṇuparasparāpekṣābuddhinimittakatvāt| tathā ca tādṛśabudhyabhāvakāle samudāyavyavahārāderasattavātpralayopapattirita cenna| kutaḥ| utpattimātranimittatvāt paramāṇūnāṃ svasamudāyotpattimātranimittatvāt| na tebhyo'pekṣābudhdyāderapyutpattiḥ saṃbhavatīti mātra śabdārthaḥ| tathā ca tannimittakavyavahārādiḥ kṣaṇikamate na kadā'pi saṃbhavatītyarthaḥ || evaṃca vittivyavahārayoḥ kadā'pyayogena sṛṣṭyabhāvaprasaṃgāt| tathāhi| ādau paramāṇūnāṃ darśanaṃtato'pekṣā tato vyavahāra iti kramaḥ| nacāsāvupapadyate| paramāṇūnāṃ kṣaṇikatvena kāryamutpādya naṣṭatvāt| na hyanyatra pradarśanamanyatrāpekṣā'nyatra vyavahāra iti saṃbhavati| atiprasaṃgāt| evaṃ puruṣe'pi viralaparamāṇujanyānāṃ militaparamāṇūnāṃ sthāyitvābhyupagame pratikṣaṇe kāryotpādaprasaṃgaḥ| tathā cālpatarakāle'pyekaikasmātparamāṇupuṃjātmakaghaṭādanekakāryotpattyākulālaśālāparipūrtiprasaṃgaḥ| ato yuktaṃ jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-20> || uttarotpāde ca pūrvanirodhāt || || evaṃ viralaparamāṇubhyo militaparamāṇūtpattimabhyupetya vyavahārādyasaṃbhavo darśitaḥ| atha visadṛśakāryotpattimapi parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || uttarotpāde ca pūrvanirodhāditi || asyārthaḥ || co'vadhāraṇe| samuccaye ca| netyanuvartate| sāmarthyāditi śeṣaḥ| tathā ca na kevalaṃ kṣaṇikamate samudāyavyavahārānupapattiḥ| kiṃtu viśeṣakāryotpattiśca na yuktā| kutaḥ| uttarotpāde ca kāraṇasya sadṛśakāryajananasāmarthyāttenakāraṇaṃ prathamaṃ svasadṛśamutpādya paścādvisadṛśakāryamutpādyatāṃ kodoṣa ityato'pyāha| uttara iti| tathā ca uttarasya svasadṛśakāryotpāde utpattau satyāmeva| pūrvanirodhāt pūrvasya kāraṇasya nāśāt punarvisadṛśakāryajanakatvāsaṃbhava ityarthaḥ || evaṃca paramate viśeṣakāryotpattyasaṃbhavaḥ| kāryasyasvasadṛkāryajanakatvasvābhāvyāt| anyathā ghaṭātpaṭotpattiprasaṃgāt| na ca svasadṛśakāryamutpādya paścādvaisādṛśyamapijanayatīti vācyaṃ| kāryotpāde tasya naṣṭatvena vaisādṛśyajananāyogāt| ato jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-21> || asati pratijñoparodho yaugapadyamanyathā || || evaṃ visadṛśakāryotpattinirāsena vyavahārādikaṃ parākṛtyedānīṃ pratikṣaṇakāryotpattimeva nirākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || asati pratijñoparodho yaugapadyamanyatheti || asyārthaḥ || kṣaṇikamate na pratikṣaṇaṃ kāryotpattiryujyate| kutaḥ| asati kāraṇe kāryamutpadyata ityaṃgīkāre| pratijñoparodhaḥ tasya tatkāryatvamiti pratijñāya siddhāṃtavyavahārasyoparodho hāniḥ syāt| anyathā kāraṇe sati kāryamutpadyata ityaṃgīkāre| yaugapadyaṃ kāraṇena saha kāraṇānāṃ ekadā'vasthā prasajjatetyarthaḥ || evaṃca pratikṣaṇaṃ kāryotpattyaṃgīkāre kimasati kāraṇe kāryamutpadyate| uta sati| ādye pratijñāhāniḥ| dvitīya prathamakṣaṇotpannānāṃ viralaparamāṇūnāṃ kāryotpattisamaye'pi bhāve kṣaṇikatvaniyamābhāvena vināśakasaṃpattiparyaṃtamavasthānaṃ syāt| tanmateca kāraṇe sati kāryaṃ bhavatyeveti niyamātpunaḥ punaḥ kāryotpattiḥ syāditi sakalakāryāṇāṃ yaugapadyaṃ syāt| tataścaikasyāṃ ghaṭikāyāṃ kulālaśālāpūrtiprasaṃgaḥ| yadvā| paramāṇūnāṃ kṣaṇikatvena yasminkṣaṇe paramāṇavastasminneva kṣaṇe kāryamiti kāryakāraṇayoḥ paurvāparyaṃ na syāt| na ca kṣaṇe pūrvāparamadhyabhāgo'sti| yena prathamabhāge paramāṇūtpattiḥ| dvitīyabhāge tu kāryajanakatvamiti syāt| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-22> || pratisaṃkhyā'pratisaṃkhyānirodhāprāptiravicchedāt || || evaṃ kṣaṇikavāde kāryotpatiṃ nirākṛtya vināśaṃ ca nirākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || pratisaṃkhyā'pratisaṃkhyānirodhāprāptiravicchedāditi || asyārthaḥ || evaṃ kṣaṇikamate pratisaṃkhyā'pratisaṃkhyānirodhāprāptiḥ pratisaṃkhyā'pratisaṃkhyānirodhayoḥ pratikṣaṇavināśasaṃtānāvināśayoḥ aprāptiḥ anupapattiḥ| kutaḥ| avicchedāt tadrītyā kāryo'tpattāvakāryāṇāṃ cāvicchinnatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca paramate vināśo na yujyate| tanmate vināśo dvividhaḥ| kāryamutpādya tadapahāya tatkṣaṇe nāśaḥ| tasyāpyevamevamiti pratikṣaṇaṃ nāśaḥ| sa eva saṃtānavināśo'pratisaṃkhyānirodha iti gīyate| saṃtānaṃ vinaiva kāraṇasya naṣṭatvāt| aparastu kāryamutpādya tena sahaiva mudgarapraharādinākṣaṇamātre nāśaḥ| sa eva saṃtānanāśaḥ pratisaṃkhyānirodha iti ca gīyate| tatrādyastāvannayujyate| kāryamutpādya tatparityāgasamaye sattvena tataśca kāryajanakatvamiti niyamātkāryamevotpādayenna naśyet| tadviyogasamaye'pyevamiti na kadāpi niḥsaṃtāno nāśaḥ| nāpi saṃtānavināśo yujyate| sato ghaṭasya hyātyaṃtiko vināśaḥ| ato'sau sattvātkāryamutpādayenna tu naśyet| evamuttaratrāpi sattvātkāryamevotpādayenna tu naśyediti sasaṃtānocchedāvasarābhāvāt| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-23> || ubhayathā ca doṣāt || || nanvathā'pi satāṃ bhāvapadārthānāṃ kṣaṇikatvaṃ niṣedbhuṃ na śakyaṃ| sattvaṃ nāmārthakriyākāritvaṃ| na ca ṇikatāmaṃtareṇa tadupapannaṃ| yadi ghaṭa ādyakṣaṇe ghaṭāṃtaramutpādya svayaṃ na naśyettarhi dvitīyādikṣaṇe ghaṭāṃtaramapi janayet| ghaṭāṃtarāṇyapi tathetyanaṃtakāryāpātaḥ| tasmādarthakriyākāritvarūpasattvasidhyai bhāvānāṃ kṣaṇikatvameṣṭevyamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || || ubhayathā ca doṣāditi || asyārthaḥ || ubhayathā kāraṇe sati kāryaṃ bhavatyeveti niyamapakṣe tadabhāvapakṣe ca| doṣasattvāt kāryakāraṇaviśeṣakāryānutpattyākhyadoṣāt| nānyatarapakṣāvalaṃbenārthāpattyā kṣaṇikapakṣo yukta ityarthaḥ || evaṃca bhāvānāṃ kṣaṇikatvāṃgīkāre tatrārthakriyākāritvaṃ sattvaṃ| tadanyathā'nupapattyā kṣaṇikatvamiti vadatā kāraṇe sati kāryaṃ bhavatyeveti yo niyama āśritaḥ sa kiṃ vāstavo na vā| ādye kāryakāraṇayoḥ savyetaraviṣāṇavatsamānakālīnatvena kāryakāraṇabhāvo na syāt| dvitīye prathamakṣaṇe kāryānutpādakatve nārthakriyākāritvābhāvādasattvaṃ syāt| tataḥ kadā'pi kāryotpattirna syāt| tataśca sattvānyathā'nupapattyā kalpyamānaṃ kṣaṇikatvaṃ ca na syāt| anena parapakṣa evobhayathā doṣasattvādasmatpakṣe doṣābhāvāditi maṃtavyaṃ| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ| <2-2-24> || ākāśe cāviśeṣāt || || nanu mābhūdarthāpattyā kṣaṇikatvasiddhiḥ| yatsattatkṣaṇikaṃ| yathā dīpādi| saṃtaścāmī bhāvāḥ padārthā ityanumānena setsyati| na ca vācyaṃ dṛṣṭāṃtasya sādhyavikalateti| yadviruddhadharmādhikaraṇaṃ tannānā yathā ghaṭapaṭau| tathā cāyaṃ dīpaḥ pūrvottarakṣaṇaviruddhadharmādhikaraṇaṃ viśeṣadarśanāditi prāpte sūtramāha || || || ākāśe cāviśeṣāditi || asyārthaḥ || co'pyarthe| dīpadṛṣṭāṃtena sattvahetunā jagati kṣaṇikatvasādhane ākāśadṛṣṭāṃtenākṣaṇikatvasyāpi sādhanāpātaḥ| nanu dṛṣṭāte sādhyavaikalyamityata uktaṃ| ākāśe aviśeṣāditi| kṣaṇikatvasādhakatvena paroktaparimāmaviśeṣādarśanādityarthaḥ || tathā ca satpratipakṣo'yaṃ heturiti na tena kṣaṇikatvasiddhiriti bhāvaḥ || evaṃca yatsattadakṣaṇikaṃ yathā''kāśamityakṣaṇikatvasyāpi sādhayituṃ śakyatvāt| na cākāśe sādhyābhāvaḥ| viśeṣadarśanābhāvena kṣaṇikatvasādhakābhāvāt| na ca hetvaṃtareṇa tatsiddhiḥ| paṃcamaskaṃdhātiriktatvena tatra tadanabhyupagamāt| ākāśe sattvaṃ nāstīti cet| kimidaṃ sattvaṃ yadākāśe nāsti| arthakriyākāritvaṃ cet| tvanbhate pūrvoktarītyā kasyāpyarthākriyākāritvābhāvenāsiddhiḥ| sādhanavikalatā ca nidarśanasya| atha svarūpeṇeti vidyamānatā'bhāvarūpatā vā| sāpyākāśe'styeveti vyabhicāro duṣparihāraḥ| ataḥ sattvahetoḥ svenaiva pratipakṣitatvānnānenāpi kṣaṇikatvasiddhiḥ| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-25> || anusmṛteśca || || evaṃ pratipakṣeṇa sattvānumānaṃ nirasya pramāṇabādhenāpi nirākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || anusmṛteśceti|| asyārthaḥ || tadevedamiti pratyabhijñānācca tadvirodhāt na sattvahetunā kṣaṇikatvasādhanaṃ yuktamityarthaḥ || evaṃca so'yaṃ ghaṭa iti pratijñāvirodhaḥ| tathā syāyitvasiddheḥ| na ca pratijñābhrāṃtiḥ| bādhakābhāvāt| ghaṭo'yaṃ niraṃtarottarakṣaṇavṛttidhvaṃsapratiyogī ghaṭatvāt musalāhataikakṣaṇavṛttivaṭavaditi coktarītyā parāstaṃ| kiṃca ghaṭaśabdena paramāṇūṃllakṣayitvā ghaṭatvaśabdena paramāṇutvameva hetutayā vivakṣyate| uta samudāyamaiva pakṣīkṛtya ghaṭatvameva hetutayā vivakṣyate| nādyaḥ| musalāhatasya ghaṭasya samudāyatvena paramāṇutvābhāvāt| tatra hetvabhāvena vyāptigrahaṇābāvaprasaṃgāt| na dvitīyaḥ| sata eva tvayā kṣaṇikatvasya sādhanīyatvenāvastunastatsādhanasyānupayuktatvāt| ato vaibhāṣikasaitrāṃtikamatasyānupapannatvenāvirodhakatvādyuktamīśvarasyāśeṣajagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ || || iti samudāyādhikaraṇaṃ || atra śūnyavādo nirākriyate| <2-2-26> || nāsato dṛṣṭatvāt || || nanu na viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ| śūnyasamayaviruddhatvāt| ekameva śūnyamataṃ| tatra parahitaṃ paramārthasat| tasmādevāśeṣaṃ jagadupaiti| na cāsaṃgasya tadanupapattiḥ| saṃvṛttisaṃbaṃdhena tadupapatteḥ| na ca śrutivirodhaḥ| tatprāmāṇyānabhyupagamāt| tataśca śūnyasamayaviruddhatvādayuktaṃ viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || nāsato dṛṣṭatvāditi || asyārthaḥ || asataḥ śūnyasya| na jagatkartṛtvaṃ yuktaṃ| kutaḥ| pramāṇābhāvāditi śeṣaḥ| tatkutaḥ| adṛṣṭatvāt| kvāpyasataḥ kāraṇatvādarśanāt| ata evānumānāmayorapyabhāvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ| sūnyasamayasyāprāmāṇikatvāt| śūnyameva jagatkāraṇamityatra pramāṇābhāvāt| pramāṇaṃ bhavatprayakṣaṃ vā'numānaṃ vā''gamo vā syāt| na tāvatpratyakṣaṃ| śūnyakāraṇatvasyāpratyakṣatvāt| nāpyanumānaṃ| dṛṣṭāṃtābhāvāt| ghaṭādāveva kāraṇatvadarśane'pi nāsau dṛṣṭāṃtaḥ| tasya tvanmate'sattvenāsati prativādinā kāraṇatvasyānupalabdhatvena kāraṇatvābhāvasyānumātuṃ śakyatvena sādhyavaikalyāt| āgamo'pi bauddhādyāgamo vā vedādirvā bhavet| nādyaḥ| tatprāmāṇyasya prativādino'saṃmateḥ| na dvitīyaḥ| tatprāmāṇyasya vādyasaṃpratipatteḥ| tathāvidhavedānupalaṃbhācca| ataḥ śūnyamatasyāyuktatveneśvarasya jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-27> || udāsīnānāmapi caivaṃ siddhiḥ || || nanvadṛṣṭamapi jagatkāraṇatvaṃ sūnyasyābhyupagate ko doṣaḥ| na coktamadṛṣṭatvādevāprāmāṇikatvānnāṃgīkārārhateti| nādṛṣṭatvena dṛṣṭānumānānupattāvapi sāmānyato dṛṣṭatvopapatteḥ| kāraṇasya hi kāryavadvastutvena sattve niṣiddhe kāryatvena hetunā'sata eva janma setsyatītyāśaṃkāṃ parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || udāsīnānāmapi caivaṃ siddhiriti || asyārthaḥ || evaṃ satyasataḥ kāryotpādakatveṃ'gīkṛte sati| udāsīnānāṃ heyopādeyatvabudhyaviṣayāṇāṃ gaganakusumādīnāṃ sakāśādapi sāraibhyādikāryasiddhiḥ syādityarthaḥ| anyathā śūnyādapi kāryotpattirna syāditi ca śabdārthaḥ || evaṃcāsataḥ kāraṇatve heyopādeyabuddhiviṣayatāvarjitānāṃ khapuṣpādīnāṃ saurabhyādikāryasiddhiprasaṃgāt| vyatirekyanumānasya tatrāpi kartuṃ śakyatvāt| parābhimatānumānānāṃ tarkabādhitatvāt| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-28> || nābhāva upalabdheḥ || || nanu bhavedetad‌dūṣaṇaṃ| yadi śūnyatattvātparamārthato mṛtpiṃḍāddhaṭa iva jagadutpadyeta| na caivaṃ| kiṃ nāma saṃvṛtti śabditājñānaviśeṣādasato rajatākāreṇeva śūnyasyāpi jagadākāreṇāvabhāsākhyavivartatvābhyupagamādityāśaṃkāṃ parākurvatsūtramāha || || || nābhāva upalabdheriti || asyārthaḥ || jagat abhāvaḥ asat na| kutaḥ| upalabdheḥ saditi pratīyamānatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca śūnyasya jagadākāreṇa vṛttyaṃgīkāre jagato mithyātvaprasaṃgāt| na ceṣṭāpattiḥ saditi pratīyamānatvāt| śūnyasya rajatākāreṇāvabhāsatve śuktereva rajatāropādhiṣṭhānatvasyānubhavasiddhatvena śūnyasya tadadhiṣṭhānatvābhāvāt| ato lakṣaṇasūtraṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-29> || vaidharmyācca na svapnādivat || || nanu saditi dṛśyamānasyāpi svāpnajāgratvāderajjubhujaṃgāderasattvāttadvajjagato'sattvaṃ kiṃ nasyādityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtramupanyasyati || || || vaidharmyācca na svapnādivāditi || asyārthaḥ || jagat svapnādivat svapnavastvanyāropitajāgrattvādivadapyasanna| kutaḥ| vaidharmyāt svāpnajāgrattvasya bādhyatvākhyavilakṣaṇadharmavattvāt jagati ca tadabhāvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca svapna evāyaṃ na jāgradrajjuriyaṃ na sarpa iti bādhakapratyayaviṣayatvavatprakṛte bādhakapratyayaviṣayatvābhāvena vaiṣamyāt| etena parodīritapratipakṣānumānasya bādhakapramāṇaviṣayatvarūpopādhistadabhāvarūpapratipakṣasya coktatvāt| tadevaṃ śūnyamatasyāpyayuktatvādyuktamīśvarasya jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ || || iti asadadhikaraṇaṃ || atra vijñānavādo nirākriyate| <2-2-30> || na bhāvo'nupalabdheḥ || || nanu na viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ| vijñānavādimataviruddhatvāt| nityaniraṃjanaṃ vijñānatattvameva khalu vidyamānaṃ| tanmātrametadaśeṣaṃ jagat| na tato'tiriktaṃ kiṃcidasti| ato jagadutpattāvīśvareṇa kṛtyābhāvādayuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti prāpte sūtramāha || || || na bhāvo'nupalabdheriti|| asyārthaḥ || jagat bhāvaḥ jñānātmakamapi na| anupalabdheḥ jñānajñeyayorabhedānanubhavādityarthaḥ || evaṃca yuktameva harerjagatkāraṇatvaṃ| vijñānavādisamayasyāyuktatvenāvirodhakatvāt| vijñānātiriktaṃ jagannāstītyatra vijñānatattve jagadadhyastaṃ cet| saditi pratīyamānatvenāropitatvāyogāt| vijñānatattvajagatorabheda iti cet| jagato jñānātmakatve pramāṇābhāvāt| na ca sahopalaṃbhaniyamādabhedo nīlataddhiyoriti vācyaṃ| bhedapratītivirodhāt| na ca sā bhrāṃtiḥ| bādhakābhāvāt| nīlādīnāṃ svapratītyabhedavadbhedasyāpi svapratītyabhedena yathārthatvāt tatpratīterbhramatvāyogācca| sāhityasya bhedavyāptatvena sahopalaṃbhādabheda iti pratijñāhetvorvirodhācca| nanu yatprakāśate tadvijñānaṃ yathā jñānaṃ| prakāśaṃte ca nīlādaya ityanumānena nīlādīnāṃ jñānatvasiddheriti cet| prakāśata ityanena jñānaviṣayatvāṃgīkāre māyāvādinā svavṛttivirodhena vijñāne sādhanavaikalyābhidhāne niruttaratvaprasaṃgāt| ajñāne vyabhicārācca| prakāśatvāṃgīkāre'siddheḥ| ato bauddhamatasyāprāmāṇikatvenāvirodhādyuktaṃ viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-31> || kṣaṇikatvācca || || yuktyaṃtareṇāpi jagato vijñānātmakatvaṃ parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || kṣaṇikatvācceti || asyārthaḥ || jñānasyaikakṣaṇāvasthāyitvājjagataḥ sthāyitvāttādvirodhānna tayoraikyamityarthaḥ || evaṃca jñānasya kṣaṇikatvājjagataśca sthāyitvena tayoraikyāyogāt| kṣaṇikatvasya vināśyatvasvābhāvyāt| ato jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-32> || sarvathā'nupapatteśca || || evaṃ pratyekaṃ dīṣitāni vaibhāṣikādibauddhamatāni punaḥ sāmānyadūṣaṇena parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || sarvathā'nupapatteśceti || asyārthaḥ || sarvaprakāreṇānupapatteḥ bauddharāddhāṃtasya yuktiśūnyatvāt tadviruddhatvācca na grāhyatvamityarthaḥ || evaṃca pratyakṣakṣaṇikatvakalpane pratikṣaṇamutpannavināśakalpane śūnyādvaitakalpane vijñānādvaitakalpane prakaṭane pracchādane vā narte | yacca kiṃcit brahmaṇyevadamāvirāsīt| ityādiśrutīnāṃ| sa eva bhūyaḥ| ityādismṛtīnāṃ| sūtroktayukattyādīnāṃ ca virodhitvena sarveṣāṃ vedaviddheṣiṇāṃ pakṣāṇāmanupapannatvena yuktaṃ viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvamiti siddhaṃ || || iti anupalabdhyakaraṇaṃ || atra syādvādimataṃ dūṣyate| <2-2-33> || naikasminnasaṃbhavāt || || nanu na viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ| jainamataviruddhatvāt| jaināstu saptabhaṃgiṃ jagadvadaṃti| tathāhi| sadityekaprakāraḥ| asadityaparaḥ| sadasadātmakamiti tṛtīyaḥ| sadasadvilakṣaṇamiti caturthaḥ| sattve sati sadvilakṣaṇamiti paṃcamaḥ| asadvilakṣaṇe satyasadvilakṣaṇamiti ṣaṣṭhaḥ| sadasadātmakaṃ sadasadvilakṣaṇamiti saptamaśceti| tataśca jagataḥ kāyaparimāṇājjīvātmano dṛṣṭādṛṣṭasādhanaiścotpattisaṃbhavātkimīśvareṇa kṛtyamityayuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti prāpte parākurvatsūtramāha || || || naikasminnasaṃbhavāditi || asyārthaḥ || jainoktasaptaprakārā ekasminvastuni na yuktāḥ| kutaḥ| asaṃbhavāt aprāmāṇikatvena teṣāmekatrāsaṃbhāvitatvādityarthaḥ| saptaprakārastu sattvaṃ, asattvaṃ, sadasattvaṃ, sadvilakṣaṇatvaṃ, sattve sati sadvilakṣamatvaṃ, asattve sati asadvilakṣaṇatvaṃ, sadasattve sati sadasadvilakṣaṇamityevaṃ rūpāḥ jñātavyāḥ || evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇorgatkāraṇatvaṃ| jainamatasyāprāmāṇitvāt| saptabhaṃgijagaditi yaduktaṃ| tanna| sadasadvayātiriktaprakārasyāprāmāṇikatvāt| ekasminnasaṃbhavācca| na caikaikāṃgīkāre doṣasya vidyamānatvādaṃgākriyata iti yuktaṃ| tathātve doṣabhayena sarvamapi tyājyaṃ syāt| sadasad‌bhyāmanyabhiṃgina evāprāmāṇikatvenaikasminsaptabhaṃgitvasya sutarāmaprāmāṇikatvāt| tataśca jainamatasyānupapannatvenāvirodhādyuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-34> || evaṃ cātmākārtsnyaṃ || || yadapi jinenoktaṃ jīvasyāṇutve sarvāṃgavedanānusaṃdhānāyogād‌vyāptatve ca dehāṃtaragatasyāpyanusaṃdhānaprasaṃgāccharīraparimitatvamiti| tatra kiṃ tatsvīyasarvaśarīrāvagataceṣṭopapattyarthamupeyate| uta śarīrāvacchinnatvamaṃtareṇātmanaḥ svataḥ parimāṇābhāvādvā| tatrādyapakṣaṃ nirasituṃ pravṛttaṃ sūtramāha || || || evaṃ cātmākārtsnyamiti || asyārthaḥ || evaṃcātmanaḥ kāyaparimāṇāṃgīkṛte sati| ātmakārtsnyaṃ ātmanaḥ prāk pipīlikādehaṃ prāptasya tatkāyaparimitasya jīvasya| akārtsnyaṃ gajagardabhādiśarīraprāptāvapūrṇatā syādityarthaḥ| evaṃ gajaśarīraṃ prāptasyātmanaḥ pipīlikādehaprāptāvakārtsnyamādhikyaṃ ca syāditi draṣṭavyaṃ || evaṃcātmanaḥ kāyaparimāṇābhyupagame'pi prāptavyasarvaśarīreṣu sarvaceṣṭānupapādakatvāt| gajagardabhādiśarīrasya tatparimāṇasyātmanaḥ pipīlikādiśarīre karmavaśātprāpte sati taccharīra evātirekaḥ syāt| tathā ca śarīraparimāṇatvabhaṃgaḥ| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-35> || na ca paryāyādapyavirodho vikārādibhyaḥ || || nanu naikadehaparimāṇa evātmā kiṃtu yadā yaccharīraṃ prāpnoti tadā tatparimāṇa iti| na caivaṃ sati prāguktadoṣaprasaktiriti prāpte pariharatsūtramupanyasyati || || || na ca paryāyādapyavirodho vikārādibhya iti || asyārthaḥ || paryāyāt kramāt| krameṇa tattaddehaparimāṇatvāṃgīkārādapi| avirodhaḥ noktadoṣa iti ca na yujyate| kutaḥ| yataḥ paryāyo| na yujyate| tadapi kutaḥ| virākādibhyaḥ tathā sati tattatkālīnaparimāṇabhedena vastubhedāt| ātmano vikāritvāpatteḥ| tataścānityatvānnirmokṣatvādidoṣaprasaṃgādityarthaḥ || evaṃcātmano vikāritvenānityatvaprasaṃgāt| tathā cānirmokṣaprasaṃgaḥ| śāstravaiphalyaṃ ca| gajapipīlikādiśarīrasthasyātmanaḥ kramikatattaddehaparimāṇatvābhyupagame coktadoṣānapagamena vikāritvāpatteranityatāpātāt| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-36> || aṃtyāvasthiteścobhayanityatvādaviśeṣāt || || idānīṃ śarīrāvacchedamaṃtareṇātmanaḥ svataḥ parimāṇābhāvāttadarthaṃ kāyaparimāṇatvamaṃgīkriyata iti dvitīyapakṣaṃ nirākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || aṃtyāvasthiteścobhayanityatvādaviśeṣāditi || asyārthaḥ || pūrvasūtrādevaṃcetyanuṣajyate| aṃtyāvasthiterityetadāvartate| ca śabdo'vadhāraṇe samuccaye ca| tathā ca evaṃ sati ātmanaḥ kāyaparimāṇatveṃ'gīkṛte aṃtyāvastiteḥ prasaṃga iti śeṣaḥ| mokṣe'pi sataḥ ātmanaḥ śarīrasattvamaṃgīkāryaṃ syādityarthaḥ| kutaḥ aṃtyāvasthiteśca| aṃtyasya mauktikaparimāṇasya avasthiteḥ avaśyamaṃgīkāryaṃ syādityarthaḥ| kutaḥ aṃtyāvasthiteśca| aṃtyasya mauktikaparimāṇasya avasthiteḥ avaśyamaṃgīkāryatvāt| avacchedakaśarīraṃ vinā avacchedyaparimāṇasattvāyogāditi bhāvaḥ| parimāṇameva kuta ityato'pyāha| aṃtyeti| aṃtyasya mauktikātmasvarūpasya muktāvasthiteravaśyaṃ svarūpasattvasya parimāṇaṃ vinā'yogāditi bhāvaḥ| astu mokṣe'pi śarīraṃ tataḥ kimityata uktaṃ| ubhayanityatvāditi| tathā sati ubhayoḥ muktikālīnayordehātmanornityatvaprasaṃgādityarthaḥ| astu mauktikaśarīranityatvaṃ tataḥ kimityata āha| tataśca sarvanityatvaṃ syādityāpādyavākyamadhyāhāryaṃ| ata eva samuccayārthakaśca śabdaḥ sarveṣāmadhunātanaśarīrāṇāṃ nityatvaṃ syādityarthaḥ| kuta ityata āha| aviśeṣāditi| muktikālīnānāṃ adhunātanānāṃ ca śarīrāṇāṃ śarīratvāviśeṣādityarthaḥ| tasmānna kāyaparimāṇatvamātmano yuktamiti bhāvaḥ || evaṃca jīvasya mokṣe parimāṇābhāva cedātmasvarūpābhāvaprasaṃgaḥ| na hi parimāṇaśūnyaṃ dravyamasti| asti ceccharīramaṃtareṇa parimāṇāyogāt| tatrāpi taccharīramanityaṃ cetsaṃsārasamānadharmatāpātaḥ| nityaṃ ceccharīratvāviśeṣādidānīṃtanaśarīramapi nityaṃ syāt| ato nātmanaḥ kāyaparimāṇatvapakṣo yuktaḥ| tasmājjainamatasyānupapannatvenāvirodhakatvādyuktaṃ jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ || || iti nekasminnadhikaraṇaṃ || atra pāśupatapakṣo'pākriyate || <2-2-37> || patyurasāmaṃjasyāt || || nanu na viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ| pāśupatasamayaviruddhatvāt| paśupatiḥ khalu sārvajñyādiguṇaśālī| māyāmupādānīkṛtya harihiraṇyagarbhādijagadutpattyādi sarvaṃ karoti| śrutismṛtayaścāsminnarthe bhavaṃti| ato lakṣaṇasūtramayuktamiti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati || || || patyurasāmaṃjasyāditi || asyārthaḥ || patyuḥ paśupateḥ| jagatkāraṇatvaṃ na yuktaṃ| kutaḥ| asāmaṃjasyāt pārataṃtryotpattyādidoṣavattvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca yuktaṃ viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ| pāśupatasamayasyāpramāṇikatvāt| na paśupatirgatkartā| pārataṃtryajananamaraṇadoṣaduṣṭatvāt| na cāsiddho hetuḥ| yaṃ kāmaye taṃ tamugramiti śrutisiddhatvāt| api caiko nārāyaṇa āsīditi śrutyā pralaye paśupaterabhāvāvagamāt| tataśca pāśupatasamayasyānupapannatvenāvirodhakatvādyuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-38> || saṃbaṃdhānupapatteśca || || yuktyaṃtareṇa paśupaterjagatkāraṇatvaṃ parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || saṃbaṃdhānupapatteśceti || asyārthaḥ || śivasyāśarīratvena jagatā saṃbaṃdhānupapatte na tasya kartṛtvamityarthaḥ || evaṃca na kevalaṃ pārataṃtryādeḥ kiṃtvaśarīratvācca paśupaterjagatkartṛtvāyogāt| na hyaśarīrasya kartṛtvaṃ dṛśyate yena tasya tathā bhavet| na ca kāryeṇa jagatā'pi saṃbaṃdhamātramaśarīrasyāpi saṃbhavati gaganāderghaṭādisaṃyogavaditi vācyaṃ| tyaktadehapuruṣavatkartṛtvarūpasaṃbaṃdhābhāvāt| tataśca paśupaterjagatkartṛtvāyogena yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-39> || adhiṣṭhānānupapatteśca || || hetvaṃtareṇa paśupaterjagatkāraṇatvaṃ parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || adhiṣṭhānānupapatteśceti || asyārthaḥ || pralaye sarveṣāṃ naṣṭatvātpunaḥ sṛṣṭikāle paśupateḥ pṛthivyādyāśrayānupapatteśca na tasya jagatkartṛtvamityarthaḥ || evaṃca paśupateradhiṣṭhānānupalaṃbhena kartṛtvāyogāt| pṛthivyādyadhiṣṭhāne sthitasya kulālāderghaṭādikāryadarśanenāsya tadabhāvāt| sautrahetunā vyatirekavyāpteḥ sāmānyataḥ pṛthivyādyadhiṣṭhānadṛṣṭāṃtena darśitatvāt| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-40> || karaṇavaccenna bhogādibhyaḥ || || nanu na pralayakāle nityatayā vidyamānaṃ prakṛtyādikaṃ sākṣātprayatnādhiṣṭheyatayā śarīrādivat| na ca sākṣātprayatnādhiṣṭheya preraṇāya śarīrāpekṣā| śarīrapreraṇārthamapi śarorāṃtarāpekṣāprasaṃgāt| ataḥ śarīrādipratinidhisadbhāvātkartṛtvamupapannamiti prāpte sūtramupanyasyati || || || karaṇavaccenna bhogādibhya iti || asyārthaḥ || nanu yataḥ sādhanajātaṃ paśupateḥ kāraṇavat śarīravat| śarīreṇatulyaṃ adhiṣṭhānatulyaṃ ca ato noktadoṣa iti cenna| kutaḥ| bhogādibhyaḥ śarīrakṛtasukhaduḥkhabhogotpattimaraṇādidoṣebhya ityarthaḥ || evaṃca kārakasamūhasya śarīratulyatvena śarīropādānaparityāgābhyāṃ jananamaraṇavattadupādānaparityāgābhyāmapi jananamaraṇaprasaṃgāt| tataśca sukhaduḥkhabhogaprāpteḥ| yajñadattādeḥ sākṣātprayatnādhiṣṭheyavikārātmakaśarīropādānahānayoḥ satostīnnamittayorutpattivināśayordarśanāt| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-41> || aṃtavattvamasarvajñatā vā || || saṃbaṃdhānupapatteḥ, karaṇavacca, ityābhyāmuktaśarīrabhāvābhāvapakṣāveva vikalpabhaṃgya doṣāṃtareṇa dūṣayatsūtraṃ paṭhitvā vyācaṣṭe || || || aṃtavattvamasarvajñatāveti || asyārthaḥ || yataḥ śivasya dehitvatadabhāvapakṣayoḥ krameṇāṃtavattvaṃ nāśavattvaṃ asarvajñatā na sarvajñatvaṃ syāt ato na tadyuktamityarthaḥ || evaṃca paśupaterjagatkartṛtvāṃgīkāre tasya śarīravattvapakṣe vināśaprasaṃgaḥ tadabhāve tu jñānābhāvaḥ| na caite doṣā viṣṇupakṣe'pi buddhimānmanovānityādiśrutyā jñānābhāvasya parihṛtatvāt| yadātmako bhagavānityādināṃ'tavattvādidoṣāṇāṃ nirastatvāt| tatra bhagavaddehasya tatsvarūpatvajñānādyātmakatvenoktatvāt| anayaiva diśā śāktaiyasauraskāṃdagāṇapatyānāṃ samayā nirākṛtā veditavyāḥ| ataḥ pāśupatasamayasyānupapannatvenāvirodhakatvādyuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || || iti patyuradhikaraṇaṃ || atra śaktipakṣo dūṣyate| <2-2-42> || utpattyasaṃbhavāt || || nanu na viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ| śākteyamataviruddhatvāt| śaktireva khalu sārvajñyādiguṇaśālinī| sakalajagajjananī| śrutismṛtītihāsapurāṇeṣu paṭhyate| ato harerna lakṣaṇasūtraṃ yuktamiti prāpte sūtramupanyasyati || || || utpattyasaṃbhavāditi || asyārthaḥ || na śaktirjagatkāraṇaṃ| kutaḥ| utpattyasaṃbhavāt śaktiśabditakevalastrībhyaḥ apatyotpattyayogādityarthaḥ || evaṃca mahāvāmānāṃ mate yaducyate śaktireva puruṣānanugṛhītajagatkāraṇamiti na tadyuktaṃ| śaktireva puruṣānanugṛhītā jagatkāraṇamityasyārthasya pramāṇādṛṣṭatvāt| kevalāyāstasyā jagatkartṛtvāsaṃbhavāt| parodāhṛtānāmajāmekāmityādipramāṇānāṃ tvīśvarādhīnatayaiva jagatkāraṇatvābhidhāyitvenātatparatvāt| tataśca mahāvāmānāṃ matamaprāmāṇamiti yukta jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-43> || na ca kartuḥ karaṇaṃ || || nanu sārvajñyādiguṇāvidhuraḥ sadāśivaḥ śaktyanugrāhako'sti| tadanugṛhītāyāḥ śakteḥ jagatkāraṇatve'jāmekāmityādiśruteḥ pramāṇatvāt| sadāśivānugṛhītaśakteḥ jagatkāraṇatvamiti vadatāṃ madhyamavāmānāṃ mataṃ nirākurvatsūtramunyasyati || || || na ca kartuḥ karaṇamiti || asyārthaḥ || yataḥ kartuḥ śaktyanugrāhakaśivasya ca kāraṇaṃ jñānādisādhanaṃ| na| ato na tasya śaktyanugrāhakatvamityarthaḥ || evaṃca sadāśivasya sārvajñyādivaidhuryeṇānugrāhakatvāyogāt| utpattyupayogijñānādestatsādhaneṃdriyādestatkāraṇaśarīrasya cābhāvenāta eva puruṣānugṛhītaśakterapi jagadutpattyasaṃbhavāt| ato madhyamavāmānāṃ matasyāprāmāṇikatvena yuktaṃ jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-44> || vijñānādibhāve vā tadapratiṣedhaḥ || || nanu śaktyanugrāhakapuruṣābhāvācchakterjagadutpattiryuktetyeva nocyate| kiṃtu tasya puṃsaḥ sārvajñyāderapi sadbhāvena yuktatarā śarterjagadutpattiritītyaṃgīkurvatāmaṇuvāmānāṃ matanirāsāya sūtramupanyasyati || || || vijñānādibhāve vā tadapratiṣedha iti || asyārthaḥ || vijñānādibhāve vā śivasya jñānecchādisatveṃ'gīkṛte ca| tadapratiṣedhaḥ| tasya śaivapakṣasya apratiṣedhaḥ anirāsaḥ anumitiḥ kṛtā syāt| sa ca dūṣita evetyarthaḥ || evaṃca yadi śaktyanugrahakartṛjagadutpattyupayogivijñānaśarīroṃdriyasattvamaṃgīkriyate tata eva śaktyanugrahakartuḥ śivādeḥ kartraṃtaramanapekṣyaiva jagadutpattyādisaṃbhavāt tadā śaktimatasya pāśupatamataikyena tasya ca nirastatvāt punarnirasane kāraṇābhāvāt| ato'ṇuvāmānāṃ matamapramāṇamiti jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-45> || vipratiṣedhācca || || evaṃ śākteyamatatrayaṃ pṛthaṅ‌nirākṛtya samuditadūṣaṇenāpi parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || vipratiṣedhācceti || asyārthaḥ || sakalaśrutismṛtivuruddhatvācca śākteyamatamasamaṃjasaṃ ayuktamityarthaḥ || evaṃca narte| eko nārāyaṇa | ityādiśrutīnāṃ| sa eva | ityādi smṛtīnāṃ| pūrvoktahetūnāṃ ca virodhena śiṣṭajanairjugupsitatvāt| sarvamapi śākteyamatamayuktameveti yuktaṃ viṣṇorjagajjanmādikāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ || || iti utpattyādhikaraṇaṃ || || iti dvitīyādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ || || śrīḥ || || hariḥ || || atha dvitīyādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ || itareṣāṃ cānupalabdheriti naye sāmānyato nirākṛtasamayānāṃ viśeṣato nirākaraṇaṃ kriyate'sminpāde || atrācetanapravṛttimataṃ nirākriyate| <2-2-1> || racanānupapatteśca nānumānaṃ || || nanu na viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ| sāṃkhyasamaye mahadādikaṃ svasadṛśakāraṇajanyaṃ| kāryatvāt| ghaṭavadityanumānena prakṛteḥ kāraṇatvaṃ prasādhya tasyā ananyādhīnatayā kāryonmukhatvābhidhānāt| ataḥ prakṛterevānanyādhīnatayā'śeṣakāryonmukhatvena neśvarakartṛtvaṃ cāstīti na jagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktamiti prāpte parākurvatsūtramāha| || || racanānupapatteśca nānumānamiti || asyārthaḥ || anumīyata ityanumānaṃ| sāṃkhyānumānakalpitaṃ| pradhānaṃ na jagatkartṛ| kutaḥ racanānupapatteḥ| pradhānasya jaḍatvena svataḥ pravṛttyanupapatteḥ| acetanasya svataḥ pravṛtau pramāṇābhāvāccetyarthaḥ || evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇoḥ jagatkartṛtvaṃ| kāryaṃ svasadṛśakāraṇavadityanumānena kāraṇatayā parikalpitasya pradhānasyācetanatvena svataḥ kāryonmukhatvāyogāt| pradhānasya svataḥ pravṛttyabhāve'cetanatvākhyahetusūcanādasiddheḥ parihṛtatvāt| tadviruddhopapattereva tadabhāvasādhakatvāt| prāguktānumānasya kāraṇatvamātrasādhakatvena svataḥ kāryonmukhatvāsādhakatvāt| pramāṇāṃtarasya cābhāvāt| ato nirīśvarasāṃkhyamatasyāprāmāṇikatvena tadvirodhābhāvādyuktaṃ janmādikāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-2> || pravṛtteśca || || evaṃ pradhānasya svataḥ pravṛttikartṛtve'cetanatvasvataḥpravṛttiśūnyatvapramāṇābhāvairnirākṛtya yuktyaṃtareṇāpi tannirākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || pravṛtteśceti || asyārthaḥ || ahaṃ karomīti cetanasyaiva pravṛtterdarśanācca na pradhānaṃ jagatkartṛ ityarthaḥ || evaṃca kulālāderghaṭādisṛṣṭau vyāpārasyāhaṃ karomītyanabhavasiddhatvāt| kiṃca paṭādisṛṣṭeścetanecchānusāritvadarśanena mahadādisṛṣṭerapi tathā'bhyupagaṃtavyatvāt| mahadādisṛṣṭiścetanecchānusāriṇī sṛṣṭitvāddhaṭasṛṣṭivaditi mānāṃtaravirodhāt| cetanasya pravṛttiḥ kriyā| sā ca kṛtiṃ vinā nopapannā| sā ca necchāṃ vinā| sā ca na jñānaṃ vineti pravṛttyādikāryāṇāṃ svasvakāraṇāvinā bhūtatvena pravṛttyā icchāpūrvakatvasādhanasaṃbhavāt| ato jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-3> || payoṃ'buvaccettatrāpi || || nanvacetanayorapi payoṃ'bunoḥ svataḥ pravṛttirddṛśyate| atastatraivācetatvahetorvyabhicārāt| acetanasya svataḥ pravṛttau ca sa eva dṛṣṭāṃto bhaviṣyatīti prāpte parākurvatsūtramāha || || || payoṃ'buvaccettatrāpīti || asyārthaḥ || api śabdaścetanapravṛttyākarṣaṇārthaḥ| payoṃ'buvat yathā'cetanayoḥ payoṃ'bunoḥ pravṛttirdṛṣṭā tathā pradhānasyāpyastviti cenna| kutaḥ| yataḥ| tatrāpi payoṃ'bvādāvapi aṃtataḥ īśvarādeva pravṛttiḥ| na svataḥ pravṛttirityarthaḥ || evaṃcaitasya vā'kṣarasya praśāsana iti śrutyā tatrāpīśvaranimittapravṛttisadbhāvāvagamāt tathā ca pūrvavādyuktapratyanumānadṛṣṭāṃte payoṃ'bvādau siddhāṃtyabhimatasādhyasyaiva satvānna tadanumānasya satpratipakṣatā na vā vyabhicāraḥ| ato janmādikāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-4> || vyatirekānavasthiteścānapekṣatvāt || || nanu śrutisāmarthyena payoṃ'bunoḥ pravṛtterīśvaradhīnatayā tatra vyabhicārābhāve'pyayaskāṃtaśilādirūpācetanāṃtasya pravṛttau siddhāyāṃ bhaviṣyati tatra vyabhicāraḥ| setsyati ca pradhānasya svataḥ pravṛttau sādhyāyāmayaskāṃtādikmeva nidarśanaṃ| udāharaṇaniyamasyānāśrayaṇīyatvādityāśaṃkāmapākurvatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || || vyatirekānavasthiteścānapekṣatvāditi || asyārthaḥ || vyatirekānavasthiteḥ na ṛta iti śrutyā īśvaravyatirekeṇa kasyāpi karmaṇaḥ asattvāvagamāt| tata evācetanasyaiva svataḥ pravṛttiriti nirīśvarasāṃkhyamatasyāprāmāṇikatvāt| ataḥ evānapekṣatvātsadbhiranādaraṇīyatvānna tadvirodho viṣṇukartṛtvasyetyarthaḥ || evaṃca na ṛte tvatkriyata iti śrutyā sarvasyāpīśvarādhīnatvāvagamāt| īśvaravyatirekeṇa taṃ vinā kasyāpi karmaṇo'navasthitiśruteracetanatvahetoḥ kutrāpi vyabhicārābhāvāt| pūrvavādyuktānumāne dṛṣṭāṃtālābhāt| sāṃkhyaparikalpitānumānasyāprāmāṇikatvena pramāṇaviruddhatvena ca mahājanaparigṛhītatvābhāvānnānumānaparikalpitaṃ pradhānaṃ jagatkartṛ| ato nirīśvarasāṃkhyamatasyāprāmāṇikatvena tadvirodhābhāvādyuktaṃ jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ || || iti racanānupapattyādhikaraṇaṃ || <2-2-5> || anyatrābhāvācca na tṛṇādivat || || nanu neśvarasya svātaṃtryeṇa kartṛtvaṃ yuktaṃ| parameśvarānugṛhītapradhānādeva| parjanyānugṛhīta pṛthivyā aṃkurotpattivajjagadutpattisaṃbhavāt| ato neśvarasya svātaṃtryeṇa jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || || anyatrābhāvācca na tṛṇādivaditi || asyārthaḥ || tṛṇādivat yathā pṛthivījanyatṛṇādikārye parjanyaṃ sahakārimātraṃ tathā prakṛtijanyamahadādikārye'pīśvaraḥ anugrāhakaḥ| na svataṃtra iti seśvarasāṃkhyapakṣo'pi na| kutaḥ| anyatrābhāvāt| īśvarādanyatra tatpreraṇāṃ vinā jagato'bhāvādīśvarasya prakṛtisattādipradatvāccetyerthaḥ || evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ| svātaṃtryeṇa tatpreraṇāmaṃtareṇa kasyāpi vastuno'bhāvāt| mūlakāraṇabhūtāyāḥ prakṛterapi tadadhīnasattākatvācca| ataḥ seśvarasāṃkhyamatasyāprāmāṇikatvenāvirodhakatvādyuktaṃ jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ || || iti anyatrābhāvādhikaraṇaṃ || atra lokāyatikapakṣo nirākriyate| <2-2-6> || abhyupagame'pyarthābhāvāt || || nanu neśvarasya svātaṃtryeṇa kartṛtvaṃ yuktaṃ| aṃtareṇāpīśvaraṃ pūrvasmātpūrvasmāduttarottarotpattisaṃbhavāt| caitanyotpatterapi madirotpattivatsvabhāvadevopapatteḥ| na ca śrutyādibādhaḥ| tasyā apramāṇyāt| na ca tasyā aprāmāṇye dharmādyasiddhiprasaṃgaḥ| atīṃdriyavastuno'bhāveneṣṭatvāt| ata iśvarābhāvānneśvarasya jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati| || || abhyupagame'pyarthābhāvāditi || asyārthaḥ || netyanuvartate| anabhyupagame'pi cārvākaiḥ svaśāstrasya siddhāṃtatvānabhyupagame siddhamasmadiṣṭaṃ| abhyupagame'pi arthābhāvāt| siddhāṃtatvavyāpakayoḥ arthaśabditaviṣayaprayojanayoḥ asattvāṃgīkārāt svavyāghātaḥ syāditi na tatpakṣo'pi yukta ityarthaḥ || evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ| cārvākasamayasya viṣayaprayojanādiśūnyatvenāpramāṇatvena virodhābhāvāt| tathāhi| na tāvattatsamayasyātīṃdriyo viṣayaḥ| tadabhāvāt| nāpyaiṃdriyakaṃ| tasya pratyakṣasiddhatvena śāstrānapekṣaṇāt| nāpi svargāpavargādi śrotṛphalaṃ| tadalābhāt| nāpi dṛṣṭaṃ dhanādi| tasya kṛṣyādilaghūpāyasādhyatvāt| nāpi praṇetuḥ prayojanaṃ| na ca dharmādyabhāvapratipādanadvārā lokopakāraḥ prayojanamiti vācyaṃ| dharmādyabhāvajñāne parasparahiṃsādinā'pakārasyaiva prāpteḥ| nāpyupakāraḥ svataḥ prayojanaṃ| sukhaduḥkhāvāptihānirūpatvābhāvāt| na vā tenāpi kiṃcitsādhyaṃ prayojanaṃ| evaṃ vidhe'dhikārī dūrotsāritaḥ| tadabhāvādeva saṃbaṃdho'pi ataścārvākasamayasyāprāmāṇikatvādyuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || || iti abhyupagamādhikaraṇaṃ || || adhikaraṇaṃ || atra puruṣopasarjanaprakṛtikartṛvādo nirākriyate| <2-2-7> || puruṣāśmavaditi cettatrāpi || || nanu na harerjagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ| cetanopasarjanaśarīrasyāśmānayanādikartṛtvadarśanena puruṣopasarjanapradhānenaiva jagadutpattisaṃbhavāt| pradhānaṃ cetanasaṃnidhānātsvataḥ pravṛttimat acetanatvāt śarīravaditi mānasadbhāvāt| ata īśvarasyaivābhāvājjagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ tasyaivetyetad‌dūrotsāritamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || || puruṣāśmavaditi cettatrāpīti || asyārthaḥ || puruṣāśmavat yathā puruṣasaṃbaṃdhādacetanaṃ śarīraṃ aśmānayanādau pravartate tathā'cetanaprakṛtiḥ cetanasaṃbaṃdhātpravartata iti cenna| kutaḥ| yataḥ tatrāpi śarīrapravṛttāvapi cetanasya īśvarasyaiva kartṛtvena dṛṣṭāṃtābhāvaḥ ata ityarthaḥ || evaṃca yuktameva harerjagatkāraṇatvaṃ| puruṣopasarjanaprakṛterjagatkāraṇatvasādhane dṛṣṭāṃtābhāvāt| na ca śarīrameva dṛṣṭāṃta iti vācyaṃ| na ṛte tvatkriyata iti śrutyā śarīrapravṛttāvapi paramātmādhīnatvena dṛṣṭāṃtasya sādhyavikalatvāt| tataśca matāṃtaravirodhābhāvena yuktaṃ jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-8> || aṃgitvānupapatteḥ || || evaṃ śrutilakṣaṇahetunā dṛṣṭāṃte sādhyavaikalyamabhidhāya hetvaṃtareṇa dṛṣṭāṃte sādhyavaikalyopapādanāya sūtramupanyasyati || || || aṃgitvānupapatteriti || asyārthaḥ || puruṣāsyāṃgatveṃ'gīkṛte sati aṃgamaṃgīti vākye aṃgitvasya prādhānyasya ukttyanupapatteḥ| na puruṣopasarjanaprakṛtikartṛtvapakṣe dṛṣṭāṃto'stītyarthaḥ || evaṃca yadi puruṣopasarjanaṃ śarīrameva kartṛ syāttarhi puruṣom̐'gī śarīramaṃgamiti prāmāṇikalaukikavyavahāro na syāt| asti cāsau| ato nāyaṃ dṛṣṭāṃtaḥ| tasmātpuruṣasaṃvalitaśarīrasyaiva svataḥ pravṛttāvucyamānāyāṃ puruṣasyāṃgatvāpradhānatvāvaśyaṃ bhāvādaṃgamiti smṛtau puruṣasyāṃgitvavyavahāraḥ śarīraṃ prati prādhānyavyavahāropadeśo'nupapannaḥ syāt| evaṃ dārṣṭāṃtike'pi puruṣasya pradhānāṃgatvāpattyāṃ'gitvavyavahārānupapattiḥ| tathā ca dṛṣṭāṃtābhāvo bādhaśca darśite| ato matāṃtaravirodhābhāvena yuktaṃ jagatkāratṇavalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ || || iti puruṣāśmādhikaraṇaṃ || atra prakṛtyupasarjanapuruṣakṛrtṛvādo nirākriyeta| <2-2-9> || anyathā'numitau ca jñaśaktiviyogāt || || nanu na harerjagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ| pradhānopasarjanapuruṣādeva jagadutpattisaṃbhaveneśvaravaiyarthyāt| tathā ca prayogaḥ| vimatā pravṛttiḥ acetanopasarjanapuruṣādhīnā pravṛttitvāt aśmānayanādipravṛttivaditi| ato na jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || || anyathā'numitau ca jñaśaktiviyogāditi || asyārthaḥ || śabdenāṃgitvānupapatterityasya samākarṣaḥ| yathā prācīnapakṣānyaprakāreṇa prakṛtyupasarjanapuruṣakartṛtvasyānumitau sādhane'pi| jñaśaktiviyogāt| jñasya jīvasya śarīrasaṃbaṃdhārthaṃ pravṛttiśaktiviyogāt āṃgitvānupapatterevetyarthaḥ || evaṃca yuktameveśvarasya jagatkāraṇatvaṃ| prakṛtyupasarjanapuruṣasya kartṛtve mānābhāvāt| atha mataṃ| prācīnamatādanyathā'numitamiti| tathā sati dṛṣṭāṃte sādhyābhāvāt| kevalasya pravṛttiśakteraṃgīkāre śarīravaiyarbhyaṃ| noceccharīrasaṃbaṃdhābhāvaprasaṃgenāśmānayanādipravṛttirna syāt| asti cāsau| ataḥ puruṣasya śarīrasaṃbaṃdhaghaṭako'śmānayanādiśaktiprada īśvaroṃ'gīkārya iti kathaṃ na dṛṣṭāṃtaḥ sādhyavikalaḥ| ato jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-10> || vipratiṣedhāccāsamaṃjasaṃ || || evaṃ pratyekaṃ dūṣitānyanīśvaramatāni sāmānyadūṣaṇenāpi nirākurvatsūtra paṭhati || || || vipratiṣedhāccāsamaṃjasamiti || asyārthaḥ || vipratiṣedhāt sakalaśrutismṛtiyuktiviruddhatvādanīśvaramataṃ asamaṃjasaṃ ayuktamityarthaḥ || evaṃca dyāvābhūmī janayan | yato vā | ya sarvajña ityādiśrutīnāṃ utpattisthitisaṃhārāḥ| sraṣṭā pātā tathaivāttā| ityādi smṛtīnāṃ| vimataṃ sakartṛkaṃ kāryatvāt| ciccaittye kenacinniyete'svataṃtratvāt| ityādiyuktīnāṃ ca virodhena prakṛtisvātaṃtryādirūpamarthaṃ vadato'nyonīco nāstīti vacanāt| tataśca sakalaśrutismṛtiyuktiviruddhatvātsarvamapyanīśvaramatamapramāṇaṃ| ato na sāṃkhyādimatavirodhena na lakṣaṇāsaṃbhava iti siddhaṃ || || iti anyathā'numityadhikaraṇaṃ || atra paramāṇvāraṃbhavādo'pākriyate| <2-2-11> || mahaddīrghavadvā hrasvaparimaṃḍalābhyāṃ || || nanu dravyādipadārthāḥ saptaiva| tatra dravyāṇi pṛthivyādinavaiva| guṇāstu rūpādicaturviṃśatireva| karma cotkṣepaṇādipaṃcavidhaṃ| sāmānyamanekavidhaṃ| jātirūpamupādhirūpaṃ ca samavāyastveka eva| viśeṣāstvanaṃtāḥ| etattritayaṃ nityameva| tatrānityaṃ kāraṇatritayajanyaṃ| yatsamavetaṃ kāryamutpadyate tatsamavāyikāraṇaṃ| paramāṇvādidravyameva| tatra paramāṇavo dvyaṇukādikrameṇāvayavinamārabhaṃte| samavāyikāraṇapratyāsannamavadhṛtasāmarthyasamavāyikāraṇaṃ| tatra kāryadravyasyāvayavasaṃyoga eva kāryaikārthapratyāsattyā'samavāyikāraṇaṃ bhavati| kāraṇaguṇakarma ca kāryaguṇānāṃ kāryaikārthapratyāsattyā'samavāyikāraṇaṃ| karmaṇaśca kāraṇagataguṇakarmaṇi kāryaikārthapratyāsattyā'samavāyikāraṇaṃ| tatra parimāṇaṃ kāraṇagataṃ| kāryagataparimāṇasthāsamavayikāraṇaṃ bhavati| paramāṇud‌vyaṇukatūlagataṃ parimāṇaṃ na d‌vyaṇukatryaṇukatūlapiṃḍagatāḥ parimāṇāḥ asamavāyakāraṇaṃ| kiṃtu d‌vyaṇukatryaṇukagatasaṃkhyayaiva| tūlapiṃḍaparimāṇaṃ tu pracayena bhavati| etadanyatkāraṇaṃ nimittaṃ| īśvarādṛṣṭakālādi| tatreśvara ātmaviśeṣaḥ| ātmā ca saṃkhyādicaturdaśaguṇayuktaḥ| parameśvarastu saṃkhyādipaṃcaguṇakaḥ| kartṛtvopayogijñānecchā prayatnaśālī ca śiṣṭaṣaḍ‌guṇāyogya iti kathaṃ tasyānaṃtaguṇakttvaṃ yuktaṃ| ato vyartha eva pūrvādhyāya iti prāpte sūtritaṃ| || || mahaddīrghavadvā hrasvaparimaṃḍalābhyāmiti || asyārthaḥ || mahaddīrghavat vaiśeṣikamate tryaṇukādigatānmahattvāt dīrghatvācca caturaṇukādigataparimāṇamutpadyate| tathā hrasvaparimaṃḍalābhyāmapi dvyaṇukaparamāṇūbhayagata hrasvattvapārimāṃḍilyaparimāṇābhyāmapi tryaṇukadvyaṇukagataparimāṇotpattiḥ syādityarthaḥ || anyathā mahattvadīrghatvābhyāmapi kāryotpattirna syāditi vā śabdārthaḥ| tasmādvaiśeṣikamatamanupapannamiti bhāvaḥ || evaṃca yuktameva hareranaṃtaguṇaparipūrṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ| vaiśeṣikādīnāmanupapannabhāṣitvena tatsamayasyāprāmāṇikatvāt| yaccoktaṃ| hrasvāṇuparimāṇayornāsamavāyikāraṇatvamiti| tanna| tathāsati mahattvadīrghatvayorapi tadabhāvāpātāt| mahaddīrghaparimāṇayoḥ kāraṇatve'nayorapi tatsāmyāt| aviśeṣāt| tasmādutpattiviruddhatvānna tayorasamavāyikāraṇatvaṃ| kiṃtvetayoreveti vaiśeṣikādyuktamasamaṃjasasameveti na tadvirodha īśvarānaṃtaguṇatvasyeti yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-12> || ubhayathā'pi na karmātastadabhāvaḥ || || evaṃ vaiśeṣikādimate mahattvadīrghatvāderasamavāyikāraṇatvakhaṃḍanarītyāsamavāyikāraṇamātraṃ nirastaṃ bhavatītyamipretya nimittakāraṇamapyevaṃ nirākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || ubhayathā'pi na karmātastadabhāva iti || asyārthaḥ || ubhayathā'pi īśvarecchayā nityatvānityavarūpapakṣadvaye'pi| na paramāṇuṣu kriyotpattisaṃbhavaḥ| atastadabhāvaḥ tasmindvyaṇukādikāryābhāvaḥ syādityarthaḥ || evaṃceśvarecchā nimittakāraṇamiti cet| sā kiṃ nityā'nityā vā| ubhayathā'pi na paramāṇukarma saṃbhavati| yadīśvarecchā nityā tarhi pralaye satyāmapi tasyāṃ paramāṇuceṣṭābhāvenā'nyadā'pi tadabhāvaḥ| athānityā tatkāraṇābhāveneśvarecchānutpattyā paramāṇukarmābhāvaḥ| na ca vācyaṃ pūrvakalpīyecchā'nityā'pi yāgavannimittamiti| pramāṇābhāvāt| atha neśvarecchā kāraṇaṃ tadevāstu| tarhyanyatrāpi kāraṇaṃ na syāt| sa eva paramate paramāṇukarmābhāvena saṃyogābhāvād‌vyaṇukādikāryābhāvaḥ| vaidikeśvarapakṣe tu satyāmapīśvarecchāyāṃ sarvaṃ kāryānutpādikamīśvarāciṃtyaśaktita evopapadyate| na ca parapakṣe samametat| tasyānumānagamyeśvaratvena vedaikagamyeśvaratvābhāvāt| ato vaiśeṣikādyuktasyāsāmaṃjasyena yuktaṃ hareranaṃtaguṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-13> || samavāyābhyupagamācca sāmyādanavasthiteḥ || || evaṃ vaiśeṣikādipakṣe nimittakāraṇāsaṃbhavaṃ darśayitvā samavāyikāraṇamapi nirākurvatsūtramāha || || || samavāyābhyupagamācca sāmyādanavasthiteriti || asyārthaḥ || vaiśeṣikaiḥ avayavāvayavyādīnāṃ bhinnatvanimittena samavāyābhyupagamāt samavāyasaṃbaṃdhāṃgīkārāt| sāmyāt samavāyyasamavāyinorapi bhinnatvasāmyāt| tatrāpi samavāyābhyupagame anavasthiteḥ| anavasthānācca tanmatamayuktamityarthaḥ || evaṃca yadapi paramāṇvādidravyaṃ samavāyikāraṇamiti| tanna| avayavāvayavinorbhinnatvamaṃgīkṛtya viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvopapattaye samavāyābhyupagamāt| samavāyasyāpi bhinnatvasāmyena mṛddhaṭasamavāya ityādiviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvopapattaye samavāyāṃtarāpekṣā syāt| tatrāpyevamityanavasthānāt| mūlabhūtāvāyavāvayavyādisaṃbaṃdhasyaivāsidhyā tadasiddhiḥ| teṣāṃ prathamasaṃbaṃdhasidhyarthamabhyupagaṃtavyānāṃ saṃbaṃdhāṃtarāṇāṃ sutarāmasiddheḥ| samavāyasya svanirvāhakatve svasminsvayameva viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvabuddhijanakatveṃ'gīkṛte samavāyāsiddheḥ| guṇaguṇyādibhedaṃ tatsamavāyaṃ cāṃgīkṛtya tatsvanirvāhakatvakalpanāpekṣayā lāghavena guṇaguṇyāderabhedamaṃgīkṛtyaikasya dravyasyaiva svanirvāhakatvopapattau samavāyavaiyarthyāt| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-14> || nityameva ca bhāvāt || || evaṃ paramate kāraṇatrayanirāsena sṛṣṭiṃ nirasya pralayanirāsārthaṃ pravṛttaṃ sūtramupanyasyati || || || nityameva ca bhāvāditi || asyārthaḥ || doṣasamuccaye caḥ| īśecchāparamāṇvādikāraṇānāṃ sadātvāt| vaiśeṣikamate nityameva sarvadaiva| bhāvāt kāryotpattiḥ syāt| na tu kadācidityarthaḥ || evaṃca paramate layāsaṃbhavaḥ| samavāyikāraṇāsamavāyikāraṇanimittakāraṇānāṃ sadbhāvena kāryānutpāde kāraṇābhāvāt| samavāyikāraṇaparamāṇūnāṃ sadātanatve samavāyasyaiva janitvāṃgīkāre sarvaṃ kāryaṃ nityaṃ janimadeva syāt| samavāyikāraṇādisatve kāyotpattyuparame kadā'pi tasmātkāryotpattirna syāt| sati puṣkalakāraṇe kāryānutpāde tasya tatkāraṇatvāyogāt| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-15> || rūpādimattvācca viparyayo darśanāt || || evaṃ paramāṇūnāṃ nityatvamubhyupetya tadāraṃbhakavādo dūṣitaḥ| idānīṃ nityatvamapākurvatsūtramupanyasyāti || || || rūpādimattvācca viparyayo darśanāditi || asyārthaḥ || kiṃca vaiśeṣikamate pārthivāpyataijasaparamāṇūnāṃ rūpādimattvāt| viparyayaḥ nityatvaviparītānityatvaṃ syāt| kutaḥ| darśanāt yadrūpādimattadanityamiti vyāpteḥ ghaṭādau dṛṣṭatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca vastutastu na paramāṇūnāṃ nityatvamupapadyate| prākṛtarūpatvenāvaśyaṃ bhāvāt| dṛśyate khalu loke yatprākṛtarūpādimattadanityamiti| pārthivāpyataijasaparamāṇūnāṃ bhautikarūparasagaṃdhasparśavattvādanityatvaṃ| tataśca paramāṇūnāṃ nityatvābhāvenoktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-16> || ubhayathā ca doṣāt || || nanu yadrūpādimattadanityamiti sāmānyavyāptiḥ| yanniravayavaṃ dravyaṃ tannityamiti viśeṣavyāptirbalavatī| atastayā bādhitatvena rūpādimattvaṃ paramāṇūnāmanityatvaṃ na sādhayet| astu vā paramāṇūnāṃ sāditvaṃ| tathā'pi na dvyaṇukādikāryābhāvaḥ| pāramāṇūnāṃ kāraṇāṃtareṇotpattau tebhyo d‌vyaṇukādyutpattisaṃbhavāditi prāpte parākurvatsūtramāha || || || ubhayathāca doṣāditi || asyārthaḥ || vaiśeṣika ubhayathā ca maramāṇunityatvānityatvarūpapakṣadvaye'pi| doṣāt tadvatsarvanityatvakāraṇābhāvanimittakatadutpattibhāvasya doṣasattvāt na tatpakṣo yukta ityarthaḥ || evaṃca yaduktaṃ| yadrūpādimattadanityamiti sāmānyavyāptiriti| tanna| rūpādimatyanityatvāpavādakasya viśeṣapramāṇasyābhāvāt| na ca niravayavatvaṃ viśeṣapramāṇaṃ| rūpādimattvena paramāṇau tadabhāvasyāpi sādhayituṃ śakyatvāt| yadapyanityatve doṣābhāva iti| tanna| tvanmate paramāṇūnāṃ kāraṇāsaṃbhavenānutpattau d‌vyaṇukādikāryānutpattiprasaṃgalakṣaṇabādhakasadbhāvāt| evaṃ pakṣadvaye'pi doṣaduṣṭatvena yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-17> || || aparigrahāccātyaṃtamanapekṣā || || evaṃ prapaṃcena dūṣitaṃ paramāṇvāraṃbhavādamaprāmāṇikatvenāpi dūṣayatsūtramāha || || || aparigrahāccātyaṃtamanapekṣeti || asyārthaḥ || aparigrahāt vaiśeṣikamatasya śrutyādiparigrahaśūnyatvāt tadviruddhatvācca| tatrātyaṃtamanapekṣā anādaraḥ kārya ityarthaḥ || evaṃca vaiśeṣikamatasya sakalaśrutismṛtyādyaparigṛhītatvāttadviruddhatvācca| pradhānakāraṇatvavādāpekṣayā'tiśayenānādaraṇīyatvāt| ānvīkṣakīmiti mokṣadharmavacananiṃditatvācca| ataḥ paramāṇvāraṃbhavādasyānupapannatvenāvirodhādyuktaṃ pūrvādhyāyoktamīśvarasyānaṃtaguṇapūrṇatvamiti siddhaṃ || || iti vaiśeṣikādhikaraṇaṃ || atra paramāṇupuñjavādimatamapākriyate| <2-2-18> || sumudāya ubhayahetuke'pi tadaprāptiḥ || || nanu na viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ| vaibhāṣikasautrāṃtikamata viruddhatvāt| rūpavijñānavedanāsaṃjñāsaṃskārarūpeṇāvasthitaṃ khalu jagatparamārthasattadaśeṣaṃ paramāṇusamudāyātmakaṃ| natvavayavī nāma kaścidasti| paramāṇusamudāya eva ghaṭādibudhdyupapattau paramāṇuparimāṇasya tadārabdhasya vā'vayavino'bhyupagamasya vyarthatvāt| vidyamānaṃ ca sarvaṃ kṣaṇikameva| asattvasya kṣaṇikatvavyāptyabhāvāt| vyāpakābhāve vyāpyāyogāt| taccaitatkāryajātaṃ kālakarmarūpanimittenaiva bhavati| nopādānāpekṣā| tataḥ pūrva pūrva paramāṇūnāṃ vināśenopādānābhāvepyuttarottaraparamāṇūnāṃ sṛṣṭiḥ kālakarmādinaiva bhavatīti kimīśvareṇa kṛtyaṃ| naceśvare pramāṇamasti| vedāderapramāṇatvāt| ata īśvarasyaivābhāvena tasya janmādikāraṇatvamayuktamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || samudāya ubhayahetuke'pi tadaprāptiriti || asyārthaḥ || yataḥ samudāyai paramāṇusamudāye'nekatvasaṃkhyārūpe militānekaparamāṇunimittakeṃ'gīkṛte satyapi viralānekahetuke vāṃ'gīkṛte sati| tadaprāptiḥ tasya samudāyasya viralānekahetukasyāprāptiḥ anupapattiḥ| kutaḥ| anyonyāśrayādidoṣāditi śeṣaḥ| tadupapāditaṃ ṭīkāyāṃ| ataḥ paramāṇupuṃja eva ghaṭāvayavīti bauddhapakṣo'pi na kṣama ityarthaḥ || evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvābhidhānaṃ| vaibhāṣikasautrāṃtikayoranupapannabhāṣitvena tatsamayasyāprāmāṇyāt| yaduktaṃ| kālakarmādinimittena kṣaṇikaparamāṇunimittakaḥ samudāyo bhavati natvavayavī kaścidastīti| tanna| tatra kimayaṃ samudāya ekaparamāṇuhetuko vā'nekaparamāṇuhetuko veti| nādyaḥ| ekasmātsamudāya ityasya vyāhatatvāt| dvitīye'pi kiṃ militānekahetuko viralānekahetuko vā| nādyaḥ| melanasyaiva samudāyatvenātmāśrayāt| samudāyadvayasya kāryakāraṇabhāvāṃgīkāre'nyonyāśrayāt| vyaktibāhulyāṃgīkāre'navasthānāt| nottara| viralaparamāṇupravāhasya sadā sadbhāvena samudāyarūpakāryaviralātmakapralayābhāvaprasaṃgāt| ato samudāyasya prāptyabhāvena goghaṭādibuddhivedyo natvavayavī kaścidastīti pakṣasyāyuktatvena yuktaṃ jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-19> || itaretarapratyayatvāditi cennotpattimātranimittatvāt || || nanvastveva sadā samudāyotpattiḥ| tathā'pi na pralayābhāvaḥ| vittivyavahārābhāvādeva pralayopapattiriti prāpte sūtramāha || || || itaretarapratyayatvāditi cennoptatti mātranimitatvāditi || asyārthaḥ || nanu paramāṇupuṃjasya sadā sattve'pi nāsmatpakṣe pralayānupapattiḥ| kutaḥ| tadvyavahārāderitaretarapratyayatvāt| idamidaṃceti paramāṇuparasparāpekṣābuddhinimittakatvāt| tathā ca tādṛśabudhyabhāvakāle samudāyavyavahārāderasattavātpralayopapattirita cenna| kutaḥ| utpattimātranimittatvāt paramāṇūnāṃ svasamudāyotpattimātranimittatvāt| na tebhyo'pekṣābudhdyāderapyutpattiḥ saṃbhavatīti mātra śabdārthaḥ| tathā ca tannimittakavyavahārādiḥ kṣaṇikamate na kadā'pi saṃbhavatītyarthaḥ || evaṃca vittivyavahārayoḥ kadā'pyayogena sṛṣṭyabhāvaprasaṃgāt| tathāhi| ādau paramāṇūnāṃ darśanaṃtato'pekṣā tato vyavahāra iti kramaḥ| nacāsāvupapadyate| paramāṇūnāṃ kṣaṇikatvena kāryamutpādya naṣṭatvāt| na hyanyatra pradarśanamanyatrāpekṣā'nyatra vyavahāra iti saṃbhavati| atiprasaṃgāt| evaṃ puruṣe'pi viralaparamāṇujanyānāṃ militaparamāṇūnāṃ sthāyitvābhyupagame pratikṣaṇe kāryotpādaprasaṃgaḥ| tathā cālpatarakāle'pyekaikasmātparamāṇupuṃjātmakaghaṭādanekakāryotpattyākulālaśālāparipūrtiprasaṃgaḥ| ato yuktaṃ jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-20> || uttarotpāde ca pūrvanirodhāt || || evaṃ viralaparamāṇubhyo militaparamāṇūtpattimabhyupetya vyavahārādyasaṃbhavo darśitaḥ| atha visadṛśakāryotpattimapi parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || uttarotpāde ca pūrvanirodhāditi || asyārthaḥ || co'vadhāraṇe| samuccaye ca| netyanuvartate| sāmarthyāditi śeṣaḥ| tathā ca na kevalaṃ kṣaṇikamate samudāyavyavahārānupapattiḥ| kiṃtu viśeṣakāryotpattiśca na yuktā| kutaḥ| uttarotpāde ca kāraṇasya sadṛśakāryajananasāmarthyāttenakāraṇaṃ prathamaṃ svasadṛśamutpādya paścādvisadṛśakāryamutpādyatāṃ kodoṣa ityato'pyāha| uttara iti| tathā ca uttarasya svasadṛśakāryotpāde utpattau satyāmeva| pūrvanirodhāt pūrvasya kāraṇasya nāśāt punarvisadṛśakāryajanakatvāsaṃbhava ityarthaḥ || evaṃca paramate viśeṣakāryotpattyasaṃbhavaḥ| kāryasyasvasadṛkāryajanakatvasvābhāvyāt| anyathā ghaṭātpaṭotpattiprasaṃgāt| na ca svasadṛśakāryamutpādya paścādvaisādṛśyamapijanayatīti vācyaṃ| kāryotpāde tasya naṣṭatvena vaisādṛśyajananāyogāt| ato jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-21> || asati pratijñoparodho yaugapadyamanyathā || || evaṃ visadṛśakāryotpattinirāsena vyavahārādikaṃ parākṛtyedānīṃ pratikṣaṇakāryotpattimeva nirākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || asati pratijñoparodho yaugapadyamanyatheti || asyārthaḥ || kṣaṇikamate na pratikṣaṇaṃ kāryotpattiryujyate| kutaḥ| asati kāraṇe kāryamutpadyata ityaṃgīkāre| pratijñoparodhaḥ tasya tatkāryatvamiti pratijñāya siddhāṃtavyavahārasyoparodho hāniḥ syāt| anyathā kāraṇe sati kāryamutpadyata ityaṃgīkāre| yaugapadyaṃ kāraṇena saha kāraṇānāṃ ekadā'vasthā prasajjatetyarthaḥ || evaṃca pratikṣaṇaṃ kāryotpattyaṃgīkāre kimasati kāraṇe kāryamutpadyate| uta sati| ādye pratijñāhāniḥ| dvitīya prathamakṣaṇotpannānāṃ viralaparamāṇūnāṃ kāryotpattisamaye'pi bhāve kṣaṇikatvaniyamābhāvena vināśakasaṃpattiparyaṃtamavasthānaṃ syāt| tanmateca kāraṇe sati kāryaṃ bhavatyeveti niyamātpunaḥ punaḥ kāryotpattiḥ syāditi sakalakāryāṇāṃ yaugapadyaṃ syāt| tataścaikasyāṃ ghaṭikāyāṃ kulālaśālāpūrtiprasaṃgaḥ| yadvā| paramāṇūnāṃ kṣaṇikatvena yasminkṣaṇe paramāṇavastasminneva kṣaṇe kāryamiti kāryakāraṇayoḥ paurvāparyaṃ na syāt| na ca kṣaṇe pūrvāparamadhyabhāgo'sti| yena prathamabhāge paramāṇūtpattiḥ| dvitīyabhāge tu kāryajanakatvamiti syāt| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-22> || pratisaṃkhyā'pratisaṃkhyānirodhāprāptiravicchedāt || || evaṃ kṣaṇikavāde kāryotpatiṃ nirākṛtya vināśaṃ ca nirākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || pratisaṃkhyā'pratisaṃkhyānirodhāprāptiravicchedāditi || asyārthaḥ || evaṃ kṣaṇikamate pratisaṃkhyā'pratisaṃkhyānirodhāprāptiḥ pratisaṃkhyā'pratisaṃkhyānirodhayoḥ pratikṣaṇavināśasaṃtānāvināśayoḥ aprāptiḥ anupapattiḥ| kutaḥ| avicchedāt tadrītyā kāryo'tpattāvakāryāṇāṃ cāvicchinnatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca paramate vināśo na yujyate| tanmate vināśo dvividhaḥ| kāryamutpādya tadapahāya tatkṣaṇe nāśaḥ| tasyāpyevamevamiti pratikṣaṇaṃ nāśaḥ| sa eva saṃtānavināśo'pratisaṃkhyānirodha iti gīyate| saṃtānaṃ vinaiva kāraṇasya naṣṭatvāt| aparastu kāryamutpādya tena sahaiva mudgarapraharādinākṣaṇamātre nāśaḥ| sa eva saṃtānanāśaḥ pratisaṃkhyānirodha iti ca gīyate| tatrādyastāvannayujyate| kāryamutpādya tatparityāgasamaye sattvena tataśca kāryajanakatvamiti niyamātkāryamevotpādayenna naśyet| tadviyogasamaye'pyevamiti na kadāpi niḥsaṃtāno nāśaḥ| nāpi saṃtānavināśo yujyate| sato ghaṭasya hyātyaṃtiko vināśaḥ| ato'sau sattvātkāryamutpādayenna tu naśyet| evamuttaratrāpi sattvātkāryamevotpādayenna tu naśyediti sasaṃtānocchedāvasarābhāvāt| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-23> || ubhayathā ca doṣāt || || nanvathā'pi satāṃ bhāvapadārthānāṃ kṣaṇikatvaṃ niṣedbhuṃ na śakyaṃ| sattvaṃ nāmārthakriyākāritvaṃ| na ca ṇikatāmaṃtareṇa tadupapannaṃ| yadi ghaṭa ādyakṣaṇe ghaṭāṃtaramutpādya svayaṃ na naśyettarhi dvitīyādikṣaṇe ghaṭāṃtaramapi janayet| ghaṭāṃtarāṇyapi tathetyanaṃtakāryāpātaḥ| tasmādarthakriyākāritvarūpasattvasidhyai bhāvānāṃ kṣaṇikatvameṣṭevyamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || || ubhayathā ca doṣāditi || asyārthaḥ || ubhayathā kāraṇe sati kāryaṃ bhavatyeveti niyamapakṣe tadabhāvapakṣe ca| doṣasattvāt kāryakāraṇaviśeṣakāryānutpattyākhyadoṣāt| nānyatarapakṣāvalaṃbenārthāpattyā kṣaṇikapakṣo yukta ityarthaḥ || evaṃca bhāvānāṃ kṣaṇikatvāṃgīkāre tatrārthakriyākāritvaṃ sattvaṃ| tadanyathā'nupapattyā
