kṣaṇikatvamiti vadatā kāraṇe sati kāryaṃ bhavatyeveti yo niyama āśritaḥ sa kiṃ vāstavo na vā| ādye kāryakāraṇayoḥ savyetaraviṣāṇavatsamānakālīnatvena kāryakāraṇabhāvo na syāt| dvitīye prathamakṣaṇe kāryānutpādakatve nārthakriyākāritvābhāvādasattvaṃ syāt| tataḥ kadā'pi kāryotpattirna syāt| tataśca sattvānyathā'nupapattyā kalpyamānaṃ kṣaṇikatvaṃ ca na syāt| anena parapakṣa evobhayathā doṣasattvādasmatpakṣe doṣābhāvāditi maṃtavyaṃ| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ| <2-2-24> || ākāśe cāviśeṣāt || || nanu mābhūdarthāpattyā kṣaṇikatvasiddhiḥ| yatsattatkṣaṇikaṃ| yathā dīpādi| saṃtaścāmī bhāvāḥ padārthā ityanumānena setsyati| na ca vācyaṃ dṛṣṭāṃtasya sādhyavikalateti| yadviruddhadharmādhikaraṇaṃ tannānā yathā ghaṭapaṭau| tathā cāyaṃ dīpaḥ pūrvottarakṣaṇaviruddhadharmādhikaraṇaṃ viśeṣadarśanāditi prāpte sūtramāha || || || ākāśe cāviśeṣāditi || asyārthaḥ || co'pyarthe| dīpadṛṣṭāṃtena sattvahetunā jagati kṣaṇikatvasādhane ākāśadṛṣṭāṃtenākṣaṇikatvasyāpi sādhanāpātaḥ| nanu dṛṣṭāte sādhyavaikalyamityata uktaṃ| ākāśe aviśeṣāditi| kṣaṇikatvasādhakatvena paroktaparimāmaviśeṣādarśanādityarthaḥ || tathā ca satpratipakṣo'yaṃ heturiti na tena kṣaṇikatvasiddhiriti bhāvaḥ || evaṃca yatsattadakṣaṇikaṃ yathā''kāśamityakṣaṇikatvasyāpi sādhayituṃ śakyatvāt| na cākāśe sādhyābhāvaḥ| viśeṣadarśanābhāvena kṣaṇikatvasādhakābhāvāt| na ca hetvaṃtareṇa tatsiddhiḥ| paṃcamaskaṃdhātiriktatvena tatra tadanabhyupagamāt| ākāśe sattvaṃ nāstīti cet| kimidaṃ sattvaṃ yadākāśe nāsti| arthakriyākāritvaṃ cet| tvanbhate pūrvoktarītyā kasyāpyarthākriyākāritvābhāvenāsiddhiḥ| sādhanavikalatā ca nidarśanasya| atha svarūpeṇeti vidyamānatā'bhāvarūpatā vā| sāpyākāśe'styeveti vyabhicāro duṣparihāraḥ| ataḥ sattvahetoḥ svenaiva pratipakṣitatvānnānenāpi kṣaṇikatvasiddhiḥ| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-25> || anusmṛteśca || || evaṃ pratipakṣeṇa sattvānumānaṃ nirasya pramāṇabādhenāpi nirākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || anusmṛteśceti|| asyārthaḥ || tadevedamiti pratyabhijñānācca tadvirodhāt na sattvahetunā kṣaṇikatvasādhanaṃ yuktamityarthaḥ || evaṃca so'yaṃ ghaṭa iti pratijñāvirodhaḥ| tathā syāyitvasiddheḥ| na ca pratijñābhrāṃtiḥ| bādhakābhāvāt| ghaṭo'yaṃ niraṃtarottarakṣaṇavṛttidhvaṃsapratiyogī ghaṭatvāt musalāhataikakṣaṇavṛttivaṭavaditi coktarītyā parāstaṃ| kiṃca ghaṭaśabdena paramāṇūṃllakṣayitvā ghaṭatvaśabdena paramāṇutvameva hetutayā vivakṣyate| uta samudāyamaiva pakṣīkṛtya ghaṭatvameva hetutayā vivakṣyate| nādyaḥ| musalāhatasya ghaṭasya samudāyatvena paramāṇutvābhāvāt| tatra hetvabhāvena vyāptigrahaṇābāvaprasaṃgāt| na dvitīyaḥ| sata eva tvayā kṣaṇikatvasya sādhanīyatvenāvastunastatsādhanasyānupayuktatvāt| ato vaibhāṣikasaitrāṃtikamatasyānupapannatvenāvirodhakatvādyuktamīśvarasyāśeṣajagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ || || iti samudāyādhikaraṇaṃ || atra śūnyavādo nirākriyate| <2-2-26> || nāsato dṛṣṭatvāt || || nanu na viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ| śūnyasamayaviruddhatvāt| ekameva śūnyamataṃ| tatra parahitaṃ paramārthasat| tasmādevāśeṣaṃ jagadupaiti| na cāsaṃgasya tadanupapattiḥ| saṃvṛttisaṃbaṃdhena tadupapatteḥ| na ca śrutivirodhaḥ| tatprāmāṇyānabhyupagamāt| tataśca śūnyasamayaviruddhatvādayuktaṃ viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || nāsato dṛṣṭatvāditi || asyārthaḥ || asataḥ śūnyasya| na jagatkartṛtvaṃ yuktaṃ| kutaḥ| pramāṇābhāvāditi śeṣaḥ| tatkutaḥ| adṛṣṭatvāt| kvāpyasataḥ kāraṇatvādarśanāt| ata evānumānāmayorapyabhāvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ| sūnyasamayasyāprāmāṇikatvāt| śūnyameva jagatkāraṇamityatra pramāṇābhāvāt| pramāṇaṃ bhavatprayakṣaṃ vā'numānaṃ vā''gamo vā syāt| na tāvatpratyakṣaṃ| śūnyakāraṇatvasyāpratyakṣatvāt| nāpyanumānaṃ| dṛṣṭāṃtābhāvāt| ghaṭādāveva kāraṇatvadarśane'pi nāsau dṛṣṭāṃtaḥ| tasya tvanmate'sattvenāsati prativādinā kāraṇatvasyānupalabdhatvena kāraṇatvābhāvasyānumātuṃ śakyatvena sādhyavaikalyāt| āgamo'pi bauddhādyāgamo vā vedādirvā bhavet| nādyaḥ| tatprāmāṇyasya prativādino'saṃmateḥ| na dvitīyaḥ| tatprāmāṇyasya vādyasaṃpratipatteḥ| tathāvidhavedānupalaṃbhācca| ataḥ śūnyamatasyāyuktatveneśvarasya jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-27> || udāsīnānāmapi caivaṃ siddhiḥ || || nanvadṛṣṭamapi jagatkāraṇatvaṃ sūnyasyābhyupagate ko doṣaḥ| na coktamadṛṣṭatvādevāprāmāṇikatvānnāṃgīkārārhateti| nādṛṣṭatvena dṛṣṭānumānānupattāvapi sāmānyato dṛṣṭatvopapatteḥ| kāraṇasya hi kāryavadvastutvena sattve niṣiddhe kāryatvena hetunā'sata eva janma setsyatītyāśaṃkāṃ parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || udāsīnānāmapi caivaṃ siddhiriti || asyārthaḥ || evaṃ satyasataḥ kāryotpādakatveṃ'gīkṛte sati| udāsīnānāṃ heyopādeyatvabudhyaviṣayāṇāṃ gaganakusumādīnāṃ sakāśādapi sāraibhyādikāryasiddhiḥ syādityarthaḥ| anyathā śūnyādapi kāryotpattirna syāditi ca śabdārthaḥ || evaṃcāsataḥ kāraṇatve heyopādeyabuddhiviṣayatāvarjitānāṃ khapuṣpādīnāṃ saurabhyādikāryasiddhiprasaṃgāt| vyatirekyanumānasya tatrāpi kartuṃ śakyatvāt| parābhimatānumānānāṃ tarkabādhitatvāt| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-28> || nābhāva upalabdheḥ || || nanu bhavedetad‌dūṣaṇaṃ| yadi śūnyatattvātparamārthato mṛtpiṃḍāddhaṭa iva jagadutpadyeta| na caivaṃ| kiṃ nāma saṃvṛtti śabditājñānaviśeṣādasato rajatākāreṇeva śūnyasyāpi jagadākāreṇāvabhāsākhyavivartatvābhyupagamādityāśaṃkāṃ parākurvatsūtramāha || || || nābhāva upalabdheriti || asyārthaḥ || jagat abhāvaḥ asat na| kutaḥ| upalabdheḥ saditi pratīyamānatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca śūnyasya jagadākāreṇa vṛttyaṃgīkāre jagato mithyātvaprasaṃgāt| na ceṣṭāpattiḥ saditi pratīyamānatvāt| śūnyasya rajatākāreṇāvabhāsatve śuktereva rajatāropādhiṣṭhānatvasyānubhavasiddhatvena śūnyasya tadadhiṣṭhānatvābhāvāt| ato lakṣaṇasūtraṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-29> || vaidharmyācca na svapnādivat || || nanu saditi dṛśyamānasyāpi svāpnajāgratvāderajjubhujaṃgāderasattvāttadvajjagato'sattvaṃ kiṃ nasyādityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtramupanyasyati || || || vaidharmyācca na svapnādivāditi || asyārthaḥ || jagat svapnādivat svapnavastvanyāropitajāgrattvādivadapyasanna| kutaḥ| vaidharmyāt svāpnajāgrattvasya bādhyatvākhyavilakṣaṇadharmavattvāt jagati ca tadabhāvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca svapna evāyaṃ na jāgradrajjuriyaṃ na sarpa iti bādhakapratyayaviṣayatvavatprakṛte bādhakapratyayaviṣayatvābhāvena vaiṣamyāt| etena parodīritapratipakṣānumānasya bādhakapramāṇaviṣayatvarūpopādhistadabhāvarūpapratipakṣasya coktatvāt| tadevaṃ śūnyamatasyāpyayuktatvādyuktamīśvarasya jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ || || iti asadadhikaraṇaṃ || atra vijñānavādo nirākriyate| <2-2-30> || na bhāvo'nupalabdheḥ || || nanu na viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ| vijñānavādimataviruddhatvāt| nityaniraṃjanaṃ vijñānatattvameva khalu vidyamānaṃ| tanmātrametadaśeṣaṃ jagat| na tato'tiriktaṃ kiṃcidasti| ato jagadutpattāvīśvareṇa kṛtyābhāvādayuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti prāpte sūtramāha || || || na bhāvo'nupalabdheriti|| asyārthaḥ || jagat bhāvaḥ jñānātmakamapi na| anupalabdheḥ jñānajñeyayorabhedānanubhavādityarthaḥ || evaṃca yuktameva harerjagatkāraṇatvaṃ| vijñānavādisamayasyāyuktatvenāvirodhakatvāt| vijñānātiriktaṃ jagannāstītyatra vijñānatattve jagadadhyastaṃ cet| saditi pratīyamānatvenāropitatvāyogāt| vijñānatattvajagatorabheda iti cet| jagato jñānātmakatve pramāṇābhāvāt| na ca sahopalaṃbhaniyamādabhedo nīlataddhiyoriti vācyaṃ| bhedapratītivirodhāt| na ca sā bhrāṃtiḥ| bādhakābhāvāt| nīlādīnāṃ svapratītyabhedavadbhedasyāpi svapratītyabhedena yathārthatvāt tatpratīterbhramatvāyogācca| sāhityasya bhedavyāptatvena sahopalaṃbhādabheda iti pratijñāhetvorvirodhācca| nanu yatprakāśate tadvijñānaṃ yathā jñānaṃ| prakāśaṃte ca nīlādaya ityanumānena nīlādīnāṃ jñānatvasiddheriti cet| prakāśata ityanena jñānaviṣayatvāṃgīkāre māyāvādinā svavṛttivirodhena vijñāne sādhanavaikalyābhidhāne niruttaratvaprasaṃgāt| ajñāne vyabhicārācca| prakāśatvāṃgīkāre'siddheḥ| ato bauddhamatasyāprāmāṇikatvenāvirodhādyuktaṃ viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-31> || kṣaṇikatvācca || || yuktyaṃtareṇāpi jagato vijñānātmakatvaṃ parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || kṣaṇikatvācceti || asyārthaḥ || jñānasyaikakṣaṇāvasthāyitvājjagataḥ sthāyitvāttādvirodhānna tayoraikyamityarthaḥ || evaṃca jñānasya kṣaṇikatvājjagataśca sthāyitvena tayoraikyāyogāt| kṣaṇikatvasya vināśyatvasvābhāvyāt| ato jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-32> || sarvathā'nupapatteśca || || evaṃ pratyekaṃ dīṣitāni vaibhāṣikādibauddhamatāni punaḥ sāmānyadūṣaṇena parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || sarvathā'nupapatteśceti || asyārthaḥ || sarvaprakāreṇānupapatteḥ bauddharāddhāṃtasya yuktiśūnyatvāt tadviruddhatvācca na grāhyatvamityarthaḥ || evaṃca pratyakṣakṣaṇikatvakalpane pratikṣaṇamutpannavināśakalpane śūnyādvaitakalpane vijñānādvaitakalpane prakaṭane pracchādane vā narte | yacca kiṃcit brahmaṇyevadamāvirāsīt| ityādiśrutīnāṃ| sa eva bhūyaḥ| ityādismṛtīnāṃ| sūtroktayukattyādīnāṃ ca virodhitvena sarveṣāṃ vedaviddheṣiṇāṃ pakṣāṇāmanupapannatvena yuktaṃ viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvamiti siddhaṃ || || iti anupalabdhyakaraṇaṃ || atra syādvādimataṃ dūṣyate| <2-2-33> || naikasminnasaṃbhavāt || || nanu na viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ| jainamataviruddhatvāt| jaināstu saptabhaṃgiṃ jagadvadaṃti| tathāhi| sadityekaprakāraḥ| asadityaparaḥ| sadasadātmakamiti tṛtīyaḥ| sadasadvilakṣaṇamiti caturthaḥ| sattve sati sadvilakṣaṇamiti paṃcamaḥ| asadvilakṣaṇe satyasadvilakṣaṇamiti ṣaṣṭhaḥ| sadasadātmakaṃ sadasadvilakṣaṇamiti saptamaśceti| tataśca jagataḥ kāyaparimāṇājjīvātmano dṛṣṭādṛṣṭasādhanaiścotpattisaṃbhavātkimīśvareṇa kṛtyamityayuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti prāpte parākurvatsūtramāha || || || naikasminnasaṃbhavāditi || asyārthaḥ || jainoktasaptaprakārā ekasminvastuni na yuktāḥ| kutaḥ| asaṃbhavāt aprāmāṇikatvena teṣāmekatrāsaṃbhāvitatvādityarthaḥ| saptaprakārastu sattvaṃ, asattvaṃ, sadasattvaṃ, sadvilakṣaṇatvaṃ, sattve sati sadvilakṣamatvaṃ, asattve sati asadvilakṣaṇatvaṃ, sadasattve sati sadasadvilakṣaṇamityevaṃ rūpāḥ jñātavyāḥ || evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇorgatkāraṇatvaṃ| jainamatasyāprāmāṇitvāt| saptabhaṃgijagaditi yaduktaṃ| tanna| sadasadvayātiriktaprakārasyāprāmāṇikatvāt| ekasminnasaṃbhavācca| na caikaikāṃgīkāre doṣasya vidyamānatvādaṃgākriyata iti yuktaṃ| tathātve doṣabhayena sarvamapi tyājyaṃ syāt| sadasad‌bhyāmanyabhiṃgina evāprāmāṇikatvenaikasminsaptabhaṃgitvasya sutarāmaprāmāṇikatvāt| tataśca jainamatasyānupapannatvenāvirodhādyuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-34> || evaṃ cātmākārtsnyaṃ || || yadapi jinenoktaṃ jīvasyāṇutve sarvāṃgavedanānusaṃdhānāyogād‌vyāptatve ca dehāṃtaragatasyāpyanusaṃdhānaprasaṃgāccharīraparimitatvamiti| tatra kiṃ tatsvīyasarvaśarīrāvagataceṣṭopapattyarthamupeyate| uta śarīrāvacchinnatvamaṃtareṇātmanaḥ svataḥ parimāṇābhāvādvā| tatrādyapakṣaṃ nirasituṃ pravṛttaṃ sūtramāha || || || evaṃ cātmākārtsnyamiti || asyārthaḥ || evaṃcātmanaḥ kāyaparimāṇāṃgīkṛte sati| ātmakārtsnyaṃ ātmanaḥ prāk pipīlikādehaṃ prāptasya tatkāyaparimitasya jīvasya| akārtsnyaṃ gajagardabhādiśarīraprāptāvapūrṇatā syādityarthaḥ| evaṃ gajaśarīraṃ prāptasyātmanaḥ pipīlikādehaprāptāvakārtsnyamādhikyaṃ ca syāditi draṣṭavyaṃ || evaṃcātmanaḥ kāyaparimāṇābhyupagame'pi prāptavyasarvaśarīreṣu sarvaceṣṭānupapādakatvāt| gajagardabhādiśarīrasya tatparimāṇasyātmanaḥ pipīlikādiśarīre karmavaśātprāpte sati taccharīra evātirekaḥ syāt| tathā ca śarīraparimāṇatvabhaṃgaḥ| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-35> || na ca paryāyādapyavirodho vikārādibhyaḥ || || nanu naikadehaparimāṇa evātmā kiṃtu yadā yaccharīraṃ prāpnoti tadā tatparimāṇa iti| na caivaṃ sati prāguktadoṣaprasaktiriti prāpte pariharatsūtramupanyasyati || || || na ca paryāyādapyavirodho vikārādibhya iti || asyārthaḥ || paryāyāt kramāt| krameṇa tattaddehaparimāṇatvāṃgīkārādapi| avirodhaḥ noktadoṣa iti ca na yujyate| kutaḥ| yataḥ paryāyo| na yujyate| tadapi kutaḥ| virākādibhyaḥ tathā sati tattatkālīnaparimāṇabhedena vastubhedāt| ātmano vikāritvāpatteḥ| tataścānityatvānnirmokṣatvādidoṣaprasaṃgādityarthaḥ || evaṃcātmano vikāritvenānityatvaprasaṃgāt| tathā cānirmokṣaprasaṃgaḥ| śāstravaiphalyaṃ ca| gajapipīlikādiśarīrasthasyātmanaḥ kramikatattaddehaparimāṇatvābhyupagame coktadoṣānapagamena vikāritvāpatteranityatāpātāt| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-36> || aṃtyāvasthiteścobhayanityatvādaviśeṣāt || || idānīṃ śarīrāvacchedamaṃtareṇātmanaḥ svataḥ parimāṇābhāvāttadarthaṃ kāyaparimāṇatvamaṃgīkriyata iti dvitīyapakṣaṃ nirākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || aṃtyāvasthiteścobhayanityatvādaviśeṣāditi || asyārthaḥ || pūrvasūtrādevaṃcetyanuṣajyate| aṃtyāvasthiterityetadāvartate| ca śabdo'vadhāraṇe samuccaye ca| tathā ca evaṃ sati ātmanaḥ kāyaparimāṇatveṃ'gīkṛte aṃtyāvastiteḥ prasaṃga iti śeṣaḥ| mokṣe'pi sataḥ ātmanaḥ śarīrasattvamaṃgīkāryaṃ syādityarthaḥ| kutaḥ aṃtyāvasthiteśca| aṃtyasya mauktikaparimāṇasya avasthiteḥ avaśyamaṃgīkāryaṃ syādityarthaḥ| kutaḥ aṃtyāvasthiteśca| aṃtyasya mauktikaparimāṇasya avasthiteḥ avaśyamaṃgīkāryatvāt| avacchedakaśarīraṃ vinā avacchedyaparimāṇasattvāyogāditi bhāvaḥ| parimāṇameva kuta ityato'pyāha| aṃtyeti| aṃtyasya mauktikātmasvarūpasya muktāvasthiteravaśyaṃ svarūpasattvasya parimāṇaṃ vinā'yogāditi bhāvaḥ| astu mokṣe'pi śarīraṃ tataḥ kimityata uktaṃ| ubhayanityatvāditi| tathā sati ubhayoḥ muktikālīnayordehātmanornityatvaprasaṃgādityarthaḥ| astu mauktikaśarīranityatvaṃ tataḥ kimityata āha| tataśca sarvanityatvaṃ syādityāpādyavākyamadhyāhāryaṃ| ata eva samuccayārthakaśca śabdaḥ sarveṣāmadhunātanaśarīrāṇāṃ nityatvaṃ syādityarthaḥ| kuta ityata āha| aviśeṣāditi| muktikālīnānāṃ adhunātanānāṃ ca śarīrāṇāṃ śarīratvāviśeṣādityarthaḥ| tasmānna kāyaparimāṇatvamātmano yuktamiti bhāvaḥ || evaṃca jīvasya mokṣe parimāṇābhāva cedātmasvarūpābhāvaprasaṃgaḥ| na hi parimāṇaśūnyaṃ dravyamasti| asti ceccharīramaṃtareṇa parimāṇāyogāt| tatrāpi taccharīramanityaṃ cetsaṃsārasamānadharmatāpātaḥ| nityaṃ ceccharīratvāviśeṣādidānīṃtanaśarīramapi nityaṃ syāt| ato nātmanaḥ kāyaparimāṇatvapakṣo yuktaḥ| tasmājjainamatasyānupapannatvenāvirodhakatvādyuktaṃ jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ || || iti nekasminnadhikaraṇaṃ || atra pāśupatapakṣo'pākriyate || <2-2-37> || patyurasāmaṃjasyāt || || nanu na viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ| pāśupatasamayaviruddhatvāt| paśupatiḥ khalu sārvajñyādiguṇaśālī| māyāmupādānīkṛtya harihiraṇyagarbhādijagadutpattyādi sarvaṃ karoti| śrutismṛtayaścāsminnarthe bhavaṃti| ato lakṣaṇasūtramayuktamiti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati || || || patyurasāmaṃjasyāditi || asyārthaḥ || patyuḥ paśupateḥ| jagatkāraṇatvaṃ na yuktaṃ| kutaḥ| asāmaṃjasyāt pārataṃtryotpattyādidoṣavattvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca yuktaṃ viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ| pāśupatasamayasyāpramāṇikatvāt| na paśupatirgatkartā| pārataṃtryajananamaraṇadoṣaduṣṭatvāt| na cāsiddho hetuḥ| yaṃ kāmaye taṃ tamugramiti śrutisiddhatvāt| api caiko nārāyaṇa āsīditi śrutyā pralaye paśupaterabhāvāvagamāt| tataśca pāśupatasamayasyānupapannatvenāvirodhakatvādyuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-38> || saṃbaṃdhānupapatteśca || || yuktyaṃtareṇa paśupaterjagatkāraṇatvaṃ parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || saṃbaṃdhānupapatteśceti || asyārthaḥ || śivasyāśarīratvena jagatā saṃbaṃdhānupapatte na tasya kartṛtvamityarthaḥ || evaṃca na kevalaṃ pārataṃtryādeḥ kiṃtvaśarīratvācca paśupaterjagatkartṛtvāyogāt| na hyaśarīrasya kartṛtvaṃ dṛśyate yena tasya tathā bhavet| na ca kāryeṇa jagatā'pi saṃbaṃdhamātramaśarīrasyāpi saṃbhavati gaganāderghaṭādisaṃyogavaditi vācyaṃ| tyaktadehapuruṣavatkartṛtvarūpasaṃbaṃdhābhāvāt| tataśca paśupaterjagatkartṛtvāyogena yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-39> || adhiṣṭhānānupapatteśca || || hetvaṃtareṇa paśupaterjagatkāraṇatvaṃ parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || adhiṣṭhānānupapatteśceti || asyārthaḥ || pralaye sarveṣāṃ naṣṭatvātpunaḥ sṛṣṭikāle paśupateḥ pṛthivyādyāśrayānupapatteśca na tasya jagatkartṛtvamityarthaḥ || evaṃca paśupateradhiṣṭhānānupalaṃbhena kartṛtvāyogāt| pṛthivyādyadhiṣṭhāne sthitasya kulālāderghaṭādikāryadarśanenāsya tadabhāvāt| sautrahetunā vyatirekavyāpteḥ sāmānyataḥ pṛthivyādyadhiṣṭhānadṛṣṭāṃtena darśitatvāt| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-40> || karaṇavaccenna bhogādibhyaḥ || || nanu na pralayakāle nityatayā vidyamānaṃ prakṛtyādikaṃ sākṣātprayatnādhiṣṭheyatayā śarīrādivat| na ca sākṣātprayatnādhiṣṭheya preraṇāya śarīrāpekṣā| śarīrapreraṇārthamapi śarorāṃtarāpekṣāprasaṃgāt| ataḥ śarīrādipratinidhisadbhāvātkartṛtvamupapannamiti prāpte sūtramupanyasyati || || || karaṇavaccenna bhogādibhya iti || asyārthaḥ || nanu yataḥ sādhanajātaṃ paśupateḥ kāraṇavat śarīravat| śarīreṇatulyaṃ adhiṣṭhānatulyaṃ ca ato noktadoṣa iti cenna| kutaḥ| bhogādibhyaḥ śarīrakṛtasukhaduḥkhabhogotpattimaraṇādidoṣebhya ityarthaḥ || evaṃca kārakasamūhasya śarīratulyatvena śarīropādānaparityāgābhyāṃ jananamaraṇavattadupādānaparityāgābhyāmapi jananamaraṇaprasaṃgāt| tataśca sukhaduḥkhabhogaprāpteḥ| yajñadattādeḥ sākṣātprayatnādhiṣṭheyavikārātmakaśarīropādānahānayoḥ satostīnnamittayorutpattivināśayordarśanāt| ato yuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-41> || aṃtavattvamasarvajñatā vā || || saṃbaṃdhānupapatteḥ, karaṇavacca, ityābhyāmuktaśarīrabhāvābhāvapakṣāveva vikalpabhaṃgya doṣāṃtareṇa dūṣayatsūtraṃ paṭhitvā vyācaṣṭe || || || aṃtavattvamasarvajñatāveti || asyārthaḥ || yataḥ śivasya dehitvatadabhāvapakṣayoḥ krameṇāṃtavattvaṃ nāśavattvaṃ asarvajñatā na sarvajñatvaṃ syāt ato na tadyuktamityarthaḥ || evaṃca paśupaterjagatkartṛtvāṃgīkāre tasya śarīravattvapakṣe vināśaprasaṃgaḥ tadabhāve tu jñānābhāvaḥ| na caite doṣā viṣṇupakṣe'pi buddhimānmanovānityādiśrutyā jñānābhāvasya parihṛtatvāt| yadātmako bhagavānityādināṃ'tavattvādidoṣāṇāṃ nirastatvāt| tatra bhagavaddehasya tatsvarūpatvajñānādyātmakatvenoktatvāt| anayaiva diśā śāktaiyasauraskāṃdagāṇapatyānāṃ samayā nirākṛtā veditavyāḥ| ataḥ pāśupatasamayasyānupapannatvenāvirodhakatvādyuktaṃ lakṣaṇasūtramiti siddhaṃ || || iti patyuradhikaraṇaṃ || atra śaktipakṣo dūṣyate| <2-2-42> || utpattyasaṃbhavāt || || nanu na viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ| śākteyamataviruddhatvāt| śaktireva khalu sārvajñyādiguṇaśālinī| sakalajagajjananī| śrutismṛtītihāsapurāṇeṣu paṭhyate| ato harerna lakṣaṇasūtraṃ yuktamiti prāpte sūtramupanyasyati || || || utpattyasaṃbhavāditi || asyārthaḥ || na śaktirjagatkāraṇaṃ| kutaḥ| utpattyasaṃbhavāt śaktiśabditakevalastrībhyaḥ apatyotpattyayogādityarthaḥ || evaṃca mahāvāmānāṃ mate yaducyate śaktireva puruṣānanugṛhītajagatkāraṇamiti na tadyuktaṃ| śaktireva puruṣānanugṛhītā jagatkāraṇamityasyārthasya pramāṇādṛṣṭatvāt| kevalāyāstasyā jagatkartṛtvāsaṃbhavāt| parodāhṛtānāmajāmekāmityādipramāṇānāṃ tvīśvarādhīnatayaiva jagatkāraṇatvābhidhāyitvenātatparatvāt| tataśca mahāvāmānāṃ matamaprāmāṇamiti yukta jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-43> || na ca kartuḥ karaṇaṃ || || nanu sārvajñyādiguṇāvidhuraḥ sadāśivaḥ śaktyanugrāhako'sti| tadanugṛhītāyāḥ śakteḥ jagatkāraṇatve'jāmekāmityādiśruteḥ pramāṇatvāt| sadāśivānugṛhītaśakteḥ jagatkāraṇatvamiti vadatāṃ madhyamavāmānāṃ mataṃ nirākurvatsūtramunyasyati || || || na ca kartuḥ karaṇamiti || asyārthaḥ || yataḥ kartuḥ śaktyanugrāhakaśivasya ca kāraṇaṃ jñānādisādhanaṃ| na| ato na tasya śaktyanugrāhakatvamityarthaḥ || evaṃca sadāśivasya sārvajñyādivaidhuryeṇānugrāhakatvāyogāt| utpattyupayogijñānādestatsādhaneṃdriyādestatkāraṇaśarīrasya cābhāvenāta eva puruṣānugṛhītaśakterapi jagadutpattyasaṃbhavāt| ato madhyamavāmānāṃ matasyāprāmāṇikatvena yuktaṃ jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-44> || vijñānādibhāve vā tadapratiṣedhaḥ || || nanu śaktyanugrāhakapuruṣābhāvācchakterjagadutpattiryuktetyeva nocyate| kiṃtu tasya puṃsaḥ sārvajñyāderapi sadbhāvena yuktatarā śarterjagadutpattiritītyaṃgīkurvatāmaṇuvāmānāṃ matanirāsāya sūtramupanyasyati || || || vijñānādibhāve vā tadapratiṣedha iti || asyārthaḥ || vijñānādibhāve vā śivasya jñānecchādisatveṃ'gīkṛte ca| tadapratiṣedhaḥ| tasya śaivapakṣasya apratiṣedhaḥ anirāsaḥ anumitiḥ kṛtā syāt| sa ca dūṣita evetyarthaḥ || evaṃca yadi śaktyanugrahakartṛjagadutpattyupayogivijñānaśarīroṃdriyasattvamaṃgīkriyate tata eva śaktyanugrahakartuḥ śivādeḥ kartraṃtaramanapekṣyaiva jagadutpattyādisaṃbhavāt tadā śaktimatasya pāśupatamataikyena tasya ca nirastatvāt punarnirasane kāraṇābhāvāt| ato'ṇuvāmānāṃ matamapramāṇamiti jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <2-2-45> || vipratiṣedhācca || || evaṃ śākteyamatatrayaṃ pṛthaṅ‌nirākṛtya samuditadūṣaṇenāpi parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || vipratiṣedhācceti || asyārthaḥ || sakalaśrutismṛtivuruddhatvācca śākteyamatamasamaṃjasaṃ ayuktamityarthaḥ || evaṃca narte| eko nārāyaṇa | ityādiśrutīnāṃ| sa eva | ityādi smṛtīnāṃ| pūrvoktahetūnāṃ ca virodhena śiṣṭajanairjugupsitatvāt| sarvamapi śākteyamatamayuktameveti yuktaṃ viṣṇorjagajjanmādikāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ || || iti utpattyādhikaraṇaṃ || || iti dvitīyādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ || <2.3> || śrīḥ || || hariḥ || || atha dvitīyādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ || jīvaparamātmādhibhūtādhidaiveṣu śrutīnāṃ parasparavirodhamapākarotyasminpāde || atra viyadutpattiviṣayaśrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate| <2-3-1> || na viyadaśruteḥ || || nanu na viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ| anādirvā'yamākāśa iti śruteḥ| ākāśasyānāditvenākāśakāraṇatvābhāvāt| na cātmana ākāśaḥ saṃbhūta iti śrutyā''tmana ākāśakāraṇatvamupapadyate| anubhūtiyuktibahuvāgviruddhatvena tasyāḥ śruteraprāmāṇyāt| na ca saṃbhūtaśruterarthāṃtaraparatvenāprāmāṇyābhāvaḥ| vāyvādāvapyanyārthatāpātāt| na hi yatra śabdaḥ śrūyate tatrāmukhyo yātrākṛṣyate tatra mukhya iti saṃbhavaḥ| tasmādākāśaśruteraprāmāṇyādayuktaṃ śrutisamanvayenākāśakāraṇatvaṃ brahmaṇa iti prāpte sūtramāha || || || na viyadaśruteriti || asyārthaḥ || viyat ākāśaṃ| anutpattimanna kiṃtvīśādutpattimadeva| kutaḥ| aśruteḥ viyadanutpattau śrutyabhāvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ| ākāśānutpattau śranutyabhavādākāśasyāpyutpattimattvenākāśakāraṇatve bādhakābhāvāt| tathā'pi jīvakālādikāraṇatvasyānuktatvena na viṣṇoḥ sarvakāraṇatvamityukte viyatpadena jīvakālamahadaṃhakārāderupalakṣaṇatvena pratipāditatvāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena bhagavaditarasyotpattisiddheryuktaḥ sarvakāraṇe parabrahmaṇi śrutisamanvaya iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-2> || asti tu || nanu na viyata utpattyabhāve pramāṇaṃ niyamena vaktavyaṃ| utpattau pramāṇābhāvenaiva tatsiddheḥ| na hi ghaṭe pramāṇābhāve punaḥ pramāṇāpekṣā syāditi prāpte sūtramāha || || || asti tviti || asyārthaḥ || ākāśotpattau ātmana ākāśaḥ saṃbhūta iti śrutirastyevetyarthaḥ || evaṃcākāśa ātmanaḥ saṃbhūta iti śrutisadbhāvānnānayā śrutyā'nutpattiḥ sidhyati| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena viyadāderutpattisiddheryuktaḥ samanvaya iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-3> || gauṇyasaṃbhavāt || || nanu na viyata ātmana ākāśa iti śrutyotpattiḥ sādhayituṃ śakyā| anādirvetyanāditvābhidāyakaśrutivirodhādityāśaṃkāṃ parākurvatsūtramāha || || || gauṇyasaṃbhavāditi || asyārthaḥ || anādirvā'yamākāśa ithi śrutirgauṇī| amukhyānāditvaparā| kutaḥ| asaṃbhavāt tasyā mukhyārthatve bahulotpattiśrutyayogādityarthaḥ || evaṃcānāditvaśrutergauṇatvāt| utpattiśrutibāhulyānyathopapattyā tasyā gauṇatvasiddheḥ| utpattiśrutermukhyārthatvena sarvaviṣayatvāt| anāditvaśrutyanusāreṇoktavyavasthānaṃgīkāreṇākāśasya sarvathā'nutpatterevābhyupagame tadaprāmāṇyaprasaṃgātṣa| bāhulyasya prābalyahetutayotpattiśruterapi balavattvenāprāmāṇyasya vaktumaśakyatayā śrutidvayaprāmāṇyāyoktavyavasthāyā evāśrayaṇīyatvāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhenākāśasyotpattisiddheryuktaḥ samanvaya iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-4> || śabdācca || || na kevalamuktavyavasthā'saṃbhavayuktisiddhā| api tu śrutisiddhā cetyarthapratipādakaṃ sūtramupanyasyati || || || śabdācceti || asyārthaḥ || atha ha vāva nityānīti śrutibalāccānāditvaśrutirgauṇārthetyarthaḥ || evaṃcoktavyavasthopapadyata eva| atha ha vāva nityānīti bhāllaveya śruteḥ| etenānubhavāditi virodhasya parihṛtatvāt| tataśca śrutyavirodhena yukto bhagavati śrutisamanvaya iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-5> || syāccaikasya brahmaśabdavat || || nanu kuto'nāditvaśrutergauṇatvaṃ| mukhyārthasya bādhakābhāvāt| anyathā na jāyate na mriyata ityādāvapi gauṇārthaḥ syāt| tatra na jāyate ityanutpattyabhidhāyakaśabdasya paramātmani mukhyatvadarśanena tadekārthānāditvaśruṃtarapi tathāttvaucityādityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtramupanyasyati || || || syāccaikasya brahmaśabdavaditi || asyārthaḥ || co'vadhāraṇe| brahmaśabdavat yathā ekasyaiva brahmaśabdasya viṣṇau mukhyatvaṃ jīvetvamukhyatā'sti| tathā ekasyaivānityatvabodhakaśabdasya brahmaṇi mukhyārthatā syāt| bhavedityarthaḥ| evaṃca bhavedanyatra mukhyānutpattimacchabdasyākāśe gauṇatvaṃ| mukhyārthasyākāśe bahulotpattiśrutibādhitatvāt| brahmaṇi mukhyasyāpi brahmaśabdasya bādhakavaśena viriṃcādiṣvamukhyatvadarśanāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena yuktaḥ śrutisamanvaya iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-6> || pratijñāhāniravyatirekācchabdebhyaḥ || || nanu yuktaṃ brahmaśabdasya parabrahmaṇi mukhyamanyatrāmukhyatvaṃ| guṇapūrṇatvarūpaśabdapravṛttinimittasattvāsattvākhyakāraṇasadbhāvāt| na ca tathā'nutpattimacchabde vaktuṃ śakyaṃ| tadvatprakṛte pravṛttinimittapauṣkalyabhāvābhāvākhyakāraṇānupalaṃ bhādityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtramupanyasyāte || || || pratijñāhāniravyātirekācchabdebhya iti || asyārthaḥ || ākāśasya mukhyānutputtyuktau pratijñāhāniḥ sa idaṃ sarvamasajateti viṣṇoḥ sraṣṭrṛtvapratijñāhāniḥ syāt| kutaḥ| avyatirekāt ākāśasya sarvaśabdārthānatiriktatvāt| kiṃca yataḥ śabdebhyaḥ ātmā vā idamityādispaṣṭaśrutibhyaśca brahmaṇa eva mukhyānutpattiḥ na tvanyasyetyavasīyate| ata uktaṃ yuktamityarthaḥ || evaṃcākāśasyāpi brahmavanmukhyanityatve mukhyatastadvācyanutpattimacchabdavācyatvāṃgīkāre idamasṛjateti pratijñāhānisaṃbhavāt| na cātrākāśamasṛjatetyanuktatvena pratijñāhānyabhāvaḥ| sarvaśabdenaivākāśasya grahaṇāt| saṃkoce kāraṇābhāvāt| ātmā vā idameka evāgra iti śruteśca| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena yuktaḥ samanvaya iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-7> || yāvadvikāraṃ tuvibhāgo lokavat || || anumānenāpi brahmaṇa evānāditvamanyeṣāṃ sāditvamanutpattiśrutermukhyāmukhyatvasidhyarthaṃ sādhayatsūtramupanyasyati || || || yāvadvikāraṃ tu vibhāgo lokavāditi || asyārthaḥ || yāvacchabdo'vadhāraṇe| yāvadvikāramityavyayaṃ| tu śabdaścaśabdārthe| tathā ca yataḥ yāvadvikāraṃ vikriyamāṇameva vastu| vibhāgaḥ vibhāgaśabditālpaśaktimat na tvanyaditi niyamaḥ siddhaḥ| ato lokavat loka iti| yathā loke ghaṭādau vibhaktatvāt vikāritvamaṃgīkṛtaṃ| tathā ākāśāderapi vibhaktatvahetunā vikāritvaṃ sidhyati| tata eva sāditvamapi sidhyatītyarthaḥ || evaṃcākāśa utpattimān alpaśaktitvāt| ghaṭādivadityanumānāccākāśotpattisiddheranāditvaśrutergauṇatvāt| brahmānutpattimat avibhaktatvāt vyatirekeṇa ghaṭavadityapi mānasadbhāvāt| na ca prakṛtipuruṣa iti vacanasya nityānityapuruṣa iti prācīnaśrutivirodhaḥ| tatra prakṛtyādeḥ svarūpasyābhūtvābhavanarūpotpattyabhāvokteḥ| atra punaḥ parādhīnaviśeṣāvāptirūpotpattyukterbhinnaviṣayatvenāvirodhāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena bhagavaditarasyotpattisiddheryuktaḥ sarvakāraṇe brahmaṇi śrutisamanvaya iti siddhaṃ || || iti viyadadhikaraṇaṃ || atreśvare śrutisamanvayasiddhaye mukhyavāyorupattiviṣayaśrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate || <2-3-8> || etena mātariśvā vyākhyātaḥ || || nanu na viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ| vāyurvāveti śrutervāyorutpattyabhāvena kāraṇatvābhāvāt| na cākāśānutpattivadiyaṃ śrutirgauṇī| atha ha nityāśceti śrutyā''kāśasya nityatvamuktvā vāyunityatvokteḥ| anyathā viśiṣyanityatvoktarayuktā syāt| kiṃca yadi vāyurutpattimānsyāttadā sarvapekṣayā'tiśayitacetanatvaṃ sarvadevopāsyatvaṃ ca na syāt| yasya nādirna madhyamiti śrutyā'nāditvamuktvodayanimlocābāvasyāpyukteḥ| tataśca tābhyāṃ śūnyasyotpattiḥ saṃbhāvayituṃ yuktā| sādhakavataḥ sādhyadarśanenānutpattisādhakavato'pyutpattimattvāṃgīkāre'nubhavavyākopaḥ syāt| ato vāyorutpattyabhāvenotpattiśruteraprāmāṇyānna śrutisaṃmanvayena viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || etena mātariśvā vyākhyāta iti || asyārthaḥ || etena pūrvoktavibhaktatvādi hetunā| mātariśvā mukhyavāyuḥ| vyākhyātaḥ utpattimattvenokta ityarthaḥ || evaṃca yuktaṃ viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ| vāyorutpattimattvāt| prāṇādvāyuriti śrutipramāṇasadbhāvāt| na vā'nutpattiśrutivirodhaḥ| tasyāḥ svarūpānutpattiparatvena gauṇatvāt| na ca vāyormukhyānutpattimattvābhāve viśiṣyanityatvāteśayacetanatvoktivirodhaḥ| svarūpātiriktajñānanityatvābhiprāyeṇātiśayitatvādyuktisaṃbhavāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena vāyorutpattisiddheryuktaṃ jagatkāraṇatvalakṣaṇamiti siddhaṃ || || iti mātariśvādhikaraṇaṃ || atra bhagavadutpattiviṣayaśrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate || <2-3-9> || asaṃbhavastu sato'nupapatteḥ || || nanu na viṣṇoḥ śrutisamanvayena jagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ| tasyotpattimattvena jagatkāraṇatvāyogāt| na ca tatra pramāṇābhāvaḥ| asataḥ sadajāyatetiśruteḥ| na cānāditvaśrutipratiruddhatvena tayotpattyasiddhiḥ| brahmotpattimat utpattimadaviśiṣṭatvādityutpatti śruteḥ sayuktikatvena prabalatvāt| asata eva tatkāraṇatvena kāraṇābhāvenotpattyabhāvaḥ| ato brahmaṇopyutpattimattvādaśeṣakāraṇatayā samanvayo'yukta iti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || asaṃbhavastu sato'nupapatteriti || asyārthaḥ || tu śabdo'vadhāraṇe| sataḥ viṣṇoḥ| asaṃbhavaḥ anutpattireva natvasataḥ sadajāyateti śrutyā'sataḥ sakāśādutpattirvācyā| kutaḥ| anupapatteḥ ato viṣṇorasadutpatterayogādityarthaḥ || evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ| asataḥ sadutpatteḥ kvāpyadarśanenāsataḥ sakāśādutpattyanupapatteḥ| brahma vā'sat sadvāvaprāṇa itiśruterbrahmaṇaḥ sakāśādvāyorutpattiḥ śrutyartha iti| tvaṃ devaśakttyāmiti bhāgavatavacanāt| na ca rāmakṛṣṇādirūpeṇa harerjāyamānatvaṃ| tadrūpāṇāṃ prādurbhāvatvena janeranupapannatvāt| pratyakṣatvaṃ hareriti vacanāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena brahmaṇo'nāditvasiddhestatra śrutisamanvayena jagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || || iti asaṃbhāvādhikaraṇaṃ || atra tejojanmaviṣayaśrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate| <2-3-10> || tejo'tastathā hyāha || || nanu na śrutisamanvayena viṣṇorasādhāraṇyena jagatkāraṇatvaṃ vācyaṃ| tejaso vāyujātatve śrutisadbhāvena viṣṇuvadvāyorapyagnikāraṇatvena viṣṇorviśeṣābhāvāt| na ca vāyudvārā paramātmajātatvābhidhāyakaṃ śrutervācyaṃ| brahma vāyudvāramaṃtareṇa tejaḥ sraṣṭumiṣṭe cettadvāravaiyarthyaṃ| nocetsāmyaṃ tayoravarjanīyaṃ| ato na jagatkāraṇatvena sarvaśrutisamanvayo yukta iti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || tejo'tastathā hyāheti || asyārthaḥ || tejaḥ tejobhūtaḥ| ata brahmaṇa evotpadyate na vāyoḥ| kutaḥ| hi yasmāt| tatteja iti śrutiḥ| tathā uktaprakāreṇa āha vakti| tasmādityarthaḥ || evaṃca yuktameva tatra sarvaśrutisamanvayena jagatkāraṇatvaṃ| tattejo'sṛjateti śruteragnerviṣṇujātatvāt| na ca vāyoragnirityādiśrutivirodhaḥ| tatra vāyudvārā tejaso brahmajātatvokteḥ| na ca dvāravaiyarthyānyathā'nupapattyobhayorapi kāraṇatvaṃ vācyaṃ| śaktasyāpi brahmaṇaḥ svecchayaiva dvāramanusṛtya kāraṇatvasya pramāṇasiddhatvāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena tejaso brahmajātatvasiddheḥ sarvaśrutisamanvayena jagatkāraṇatve hareriti siddhaṃ || || iti tejo'dhikaraṇaṃ || atrābjanmaviṣayaśrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate| <2-3-11> || āpaḥ || || nanu na hareḥ śrutisamanvayena jagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ| apāmagnerāpa iti śrutibalena tejojātatvāt| na ca tadaposṛjateti śrutivirodhena pratītārthe tejojātatvaśruteraprāmāṇyaṃ āpastejaso jāyaṃte| aptvātsvedavaditi yuktiyuktatvena prābalyāt| tathā ca tatteja aikṣateti śruteḥ| tataśca na brahmaṇaḥ śrutisamanvayena jagatkāraṇatvamiti prāpte sūtramāha| || || āpa iti || asyārthaḥ || atrāpi ataḥ tathā hyāhetyanuvartate| tathā ca āpaḥ ataḥ viṣṇorevetpattimattyaḥ| na tvanyataḥ| kutaḥ| hi yasmāt| brahmaivedamiti8utistathā āha| tasmādityarthaḥ || evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ| agnerāpa iti śruterapāṃ paramātmana utpattāvagnidvāramityevaṃ paratvena brahmaivedamagra iti śruteḥ| na ca śrutidvayānyathā'nupapattyā brahmatejasoḥ sāmyenaiva kāraṇatvaṃ| kartā sarvasya vai viṣṇuriti vacanavirodhāt| tataśca śrutyavirodhenāpāṃ brahmajātatvasiddheryuktaṃ vedasamanvayena jagatkāraṇatvaṃ hareriti siddhaṃ || || iti abadhikaraṇaṃ || atrānyadvārā jagatkāraṇe samanvayasidhyarthamapāṃ brahmadvāratve śrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate| <2-3-12> || pṛthivyadhikārarūpaśabdāntarādibhyaḥ || || nanu na viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ| dvārakāraṇaviṣayaśrutīnāṃ parasparavirodhenāprāmāṇyāt| tathā hi| tā annamasajaṃtetyannasṛṣṭerapsṛṣṭyānaṃtaryamucyate| ad‌bhyaḥ pṛthivīti pṛthivīsṛṣṭerapsṛṣṭyānataryaṃ| virodhenobhayāsaṃbhavāt| na ca tatrānnaśabdena pṛthivyeva vivakṣitā| annaśruteḥ prasiddhānnaparatve bahuvākyānusāritvaguṇalābhāt| tasmādyatra kva ca varṣatīti prasiddhānnaliṃgācca| na ca pṛthivīpadenānnasaṃgrahaḥ| ad‌bhya evānnasṛṣṭyaṃgīkāre'd‌bhyaḥ pṛthivīti śrutivirodhāt| nāpi pṛthivyannayāṃrad‌byo yugapadutpattiḥ| uktaśrutivirodhāt| na cānnasya sṛṣṭibedenād‌bhya oṣadhībhyo'pi janmabahukalpanāpātāt| ataḥ śrutidvayasya parasparaviruddhatvenāprāmāṇyameveti na śrutisamanvayo yukta iti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || pṛthivyadhikārarūpaśabdāṃtarādibhya iti || asyārthaḥ || pṛthivī pṛthivyeva| tā annamāsṛjaṃteti śrutisthānna śabdenocyate| na prasiddhānnāṃ kutaḥ| adhikārarūpaśabdāṃtarādibhyaḥ| adhikāraśabditabhūtaprakṛraṇāt| rūpaśabdoktakṛṣṇarūpasya ca śravaṇāt| śabdāṃtaraṃ śabdaviśeṣaḥ pṛthivī vā'nnamiti śrutiviśeṣāccetyarthaḥ| apauruṣayatvenādoṣasya vākyasya nāprāmāṇyamityādiyuktirādiśabdārthaḥ || evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ| śrutyoravirodhāt| tathā hi| tā annamityatrānnaśabdena pṛthivī vivakṣitā| tattejo'sajateti bhūtaprakaraṇāt| yadrohitamityannasya kārṣṇyaśravaṇāt| na caitāvallakṣaṇaṃ| āpaśca pṛthivī cānnamiti śabdāṃtare pṛthivyā annaśabdābhidheyatvābhidhānāt| na ca vṛṣṭijatvaliṃgāvirodhaḥ| pārthivapadārthānāṃ vṛṣṭyutpannārthatvenopapatteḥ| na ca śruterarthāṃtara kalpanā'yogena śrutyorvirodhenāprāmāṇyaṃ| vedo nāpramāṇaṃ| aprāmāṇyakāraṇadoṣaśūnyatvāt pratyakṣavadityuktivirodhāt| tataśca virodhābhāvena yuktaḥ śrutisamanvaya iti siddhaṃ || || iti pṛthivyadhikaraṇaṃ || atra brahmaṇaḥ prakṛtādhibūtādhidaivaviṣayasaṃhṛtikartṛtve śrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate| <2-3-13> || tadabhidhyānādeva tu talliṃgātsaḥ || || nanu na viṣṇuḥ sarvasaṃhartā| api tu rudra eva| prāṇānāṃ graṃthirasīti śruteḥ na ca viṣṇoḥ sarvaśabdavācyatvena sāśrutirviṣṇuparā rudraparatve'pi tasya dvārakaraṇābhidhātrī| lokavirodhāt loke hi pitā na putramārakaḥ| mārako'pi mūḍha eva na prājñaḥ| tataśca piturīśvarasya jaganmārakatvāṃgīkāre mauḍhyameveti na ca tadyuktamiti lokavirodho durvāraḥ| na ca viṣṇoḥ sarvasaṃhartṛtve'pi yatprayaṃtīti śrutisadbhāvaṃ vācyaṃ| tasyā balavadetacchutivirodhenāprāmāṇyāt| ato na viṣṇoḥ sarvasaṃhartṛtvamiti prāpte sūtramāha|| || || tadabhidhyānādeva tu talliṃgātsa iti || asyārthaḥ || tu śabdo'vadhāraṇe| abhidhyāna śabdenecchocyate| tacchabdena viṣṇurgṛhyate| tathā ca sa viṣṇureva saṃhārakartā na rudraḥ| kutaḥ| tadamidhyānāt| tasyābhidhyānāditi śrutyuktatvāt| tasya viṣṇoḥ abhidhyānarūpaśabdajñāpitasaṃjihīrṣāviśeṣitādanādibaṃdhasaṃhārecchārūpāt talliṃgādeva sādijagatsaṃhartṛtvasādhakādevetyarthaḥ| evakārastu bhāṣyarītyā kimu śratibhya iti kaimutyasūcakaḥ || evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇoḥ sarvasaṃhartṛtvaṃ| tasyābhidhyānāditi śrutau taddhyānajanyaprasādarūpecchādhīnatvasya baṃdhanivṛtterabhidhānāt| kiṃcātastadicchādhīnatvena kartṛtvamanumīyate| evaṃcānāderbaṃdhasya layakārtā sutarāṃ sāderjagataḥ saṃhārakarteti sidhyati| yaidaṃ sarvaṃ vilāpayatīti śruteśca| rudādisaṃhārakartṛtvābidhāyakaśruterdvārakāraṇatvābidhāyakatvena virodhābhāvāt| na ca pitṛtvādīśvarasya vināśakatve mauḍhyaprasaṃgaḥ| laukikapitṛṇāṃ mamatāyuktatvena haṃtṛtvāyogena mauḍhyasyopādhikṛtatvenāṃgīkārāt| īśvarasya tu tadabhāvena vinā mauḍhyamapi saṃhartṛtvopapatteḥ| ataḥ śrutivirodhābhāvena yuktaṃ sarvasaṃhārakartṛtvaṃ viṣṇoriti siddhaṃ || || iti tadabhidhyānādhikaraṇaṃ || atrādhebhūtādisaṃhārakramaviṣayaśrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate| <2-3-14> || viparyayeṇa tu kramo'ta upapadyate ca || || nanu śrutisamanvayena na bhagavato vyutkrameṇa saṃhartṛtvaṃ yuktaṃ| vyutkramapratipādakaśruteraprāmāṇyāt| tathā hi| ata eva hīdamiti kramāllayapratipādakaśruteḥ| sā ca pratyakṣānuguṇā| kramādvilīyata ityādyāḥ śrutayo'sminnarthe bhavaṃti| tataśca balavadetacchrutivirodhena vyutkramapratipādakaśruteraprāmāṇyameveti na yukta iti prāpte sūtramāha || || || viparyaṃyeṇa tu kramo'ta upapadyate ceti || asyārthaḥ || tu śabdo'vadāraṇe| ata ityāvartate| ataḥ utpattikramāt| viparyayeṇa vaiparītyena| kramaḥ layakramaḥ| na tūtpattikrameṇa| ata eva vyutkramāditi śrutareva| kiṃca upapadyate yujyate cāyaṃ vyutkramaḥ| kutaḥ pūrvotpannānāṃ uttarotpannebhyo'dhikasāmarthyena teṣāmadhikakālavasthānasya yuktatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca vyutkrameṇaiva layo yuktaḥ| kramaśruteḥ sāvakāśatvenābādhakatvāt| āsti vyutkramaśabde'pi kramapraveśaḥ| kramāllayābhidhāyakabhāllaveyaśrutāveva vyutkrameṇa layābhidhānāt| anurūpaḥ krama iti vacanācca| na ca lokavirodhaḥ| pūrveṣāṃ pūrveṣāṃ sāmarthyādhikyena lokavirodhasyaivānuguṇyāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena vyutkramāllayasiddheryukto harau śrutisamanvaya iti siddhaṃ || || iti viparyayādhikaraṇaṃ || atra pūrvoktavyutkrameṇa laye vijñānādau kvacidapavādaśaṃkā nirākriyate| <2-3-15> || aṃtarāvijñānamanasī krameṇa talliṃgāditi cennāviśeṣāt || || nanu na viṣṇorvyutkrameṇa sarvasaṃhartṛtvaṃ yuktaṃ| kiṃtu vijñānamanasī aṃtarā vyutkrameṇa layakartṛtvaṃ| manasaśca vijñānamiti manasa utpanne vijñānatattve tadyacchedvijñānātmanīti manastattvasya layaśravaṇāt| lokānuguṇācca| loke krameṇa vyutkrameṇa ca layadarśanāt| na ca sāmarthyatāratamyavirodhaḥ| manasa utpattiviṣayasāmarthyādhikyavijñānasya tu layaviṣaye sāmarthyādhikyamityaṃgīkāre bādhakābhāvāt| ataḥ sayuktikaliṃgadarśanaviruddhāyāḥ kramaśruteraprāmāṇyopapatterna śrutisamanvayo yukta iti prāpte sūtramāha || || || aṃtarā vijñānamanasī krameṇa talliṃgāditi ccennāviśeṣāditi || asyārthaḥ || vijñānamanasī vijñānatattvamanastattva| atarā vinā| anyatra krameṇa vyutkrameṇa layaḥ na tayorapi| kutaḥ| talliṃgāt manasaśca vijñānamityatra vijñānātpūrvotpannatayā bhūtasyāpi manasaḥ yacche dvāṅmanasīti pūrvameva layoktirūpasādhakadarśanāditi cenna| kutaḥ| aviśeṣāt vijñānamanastattvayoryathotpattilaya ityatra viśeṣapramāṇābhāvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇorvyutkrameṇa sarvasaṃhartṛtvaṃ| vijñānamanasorapi bādhakābhāvena vyutkrameṇa layāṃgīkārāt| sarvaṃ vaitatkramādutpadyate kramādvilīyata iti viśeṣapramāṇābhāvāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena sarveṣāṃ vyutkrameṇa layasiddheḥ samanvayo yukta iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-16> || carācaravyapāśrayastu syāttadvyapadeśo bhāktastadbhāvabhāvitvāt || || nanu manasaśca vijñānamiti śrutyā manastattvādvijñānatattvasyotpannatvena manastattvasya vijñānatattve layāṃgīkāre virodha evāpatīta iti prāpte parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || carācara vyapāśrayastu syāttadvyapadeśo bhāktastadbhāvabāvitvāditi || asyārthaḥ || carācaravyapāśrayaḥ carācaraśabditeṃdriyatadvṛttijñānaviṣayasādhāraṇaḥ| tadvyapadeśastu manasaśca vijñānamiti śrautavyavahārastu| bhāktaḥ ekadeśaḥ| manovijñānaśabdārthaikadeśabhūteṃdriyavṛttijñānaviṣayaka eva na tattvaviṣayakaḥ| kasmānnimittāt| tadbhāvabāvitvāt tasyā avṛttiḥ tasmin carācara śabditacetanācetanaviṣaye| tadbhāvena manobhāvena ālocanena| bhāvitvāt utpadyamānatvāt| ato noktaliṃgadarśanaṃ bādhakamityarthaḥ || evaṃcoktāvirodhaḥ| śrutyarthāparijñānāt| na hi tatparāśrutirmanastattvādvijñānatattvasyautpattimācaṣṭe| kiṃ tarhi mana iṃdriyājjñānasyotpattimācaṣṭe| parādavyaktamiti vacanāt| evaṃca śrutyavirodhena harau śrutisamanvayo yukta iti siddhaṃ || || iti aṃtarādhikaraṇaṃ || atra paramātmani layaviṣayaśrutivirodhaparihāraḥ kriyate || <2-3-17> || nātmā'śruternityatvācca tābhyaḥ || || nanu na viṣṇoḥ śrutivaॉsamanvayo yuktaḥ| tasyāpi vināśitvāt| aṃtastamasi nilīna iti śruteḥ| na ca nityo nityānāmiti śrutivirodhaḥ| īśvaro vināśī cetanatvāditi yuktisāhityena vināśaśruteḥ prābalyāt| na ca svātaṃtryeṇa hetuneśvarasyānutpatteḥ sādhitvena vināśāyogaḥ| svataṃtrasyāpi līlayā vigrahagrahaṇe satyavarjanīyapātopapatteḥ| yathālīlayā kuḍyātkuḍyamutpatataḥ pātaḥ| na hyutpatanaṃ līlayeti pāto'pi līlayā'pi tu kāraṇāṃtarādavarjanīyaḥ| ataḥ sayuktikaśrutivirodhenānyataraśruteraprāmāṇyānnoktasamanvayo yukta iti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati || || || nātmā'śruternityatvācca tābhya iti || asyārthaḥ || ātmā paramātmā na vilīyate| kutaḥ| aśruteḥ tallayasya kvāpyaśravaṇāt| kiṃca tābhyaḥ sa nityo nirguṇa ityādiśrutibhyaḥ nityatvāt viṣṇornityatvāvagamācca na tasya nāśa ityarthaḥ || evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ| pralayasyāprāmāṇikatvāt| na cāṃtastamasi nilīna iti śrutiratra pramāṇaṃ| aṃtastamasi nilīna ityutkvā puruṣādīniti vacanena nilīnaśabdasyāpihitārthatvāt| anyathā nityo nityānāmityādibahuśrutivirodhāpātāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena paramātmalayasya nirastatvāduktasamanvayo yukta iti siddhaṃ || || iti ātmādhikaraṇaṃ || atra jīvajanmaviṣayaśrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate || <2-3-18> || jño'ta eva || || nanu na bhagavato jagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktaṃ| jīvasyānutpannatvāt| nityo nityānāmiti śruteḥ| na cotpattāvapi sarva eta iti śrutirastīti| jīvonotpattimān anāditvāt īśvaravadityādiyuktisahitatvenānāditvaśruteḥ prābalyāt| na ca sādyāviśiṣṭatā hetoḥ| anādiśabdena tatsattāyā anādikālīnatvasya vivakṣitatvāt| na ca pralaye jīvādīnāṃ sattve vivādaḥ| tathā sati jīvābhāvena taddharmasyādṛṣṭasyāpyabhāvapattyā kāraṇābhāvena jagadutpattireva na syāt| athavā kāraṇaśūnyatvamanāditvaṃ vivakṣitaṃ| na ca tatrāpi vivādaḥ| kāraṇānupalaṃbhāt| ato na jagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || jño'ta eveti || asyārthaḥ || jānātīti jñaḥ jīvaḥ api| ataḥ viṣṇoḥ utpadyata eva| kutaḥ| ata eva avinaṣṭā evotpadyanta iti śruterevetyarthaḥ || evaṃca yukta eva samanvayaḥ| anādinityānāmeva jīvānāṃte vā eta iti śrutyotpattividhānāt| na ca kāraṇābhāvaḥ| parameśvarasyaiva kāraṇatvāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena jīvasya brahmajātatvasiddheryuktastatra samanvaya iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-19> || || yukteśca || || nanvanādinityasya jīvasyotpattiḥ śrutā'pi tasyotpattyaṃgīkāre vaṃdhyātvamabhyupagamya mātṛtvavacanavat nityatvamabhyupagamya punarutpattivacanasya vyāhatatvādityāśaṃkāṃ parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || yukteśceti || asyārthaḥ || anādinityasyāpi jīvasyesādhīnadehavattvarūpotpatteḥ yuktatvācca jīva utpattimānevetyarthaḥ || evaṃca nityasyāpi jīvasyopādhyutpattyapekṣayotpattyupapatteḥ| tathā'pi svarūpalābharūpotpatteralābhe'pi parādhīnaviśeṣāvāptirūpotpattereva vivakṣitatvena tadabhāvasyeṣṭatvāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena jīvasya brahmajātatvasiddheryuktastatra samanvaya iti siddhaṃ || || iti jñādhikaraṇaṃ || atra jīvadharme parimāṇe'ṇutvaśrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate || <2-3-20> || || utkrāṃtigatyāgatīnāṃ || || nanu na jīvo'ṇuḥ| vyāptā hyātmāna iti śrutiviruddhatvāt| na cāṇutve'pi śrutirastīti vācyaṃ| vyāptiśruteḥ sayuktikatvena prābalyāt| tabdādhitaitacchruteḥ prāmāṇyāyogāt| ātmā nāṇuḥ sarvadehāvacchedena sparśādigrāhitvāt| nāpyaṇutveyugapatsarveṃdriyairjñānaṃ bhavati| na cātmādehaparimāṇaḥ| madhyamaparimitatvenānityatvaprasaṃgāt| ataḥ pariśeṣādātmano vyāpakatvameva svīkāryaṃ| tathā prayogo'pi sarvamidaṃ mūrttamātmanā sṛṣṭaṃ mūrttatvānmaccharīravaditi| tataścāṇutvaśruteraprāmāṇyena śrutimātrasya prāmāṇyanaiyattyābhāvānna śrutisamanvayo yukta iti prāpte sūtramāha || || || utkrāṃtigatyāgatīnāmiti || asyārthaḥ || so'smādityādivākyoktadehotkramaṇaṃ lokāṃtaragamanaitallokāgamanarūpahetūnāṃ sakāśādaṇurevajīvaḥ na vibhurityarthaḥ || evaṃca jīvo'ṇureva na vyāptaḥ| utkrāṃtigatyāgatimattvāt| patatriśarīravaditi| atra mahatparimāṇātiriktaparimāṇasyaiva vivakṣitatvena dṛṣṭāṃtasya sādhyavikalatvābhāvāt| so'smāccharīrāditi śrutibalena vibhutvabādhakānāmaṇutvasādhakānāṃ hetūnāmasiddhatvāt| na ca madhyamaparimāṇatvenānyatāsiddhiḥ| tasyānityatvaprasaṃgena nirākṛtatvāt| ataḥ śratyavirodhena jīvāṇutve siddhe yuktaḥ śrutisamanvaya iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-21> || svātmanācottarayoḥ || || nanu na jīvasyotkrāṃtyādikaṃ parameśvareṇeti yujyate| kiṃtu tasya svayameva saṃbhavati| na ca so'smāccharīrāditi śrutau jīvasyotkrāṃtyādyeva śrūyate na tvanyādhīnatā viviniṣedho vā'to na tayā dṛḍhanirṇayābhāva iti vācyaṃ| ekaḥ prasūyata iti smṛtyā jīvasya svātaṃtryeṇotpattivināśayoruktatvena tadanusāreṇa śruterapi jīvasyotkrāṃtyādeḥ parādhīnatāniṣedhārthaparatvāt| iti prāpte parākurvatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || || svātmanā cottarayoriti || asyārthaḥ || ca śabda evārthaḥ| jīvaḥ svātmanā svataṃtraparamātmanaiva tatpreraṇayaivotkrāṃtyādimān na svataḥ| kutaḥ| uttarayoḥ sakāśāt sa etenaiva svātmanā eṣa hyenaṃ jīvamiti uttaravākyadvayabalādityarthaḥ || evaṃca svātmaśabdavācyena paramātmanā'nugṛhītajīvasya mātṛdehasthagarbhapraveśasya tatpreraṇaiva janermokṣārthaṃ cordhvagamanasya coktatvāt| sa etenaiveti śruteḥ| svātmaśabdasya bhagavati vidvadrūḍherdarśitatvāt| nirdiṣṭasmṛtestu prasavādi duḥkhānubhave paramātmadattasvātaṃtryapratipādakatvenāvirodhāt| ata uttaravākyabalājjīvasyotkrāṃtyādayaḥ paramātmanevaiti siddhaṃ || <2-3-22> || nāṇuratacchruteriti cennetarādhikārāt || || nanvathā'pi na jīvo'ṇuḥ| vyāptā hyatmanaścetanā nirguṇāśceti vyāptiśrutivirodhenāṇutvāyogāt| bahuvacanaśravaṇād‌vyaptiśruteḥ paramātmani niravakāśāt| utkrāṃtyādikasya tu manogatatvena jīvātmanyupacaritatvāditi prāpte parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || nāṇuratacchruteritirennetarādhikārāditi || asyārthaḥ || nanu na jīvo'ṇuḥ| kutaḥ| atacchruteḥ vyāptā hyātmana ityaṇutvaviruddhavyāptatvaśruteḥ śravaṇāditi cenna| kutaḥ| itarādhikārāt paramātmaprakaraṇāt| tathā ca vyāptatvaśruteḥ paramātmaviṣayatvāt| nāṇutvabādhakatvamityarthaḥ || evaṃca sa ātmedaṃ sṛjati sa dvidhedamityādinā prakṛtasya paramātmana evātrābhidhānāt| na cāsya vākyasya viṣṇuratve bahuvacanavirodhaḥ| sa ātmā sa ātmānaḥ sa īśa ityādinā bahuvacanāṃtapadavācyatvena tasyaiva prakṛtatvāt| nirguṇā iti baṃdharāhityokteśca| tataścaitacchrutibādhenotkrāṃtyādīnāmaupacārikatvakalpanāyogāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena jīvāṇutvasiddheryuktaḥ samanvaya iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-23> || svaśabdonmānābhyāṃ ca || || nanu yaduktaṃ vyāptiśrutirīśvaraviṣayātatprakaraṇāditi| tanna| śrutyapekṣayā prakaraṇasya durbalatvāt| tanmātreṇa bahuvacanaśruterīśvarakaviṣayatvena saṃkocarūpabādhāyogādityāśaṃkāmapākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || svaśabdonmānābhyāṃ ceti || asyārthaḥ || caḥ samuccayo| na kevalaṃ prakaraṇabalādvyāptatvaśrutirviṣṇuparā| kiṃ tarhi eṣo hyātmādhyudgatomānaśakteriti vākyasthasvaśabdagṛhītabrahmavācakātmaśabdādunmānaśabditāparimitatvaliṃgācca vyāptatvaśrutirviṣṇuparaiva na jīvaparetyarthaḥ || evaṃcoktadoṣo bhavet| yadi prakaraṇamātreṇa vyāptiśrutestadviṣayamucyeta| na caivaṃ| kiṃ nāmaiṣohyātmā'dhyud‌gata iti vākyaśeṣe śrutātmaśabdāparimitatvaliṃgābhyāṃ| tathā ca śrutiliṃgasahitaprakaraṇena kevalayā bahuvacanaśruterbādhasya yuktatvāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena jīvāṇutvasiddheryuktaḥ samanvaya iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-24> || avirodhaścaṃdanavat || || nanvathā'pi na jīvasyāṇutvaṃ yuktaṃ| aṇostasya śarīrakaikadeśasthatvena tadanyatrābhāvena kasyāpyaprāptakaraṇena kriyānivartakatvābhāvena sarvaśarīragatasparśajñānāyogastatra tatra cakṣurādiṣu taistairyugapadrūpādiparijñānāyogāditi prāpte sūtramupanyasyati || || || avirodhaścaṃdanavaditi || asyārthaḥ || caṃdanavat caṃdanarasa iva| yathā caṃdanabiṃdorekadeśapatitatve'pi svāṃśaiḥ śarīravyāptiḥ| tathā'virodhaḥ jīvasyāṇutve'pi svāśairdehavyāptau na virodha ityarthaḥ || evaṃcāṇorapi jīvasyāṇutvavyāptyavirodhenāṇutve'pyaṃśaiḥ sarvaśarīravyāptiryujyeta| atastatra tatra parijñānāyogākhyavirodhābhāvāt| śarīraikadeśanipatitagaṃdhasārākhyamalayagiritarukāṣṭhakṛtadravyabiṃdoriva jīvasyāṃśaiḥ sarvaśarīravyāptyaṃgīkārāt| amumātro'pyayaṃ jīva iti smṛteḥ tataśca śrutyavirodhena yuktaḥ śrutisamanvaya iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-25> || avasthitivaiśeṣyāditi cennatbhyupagamāddhṛdi hi || || nanu bhavatāṃ caṃdanabiṃdovyāptyavyāptī| tasya sāṃśatvena śarīraikadeśe samyagavasthānasyānyatrāsamyagavasthānasya ca viśeṣasyānubhavasiddhatvāt| jīvasya tu sāṃśatvābhāvena tadviśeṣābhāvāt| anyathā'nityatvaprasaṃgāditi prāpte sūtramupanyasyati || || || avasthitivaiśeṣyāditi cennābhyupagamāddhṛti hīti || asyārthaḥ || nanu yuktaṃ caṃdanabiṃdoḥ śarīre vyāptatvaṃ| kutaḥ| avasthitavaiśeṣyāt dehe kvacitpradeśe samyagavasthānasatvāt na tathā jīvasya tadabhāvāditi cenna| kutaḥ| yataḥ hṛdi hi hṛdi hyeṣa iti śrutiḥ jīvasyāpi hṛdi samyagavasthānamavayavāṃtare tvasamyagavasthānāṃgīkārādityarthaḥ || evaṃca jīvasyāpi caṃdanabiṃduvatsāṃśatvāṃgīkāreṇa caṃdanabiṃduvaddehe hṛdayataditarasthānayoḥ samyagasamyagavasthānābhyupagamāt| na cānityatvaprasaṃgaḥ| sāṃśatvamātrasyānityatve prayojakābhāvena kiṃtvāraṃbhakāṃśavattvasya prayojakatvasaṃbhavena tasya ca jīve'bhāvāt| anyathā prakṛtyāderapi daśadiksaṃbaṃdhena sāṃśatvādanityatvaprasaṃgāt| hṛdi hyeṣa ātmeti śruteḥ| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena yuktaḥ śrutisamanvaya iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-26> || guṇādvā''lokavat || || evaṃ svarūpatadaṃśābhyāmātmanaḥ śarīravyāptyavyāptī sadṛṣṭāṃtamuktvā prakārāṃtareṇāpi tadupapādakasūtramupanyasyati || || || guṇādvā''lokavaditi || asyārthaḥ || vā śabdaḥ prakārāṃtare| ālokavat pradīpasyeva| yathā dīpasya prabhayā vyāptiḥ tadvadaṇorapi jīvasya| guṇāt prakāśaguṇāt| vyāptiryujyata ityarthaḥ || avirodha iti sūtroktāṃśato vyāptiḥ devānāṃ guṇādveti sūtroktaprakāśato vyāptistu manuṣyāṇāmiti viveko draṣṭavyaḥ || evaṃca keṣāṃcidguṇena keṣāṃcidaṃśairvyāptyaṃgīkārāt| asamyaksamyagiti ceti smṛteḥ| yathā''lokasya prakāśākhyaguṇena vyāptiḥ pradīparūpeṇāvyāptirevaṃ jñānākhyaguṇena vyāptirjīvarūpeṇāvyāptiriti saṃbhavena parijñānāyogākhyavirodhābhāvāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena jīvāṇutvasiddheryukto harau śrutisamanvaya iti siddhaṃ || || iti utkrāṃtyadhikaraṇaṃ || atra jīvasyaikarūpatvānekarūpatvaviṣayaśrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate || <2-3-27> || vyatireko gaṃdhavattathā ca darśayati || || nanu jīvo naikadā'nekaśarīrāvacchinnaḥ kiṃtvekenaiva| sa ekadheti śruteḥ| na cānyatrāpi sa paṃcadheti śrutirastīti vācyaṃ| tasyā yuktiviruddhatvenāprāmāṇyāt| anekaśarīrāvacchinnatvaṃ hi vibhutvena vā sāṃśatvena vā bhavet| na cobhayoḥ saṃbhavaḥ| aṇutve niravayavatve ca śratisadbhāvāt| na cobhayābhāve'pi yogināmaghaṭitaghaṭakasāmarthyopetatvenāpepannamanakeśarīratvaṃ| samudrapānādikaṃ ca teṣāṃ dṛṣṭacaramiti vācyaṃ| tathātve jīvasyeśvaraguṇasāmyaprasaṃgāt| ataḥ sayuktikaitacchrutivirodhena bahurūpaśruteraprāmāṇyānna śrutisamanvayo yukta iti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || vyatireko gaṃdhavattathā ca darśayatīti || asyārthaḥ || ca śabdo'ciṃtyayeti smṛti samuccāyakaḥ| gaṃdhavat gaṃdhasyeva| yathā puṣpagaṃdhasya svāṃśaiḥ| vyatireko vibhāgastathā'ṇorapi jīvasya svāṃśaiḥ īśaśaktyā vyatireko yujyate| kuta etatpratipādayati| yeto'theti śratiḥ tathā darśayati| ata evetyarthaḥ || evaṃca na jīvasyaikarūpatvamiti niyamaḥ| api tu yogādyāpāditeśvarānugraheṇa keṣāṃcidyugapadekalūpatvamapi| na cāṃśinaṃ vihāyāṃśasya gamanānupapattiḥ| dṛśyate khalu guṇasyāpi gaṃdhasya dharmiṇaṃ vihāyānyatra gatiḥ| sati caivaṃ kā'nupapattiḥ| dravyasyāṃśasyāṃśinaṃ vihāyānyatra gamane caikadheti śrutyavirodhaḥ| tasyāḥ svarūpaikyāviṣayatvāt| athaika eva sanniti śruteḥ| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena jīvasya bahurūpatvopapatteryuktaḥ samanvaya iti siddhaṃ || || iti vyatirekādhikaraṇaṃ || atra jīvasya paramātmābhinnatvādiviṣayaśrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate| <2-3-28> || pṛthagupadeśāt || || nanvabhinna eva jīvaḥ paramātmanā| tattvamasītyādi śruteḥ| yadyapi śrutiriyaṃ śvetaketoreva sākṣādaikyaṃ bodhayati| tathā'pi sarvajīvābhedetātparyavattvena bhavatyeva sarvajīvābhede pramāṇaṃ| satu tāvajjīvo na rāmādivadbhagavadaṃśaḥ| naiva somyeti pūrvavākyaparyālocanayā tathā'vagamāt| na ca jīvatvāviśeṣe kasyacid‌brahmābhedaḥ kasyacinneti saṃbhavati| tataśca sarvajīvānāṃ brahmābhedaṃ vivakṣitvaiva sā tasya brahmābhedaṃ vakti| na ca viparyaye'pi dvā suparṇetyādiśrutirasti| advaitaśruteḥ sopapattiṣaḍ‌vidhatātparyaliṃgayuktatvena balavattvāt| ato'dvaitaśrateradvaita eva tātparyeṇa tadviruddhabhedaśrateratattvāvedaketvameveti na bhagavataḥ śrutisamanvaya iti prāpte sūtritaṃ| || || pṛthagupadeśāditi || asyārthaḥ || jīvaḥ paramātmanā pṛthak bhinnaḥ| kutaḥ| upadeśāt bhinno'ciṃtya iti śruterityarthaḥ || evaṃca bhinna eva jīvo bhagavatā| bhinno'ciṃtya iti śruteḥ| na cābhede'pi śrutirastīti vācyaṃ| viruddhadharmādhikaraṇasya yuktiyuktatvena bhedaśruteḥ prābalyāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena jīveśayorbhedasiddherbrahmāṇi śrutisamanvayo yukta iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-29> || tadguṇasāratvāttu tadvyapadeśaḥ prājñavat || || nanvevaṃ tarhyadvaitatattvamasītyādyadvaitaśruterniviṣayatvenāprāmāṇyaṃ prāptamityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtramupanyasyati || || || tadguṇasāratvāttu tadvyapadeśaḥ prājñavaditi || asyārthaḥ || prājñavat brahmaṇīva yathā prājñe brahmaṇi sarvaṃ khalvidaṃ brahmeti jagadabhedoktiḥ| tathā jīve| tadvyapadeśaḥ tattvamasīti brahmaikyoktiryujyate| kutaḥ| tadguṇasāratvāt| jīvasya brahmaguṇasadṛśacidānaṃdādiguṇasvarūpatvānnimittādityarthaḥ || evaṃcābhedaśruterapi prāmāṇyaṃ| tathā'pi jīvasya paramātmaguṇasadṛśānaṃdādiguṇavattvāt| ahaṃ brahmāsmītyādiśrutigatānāṃ brahmādiśabdānāṃ gauṇyāvṛttyā jīve pravṛttatvena sādṛśyābhedasya śrutyarthatvāt| tattvamasītyādibrahmavācakaśabdasya jīve gauṇavṛttyaṃgīkāra ivāsipadasyajīvārthelakṣaṇāṃgīkāre'pi sādṛsyābhedapratīteśca| abhedābhāvepyabhedavyapadeśasya tadguṇasāratvena sarvaṃ khalvityādau darśanāt| tattvaṃpadabodhyayorviśiṣṭayoraikyasya bādhitatvāt| nirviśeṣayorviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvāyogenābhedabodhanāyogāt| abhedasya nīlamutpalamityādāviva tadbhāvatatvāt| nirviśeṣayorviśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvāyogenābhedabodhanāyogāt| abhedasya nīlamutpalamityādāviva tadbhāvamukhenaiva bodhanīyatvāt| yathā gaṃgāyāṃ ghoṣa ityādilaukikavākyasya gaṃgādipadāmukhyārthadvāraka eva vākyārtho na tu mukhyārthadvārakaḥ| naivaṃ vede| vedo hi svapadānāṃ mahāyogādivṛttyā'rthaṃ pradipādyaiva gauṇyādivṛttyā'rthāṃtaraṃ pratipādayatītyāha| pararītyā prāptisadbhāvenāprāptiniṣedhāyogābhāvāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena jīvabrahmaṇorbhedasiddheryuktaḥ samanvaya iti siddhaṃ || || iti pṛthagadhikaraṇaṃ || atra jīvanityatvaviṣayaśrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate| <2-3-30> || yāvadātmabhāvitvācca na doṣastaddarśanāt || || nanvanitya eva jīvaḥ| brahman layamabhyupaitītyanityatvaśruteḥ| na ca so'nādineti śrutistasya nityatve'stīti vācyaṃ| anityatvaśruteḥ sayuktikatvena prābalyāt| uktā khalu jīvasyotpattirjño'ta eveti| tataśca jīvo vināśī| bhāvatvesatyutpattimattvāditi mānasadbhāvāt| na ca tatropādherevotpattiruktā na tu jīvasyeti| upādherutpattimattvādvināśe pratibiṃbavināśasyāvarjanīyatvāt| ataḥ sayuktikaśrutivirodhāttasyānādikarmasaṃbaṃdhādyuktestadabhidhāyakaśruteraprāmāmyādayuktaḥ śrutisamanvaya iti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || yāvadātmabhāvitvācca na doṣastaddarśanāditi || asyārthaḥ || yāvadātmabhāvitvācca jīvasya yāvatparamātmasattvāt| nityatvāditi yāvat| na doṣaḥ so'nādineti puṇyapāpaṃsaṃbadhabodhakaśrutyaprāmāṇyadoṣo nāsti| kuta etat| taddarśanāt tasya nityatvasya nityo jīva iti tāvuktatvāt ca ātmā nityaḥ jīva iti smṛtidvayāccetyarthaḥ || evaṃca jīvo nitya eva| nityaḥ para iti śrutāvātmavajjīvasyāpi nityatvābhidānāt| tathā''tmānitya iti smṛtau jīvasya nityatvamuktvā taccharīrāderanityatvābhidhānāt| na copādhināśe pratibiṃbasya jīvasyāpi nāśo duṣparihāraḥ| tasyāpratibiṃbatvāt| na ca rūpaṃ rūpamiti śrutirjīvasya pratibiṃbatvamāpādayatīti vācyaṃ| tasyāstadadhīnatve sati tatsadṛśatvarūpagauṇapratibiṃbatvaparatvena mukhyapratibiṃbatvānāvedakatvāt| na caikasminnupādhāvesyaiva pratibiṃbo nānyasyeti saṃbhavati| darpaṇādāvapi tathā prasaṃgāt| api ca pratibiṃbasyopādhyekadeśavṛttitvaniyamena jīvasya ciccharīrakaideśavṛttitvaṃ prāpnoti| kiṃ ca bāhyaśarīre pratibiṃbabhāve tadbāhyaśarīranāśe jīvanāśo duṣparihāraḥ| tadabhāve tu jīvopādhirdvidhā proktā ityādau tasyopādhitvavacanamayuktamevāpatati| atha tasyopādhitvavacanaṃ gauṇaṃ tarhi ciccharīrasyāpi tadvacanaṃ gauṇamastu| ardhajaratīyānupapatteḥ| astu vā jīvasya pratibiṃbatvaṃ| tathā'pi biṃbopādhitatsannidhīnāṃ nityatvena na jīvasya nāśo bhavati| kāraṇābhāvāt| upādhyanityatāvacanāni bāhyopādhiviṣayāṇi| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena jīvasya nityatvasiddheryuktaḥ samanvaya iti siddhaṃ || || iti yāvadadhikaraṇaṃ || atra jīvasyānaṃdādirūpatvatadabhāvaśrutyorvirodhaḥ parihriyate| <2-3-31> || puṃstvādivattvasya sato'bhivyaktiyogāt || || nanu na jīvo jñānānaṃdādirūpaḥ| sukhaduḥkhādvimukta iti śruteḥ| na cānaṃdādirūpatve'pi sa balamānaṃda iti śrutirastīti nānaṃdādirūpātvābhāvanirṇayaḥ saṃbhavatīti vācyaṃ| jīvo nānaṃdādirūpaḥ| tatopalabdhiyogyatve sati tathā'nupalabhyamānatvāditi mānasadbhāvenānānaṃdaśruteḥ sayuktikatvāt| na ca pratibaṃdhakavaśenānupalabdhistannivṛttyarthaṃ prayatnasaṃbhavaḥ| jīvasyāhamiti nityābhivyaktatvena tatsvarūpabhūtānāṃ vyavadhānasyaivānupapatteḥ| kiṃcāvaraṇaṃ nāmājñānaṃ| tasya vaśādananubhava iti cet| jīvasyānaṃdādirūpatve ānaṃdādyajñānamanupapannamiti codite'jñānavaśādajñānamupapannamiti parihārāyogāt| āvaraṇaṃ śarīrāditi cet| vaiparītyamapi vaktuṃ śakyatvāt| tadevaṃ sayuktikaśrutivirodhādapramāṇamevānyāśrutirato neśvare śrutisamanvayo yukta iti prāpte sūtramāha || || || puṃstvādivattvasya sato'bhivyaktiyogāditi || asyārthaḥ || tu śabda evārthe| puṃstvādivat puṃstvāderiva puruṣayoṣidādīnāmapatyotpattiśaktisvarūpatve'pi kālaviśeṣe tadabhivyaktiḥ| tathā sataḥ jīvasvarūpatvena mukteḥ pūrvamapi vidyamānasyaivāsya jñānānaṃdāderabhivyaktiyogāt muktāvabhivyatkyā nimittabhūtayā yogāt ānaṃdī bhavatīti śrutyupapatteḥ| na jīvasyānaṃdādirūpatve tacchrutivirodha iti jīva ānaṃdādirūpa evetyarthaḥ || evaṃca bhavatyeva jīva ānaṃdādirūpaḥ| tathāśruteḥ| na cānaṃdī bhavatīti śrutivirodhaḥ| yathā puruṣayoṣidādīnāmapatyotpattiśaktisvarūpatve'pi kālatastadabhivyakternāyaṃ pūrvaṃ pumānidānīṃ pumānityādi yujyate| evaṃ jīvasvarūpatvena mukteḥ pūrvamapi sato jñānānaṃdāderīśvaraprasādenābhivyaktinimittenānaṃdī bhavatītyādivyapadeśopapatteḥ| nāpiprayatnānupapattiḥ| tadabhivyaktyarthameva mumukṣūṇāṃ tadupapatteḥ| na cāvaraṇānupapattiḥ| jñānābhāvātiriktāvidyāyā evāvaraṇatvābhyupagamāt| tadevaṃ śrutyavirodhena jīvasyānaṃdādirūpatvasiddheryuktaḥ samanvaya iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-32> || nityopalabdhayanupalabdhiprasaṃgo'nyataraniyamo vā'nyathā || || nanu jīvasvarūpabhūtānāmānaṃdādīnāṃ prāganabhivyaktānāṃ mokṣe'bhivyaktirityayuktaṃ| jīvasvarūpasya nityābhivyaktatvāditi prāpte sūtramāha || || || nityopalabdhyanupalabdhiprasaṃgo'nyataraniyamo vā'nyatheti || asyārthaḥ || vā śabdo vyavasthitavikalpārthaḥ| upalabdhiḥ anubhavaḥ| anyathā jīvasyānaṃdādirūpatvamaṃgīkṛtya āvaraṇānaṃgīkāre nityopalabdhanupalabdhiprasaṃgaḥ| yathāyogyamanvayaḥ| muktiyogyānāṃ nityamānaṃdādyanubhavaḥ syāt| tamoyogyānāṃ na kadāpyānaṃdānubhavaḥ syāt| kiṃtu svarūpaduḥkhānubhava eva syāt| evaṃ madhyamamanuṣyāṇāmanyataraniyamaḥ anyatarayoḥ sukhaduḥkhānubhavayoḥ niyamaḥ sāmyameva syāt| pratibaṃdhakībhūtāvaraṇagatādityarthaḥ| tasmājjīvasyāvaraṇamaṃgīkāryamiti bhāvaḥ| evaṃca jīvasvarūpasyānaṃdādirūpatvamaṃgīkṛtyāvaraṇanivṛttyanaṃgīkāre āvaraṇābhāvo mūlamiti cet| devadānavamānavānāṃ nityaṃ svasvarūpopalabdhiprasaṃgāt| āvaraṇābhāve'nubhavābhāvāyogāt| āvaraṇanivṛttyanaṃgīkāre tu devadānavamānavānāṃ kadā'pi svasvarūpānupalabdhiprasaṃgāt| pratibaṃdhakasya tadātanatvāt| nityānaṃda iti śrutiviruddhatvāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena jīvasyānaṃdādirūpatvasiddheryuktaḥ samanvaya iti siddhaṃ || || iti puṃstvādhikaraṇaṃ || atra jīvakartṛtvaviṣayaśrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate| <2-3-33> || kartā sāstrārthavattvāt || || nanu jīvo na kartā| nānyaḥ karteti śruteḥ| na ca yatkarma kuruta iti śrutirjīvakartṛtve pramāṇaṃ| akartṛkatvaśruteḥ sayuktakatvena prābalyāt| samarthitaṃ khalvīśvarasyaivānanyayogena kartṛtvamitaravyapadeśādityādau| tataśca jīvasya kartṛtvameva nāstītyeṣa u eva sādhukarma kārayatītyādisamanvayo na yukta iti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati || || || kartā sāstrārthavattvāditi || asyārthaḥ || jīvo'pi kartā| kutaḥ| tathā satyeva śāstrārthavattvāt vidhiniṣedharūpaśāstrasya prayojanavattvāt| anyathā vaiyarthyaprasaṃgādityarthaḥ || evaṃcoktaśrutisamanvayo yukta eva| jīvasyāpi kartṛtvena tatprerakatvasaṃbhavāt| anyathā vidhiniṣedhaśāstravaiyarthyaṃ syāt| na hi kartāramaṃtareṇāraṇyarodanāyamānaśās6sya sārthakyaṃ bhavet| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena jīvasya kartṛtvasiddheryuktaḥ śrutisamanvaya iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-34> || vihāropadeśāt || || nanvathā'pi jīvasya na vāstavaṃ kartṛtvamabhyupeyaṃ| jīvasya svataḥ kartṛtvābhāve'pi paragatakartṛtve svīyatvāgraho'styeva| ataḥ kālpanikakartṛtvavaṃtaṃ jīvaṃ prati vidhiniṣedhaśāstrapravṛttirbhavedityāśaṃkāmapākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || vihāropadeśāditi || asyārthaḥ || muktāvapi jakṣankrīḍanniti vihārakartṛtvokteḥ jīvaḥ paramārthata eva kartā na kālpanikakartetyarthaḥ || evaṃca mokṣe'pi strībhirvā yānairvetyādinā vihārakartṛtvopadeśāt| na ca mokṣe sato vyāvahārikatvasaṃbhavaḥ| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena jīvakartṛtvasiddheryuktaḥ samanvaya iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-35> || upādānāt || || nanvastu tarhi jīvasya mokṣe kartṛtvaṃ pāramārthikaṃ| prāmāṇikatvāt| saṃsāre tu vyāvahārikameva| tāvatā śāstrasārthakyaṃ bhavedityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtramupanyasyati || || || upādānāditi || asyārthaḥ || jīvasya mokṣārthe sādhanādyanuṣṭhānadarśanāt| tataḥ phaladarśanācca| na jīvaḥ saṃsāre'pi kālpanikakartetyarthaḥ || evaṃca mokṣārthaṃ sādhanādyupādānadarśanāt| na ca tadapi paragatameva jīva āropyamiti vācyaṃ| phalābhāvaprasaṃgāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena jīvakartṛtvasiddheryuktaḥ samanvaya iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-36> || vyapadeśāccākriyāyāṃ na cennirdeśaviparyayaḥ || || evaṃ saṃsāre śāstrārthavattvarūpayuktyā sādhanādyupādānapratyakṣeṇa ca sādhitaṃ jīvakartṛtvaṃ śrutyā'pi samarthayatsūtramāha || || || vyapadeśāccākriyāyāṃ na cennirdeśaviparyaya iti || asyārthaḥ || kriyāyāṃ ātmānameva lokamupāsīte tyuktopāsanakriyāyāṃ| vyapadeśāt jīvasya kartṛtvokteśca| jīvaḥ kartā| na cet kartṛtvaṃ na cet| nirdeśaviparyayaḥ| nirdeśasya jīvasya kartṛtveneśvarasya karmatvena vacanasya| viparyayaḥ ātmaivopāsītetyevaṃ rūpavaiparītyaṃ syādityarthaḥ || evaṃcātmānameva lokamupāsīteti śrutau jīvasya kartṛtvavyapedaśāt| jīvasyopāsanākriyāyāṃ kartṛtvena śrutyanabhimatatve kriyāyā akartṛkatvajaḍakartṛtvayorasaṃbhavācchrutivaiyarthyāpattyā tatparihārāya paramātmana eva kriyākartṛtvena tadabhimatatve ātmaiva lokamiti nirdeśaḥ syāt| tathā cāsya kartatvānnāsti cāsau viparītanirdeśastasmānna jīvo'kartā kiṃtu kartaiveti viparyayaparyavasāne jīvasyāpi kartṛtāsiddheḥ| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena samanvayo yukta iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-37> || upalabdhivadaniyamaḥ || || nanvevaṃ jīvasyāpi kartṛtve kathamitaravyapadeśādityādāvīśvara eva karteti samarthitaṃ| kathaṃ ca nānyaḥ karteti śrutirupapadyate| atastadvirodho'styevetyāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || || upalabdhivadaniyama iti || asyārthaḥ || upalabdhivat upalabdhāviva| yathā jīvasyopalabdhau jñāne| aniyamaḥ svecchānusāreṇa jñānālābhaḥ tathā kriyāyāmapi aniyamo yukta ityarthaḥ || evaṃca yathedamahaṃ jñāsyāmītīcchāyāmapi na svecchānusāreṇa jñānalābho jīvasya| evamidaṃ kariṣyāmīti saṃkalpe'pi na svecchānusāreṇa kāryasiddhiḥ| īśvarasya tu svecchānusāreṇa kāryasiddhirbhavatīti svātaṃtryābhiprāyeṇeśvara eva kartā na jīvaḥ kartetyucyata ityabhiprāyakatvāt| tataśca jīvasya karmaṇi niyamābhāveneśvarasya tu tadbhāvasiddheḥ| ananyādhīnakartṛtvavivakṣayeśvarasyeva kartṛtvasya na jīvasyeti prāguktatvāt| na tu sarvathā kartṛtvābhāvābhiprāyeṇeti na pūrvoktavirodhaḥ| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena jīvakartṛtvasiddheḥ samanvayo yukta iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-38> || śaktiviparyayāt || || nanvīśvarasya jīvavatsādhanāsāpekṣakartṛtvenāviśeṣāt| īśvarasyaiva svataṃtryaṃ na jīvasyetyetatkuta ityākāṃkṣāyāṃ pariharatsūtramupanyasyati || || || śaktiviparyayāditi || asyārthaḥ || īśajīvayoḥ śaktiviparyayāt pūrṇāpūrṇarūpaśaktibhedamapekṣya kartṛtvamapi svataṃtraparataṃtrabhedabhinnamityarthaḥ| yadvā| īśvaravat jīve pūrṇaśaktyabhāvānna tasya svataṃtrakartṛtvamityarthaḥ || evaṃceśvarasya sakalasādhananiyāmakatvena sādhanasvātaṃtryasadbhāvāt| kāryasiddhau ca svātaṃtryasāpekṣatvāt| jīvasya tu sādhanasvātaṃtryābhāvena phalasvātaṃtryābhāvāt| tataśca jīvasyālpasaktitvena svātaṃtryābhāvādyuktaḥ samanvaya iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-39> || || samādhyabhāvācca || || yuktyaṃtareṇeśajīvayoḥ svātaṃtryapārataṃtrye samarthayatsūtramupanyasyati || || || samādhyabhāvācceti || asyārthaḥ || samādhiḥ alaṃbuddhiḥ| tadabhāvāt na jīvasya svataṃtrakartṛtvaṃ kiṃtu parataṃtrakartṛtvamevetyarthaḥ || evaṃceśvarasya pūrṇakāmatvātphalasvātaṃtryaṃ jīvasya tadabhāvātphalasvātaṃtryābhāvaḥ| tataśca jīveśayoḥ svātaṃtryapārataṃtryoḥ pratīyamānatvena tābhyāṃ nimittābhyāṃ karmaṇi niyamāniyamayoḥ pratipattavyatvāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena samanvayo yukta iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-40> || yathā ca takṣobhayathā || || nanu jīvasya na svātaṃtryeṇa kartṛtvaṃ cettarhi śrutismṛtyādau kathaṃ kartetyucyate| asvātaṃtryakartari kartṛśabdaprayogābhāvena tasya svataṃtrakartṛtvamātrapratyāyakatvāditi prāpte parākurvatsūtramāha || || || yathāca takṣakobhayatheti || asyārthaḥ || dārṣṭāṃtikasamuccaye ca śabdaḥ| yathā takṣā vardhakiḥ| ubhayathā prāsādādikārayitṛpreritatvena tatkartṛtvena ca vyapadiśyate tathā īśvaraniyato'pi jīvaḥ karteti vaktuṃ śakyata ityarthaḥ || evaṃcāsvataṃtre'pi kartari prāsādakartāyaṃ takṣeti prayogadarśanena kartṛśabdasya svataṃtrakartṛmātrapratyāyakatvaniyamābhāvāt| jīvasyāpīśvaraniyatatvasya ghaṭādikartṛtvasya ca sadbhāvāt| ato jīva kartṛtvasiddheḥ samanvayo yukta iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-41> || parāttu tacchruteḥ || || nanu kiṃ takṣṇa iva jīvasya kartṛtvaśaktirjīvādhīnaiva| īśvarādhīnatvaṃ tu vacanavetanadānādivaduta kartṛtvaśaktirapīśvarādhīnā| ādya īśvarasyaiva kartṛtvamiti gataḥ pakṣaḥ| dvitīye na jīvasya kartṛtvaśaktiriti prāpte samādadhatsūtramāha || || || parāttu tacchruteriti || asyārthaḥ || jīvasya kartṛtvaśaktiḥ parāttu paramātmānamanusṛtyaiva tadadhīnaivāsti| kutaḥ| tacchruteḥ kartṛtvaṃ kāraṇatvaṃ ceti jīvakatṛtvasyeśādhīnatvaśravaṇādityarthaḥ || evaṃca kartṛtvaṃ karaṇatvaṃ ceti śrutibalena jīvasya kartṛtvaśakterīśvarādhīnatvāṃgīkārāt| īśvarasya kartumakartumanyathākartumiti sāmarthyasadbhāvena tadicchayaiva jīvādīnāṃ kartṛtvādisaṃpattidarśanāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena samanvayo yukta iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-42> || kṛtaprayatnāpekṣastu vihitapratiṣedhāvaiyarthyādibhyaḥ || || nanvasminpakṣe'pi doṣa uktaḥ| yadi kartṛtvaśaktirīśvarādhīnā tarhi tasyaiva kartṛtvaṃ na jīvasya| dāru pratimāvadanyādīnasyeti punaḥ śāstravaiyarthyāpāta iti prāpte parākurvatsūtramāha || || || kṛtaprayatnāpekṣastu vihitapratiṣedhāvaiyarthyādibhya iti || asyārthaḥ || turavadhāraṇe| yataḥ paramātmā vihitapratiṣedhāvaiyarthyādibhyaḥ| tādarthye caturthī| vidhiniṣedhaśāstrāvaiyarthyāya svasya vaiṣamyanairdhṛṇyaparihārāya ca kṛtaprayatnāpekṣaḥ jīvakarmaprayatnayogyatāpekṣamāṇa eva jīvaṃ prerayati na tvanapekṣaḥsan| ato jīvaśakterīśādhīnatve'pi tasyāpekṣitakṛtimattvamastyevetyarthaḥ| evaṃca vidhiniṣedhaśāstrayaiyarthyaparihārāya svasya vaiṣamyanairghṛṇyaparihārāya ca jīvakarmaprayatnayogyatāpekṣyaiveśvaro jīvaṃ prerayatītyaṃgīkārāt| pūrvakarmaprayatnaṃ ceti vacanāt| jīvasya vidhivākyatadarthajñāne tajjanyasādhanaphalecchayoḥ sādhanaviṣayakakṛtau ca bhagavatpreryatve'pi na vidhiviṣayatvakarmaphalabhāktvayoranupapattiriti na śāstrapravṛttivaiyarthyaṃ| rājabhaṭādyutpāditecchādimato'pi trivarṇādorviṣṭigṛhītasya ca saṃdhyopāsanādau bhāravahanādau ca vidhyādidarśanena tadvadevāsvataṃtrakartṛtāmātreṇa tayorupapatteḥ| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena jīvakartṛtvasiddheryuktaḥ śrutisamanvaya iti siddhaṃ || || iti kartṛtvādhikaraṇaṃ || atra jīvaviṣaye śrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate| <2-3-43> || aṃśo nānāvyapadeśādanyathā cāpi dāśakitavāditvamadhīyata eke || || nanu na jīvaḥ parameśvarāṃśaḥ| tatra pramāṇābhāvāt| na cāṃśā eva hīme jīvā iti śruteḥ prāmāṇyaṃ| naivāṃśa iti śrutibādhitatvena svārthaniścāyakatvābhāvena tacchruteraprāmāṇyāt| jīveśayorbhedasya sādhitatvena bhinnasya cāṃśatvāyogāt| asaṃbhavadarthāyāḥ prācīnaśruteḥ saṃbhavadarthāyā naivāṃśa iti śruteḥ prabalatvena bādhakatvāt| evaṃ cāṃśatvaśruteraprāmāṇyānna tatsamanvayo yukta iti || yadvā || ṭīkoktarītyā| anirṇāyakameva śrutidvayaṃ| parasparapratibaṃdhāt| na ca vrīhiyavaśrutyoriva vikalpo yuktaḥ| vastuvikalpāyogāt| na ca deśakālabhedena vyavasthitavikalpo yuktaḥ| viśeṣapramāṇābhāvāt| ataḥ śrutidvayasyāprāmāṇyameveti noktayuktayo yuktā iti| prāpte sūtramāha || || || aṃśo nānāvyapadeśādanyathā cāpi dāśakitavāditvamadhīyata eka iti || asyārthaḥ || jīvaḥ paramātmanoṃ'śa eva| pitāputratvādisaṃbaṃdhena kevalaṃ tadupajīvakatvarūpāṃśatvena ca na tu na kadācidīśvaravadupajīvyaḥ| kutaḥ| nānāvyapadeśāt māṃ rakṣatvityādau pitṛtvabhrātṛtvādinānāprakāreṇa jīvasyeśasaṃbaṃdhitvokteḥ| kiṃ ca yataḥ| eke śākhinaḥ| anyaḥ paro'nyo jīva ityādinā enaṃ jīvaṃ parāt| anyathā bhinnatvenaḥ| adhīyate paṭhaṃti| yataḥ anyeca śākhinaḥ brahma dāśā ityādinā brahmaṇo dāśakitavāditvaṃ dāśakitavaśabditajātiviśeṣayuktajīvaprabhṛtibhāvaṃ tadabhedamiti yāvat| dāśakitavādeva cābrahmatvamadhīyate| atoṃ'śatvarūpāṃśatvavānityarthaḥ || evaṃcāṃśa eva jīvo bhagavataḥ| māṃ rakṣatvityādi nānāprakāreṇa jīvasyeśasaṃbaṃdhitvavyapadeśāt| tatsaṃbaṃdhitvasyaiva tadaṃśarūpatvāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena jīvasyeśvarāṃśatvopapatteryuktaḥ samanvaya iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-44> || maṃtravarṇāt || || evamupapattyā jīvasyeśvarāṃśatvamupapādya śrutyā'pi tatsādhayatsūtramācarati || || || maṃtravarṇāditi || asyārthaḥ || pādo'syeti śruteśca jīvaḥ paramātmāṃśa ityarthaḥ || evaṃca pādo'sya viśvābhūtānīti maṃtravarṇātsarve jīvā asya paramātmanoṃ'śā ityuktatvāt| tataśca jīvasyeśvarāṃśatvopapatteryukto harau śrutisamanvaya iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-45> || api smaryate || || smṛtyā'pi jīvasya paramātmāṃśatvaṃ sādhayatsūtramupanyasyati || || || api smaryata iti || asyārthaḥ || jīvasyāṃśatvaṃ kṛṣṇādibhiḥ mamaivāṃśa iti smṛtyā kathyate cetyarthaḥ || evaṃca mamaivāṃśa iti smṛtāvīśvaro jīvasya śarīrāvāptau mūlakāraṇādiṃdriyāṇi karṣati tadutkrameṇa tu śarīrāt sthitau tu golakādibhya iti jīvasya paramātmāṃśatvenoktatvāt| ato jīvasyeśvarāṃśatvasiddheryuktaḥ samanvaya iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-46> || prakāśādivannaivaṃ paraḥ || || nanu na yuktaṃ jīvasyeśāṃśatvaṃ| tathā satyaṃśatvāviśeṣājjīvānāṃ mastyādisāmyāpātāt| anaṃśatvaśrutivirodhāccetyāśaṃkāṃ parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || prakāśādivannaivaṃ para iti || asyārthaḥ || jīvaḥ prakāśādivat khadyotādyabhimānitejoṃśavat| paramātmano bhinnāṃśaḥ| paraḥ matsyādirūpī viṣṇustu| naivaṃ jīvavadbhinnāṃśo na| kiṃtu prakāśādivat kālāgnyādyabimānitejoṃśavat| īśābhinnāṃśa evetyarthaḥ || evaṃcānaṃśatvaśrutermatsyādivatsvarūpāṃśatvābhāvaparatvāt| ata eva na matsyādibhiḥ sukhādisāmyaṃ| na cāṃśatvoktisāmyena jīvānāṃ bhinnāṃśatvaṃ matsyādīnāṃ svarūpāṃśatvamiti vaiṣamyamityayuktaṃ syāt| kālāgnikhadyotādestejoṃśatvoktisāmye'pi svarūpāṃśatvabhinnāṃśatvarūpavaiṣamyadarśanāt| ato jīvasyeśāṃśatvasiddheryukto harau śrutisamanvaya iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-47> || smaraṃti ca || || nanu dṛṣṭāṃtamātrasyānirṇāyakatvena tatra kālāgnikhadyotādīnāmekaprakārāṃśatvābhāve'pi matsyādīnāṃ jīvānāṃ ca svarūpāṃśatvamabhedaśca kiṃ na syādityāśaṃkāṃ parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || smaraṃti ceti || asyārthaḥ || smartāraḥ jīveśayoḥ bhinnāṃśatve'bhinnāṃśatve ete svāṃśakalā ityādismṛtyā kathayaṃti cetyarthaḥ || evaṃca bhāgavata ete svāṃśakalāḥ puṃsa ityādinā vārāhādīnāmabhinnāṃśatvenoktatvāt| ataḥ paraṃ yadavyaktamiti jīvānāṃ bhinnāṃśatvābhidhānācca| api ca svāṃśaścātho vibhinnāṃśa iti vacanena kevalamasaṃsāritvasaṃsāritvābhyāṃ rakṣatvārakṣatvābhyāṃ matsyādīnāṃ jīvānāṃ cāṃśino'bhedabhedāvasābhyaṃ ca kiṃtu matsyādīnāṃ svarūpāṃśalakṣaṇayuktatvājjīvānāṃ tu bhinnāṃśalakṣaṇayogitvādaṃśinābhedābhedāvasāmyaṃ ceti svarūpāsvarūpāṃśavibhāgapūrvakaṃ tayorlakṣaṇasyoktatvāt| ato jīvasyeṃśātvasiddheryuktaḥ samanvaya iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-48> || anujñāparihārau dehasaṃbadhājjyotirādivat || || evaṃ jīvānāṃ matsyādīnāṃ cāṃśinā krameṇa bhedābhedasadbhāvānnaikavidhetyuktaṃ| yuktyaṃtareṇa caikavidhatāṃ parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || anujñāparihārau dehasaṃbaṃdhājjyotirādivaditi || asyārthaḥ || yato jyotirādivat cakṣurgolakādisthitāpabhraṣṭadevatādestattaddehasaṃbaṃdhāt sūryavaruṇādyanujñayā tatpravṛttyāderiva jīvasyāpi tattaddehasaṃbaṃdhāddhetoḥ anujñāparihārau paramātmānujñādhīnapravṛttibaṃdhaparihārau na tathā matsyādeḥ| kiṃtu jyotirādivat sūryaprabhādyabhimāninaḥ yathā tadanadhīnapravṛttyādimattvaṃ tatheśānadhīnapravṛttireva| ato'pi jīvaḥ paramātmo bhinnāṃśaḥ| matsyādistu abhinnāṃśa iti vyavasthāsiddhetyarthaḥ || evaṃca paramādhīnapravṛttimokṣābhyāṃ jīvasya bhinnāṃśatvāvagateḥ| ya ātmānamaṃtara iti śruteḥ| vāsudeva saṃkarṣaṇa iti smṛteśca| matsyādiḥ svāṃśyadhīna pravṛttirna bhavati| svāṃśīkarmānirmitadehasaṃbaṃdhāt| viyad‌gataprakāśādyabhimānivaditi prayogasaṃbhavāt| jīvānāṃ dehasaṃbaṃdhānmatsyādivaccaktyabhāva īśvarānugrāhyatvaṃ tata eva baṃdhanivṛttiśca bhavet| śuklaṃ kṛṣṇamiti śruteḥ| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena jīvasyeśāṃśatvopapatteryukto harau śrutisamanvaya iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-49> || asaṃtateścāvyatikaraḥ || || yuktyaṃtareṇa matsyādīnāṃ jīvānāṃ caikavidhyaṃ parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || asaṃtateścāvyatikara iti || asyārthaḥ || asaṃtateḥ jīvasya samyak śaktyabhāvāt matsyādīnāṃ tu tadbhāvāt| avyatikaraḥ jīveśayorbhinnābhinnāṃśatvamityuktārthasya vyatyāsābhāva ityarthaḥ| evaṃcāṃśatvena śrutyuktanve'pi matsyādīnāṃ pūrṇaśaktitvājjīvānāṃ tadabhāvācca noktavyatikaraḥ| tasya ha vā etasyeti śrutau parāvarabhedena cetanānāṃ dvaividhyamuktvā tatra nārāyaṇasya sakalarūpāṇāṃ pūrṇatvādiguṇānabhidhāya taditareṣāṃ jīvānāmapūrṇatvabaddhatvānityamuktatvādīnāmuktatvāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena jīvasyeśvarāṃśatvopapatteryuktaḥ samanvaya iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-50> || ābhāsa eva ca || || yuktyaṃtareṇoktamarthaṃ sādhayatsūtramupanyasyati || || || ābhāsa eva ceti || asyārthaḥ || caḥ samuccaye| yato jīvaḥ parasya ābhāsa eva pratibiṃba eva| matsyādistu na tathā| ato'pyuktasya na vyatyāsa ityarthaḥ || evaṃca rūpaṃ rūpaṃ pratirūpo babhūveti jīvānāṃ pratibiṃbatvābhidhānāt| matsyādīnāṃ ca svarūpāṃśatvenoktatvāt| jīvasya matsyādivatsvarūpāṃśatvābhāvenānaṃśatvaśruteḥ svarūpāṃśatvābhāvaviṣayatvāt| puruṣasya dehasya chāyāvajjīvajātasya paramātmapratibiṃbatvena tadadhīnavṛttitvāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena yuktaḥ samanvaya iti siddhaṃ || || iti aṃśādhikaraṇaṃ || atra jīvasyeśvarapratibiṃbaviṣayaśrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate| atra jīvasyeśvarapratibiṃbaviṣayaśrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate| <2-3-51> || adṛṣṭo'niyamāt || || nanu na jīvā bhagavatpratibiṃbāḥ| naivāṃśo na saṃbaṃdha iti śruteḥ| na ca pratibiṃbatve'pi rūpaṃ rūpamiti śrutirastīti vācyaṃ| na saṃbaṃdha iti śruteḥ sayuktikatvāt| jīvāstāvatsuranaratiryagādibhedena vicitrāḥ| na ca tadekapratibiṃbatve saṃbhavatītyapratibiṃbatvameva jīvānāṃ| tataśca sayuktikapratibiṃbatvaśrutivirodhena pratibiṃbatvaśruteraprāmāṇyameveti noktasamanvayasiddhiriti prāpte sūtramāha || || || adṛṣṭo'niyamāditi || asyārthaḥ || adṛṣṭapadopalakṣitāvidyākarmasaṃskārāṇāṃ aniyamāt niyamo nāmaikaprakāratā| aniyamo'nekaprakāratā| tathā ca vaicitryaṃ vaicitryāt| pratibiṃbabhūtajīvānāmapi devadānavamānavādivaicitryaṃ yujyata ityarthaḥ || evaṃcoktadoṣo bhavedyadi jīvasya pratimukhavatpratibiṃbatvaṃ syāt| nacaivaṃ| kiṃ nāma pāribhāṣikaṃ tadadhīnatve sati tatsadṛśatvarūpaṃ| na cāsminpakṣe vaicitryābhāvaḥ| pitrādhīnatve sati sadṛśānāṃ putrāṇāṃ mitho vaicitryadarśanāt| astu vā pratimukhavadeva pratibiṃbatvaṃ| tathā'pi na vaicitryānupapattiḥ| adṛṣṭādivaicitryarūpakāraṇasadbhāvāt| adṛṣṭādivaicitryameva kathamiti cet| tasyāpi pūrvakarmavaicitryādhīnatvāt| karmabhedaparaṃparāyāścānāditvāt| ato nārāyaṇe śrutisamanvayo yukta iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-52> || abhisaṃdhyādiṣvapi caivaṃ || || nanu kimadṛṣṭakalpanayā| rāgadveṣamohādidoṣavaicitryeṇaiva vaicitryasaṃbhavādityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtramupanyasyati || || || abhisaṃdhyādiṣvapicaivamiti || asyārthaḥ || yato'bhisaṃdhyādiṣu kāmakrodhādidoṣeṣvapi| evaṃ adṛṣṭādivaicitryādeva vaicitryaṃ vāccaṃ| ataḥ āvaśyakatvādadṛṣṭavaicitryameva jīvavaicitryakāraṇaṃ| na doṣādivaicitryamityarthaḥ || evaṃca doṣavaicitryārthamapyaṃtato'dṛṣṭakalpanīyatvāddoṣavaicitryābhāve'pi pratikṣaṇavaicitryadarśanācca| na kevalamabhisaṃdhipadoktarāgādiṣu vaicitryamadṛṣṭāniyamātkiṃtvekapunniṣṭha pratikṣaṇavaicitryasyādṛṣṭaniyamādeva saṃbhavena na kāraṇāṃtarādataḥ śrutisamanvayo yukta iti siddhaṃ || <2-3-53> || pradeśāditi cennāṃtarbhāvāt || || nanu svargasthāḥ surā bhūmisthā narā ityādirūpeṇa sthānavaicitryādeva surānarādivaicitryopapatteḥ kimadṛṣṭavaicitryeṇetyāśaṃkāṃ parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || pradeśāditicennāṃtarbhāvāditi || asyārthaḥ || nanu pradeśāt svargabhūmyādisthānavaicitryādeva suranarādijanavaicitryamastu nādṛṣṭavicitrāditi cenna| kutaḥ| aṃtarbhāvāt sthānavaicitrye kiṃ kāraṇamiti kāraṇānveṣaṇe tatkāraṇasyādṛṣṭavaicitrya evāṃtarbhāvāt tadrūpatvāt| ataḥ a vaśyakatvādadṛṣṭavaicitryameva suranarādivaicitryaniyāmakamityarthaḥ || evaṃca svargādiprāpterapyadṛṣṭasādhyatvāt| ekapradeśasthitānāṃ vecitryadarśanācca| tadeva pāribhāṣikapratibiṃbatvasya yuktivirodhaprasaktyabhāvāt| naivāṃśo na saṃbaṃdha iti śruteśca| pratimukhatvapratibiṃbatvābhāvaviṣayatvena tadvirodhasyāpyabhāvena rūpaṃ rūpamiti śrutyā pāribhāṣika pratibiṃbatvasiddheryukto nārāyaṇe śrutisamanvaya iti siddhaṃ || || iti adṛṣṭādhikaraṇaṃ || || iti dvitīyādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ || <2.4> || śrīḥ || || hariḥ || || atha dvitīyādhyāyasya caturthaḥ pādaḥ || yuktisahitaśrutivirodhaḥ śrutināmapākriyate'sminpāde || ateṃdriyotpattiviṣayaśrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate| <2-4-1> || tathā prāṇāḥ || || nanu na prāṇāutpattimaṃtaḥ| prāṇā eveti śruteḥ| na cotpattāvapi etasmāditi śrutirastīti vācyaṃ| anutpattiśruteḥ spaṣṭārthatayā niravakāśatvena prābalyāt| etasmājjāyata iti śruteḥ prādurbhāvaparatayā'pi yojayituṃ śakyatvādavispaṣṭārthatvena daurbalyāt| prāṇā notpattimaṃtaḥ nirupādānatvāditi yuktiyuktatvāt| na cāsiddhiḥ| nopādānamiti smṛtisiddhatvāt| ataḥ prabalaśrutivirodhādutpattiśrutirapramāṇameveti neśvarasya śrutisamanvayena jagatkāraṇatvasiddhiriti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || tathā prāṇā iti || asyārthaḥ || yathā ākāśādayaḥ viṣṇorutpadyaṃte| tathā prāṇāḥ iṃdriyāṇyapi utpadyaṃta eva na tvanutpattimaṃtītyarthaḥ || evaṃcotpattimaṃta eva prāṇāḥ| ākāśasyotpattisādhakānāṃ hetūnāmihāpi sadbhāvāt| tataśca parādhīnaviśeṣāvāptimaṃta eveti paramātmana utpannatvasiddheryuktaṃ śrutisamanvayena brahmaṇo jagatkāraṇatvamiti siddhaṃ || <2-4-2> || gauṇyasaṃbhavāt || || nanvākāśotpattisidhyarthaṃ śrutyabhāvoheturuktaḥ| na cāsāviha saṃbhavati| prāṇā evetyanutpattiśrutervidyamānatvāditi prāpte parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || gauṇyasaṃbhavāditi || asyārthaḥ || prāṇā evānādaya ityanāditvaśrutiḥ gauṇī amukhyā| sūkṣmarūpeṇānutpattiviṣayā| kutaḥ| asaṃbhavāt iṃdriyāṇāṃ mukhyānāditvāyogāt| etasmāditi śrutyayogāccetyarthaḥ || evaṃca śrutisadbhāve'pi tasyā mukhyārthatvābhāvena gauṇyarthatvāt| paramātmanā sāmyaprasaṃgena mukhyārthāsaṃbhavāt| prāṇā utpattimaṃtaḥ alpaśaktitvāditi yuktiviruddhatvācca| ataḥ prāṇānāṃ paramātmana utpannatvaṃ siddhaṃ || <2-4-3> || pratijñānuparodhācca || || viyadadhikaraṇoktapratijñāhānyuktyeṃdriyāṇāmutpattiṃ samarthayatsūtramupanyasyati || || || pratijñānuparodhācceti || asyārthaḥ || idaṃ sarvamasṛjateti pratijñānuparodhāt pratijñā'nusārācca prāṇā utpadyaṃta ityaṃgīkāryamityarthaḥ || evaṃca prāṇānāmutpatyaṃgīkāre sa idamiti śruteranusārādavirodhaḥ| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena prāṇānāṃ paramātmana utpannatvaṃ siddhaṃ || || iti prāṇotpattyādhikaraṇaṃ || atra manojanmaviṣayaśrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate| <2-4-4> || tatprāk śruteśca || || nanu notpattirmanasaḥ| nityaṃ mano'nāditvāditi śruteḥ| na cotpattiśrutyanusāreṇeṃdriyotpattiśrutivadanāditvaśrutergauṇārthavarṇanaṃ yuktaṃ| iṃdriyāṇāmanityatvamuktvā viśiṣya manaso nityatvābhidhānāt| kiṃ ca manasaḥ sāditve tadvinā kadācidanādinā puruṣeṇāvasthātavyaṃ| na ca tatsaṃbhavati| tathā sati tadā saṃsārābhāvaprasaṃgāt| manasaḥ saṃsārakāraṇatvāt| mana eva manuṣyāṇāmiti smaraṇāt| ato nityameva manaḥ| evaṃca yuktiyuktiviśeṣaśruteḥ prābalyāttadvirodhenotpattiśruteraprāmāṇyānna śrutisamanvayeneśvarasya jagatkāraṇatvasiddhiriti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || tatprāk‌śruteśceti || asyārthaḥ || tadanutpattīti samuccaye ca śabdaḥ| tasya manasaḥ| tebhyo'nyeṃdriyebhyaḥ prāk pūrvaṃ utpannatvena| śruteḥ manaḥ sarveṃdriyāṇi ceti śravaṇāt| mana utpattimadeva na tvanutpattimadityarthaḥ || evaṃca nānutpattirmanaso yujyate| utpannatve śrutisadbhāvāt| na cāsyā gatyaṃtaraṃ| pṛthaṅmanaso janmābhidhāyakatvena viśeṣaśrutitvāt| na cānyeṃdriyavanmanaso'pyutpattimatve tasyeṃdriyārthasya pṛthagabhidhānaṃ vyarthaṃ| anyeṃdriyebhyo'pi prāguktotpannatvābhiprāyeṇa tadupapatteḥ| na cānutpattiśrutivirodhaḥ| tasyāḥ sūkṣmarūpamanoviṣayattvāt| na ca viśiṣyanityatvoktivirodhaḥ| anyeṃdriyebhyo'lpopacayābhiprāyakatvāttasyāḥ| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena manasobhagavadutpannatvasiddheryukto jagatkāraṇe brahmaṇi śrutisamanvaya iti siddhaṃ || || iti tatprāgadhikaraṇaṃ || atra vāgutpattiśruteranutpattiśrutyā virodhaḥ parihriyate| <2-4-5> || tatpūrvakatvādvācaḥ || || nanu na vāgutpattimatī| vāgvāveti śruteḥ| na ceyaṃ śrutirvedaviṣayeti vācyaṃ| asyāṃ hi śrutiravatiṣṭhata iti śrutaśrutyāśrayatvāyogāt| kiṃca vāganutpattimatī nityaśrutyāśrayatvādityanumānavirodho vācaḥ sāditve duṣpariharaḥ| sādernityāśrayatvādarśanāt| na cānāditvaśrutiḥ sūkṣmarūpaviṣayā| nityaśrutaśrutyuccāraṇasāmarthyarūpaśrutyāśrayatvāyogāditi prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || tatpūrvakatvādvāca iti || asyārthaḥ || vācaḥ vāgiṃdriyasya| tatpūrvakatvāt manaḥ pūrvarūpamiti manaḥ kāraṇakatvaśravaṇādvāṃgiṃdriyamutpattimadeva na tvanutpattimadevetyarthaḥ || evaṃca vāgutpattimatī| vāguttararūpamiti kāryatvaśravaṇāt| na ca kāraṇābhāvātkāryatvamanupapannaṃ| manaḥ pūrvarūpamiti śākhāṃtaraśrutyā'rthānmanaḥ kāraṇakatvasyāsidhyā kāryatvopapatteḥ| na ca śrutivirodhaḥ| śruterupacāreṇa nityatvābhidhānāt| na ca nityāśrayatvayuktyā nityatvaṃ| vāco nityaśrutisaṃnidhiyogyatāyā evāṃgīkṛtatvena nityaphalopahitaśrutyāśrayatvānaṃgīkārāt| śrutyarthaparyālocanayaupacārikanityatvasyaiva lābhāt| evaṃ satyeva hi vedāśrayatvena nityayā purāṇāśrayatvenānityayāstaumīti vākyārtho ghaṭate nānyathā| ataḥ śrutyavirodhenotpattisiddhervāco yuktaḥ śrutisamanvayo jagatkāraṇe harāviti siddhaṃ || || iti tatpūrvakatvādhikaraṇaṃ || atra prāṇasaṃkhyāviṣayaśrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate| <2-4-6> nanu `sapta prāṇāḥ prabhavaṃti' iti `dvādaśa vā' iti ca śrutyo parasparaviruddhatvādanirṇāyakatvaṃ| na cānyataraśrutyā'nyatarabādho yuktaḥ| samabalatvāt| na cābhimānināṃ saptatvātprāṇānāmapi saptatvameva| abhimānyabhimanyamānayoḥ samasaṃkhyātvaniyamāt| na ca saptatvaśrutiḥ sayuktikatvena prabalā| dvādaśaveti śrutau prāṇamāsādīnāmekadaivatyābhiprāyeṇa dvādaśamāsā ityabhihitatvena prāṇābhimānināṃ dvādaśatvena prāṇānāmapi dvādaśatvaṃ vācyaṃ|
