uktayukterapyatrāpi sāmyāt| na ca dvādaśaprāṇeṣu saptā api saṃbhavaṃtīti śrutyoravirodhaḥ| dvādaśatve kāraṇaviśeṣābhāvena saptatvokterayogāt| tataśca śrutyoraprāmāṇyena na śrutisamanvayeneśvarasya jagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || sapta gaterviśeṣitatvācceti || asyārthaḥ || ca śabdaḥ saptaprāṇāstvavagateriti pramāṇasamuccaye| gateḥ jñānasya| janakānīṃdriyāṇi sapta sapta saṃkhyākānīti nirṇaya eva| naṃ tvanirṇayaḥ| kutaḥ| viśeṣitatvāt sapta prāṇā iti śrutau guhāśayāṃ budhyarthaṃ nihitāḥ viśeṣaṇayuktatayā nirdiṣṭatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca dvādaśaiva prāṇāḥ| dvādaśaveti śruteḥ| na ca saptatvaśrutivirodhaḥ| dvādaśaprāṇeṣu saptatvasyāpi bhāvāt| na ca prāṇānāṃ dvādaśatve kāraṇābhāve saptatvokterayogaḥ| śrotracakṣuḥsparśanarasanaghrāṇamanobuddhīnāṃ jñānasādhaneṃdriyatvena tadvivakṣayā saptatvoktisaṃbhavāt| na ca teṣāṃ jñānārthatvamaprasiddhaṃ| guhāśayāṃ nihitā iti vākyaśeṣasiddhatvāt| tataśca śrutyoravirodhena prāmāṇyācchrutisamanvayena viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <2-4-7> || hastādayastu sthite'tonaivaṃ || || nanu saptabhyo'nyeṣāṃ prāṇānāṃ sadbhāve'trātharvaṇaśrutau teṣāṃ paramātmajanyatvenocyamānaiḥ saptabhiḥ `saha sapta paṃca prāṇāḥ' iti pāṭhaḥ syāt| atra sahapāṭhābhāvo dvedhā bhavet| anāditvena vā paramātmanastadakāraṇatvena veti| tadubhayamapi `tathā prāṇāḥ' ityukti viruddhatvāt| na ca sahapāṭhe vā paramātmanastadakāraṇatve vā kāraṇaṃtaramasti| akāraṇakāryotpattiścāyuktā| tataśca sahapāṭhābhāvānna saptabhyo'nye prāṇāḥ saṃtīti prāpte pariharatsūtraṃ paṭhati| || || hastādayastu sthite'tonaivamiti || asyārthaḥ || tu śabdo vailakṣaṇyadyotakaḥ yato hastādayastu hastādīṃdriyāṇi tu| sthite sthitaṃ karma| tādarthye saptamī| karmārthīni| ataḥ asmādvailakṣaṇyāttāni| evaṃ jñāneṃdriyasaha bhāvena na paṭhitāni| atasteṣāṃ saptatā siddhaivetyarthaḥ| evaṃca hastādīnāṃ paṃcānāṃ sthitihetutvalakṣaṇavailakṣaṇyamāśritya sahapāṭhopapatteḥ| ataḥ śrutyoravirodhena prāmāṇyācchrutisamanvayena viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvaniścayo yukta iti siddhaṃ || || iti saptagatyadhikaraṇaṃ || atra prāṇaparimāṇaviṣayaśrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate| <2-4-8> || aṇavaśca || || nanu vyāptāḥ prāṇāḥ| divīva cakṣuriti vyāptiśruteḥ| dūrasthavastudarśanaśravaṇānusaṃdhānādiyukteśca| na cāṇutvaśrutivirodhaḥ| viṣṇorvyāptatve dṛṣṭāṃtena cakṣurvyāpteruktatvenaitacchruteḥ prābalyāt| ataḥ prabalavyāptiśrutivirodhādaṇuśrutirapramāṇameveti prāpte sūtramāha || || || aṇavaśceti || asyārthaḥ || prāṇāḥ iṃdriyāṇi aṇavaḥ svato'ṇunītyarthaḥ| na kevalaṃ aṇūni kiṃtu tejasā vyāptāni ceti ca śabdārthaḥ || evaṃcāṇava eva hi prāṇāḥ tathāśruteḥ| na ca divīva cakṣuriti prabalaśrutivirodhenāṇutvābhāvaḥ| aṇutvasyāpi tadyathā hyaṇu na iti prabalaśrutisiddhatvāt| na caivaṃ satyanirṇayaḥ| tadyathā hyaṇu naṃ iti śrutervispaṣṭavāditvena vyāptiśrutito'pi balavatvāt| na ca tadapramāṇaṃ| tadyathā hyaṇu na iti śrutyanusāreṇa vyāptiśrutestejasāṃ vyāptyarthakatvanirṇayena yuktivirodhasya parākṛtatvāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena prāṇānāmaṇutvamiti siddhaṃ || || iti aṇvadhikaraṇaṃ || atra mukhyaprāṇajanmaviṣayaśrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate| <2-4-9> || śreṣṭhaśca || || nanu notpattimānmukhyaprāṇaḥ| naiṣa prāṇa iti śruteḥ| na ca mukhyavāyvanutpattiśrutivadiyamapi śrutiranyathā yojanīyā| tasyā utpattimaraṇakāraṇatvenotpattyādyayoga iti yuktiyuktānāditvaśruteḥ prābalyāt| ataḥ prabalānāditvaśrutivirodhādutpattiśruteraprāmāṇyānna jagatkāraṇe parameśvare śrutisamanvayopapattiriti prāpte sūtramāha || || || śreṣṭhaśceti || asyārthaḥ || yathetare prāṇā utpadyaṃte evaṃ śreṣṭhaḥ mukhyaprāṇo'pi viṣṇorutpadyata eva na tvanutpattimānityarthaḥ || evaṃca yathetare prāṇā utpadyaṃte tathā śreṣṭho'pi mukhyaprāṇa utpattimāneva| saukṣmyeṇa ha veti śruteḥ| na cānāditvaśrutivirodhaḥ| tasya sūkṣmarūpeṇa sadāsthiteḥ sthūlarūpeṇa kadāciduditatvasya coktatvāt| sthūlādibhāvasya svarūpatvābhāvāt| yadyapyasyetarajīvasādhāraṇatvānna viśeṣaḥ| tathā'pi śarīrādiṣvevāyaṃ sthūlo na tvitarajīvānāmiva caitanye| tadabhimānikṛtavikriyāviśeṣavāniti viśeṣasadbhāvāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena mukhyavāyorjananasiddheryuktaṃ jagatkāraṇatvaṃ śrutisamanvayena vāsudevasyeti siddhaṃ || <2-4-10> || na vāyukriye pṛthagupadeśāt || || nanvanāditvaśruteḥ sayuktikatvena prabalatvāttadunusāreṇotpattiśrutereva ceṣṭā bāhyavāyuviṣayatayā vyākhyātavyā| tayorapi ceṣṭāyāmiti vākye prāṇaśabdavācyatvokteretayoranutpattivacanābhāvenotpattyaṃgīkāre virodhābhāvāditi prāpte sūtramupanyasyati || || || na vāyukriye pṛthagupadeśāditi || asyārthaḥ || vāyukriye bāhyavāyuceṣṭākhyakarmaṇī na| etasmāditi prāṇotpattiśrutipratipādye na bhavataḥ| kiṃtu mukhyavāyureva tatpratipādyaḥ| kutaḥ| pṛthagupadeśāt| sa prāṇamasṛjatetyādau mukhyavāyutpatteḥ vāyukriyotpattibhyāṃ sakāśāt pṛthak śravaṇādityarthaḥ || evaṃca saprāṇamṛsṛjateti śrutau prāṇasyotpattimattvamabhidhāyaṃ prāṇācca ceṣṭāvāyvoḥ pṛthagutpattyābhidhānāt| tathaiva bhūtāni maṃtrāśceṣṭāśceti smṛtāvapyabhidhānāt| na ca sarvabhūtotpattikāraṇatvenottamatvena tasyotpattyabhāvaḥ| mahato'pi tasya tato'pyatimahatā viṣṇunā janmasaṃbhavāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena mukhyaprāṇasyotpattiriti siddhaṃ || || iti śreṣṭhādhikaraṇaṃ || atra mukhyaprāṇasvātaṃtryāsvātaṃtryaśrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate| <2-4-11> || cakṣurādivattu tatsahaśiṣṭyādibhyaḥ || || nanu svataṃtra eva mukhyaprāṇaḥ| kiṃcidāśrita iti śruteḥ| na ca prāṇasyeti pārataṃtryaśrutivirodhaḥ| svātaṃtryasādhakākhilajagacceṣṭakatvayuktiyuktatvena svātaṃtryaśruterbalavattvāt| nacotpattimatvayuktiyuktatvena parataṃtryaśrutirapi balavatī| svātaṃtryavādino janmāsaṃpratipatteḥ| janmaśrutīnāmapyetacchrutivirodhenāprāmāṇyāt| prāmāṇye'pi līlayā vigrahagrahaṇasaṃbhavena tasya pārataṃtryasādhakatvābhāve pārataṃtryaśruteḥ sayuktikatvābhāvaḥ| ataḥ prabalaśrutivirodhāparihārādapramāṇaṃ pārataṃtryaśrutiḥ| ato nārāyaṇasya śrutisamanvayena jagatkāraṇatvāsiddhiriti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || cakṣurādivattu tatsahaśiṣṭyādibhya iti || asyārthaḥ || tu śabda evārthe| mukhyaprāṇo'pi cakṣurādivatparamātmādhīna eva na tu svataṃtraḥ| kutaḥ| tatsahaśiṣṭayādibhyaḥ taiścakṣurādibhiḥ saha mukhyavāyorapi sarvaṃ hyevaitāditi śrutau parādhīnatvokteḥ| sarvakartetyādivacanoktayuktibhyaścetyarthaḥ || evaṃca mukhyaprāṇaścakṣurādivatparamātmādhīna eva| sarvaṃ hyevaitaditi cakṣurādibhiḥ sahaiva tadvaśatvābhidhānāt| mukhyavāyurna svataṃtraḥ bhagavatpreraṇāmaṃtareṇa darśanādiśaktividhuratvāditi yukteḥ| na cāsiddhiḥ| nānyo'to'stīti śrutisiddhatvāt| yadyapi prāṇaḥ sarvakartā tathā'pi sa īśvarādhīno'bhyupagaṃtavyaḥ| anyathā prāṇa eva na syāt| paramātmanaḥ svātaṃtryasyāpalāpe jagadudayādyabhāvena svātaṃtryavastudvayāsaṃbhavena ca śrutyavirodhena prāṇasyeśavaśatvasiddheruktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <2-4-12> || akaraṇatvācca na doṣastathā hi darśayati || || nanu yadi cakṣurādivadeveśvarādhīnatvaṃ mukhyaprāṇasya tarhi tasyāvāṃtareśvaratvādyasaṃbhavena na prāṇaḥ kiṃciditi svātaṃtryaśrutervaiyarthya syādityāśaṃkāṃ parākurvatsūtramāha || || || akaraṇatvācca na doṣastathā hi darśayatīti || asyārthaḥ || mukhyaprāṇasya karaṇatvāt kartṛprayojyatvarūpakaraṇābhannatvāt cakṣurādīnāṃ tadrūpatvācca asmādeva vailakṣaṇyānmukhyasyetarebhya uttamatvasiddheḥ| na doṣaḥ mukhyaprāṇasvātaṃtryavāciśruteravāṃtareśvaraparatvābhāvadoṣo nāsti| kasmādevaṃ kalpyata iti cet| hi yasmāt| tāni ha vā iti śrutistathā uktaprakāreṇa| darśayati jñāpayati| tasmādityarthaḥ || evaṃca sarveṣāmīśvarādhīnatvasāmye'pītareṣāṃ kartṛprayojyatvānmukhyaprāṇasya tadabhāvena viśeṣāt| suptyādau vyāpārabhāvābhāvarūpayuktyā tāni ha veti śrutyāca viśeṣasiddheścopapannaṃ tasyāvāṃtareśvaratvaṃ| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena prāṇasyeśavaśatvaṃ siddhaṃ || || iti cakṣurādyādhikaraṇaṃ || atra prāṇāpānādermukhyaprāṇasvarūpatvataddāsatvaviṣaye śrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate| <2-4-13> || paṃcavṛttirmanovadvyapadiśyate || || nanu sarve vā ete mukhyadāsā iti mukhyasyaiva svarūpāṇīti śrutidvayamapramāṇaṃ| arthānirṇāyakatvāt| yadyeko mukhyasyaiva svarūpāṇīti śrutiṃ vyaktasadguṇatvayuktiṃ cāvalaṃbya prāṇādayo mukhyaprāṇasvarūpāṇyeveti brūyāttarhyaparopi sarve vā eta iti tadājñayā karmakāritvayuktiṃ cāvalaṃbya prāṇādayo dāsā eveti brūyāt| ata etadyuktiśrutyavaṣṭhaṃbhenādyā dāsā eveti vrūyāttarhi paro'pi prācīnaśrutiyuktyavaṣṭhaṃbhena svarūpāṇyeveti brūyāt| samabalatvenānyataraśrutibādhāyogāt| evaṃcārthānirṇayena śrutidvayāprāmāṇyānna śrutibalena viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvasiddhiriti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || paṃcavṛttirmanobad‌vyapadiśyata iti || asyārthaḥ || manovat manasa iva| yathā manasaḥ manobudhyahaṃkāracittacetanākhyapaṃcaprakāropetatvaṃ tathā mukhyaprāṇo'pi paṃcavṛttiḥ prāṇāpānāpaṃcarūpavān| kutaḥ| yasmāt atha paṃcavṛttyeti śrutau tathā vyapadiśyate pratipādyate| tasmādityarthaḥ || evaṃca prāṇādayo dāsā eva svarūpāṇyeveti na brūmaḥ| yena parasparavirodhenānirṇayaḥ| kiṃ nāmārtha paṃcavṛttyaitaditi śrutyavaṣṭhaṃbhena manovat| prāṇādayaḥ svarūpāṇi dāsāśceti dvividhāḥ| tataśca śrutyorbhinnaviṣayatvenābādhaḥ| na ca prāṇānāṃ dāsatve vyaktasadguṇatvavirodhaḥ| dāsānāmapi tadaṃgīkārāt| na ca svāmibhṛtyabhāvānupapattiḥ| svāmināṃ tato'pi vyaktasadguṇatvena tadbhāvopapatteḥ| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena prāṇādisvarūpasiddheryakto jagatkāraṇi brahmaṇi śrutisamanvaya iti siddhaṃ || || iti paṃcavṛttyadhikaraṇaṃ || atra mukhyaprāṇaparimāṇaviṣayaśrutirodhaḥ parihriyate| <2-4-14> || aṇuśca || || nanu vyāpta evāyaṃ prāṇaḥ| prāṇa evādhastāditi vyāptiśruteḥ| na ca `aṇunetyaṇutvaśrutivirodhaḥ'| sakalajagaddhārakatvayuktiyuktatvena vyāptiśruteḥ prābalyāt| ataḥ prabalaśrutivirodhādapramāṇamaṇutvaśrutiriti prāpte sūtramāha || || || aṇuśceti || asyārthaḥ || mukhyaprāṇaḥ prāṇarūpeṇāṇuḥ| vāyurūpeṇa vyāptaścetyarthaḥ || evaṃcāṇureva mukhya prāṇaḥ| sa vā eṣa prāṇa iti śruteḥ| na ca vyāptiśrutivirodhaḥ| tasyā bahirdehādvartamānavāyurūpaviṣayatvāt| aṃtarvā'ṇurbahirmahāniti viśeṣaśruteḥ| nāḍīsaṃcāritvayukteśca| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena mukhyaprāṇasyāṇutvasiddheryukto jagatkāraṇe brahmaṇi śrutisamanvaya iti siddhaṃ || || iti aṇvadhikaraṇaṃ || atreṃdriyaviṣayaśrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate| <2-4-15> || jyotirādyadhiṣṭhānaṃ tu tadāmananāt || || nanviṃdriyāṇi jīvakaraṇāni| jīvasya karaṇānyāhuriti jīvasaṃbaṃdhitvaśruteḥ| na ca brahmaṇyoveti śrutyaṃtaravirodhaḥ| jīvavaśatvena prāṇānāṃ dṛśyamānatvayuktiyuktatvena jīvakaraṇatvaśruteḥ prābalyāt| tataścaitacchrutivirodhena brahmakaraṇaśruteraprāmāṇyāt| na śrutisamanvayena viṣṇorjagatkāraṇatvasiddhiriti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati || || || jyotirādyadhiṣṭhānaṃ tu tadāmananāditi || asyārthaḥ || jyotirādyadhiṣṭhānamityāvartate| tattvityanvayaḥ| tathā ca jyotirādyadhiṣṭhānaṃ agnyādibhūtaprerakaṃ tat‌brahmaiva| jyotirādyadhiṣṭhānaṃ cakṣurādiprerakaṃ na jīvaḥ| kutaḥ| tadāmananāt yaścakṣuṣi tiṣṭhannityādinā tathā pratipādanādityarthaḥ || evaṃca brahmasaṃbaṃdhīnyeva karaṇāni jīvasya jñānādisādhanāni| na punarjīvakaraṇāni| jīvāpekṣayā teṣāmuttamatvena jīvaprayojyatvāsaṃbhavāt| tadeva hi svaṃ nāma bhavati| yadyatheṣṭhaviniyogārhaṃ na ca tata eva na brahmasaṃbaṃdhīnyapīti vācyaṃ| etanmūlatejaḥ prabhṛti bhūtasyaiva brahmaniyamyatvena sutarāmeṣāṃ tanniyamyatvāt| yaścakṣuṣi tiṣṭhannityādiśruteśca| ato śrutyavirodhena prāṇānāṃ brahmakāraṇatvasiddheryukto jagatkāraṇe harau śrutisamanvaya iti siddhaṃ || <2-4-16> || prāṇavatā śabdāt || || nanu na karaṇāni jīvasaṃbaṃdhīni cettarhi tatkaraṇatvābidhāyakaśruteraprāmāṇyaprasaṃga ityāśaṃkāmapākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || || prāṇavatā śabdāditi || asyārthaḥ || paramātmā svaprayojyaireva cakṣurādibhiḥ karaṇaiḥ prāṇavatā jīvena kartrā darśanādi kārayati na jīvaprayojyaiḥ| kutaḥ| śabdāt eṣa hyaneneti śruterityarthaḥ || evaṃca karaṇatvābhidhāyakaśruterbrahma svakaraṇaireva darśanādi kārayatīti yācitakuṭhāravadīṣatsaṃbaṃdhitvamastīti tatparatvena prāmāṇyapapatteḥ| jīvakaraṇasaṃbaṃdhasyānādinityatvena tadabhiprāyeṇāpi pravṛttāyāstasyāḥ prāmāṇyopapatteḥ| dṛśyate khalu loke parakīye bahukālasaṃbaṃdhini tadīyatvopacāraḥ| na ca yadīṃdriyāṇi brahmakaraṇāni tarhi mukhyaprāṇasyāpi tatsamāna eveti prāguktaṃ| tasmātprāma evākaraṇa iti mukhyaprāṇakaraṇatvamayuktamiti cenna| īśvaraścakṣurādīn kiṃcijjīvecchayā prerayati| mukhyaprāṇastu svaicchayaiveti viśeṣasadbhāvena tadupapatteḥ| karaṇeḥ kāraṇamiti tyādivacanasadbhāvāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena brahmaṇijagatkāraṇe śrutisamanvayo yukta iti siddhaṃ || <2-4-17> || tasya ca nityatvāt || || evaṃ bhagavadadhīnānyapīṃdriyāṇyasvataṃtrajīvakartṛke karmaṇi sādhanatvāttatkaraṇānītyucyaṃte| yathā parakīya kuṭhāreṇāpi vraścato'sau tatkaraṇamucyata ityevaṃ mukyamarthaṃ jīvakaraṇatvaśruteruktvā'dhunā mukhyārthātarapratipādakaṃ sūtramavatārayati || || || tasya ca nityatvāditi || asyārthaḥ|| cakṣurādīnāṃ brahmakaraṇatve'pi tasya jīvasya karaṇasya ca tayoḥ saṃbaṃdhasya ca nityatvāt| tadvivakṣayā jīvakaraṇatvaśrutirapyupapadyata ityarthaḥ || evaṃca parakīye'pi bahukālasaṃbaṃdhini vastunyupacāratastadīyatvavyavahāradarśanādatrāpi bhagavadīyeṣvapīṃdriyeṣu bahukālanijīvasaṃbaṃdhitāyāḥ sadbhāvena tatkaraṇatvaśrutiḥ pravṛtteti śruterupacāritārthatvāt| athāviyogīnīti śruteḥ| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena pare brahmaṇi jagatkāraṇe śrutisamanvayo yukta iti siddhaṃ || || iti jyotiradhikaraṇaṃ || atra mukhya prāṇasyeṃdriyatvāniṃdriyatvaśrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate| <2-4-18> || ta iṃdriyāṇi tadvyapadeśādanyatra śreṣṭhāt || || nanu sarve'pi prāṇā iṃdriyāṇi| prāṇā vā iṃdriyāṇīti śruteḥ| sāmānyaśruteḥ sarvagāmitvāt| na ca dvādaśaiveṃdriyāṇīti viśeṣaśrutyā bādhaḥ| idaṃ dravaṇayuktiyuktatvena sāmānyaśruterbalavattvāt| duṣkaraṃ ca dvādaśānāmeveṃdriyatvagrahaṇaṃ| anyatamaniveśanasyāśakyatvāt| niyāmakaṃ vinā kasyacitparityāge'parasyāpi tatsyāditi dvādaśatvahāniḥ| ato yuktiyuktādyaśrutivirodhena dvitīyā aprāmāṇyena na brahmaṇi śruti yukta iti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || || ta iṃdriyāṇi tadavyapadeśādanyatra śreṣṭhāditi || asyārthaḥ || śreṣṭhāt mukhyaprāṇāt| anyatra ye prāṇāḥ| te eveṃdriyāṇi na tu mukhyaprāṇo'pi| kutaḥ| tadvyapadeśāt dvādaśaiveṃdriyāṇīti śrutau tatoktatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca na sarve prāṇā iṃdriyāṇi kiṃtu mukhyaprāṇamṛte dvādaśaiva| dvādaśaiveṃdriyāṇīti viśeṣaśruteḥ| na cedaṃ dravaṇavataḥ kathamaniṃdriyatvamiti vācyaṃ| tasya dravatāṃ svāmitvena idaṃ dravaṇābhāvāt| viṣayadravaṇātteṣāmiti vacanasadbhāvāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena mukhyaprāmasyāniṃdriyatvasiddheryukto jagatkāraṇe brahmaṇi śrutisamanvaya iti siddhaṃ || <2-4-19> || bhedaśruteḥ || || nanu yadi mukhyaprāṇo neṃdriyaṃ tarhi cakṣurapi na syāt| cakṣurmukhyaprāṇayoḥ sarvathā viśeṣābhāvāt| idaṃ dravaṇabhāvābhāvarūpasya sthitatvena sthitatvarūpasya sūtrakṛtā'nuktatvādaprayojakatvācceti prāpte sūtramāha || || || bhedaśruteriti || asyārthaḥ || mukhyaprāṇasya sarvakartṛtvakārayitṛtvarūpabhedakadharmasyānyeṣāṃ tadabhāvasya sthita eva hīti śrutau śrutatvānna tasya cakṣurādyaviśeṣa ityarthaḥ || evaṃca sthita eva hīdamiti śrutau mukhya prāṇasya sarvakartṛtvakārayitṛtvabalatvabalayitṛtvadhatṛtvadhārayitṛtvādi viśeṣoktyeśvarasāmyābhidhānena tasya kartṛprayojyatvābhāvāt| tataśca śrutyavirodhena mukhyaprāṇasyāniṃdriyatvaṃ siddhaṃ || <2-4-20> || vailakṣaṇyācca || || nanvayaṃ mukhyaprāṇo bhagavadvaśo na vā| ādye tasyāniṃdritvāsiddhiḥ| īśavaśatvasāmyāt| idaṃ dravaṇābhāvasthitatvādyavāṃtaravailakṣaṇyasya ceṃdriyeṣvapi saṃbhavāt| dvitīye cakṣurādītyuktavirodhaḥ| iti prāpte samādadhatsūtramāha || || || vailakṣaṇyācceti || asyārthaḥ || mukhya prāṇasya taditaraprāṇānāṃ ca kevaleśvarādhīnatveśvarajīvobhayādhīnatvarūpavailakṣaṇyasatvācca na tasyeṃdriyatvaṃ kiṃtu cakṣurādīnāmevetyarthaḥ || evaṃca mukhyeśvarādhīnatve'pīṃdriyāṇāmīśvarajīvobhayavaśapravṛttikatvānmukhyasya ca kevaleśvarādhīnapravṛttirūpavailakṣaṇyāt| iṃdriyeṣūktavailakṣaṇyasya pratyakṣasiddhatvāt| mukhye ca prāṇāgnaya iti śrutisiddhatvāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena yukto jagatkāraṇe harau śrutisamanvaya iti siddhaṃ || || iti ta iṃdriyādhikaraṇaṃ || atra nāmarūpaviṣaye śrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate| <2-4-21> || saṃjñāmūrtiklṛptistu trivṛtkurvata upadeśāt || || nanu viriṃca eva nāmarūpakartā| viriṃco veti tathā śruteḥ| na cātha kasmāditītara śrutivirodhaḥ| viriṃcasya yuktiyuktatvenāsyāḥ śruteḥ prābalyāt| na ceyaṃ śrutirdvārakaraṇatvaparā| mukhyāsaṃbhave'mukhyasyaiva grāhyatvāt| ataḥ sayuktikaitacchrutivirodhenetarāśrutirapramāṇamiti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati| || || saṃjñāmūrtiklṛptistu trivṛtkurvata upadeśāditi || asyārthaḥ || tu śabdo'vadhāraṇe| saṃjñāmūrtiklṛptirnāmarūpātmakadeheṃdriyaprapaṃcotpattiḥ| trivṛtkurvataḥ pṛthivyaptejasāṃ miśrībhāvaṃ kurvataḥ paramātmanaḥ sakāśādeva bhavati| na viriṃcāt| kutaḥ| upadeśāt sarvāṇi rūpāṇi viciṃtyadhīra iti śruterityarthaḥ || evaṃca paramātmaiva nāmarūpakartā| sarvāṇi rūpāṇīti śruteḥ| na ca viriṃcasyāpikartṛtve śrutirasti| nāmarūpakaraṇasya trivṛtkaraṇasāpekṣatvena tatkartṛreva mukhyato nāmarūpakartṛtvasya vaktavyatve viriṃcaśruterdvārakāraṇamātrārthatvāt| ata eva viriṃcatvayuktivirodho'pi parāstaḥ| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena śarīrasya harikartṛtvāsiddheryukta tasya śrutisamanvayena jagatkāraṇatvamiti siddhaṃ || || iti saṃjñādhikaraṇaṃ || atra śarīrakāraṇaśrutivirodhaḥ parihriyate| <2-4-22> || māṃsādibhaumaṃ yathāśabdamitarayośca || || nanvāpyameva śarīraṃ| ad‌bhyohīdamiti śruteḥ| śarīrāvayaveṣu māṃsādiṣvadharmatarpakatvadarśanāt| na tu bhūtatrayātmakaṃ| tathātve āpaḥ śarīramiti hiraṇyagarbhaśarīra iti ca viśeṣoktyayogaprasaṃgāt| athavā| pārthivaṃ| pṛthivīṃ śarīramapyetīti pṛthivyāṃ layābhidhānāt| kāṭhiṇyādi yukteśca| athavā| taijasaṃ| so'gnerdevetiśruteḥ| auṣṇyadarśanācca| ato virodhenemāstisro devatā iti śruteraprāmāṇyānna śrutisamanvayena viṣṇau jagatkāraṇatvamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || || māṃsādibhaumaṃ yathā śabdamitarayośceti || asyārthaḥ || bhaumamityupalakṣaṇaṃ| yaccharīre kaṭhiṇaṃ māṃsādi tadevaṃ bhaumaṃ pārthivaṃ na sarvaśarīraṃ| kiṃ tarhi yathā śabdaṃ yatkaṭhinaṃ sā pṛthivīti śrutimanusatya| śarīretarayoḥ aptejasośca kāryaṃ śoṇitamajjādirūpamaṃgīkāryaṃ| yathā māṃsādikaṃ bhaumaṃ pṛthivīkāryaṃ| na kevalaṃ pṛthivīkāryaṃ kiṃ nāmetarayoraptejasośca kāryaṃ yathā śrutyaṃgīkāryamityarthaḥ || evaṃca yaccharīre kaṭhinaṃ māṃsādi tadeva pārthivaṃ| yacchoṇitādi tadevāpyaṃ| yacca majjādi tadeva taijasaṃ śarīraṃ tu tryātmakaṃ| yatkaṭhinaṃ sā pṛthivīti śruteḥ| na cāpo vāva māṃsāmiti śrutivirodhaḥ| māṃsasyāpi kevalapārthivatvānaṃgīkāreṇa śrutyanusāreṇābādikāryatvasyāpyabhimatatvāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena śarīrasya pāṃcabhautikatvasiddheryukto jagatkāraṇe brahmaṇi śrutisamanvaya iti siddhaṃ || <2-4-23> || vaiśeṣyāttu tadvādastadvādaḥ || || nanu śarīrasya naikabhūtaprakṛtikatve viśeṣokterayogāt| śarīre māṃsādiṣu vā bhūtānāṃ viśeṣasaṃyoge sarvaśarīreṣu sarvabhūtānāṃ viśeṣasaṃyogabhāve ca punarekaikabhūtaprācuryavivakṣayā pārthivādiviśeṣektyayogāt| adhyāyasamāptijñāpanārthamarthabhedena jñātuṃ śakyatvena sūtrapade dvirukterayogāt| anyathā pādāṃte'pi tatprasaṃgāditi prāpte sūtramāha || || || vaiśeṣyāttu tadvādastadvāda iti || asyārthaḥ || pārthivamāpyaṃ taijasamiti viśeṣoktistu vaiśeṣyāt pṛthivyādi bhūtānāṃ tattaccharīraviśeṣasaṃyogamapekṣya yujyate| ataḥ na tadvirodha ityarthaḥ| etadadhyāyoktasarvasyārthasyāvadhāraṇārthamadhyāyāṃte dviruktiḥ || evaṃca bhūtakāryaśarīrāṇāṃ tadbhūtasaṃyogaviśeṣasadbhāvena vaiśeṣyāttattad‌vyapadeśopapatteḥ| na coktaviśeṣasaṃyogābhāvavirodhaḥ| pārthivānāṃ śarīrāṇāmiti vacanāt| nāpi dviruktivirodhaḥ| adhyāyārthaniścayarūpaprayojanasadbhāvena sarvādhyāyāṃtimasūtre padasya dvirukteḥ kriyamāṇatvāt| ataḥ śrutyavirodhena śarīrasya pāṃcabhautikatvasiddherjagatkartari viṣṇau śrutisamanvayo yukta iti siddhaṃ || || iti māṃsādhikaraṇaṃ || || iti dvitīyādhyāyasya caturthaḥ pādaḥ || || iti dvitīyādhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ || <3> <3.1> || śrīḥ || || hariḥ oṃ || || atha tṛtīyādhyāyaḥ || || sādhanavicāro'yamadhyāyaḥ || || atha prathamaḥ pādaḥ || vairāgyārthe gatyādi nirūpaṇā'sminpāde kriyate || atra bhagavatprāptisādhanavairāgyāya jīvasya bhūtāviyogaḥ samarthyate| <3-1-1> || oṃ || tadaṃtarapratipattau raṃhati saṃpariṣvaktaḥ praśnanirūpaṇābhyāṃ || oṃ || nanu nānuṣṭheyameva sādhanaṃ| phalārthaṃ hi sādhanamanuṣṭheyaṃ| phalaṃ ca baṃdhanivṛttiḥ| na maraṇādatiricyate| bhūtasaṃbaṃdho hi baṃdhaḥ| bhūtabaṃdhastu saṃsāra iti vacanāt| na ca maraṇārthameva sādhanamanuṣṭheyaṃ| vairāgyādyananuṣṭhāne'pi maraṇadarśanāt| tataśca śāstramidaṃ vyarthamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || oṃ || tadaṃtarapratipattau raṃhati pariṣvaktaḥ praśnanirūpaṇābhyāmiti || asyārthaḥ || tadaṃtarapratipattau śarīrāṃtaraprāptyarthaṃ| jīvaḥ saṃpariṣvaktaḥ pṛthivyādibhūtasaṃyukta eva raṃhati imaṃ dehaṃ parityajya lokāṃtaraṃ gacchatīti jñāyate| kutaḥ| praśnanirūpaṇābhyāṃ vettha yatheti śvetaketumṛṣiṃprati pravāhaṇasya rājñaḥ praśnāt| tathā iti tviti pravāhaṇoktaparihārāccetyarthaḥ || evaṃca baṃdhanivṛttirūpaphalasadbhāvāt| na ca maraṇameva baṃdhanivṛttiḥ| maraṇe bhūtasaṃpariṣvaktasyaiva jīvasya gamanāṃgīkārāt| tatra vetyeti praśnavākye tasyaiva parihāravākye ca mṛtasya bhūtapariṣvaṃgābhidhānāt| bhūtānāṃ vinivṛttiriti vacanaṃ tu bhūtabhāgavinivṛtyabhimatamitiṃ na tadvirodhaḥ| ato maraṇamātreṇa mokṣāyogāt| anuṣṭheyameva sādhanamiti sārthakameva śāstramiti siddhaṃ || || iti tadaṃtarādhikaraṇaṃ || atra bhagavatprāptisādhanavairāgyārthaṃ jīvasya samastabhūtapariṣvaktasya gatiḥ samarthyate| <3-1-2> oṃ || tryātmakatvāttu bhūyastvāt || oṃ || nanu jīvena saha āpa eva gacchaṃti na sarvāṇi| āpaḥ puruṣeti śruteḥ| anyathā bhūtānāti śrutiḥ syāt| ato mṛtasya samastabhūtabaṃdhābhāvātmaraṇameva mokṣa iti vyarthameva vairāgyādīti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || oṃ || trayātmakatvāttu bhūyastvāditi || asyārthaḥ || jīvaḥ sarvabhūtapariṣvakta eva gacchati| nādbhireva| āpa iti viśeṣoktistu tryātmakatvāt apāṃ kṣitisalilānalātmakatvāt| tepvapyapāṃ bhūyastvāt bāhulyāt| yujyate| ato na tadvirodha ityarthaḥ || evaṃca āpi iti punurutpattiśravaṇāt| na ca sarvabhūtapariṣvaṃgābhāve punurutpattiryujyate| bhūtabaṃdhasyaiva saṃsāratvena tadabhāve muktatvāpātāt| ekabhūtasya cābaṃdhakatvāt| na ca viśeṣaśrutivirodhaḥ| apāṃ trivṛtkṛtapṛthivyaptejaso hetutvenāp‌grahaṇenaiva sarveṣāṃ prāpteḥ| na cāpāmiva bhūtejasorapi trivṛtkṛtabhūtatrayakāraṇatvena śabdāṃtaramapahāyāp‌śabdasyaiva grahaṇe kāraṇābhāva iti| sarvaśarīreṣu saṃbhūyāpāṃ bahutvasyaiva niyāmakatvāt| ato'sti sarvabhūtānāṃ jīvaṃ pariṣvajya gamanamiti svābhāvikamaraṇena muktyabhāvādanuṣṭheyaṃ vairāgyādīti siddhaṃ || || iti tryātmakatvādhikaraṇaṃ || atra vairāgyasidhyarthaṃ jīvasya bhūtaiḥ saha gatiḥ samarthyate| <3-1-3> oṃ || prāmagateśca || oṃ || nanu na bhūtāni saha gacchaṃti| pramāṇāmāvāt| na ca praśnavyākhyāne pramāṇaṃ| tayorapi bhūtaiḥ saha gamanāpratīteḥ| ārthikakalpanāyāśca viśeṣapramāṇamaṃtareṇāsaṃbhavāt| ataḥ svābhāvikamaraṇameva muktirityalaṃ vairāgyādibhiriti prāpte sūtramāha || || oṃ || prāṇagateśceti || asyārthaḥ || bhūtavyāptaprāṇaśabditeṃdriyāṇāṃ jīvena saha gamanaśravaṇācca| jīvo bhūtasaṃpariṣvakta eva gacchatītyarthaḥ || evaṃca bhūtāni jīvena saha gatimaṃti tatsahagaṃtṛprāṇavyāpakatvāt ityanumānasadbhāvāt| na ca vyāptyabhāvaḥ| yatra vāva bhūtānīti śrutyā bhūtānāṃ prāṇānāṃ ca parasparavyāpyavyāpakabhāvāmidhānāt| ataḥ samastabhūtānāṃ jīvapariṣvaṃgasiddhena maraṇamātreṇa mokṣo'to'pekṣitaṃ vairāgyādīti siddhaṃ || || iti prāṇagatyadhikaraṇaṃ || atra prāṇānāṃ jīvena sahagatiḥ samarthyate| <3-1-4> oṃ || agnyaṇāt| tathā ca prāṇānāṃ gatyabhāvena sādhakābhāvādbhūtānāmapi na saha gatiriti maraṇameva mokṣa iti vyarthaṃ vairāgyādītyākṣipya samādadhatsūtraṃ paṭha ti || || oṃ || agnyādigatiśruteriti cenna bhāktatvāditi| asyārthaḥ || agnyādigatiśruteḥ prāṇānāṃ yatreti agnyādīn prati gamanasyokterna jīvena saha gamanamiti cenna| kutaḥ| bhāktatvāt| yatreti śruteḥ prāṇabhāgaviṣayatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca etairvāva neti śrutisadbhāvāt| prāṇānāṃ bhāgenāgnyādau gatyaṃgīkāreṇāgnimiti viśeṣaśruteravirodhaḥ| puruṣasya matāviti vacanāt| punaḥ śarīraprāptisamaye'gnyādau praviṣṭānāṃ bhāgānāṃ jīvasahagatabhāgeṣu praveśāṃgīkāreṇa sarvāpagamābhāvāt| tathā ca bhūtānāmapi maraṇakāle bhāgena jīvena saha gatiḥ| bhāgenāgnyādigatirbhavati| punaḥ śarīraprāptau jīvena saha gateṣu bhūtabhāgeṣvagnyādīnprati gatānāṃ bhūtabhāgānāṃ praveśo bhavatīti vivekāt| ato'sti prāṇānāṃ jīvena saha gatistato bhūtānāmapīti na maraṇamātreṇa mokṣo'tonuṣṭheyaṃ sādhanamiti siddhaṃ || atra bhūtānāṃ jīvena saha gatirākṣipya samādhīyate| <3-1-5> oṃ || prathame'śravaṇāditi cenna tā eva hyupapatteḥ || oṃ || nanu jīvena saha bhūtānāṃ gamanaṃ bhavet| tasminnetasminnitītyupakrame śraddhāsahitasyaiva homābhidhānāt| bhūtānāmapi saha gatāvupakrame tathoktiprasaṃgāt| ato bhūtānāṃ sahagatyabhāvena bhūtānāṃ vinivṛttireva mokṣa iti vadato maraṇasyaiva mokṣatvaprasaṃgād‌vyarthaṃ vairāgyāgītyākṣipya samādadhatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || oṃ || prathame'śravaṇāditi cenna tā eva hyupapatteriti|| asyārthaḥ || prathame tasminnityupakrame| prathame dyunāmake| prathamāgnau homaśravaṇāt bhūtānāṃ jīvasāhityaśravaṇābhāvācca| na jīvo bhūtasahito gacchatīti cenna| kutaḥ| hi yataḥ| tā eva prastutā āpa evopakramagataśraddhaśabdenocyaṃte| ataḥ| tatkutaḥ| upapatteḥ| āpaḥ puruṣavacaso bhavaṃti tyupasaṃhāropapatterityarthaḥ || evaṃca prathamāgnau bhūtasahitasya homaśravaṇena bhūtānāṃ sahagatervaktavyatvāt| śraddhaśabdasya jahatsvārthalakṣaṇayāp‌śraddhāviśiṣṭajīvavācitvāt| upasaṃhāre'pāṃ jīvena saha gatiśravaṇāt| upasaṃhārānusāreṇaivopakramasya neyatvāt| na cāgamanamātraviṣayatvamupasaṃhārasyeti vācyaṃ| maraṇakāle tatparityāgānukteḥ| madhye saṃyogamanabhidhāyāpa ityanuvādena saha gamanasyaiva kalpyatvāt| ato bhūtānāṃ jīvena saha gatisadbhāvānmaraṇasya muktitvābhāvenāpekṣitaṃ vairāgyādisādhanamiti siddhaṃ || || iti prathamādhikaraṇaṃ || atra jīvasya bhūtaiḥ saha gatiḥ samarthyate| <3-1-6> oṃ || aśrutatvāditi cenneṣṭādikāriṇāṃ pratīteḥ || oṃ || nanu māstu bhūtānāṃ jīvena saha gamanaṃ| tathā śrutyabhāvāt| na cāpāṃ prāṇānāṃ ca sahagatiḥ śrūyate'to'rthādbhūtagatirapi śrutā bhavatīti| apāṃ prāṇānāṃ ceti śrutau sākṣācchravaṇābhāvenārthikaśruterapalapanīyatvāt| vaidike'rthe sākṣācchravaṇasadbhāvādeva yuktīnāṃ pravṛtteryuktyā'pi na tatsiddhiḥ| tataśca maraṇasyaiva mokṣatvaprasaṃgādananuṣṭheyameva vairāgyādītyākṣipya parākurvatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || oṃ || aśrutatvāditicennaṣṭādikāriṇāṃ pratīteriti || asyārthaḥ || aśrutatvāt bhūtānāṃ jīvena saha gamanasyāgniṃ vāgapyetītivatpratyakṣaśravaṇābhāvānna teṣāṃ saha gamanamiti cenna| kutaḥ| athainamiti śrutyā iṣṭādikāriṇāṃ yāgahomakṛtāṃ| pratīteḥ pratyakṣata eva bhūtaviyogasahayogayoravagamādityarthaḥ || evaṃca pratyakṣaśrutyabhāvenāśravaṇamaṃgīkṛtya bhūtānāmasahagatermaṃtavyatvāyogāt| ārthikaśravaṇasyāpyaśravaṇabādhakatvāt| yajamānamaraṇe bhūtānāṃ sahagatervispaṣṭamabhihitatvena dṛṣṭāṃtena sarvatrāpi bhūtagatisiddheśca| ato'styeva bhūtānāṃ jīvena saha gateriti maraṇe mokṣābhāvādanuṣṭheyameva vairāgyādīti siddhaṃ || || iti aśrutatvādhikaraṇaṃ || atra bhagavatprāptyarthaṃ karmaṇāmasthiraphalakatvoktyā vairāgyāderāvaśyakasādhanatvaṃ samarthyate| <3-1-7> oṃ || bhāktaṃvā'nātmavittvāttathā hi darśayati || oṃ || nanu nānuṣṭheyaṃ mumukṣuṇā vairāgyādi| karmaṇaiva mokṣasiddheḥ| apāmasomamiti śruteḥ| na comayorapi sādhanatvādvairāgyādikamapyanuṣṭheyamiti vācyaṃ| sati hi laghīyastupāye gurūpāyasyānādartavyatvāt| ataḥ suśakena karmaṇā mokṣasiddhau vairāgyādinā kṛtyābhāvāditi prāpte sūtritaṃ || || oṃ || bhāktaṃ vā'nātmavittvāttathā hi darśayatīti || asyārthaḥ || kāmyakarmiṇāṃ uktamamṛtatvaṃ bhāktaṃ amukhyaṃ| kutaḥ| anātmavittvāt teṣāmabrahmajñānitvāt| vā śabdena jijñāsujñānikṛtākāmyakarmajanyāmṛtatvamapi na saṃsāranivṛttirūpamukhyāmṛtatvarūpaṃ| kiṃtu aṃtaḥkaraṇaśud‌dhyānaṃdātiśayarūpaniratiśayaparamamukhyamiti pakṣadvayaṃ sūcayati| kuta etat| hi yasmāt| amṛto veti, sa enamiti, karmaṇeti, ātmānamiti ca śrutiḥ tathoktān darśayati pratipādayati| tasmādityarthaḥ || evaṃca vairāgyādyananuṣṭhāne mokṣāsiddheḥ| nacaivaṃ śrutiṃvirodhaḥ| karma hi kāmyamakāmyaṃ ceti dvividhaṃ| akāmyamapi jñānātpūrvabhāvipaścādbhāvi ceti dvividhaṃ| tatsarvamapi śrutyarthaeva| adhikāribhedāt| yadā śrutiḥ kāmyakarmaparā na tadā mukhyāmṛtatvaṃ kiṃtu bahukālajīvanarūpabhāktamarthamāha| yadā tu jñānātpūrvabhāvyakāmyakarmaparā tadā mukhyā'mṛtatvasādhanatvamevāha| kiṃ nāma na sākṣātkiṃtu karmaṇā śuddhasattvasya vairāgyādidvārā mokṣasādhanatvamāha| yadātu jñānottarakarmaparā tadā jñānena sidhyati mokṣe'tiśayādhāyakatvamāheti vyasthāyāḥ sadbhāvāt| kathamapi karmaṇā sākṣānmukhyamokṣasādhanatvānabhidhāyakatvāt| ato vairāgyādyanuṣṭhānamaṃtareṇa mokṣāsiddherna tatpratipādakaśāstravaiyarthyamiti siddhaṃ || || iti bhāktādhikaraṇaṃ || atra vairāgyādisādhanasyāvaśyānuṣṭheyatvaṃ samarthyate| <3-1-8> oṃ || kṛtatyaye'nuśayavān dṛṣṭasmṛtibhyāṃ || oṃ || nanu vairāgyādinā'laṃ| kṛtasya karmaṇo bhogenaiva kṣaye bījābhāvena saṃsārābhāvasaṃbhavāt| na ca bhogakāle punaḥ karmāṃtarānuṣṭhānasaṃbhavena saṃsārānnivṛttiriti vācyaṃ| iha loke bhogasamaye karmānuṣṭhānaniyame'pi svargādau tadabhāvena tatraiva sarvakarmaṇāṃ bhogena kṣaye saṃsārānnivṛttisaṃbhāvat| karmaṇāṃ bhinnadeśakālavipākatve'pi yajñādyārādhitabhagavatprasādena bhavanmate saubharyādivatsvargādāveva sarvakarmakṣayo nānupapannaḥ| tataśca vairāgyāderanāvaśyakatvamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || oṃ || kṛtātyaye'nuśayavān dṛṣṭasmṛtibhyāmiti || asyārthaḥ || kṛtātyaye kṛtasya karmaṇaḥ svargādau bhogenātyaye kṣaye sati| punaranuśayavān bhuktaśeṣavānevemaṃ lokaṃ pratyāgacchatīti jñāyate| kutaḥ| dṛṣṭasmṛtibhyāṃ| tataḥ śeṣeṇeti dṛṣṭaśabditaśruteḥ| bhuktaśeṣeti smṛteścetyartha || evaṃca nirdiṣṭaśrutismṛtibhyāṃ svargādyāpādakakarmaṇa eva sāmastyena kṣayābhāvena sutarāṃ sarvakṣayāsaṃbhavāt| ekasya karmaṇo bhogāvasare punaranaṃtakarmānuṣṭhānena bhogenāsamāpterdvitrāvartaneṣu sarvakṣayābhāvāt| ācaturdaśamādvarṣāditi smṛteḥ| ato vairāgyādisādhanamāvaśyakamiti siddhaṃ || || iti kṛtātyayādhikaraṇaṃ || atra svargādāgatiprakāro nirūpyate| <3-1-9> oṃ || yathetamanevaṃca || oṃ || nanu gamanaprakāreṇaivāgamanaṃ jīvasya bhavet| yathetameveti śruteḥ| yena yathā svargaṃ prati jīvo gataḥ samārgastāvajjīvasya smṛtiviṣayaḥ| na ca smṛtimātraparityāgena mārgāṃtareṇāgamane kāraṇamastīti tenaivāyātīti vaktavyaṃ| tataścātikleśābhāvānna svarge vairāgyamāpādanīyamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || oṃ || yathetamanevaṃceti || asyārthaḥ || jīvena yathā yena mārgeṇa svargādikaṃ| itaṃ prāptaṃ| tathā tena| anevaṃ anyena mārgeṇa ca| jīva imaṃ lokamāgacchatītyarthaḥ || evaṃca dhūmādabhramiti viśeṣaśrutisadbhāvāt| ākāśaparyaṃtaṃ gatyanusāreṇāgamanasyāṃgikāreṇa pūrvaśrutestatparatvenāvirodhāt| āgamane jīvasya svātaṃtryābhāvena yukteraprayojakatvena tadavirodhāt| tasmādāgamanādāvatikleśayuktatvena svargaphale'pi viraktena bhavitavyamiti siddhaṃ || || iti yathaitādhikaraṇaṃ || atra gatāgatasya karmaphalatvaṃ samarthyate| <3-1-10> oṃ || caraṇāditi cenna tadupalakṣaṇārthetikārṣṇājiniḥ || oṃ || nanu caraṇaphalameva gatāgataṃ na yajñādikarmaṇaḥ| tadya iheti śruteḥ| caraṇasya ca sa yathā kārīti śruterācāra iti smṛteśca karmaṇo'nyatvāt| na cātha ima iti śrutergatāgataṃ yajñaphalameva na caraṇaphalamiti| iṣṭāpūrttedattamityupaśabdena yajñasamīpavarttivācinā caraṇabhamabhidhāyeṣṭāpūrtta ityanena yajñaṃ cābhidāyobhayaphalasyate dhūmamabhisaṃbhavaṃtītyādinā dvividhasvargābhidhānenātha iti śruteścaraṇaphalatvāt| ato gatāgatasyānyaphalatvātkarmaṇā punarāvṛttiśūnyasvargasiddherna vairāgyādinā kṛtyamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || oṃ || caraṇāditi cenna tadupalakṣaṇārtheti kārṣṇājiniriti || asyārthaḥ || gatāgataṃ na yajñāderbhavati| kiṃtu caraṇāt yajñāṃgabhūtācārādeva| caraṇācarāśruteriti cenna| kutaḥ| yataḥ śrutiḥ tadupalakṣaṇārthājahatsvārthalakṣaṇayā yajñācārobhayapratipādiketi kārṣṇajinirācāryo manyate| ata ityarthaḥ|| evaṃca nānyaḥ pathā iti śrutyā gatāgataśūnyaphalasya karmasādhyatāyā niṣiddhatvāt| iṣṭāpūrttāmiti śrutyā traividyāmāmiti smṛtyāca gatāgatasya karmaphalatvokteśca| na ca tadya iheti śrutivirodhaḥ| tasyāḥ śruterudāhṛtaśrutyādyanurodhena jahatsvārthalakṣaṇayā yajñādyarthatvopapatteḥ| atha yajñeneti vispaṣṭaśruteśca| api caivaṃ kārṣṇājinirācāryo manyate| ato gatāgatasya karmaphalatvābhāva iti siddhaṃ || <3-1-11> oṃ || ānarthakyamiti cenna tadapekṣatvāt || oṃ || uktamākṣipya samādadhatsūtraṃ vyācaṣṭe || oṃ || ānarthakyamiti cenna tadapekṣatvāditi || asyārthaḥ || upalakṣaṇārthatve caraṇaśabdasyānarthakyaṃ| kutaḥ| ramaṇiyakapūyapadābhyāmeva karmopalakṣaṇasaṃbhavāditi cenna| kutaḥ| tadapekṣatvāt| tasya sādhvasādhuyajñādimattvasya tadapekṣatvāt ācārādisāpekṣatvāt| tathā ca tadbodhārthaṃ tatpadasārthakyaṃ saṃbhavatītyarthaḥ || evaṃca caraṇavaiyarthyaprasaṃge yajñādyupalakṣaṇatvameva netyaṃgīkāre śrutyādivirodhasyoktatvāt| yajñādyupalakṣaṇatvamaṃgīkṛtya caraṇakṛtyamātraṃ cedyajñādikāriṇāṃ sādhvasādhucaraṇābhyameva ramaṇīyatvaṃ bhavatīti jñāpanāya caraṇapadamityabhyupagamāt| ato gatāgatasya karmaphalatvātkleśasādhanaṃ tasmiṃstatsādhye ca viraktena bhavitavyamiti siddhaṃ || <3-1-12> oṃ || sukṛtaduṣkṛte eveti tu bādariḥ || oṃ || prakārāṃtareṇa caraṇaśrutiṃ vyākurvatsūtraṃ paṭhati|| || oṃ || sukṛtadṛṣkṛte eveti tu bādariti || asyārthaḥ || sukṛtaduṣkṛte sādhvasādhukarmaṇī| eva śrutisthacaraṇaśabdavācyena tu tadaṃgācaraṇamiti bādarirācāryo manyata ityarthaḥ || tu śabdāt svasiddhāto'pi sa eveti sūcayati || evaṃca caraṇapadasya yajñādivācakameva| dharma kurutetyarthasyāṃgīkāre'pi bādhābādhāt| caratīti prayogāt| karoticaratyoḥ paryāyatvena dharmaśabdābhidheye puṇyasādhane yajñādisarvakarmaṇi niṣpannakṛtaśabdābhidheyatvasya sarvasiddhatvena tatparyāyatve karmaṇi lyuḍaṃtasya caraṇaśabdasyāpi kteravarjanīyatvāt| api caivameva bādarirācāryo manyate| ato gatāgatasya karmaphalatvātkleśasādhane tasmiṃstatsādhye ca viraktena bhavitavyamiti siddhaṃ || || iti caraṇādhikaraṇaṃ || atrāniṣṭādikāriṇāmapi gatāgatādi duḥkhamastīti samarthyate || <3-1-13> oṃ || aniṣṭādikāriṇāmapi ca śrutaṃ || oṃ || nanviṣṭādipuṇyakṛtāmeva gatāgatādikleśaḥ| teṣāṃ vidhiniṣedhabhītiyuktatvāt| bibhyanpatati pādapāditi nyāyāt| kiṃca kāmanāhi karmāṃgasaṃgameva ca karmaphalaheturna tu vyaṃgyaṃ| kāmanāvaṃtaśca te iṣṭādikāriṇastu svātmānaṃ svayameva vidhiniṣedhābhyāṃ badhnaṃti| upanītasyaiva vidhiniṣedhaviṣayatvāt| anupanītāstu mattāḥ| na hyupanītaṃ pratyaharahaḥ saṃdhyāmityādi śāstraṃ pravartata iti śakyate vaktuṃ| śūdrādīnāṃ tatprasaṃgāt| ataḥ puṇyapāpakṛtāmeva gamanāgamanādiduḥkha na tu pāpamātraratānāṃ mattānāṃ kiṃtu mokṣa eveti puṇye tatphale ca viraktyā bhavitavyaṃ na tu pāpamātrānuṣṭhāna iti prāpte sūtramāha || || oṃ || aniṣṭādikāriṇāmapi ca śrutimiti || asyārthaḥ || ca śabdo duḥkhāṃtarasamuccaye| na kevalamiṣṭādikāriṇāmeva gatāgataṃ kiṃtviṣṭaśabditayāgādikarmaviruddhapāpakāriṇāmapi| kutaḥ| yataḥ| śrutaṃ| tadya iheti śrutyā tathoktaṃ| ata ityarthaḥ || evaṃca na puṇyapāpe saṃkalyyānuṣṭhitānāmeva gatāgatādikleśaḥ| kiṃ nāma pāpamevānuraktānāṃ mattānāmapi| uktaśrutyā pratyekaṃ gatāgatakleśābhidhānāt| ato yuktamuktamiti siddhaṃ || <3-1-14> oṃ || saṃyamane tvanubhūyetareṣāmārohāvarohau tadgatidarśanāt || oṃ || na kevalamaniṣṭādikāriṇāṃ gatāgatamātraṃ| kiṃ nāmātiduḥkhaṃ pūrvasūtre caśabdena sūcitamanyadastītyarthaṃ pratipādayatsūtramupanyasyati || || oṃ || saṃyamane tvanubhūyetareṣāmārohāvarohau tadgatidarśanāditi || asyārthaḥ || tu śabdo'vadhāraṇe| saptamī dvitīyārthe| saṃyamane narake| samyagyamaśāsanamanubhūyaiva sthitānāmitareṣāmiṣṭādikāribhyo'nyeṣāṃ madhye| ārohāvarohau| keṣāṃcidārohaḥ narakādutthānaṃ keṣāṃcidavarohaḥ tato'pi nacisthāne nityanarake pāto bhavati| kutaḥ| tadgatidarśanāt| teṣāṃ aniṣṭādikāriṇāṃ| tadgateḥ evaṃvidhagateḥ| darśanāt sarva iti śrutāvuktatvādityarthaḥ || || evaṃcoktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <3-1-15> oṃ || smaraṃtica || oṃ || uktārthaṃ smṛtyā samarthayatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || oṃ || smaraṃti ceti || asyārthaḥ || smṛtikartāraḥ uktamarthaṃ gacchaṃtītyādismṛtibhiḥ pratipādayaṃti cetyarthaḥ || evaṃ na ca bhayakāmanādyabhāvavirodhaḥ| abibhyatā phalakāmanāśūnyenāpyupabhuyaktasya viṣayasya maraṇahetutvadarśanāt| ato'niṣṭādikāriṇāmapi mahānarthatvena mokṣaśāyā dūrotsāritatvādbhivitavyaṃ tatrāpi virakteneti siddhaṃ || || iti aniṣṭādhikaraṇaṃ || atra bhagavadveṣādiphalasya narakasya nityatvaṃ samarthyate| <3-1-16> oṃ || api sapta || oṃ || nanu narakaṃ na nirgatya duḥkhasādhanaṃ| yāvadiṃdrāścaturdaśetyādāvavadhimattvaśravaṇāt| na cobhayaṃ yuktaṃ| virodhāt| na ca puruṣabhedena vyavasthā| cakāra narakaṃ śūnyamiti śūnyatā'bhidhānāt| tataśca saṃyamane tvanubhūya keṣāṃcidavaroha iti prāguktamayuktamiti netarapāpebhyo bhagavadvidveṣe'tiśayena vairāgyeṇa bhāvyamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || oṃ || api sapteti || asyārthaḥ || smartāraḥ rauravādisaptavidhanapi narakān raurava iti smṛtibhiḥ pratipādayaṃtītyarthaḥ || evaṃca bhavedevaṃ yadyakameva narakaṃ syāt| na caivaṃ| kiṃ nāma rauravo'theti vacanātsaptanakāṇi| cakarā narakamiti rauravādi paṃcanarakaviṣayāṇi| naiveta utiṣṭhaṃtaityādīni tāmisrāṃdhaṃtamisraviṣayāṇi| anyāni ca bahūni kṣudranarakāṇi| tānyapyanityaphaladāni| ato bhagavadveṣādikaphalasya nityanarakatvāditarapāpebhyo'tiśayena tatraiva vaivārgayeṇabhavitavyamiti siddhaṃ || || iti apisaptādhikaraṇaṃ || atra narakasya saduḥkhatvaṃ samarthyate| <3-1-17> oṃ || tatrāpi ca tadvyāpārādavirodhaḥ || oṃ || nanu na narakaṃ saduḥkhaṃ| īśvarasyāpi duḥkhaprasaṃgāt‌| bhūlokasya svasthitānāṃ sarveṣāṃ duḥkhajananasvabhāvābhāvena bhūloke sahāvasthitayorjīveśayorjīvasyaiva duḥkhaṃ neśvarasyeti śaktivaiśeṣyāditivat tathā saṃbhave'pi narakasya svasthitānāṃ sarveṣāṃ duḥkhajananasvabhāvattvena vaiṣamyāyogāt| na ca tatreśvarābhāvānna duḥkhaprasaṃgaḥ| sarvaṃ visṛjatīti śrutyeśvarasya kāryamātraṃ prati kāraṇatvena tatreśvarābhāve sutarāṃ duḥkhāyogāt| tataścobhayathā'pi duḥkhābhāvasaṃbhavānna tatra vairāgyeṇa bhāvyamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || oṃ || tatrāpi ca tad‌vyāpārādivirodha iti || asyārthaḥ || ca śabdo duḥkhānubhavaṃ vinaivetyarthasūcakaḥ| tathā ca tatrāpi īśvarasya narake sthitvā tatsthajīvāniyaṃtṛtve sarvamiti śrutivirodhaḥ| tanniyaṃtṛtve duḥkhabhoktṛtvamityubhayavirodho netyarthaḥ || evaṃca narakepīśvaravyāpārāṃgīkāreṇākāraṇatvadoṣābhāvāt| narakasyāpi tadvaśatvenāduḥkhānubhavenaiva tatprerakatvena tasya duḥkhaprāptyabhāvāt| sasvarga iti śruteḥ narakepīti smṛteśca | tathā ca narakasya sa duḥkhatvāttatraiva vairāgyeṇa bhāvyamiti siddhaṃ || || iti tatrāpyadhikaraṇaṃ || atra jīvānāṃ gatisvātaṃtryaṃ nirākriyate| <3-1-18> oṃ || vidyākarmaṇoriti tu prakṛtatvāt || oṃ || nanu bhavaṃtyeva jīvā gatyādiphale svataṃtrāḥ| athaitayoriti vacanāt| na hi svātaṃtryābhāve gacchaṃti na gacchaṃtīti vyapadeśo yujyate| na ca jīvānāṃ syātaṃtryamapratipāditamiti vācyaṃ| sādhanaphalavadīśvaradattsvātaṃtryāṃgīkārāt| ato mūle labdhaphalo naiva śākhāgraṃ gaṃtumiṣyatīti nyāyāt phala eva svātaṃtryāt kiṃ vairāgyasādhaneneti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || oṃ || avidyākarmaṇoriti tu prakṛtatvāditi || asyārthaḥ || tu śabdo'vadhāraṇe| athaitayoḥ pathoriti śrutāvetayorityasya jñānakarmaṇorityevārthaḥ| na tu dhūmārcirādi mārgayoreti| yena jīvasya phalasvātaṃtryaṃ syāt| kutaḥ| prakṛtatvāt| tadya itthamiti tayorapi prakṛtatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca jīvānāṃ gatyādisvātaṃtryaṃ pramāṇābhāvāt| athaitayoriti śrutigataitayoriti śabdasya tadya itthamiti vidyākarmamārgayorapi prakṛtatvāttatparamarśakatvenāsya vākyasya sādhane svātaṃtryanirdeśātmakatvāt| na ca vidyākarmamārgavaddevayānapitṛyānayorapi prakṛtatvena kasyāyaṃ parāmarśa iti saṃdehenānirṇayaḥ| vidyāpatha iti vacanena parāmarśakanirṇayopapatteḥ| ataḥ phale svātaṃtryābhāvādapekṣitaṃ vairāgyādisānadhanamiti siddhaṃ || || iti vidyādhikaraṇaṃ || atrāṃdhaṃtamasasya duḥkhamātratvaṃ samarthyate| <3-1-19> oṃ || na tṛtīye tathopalabdheḥ || oṃ || nanvadhaṃtamo'pi sukhayuktameva| duḥkhayuktatvāt| duḥkhaṃ hi sukhāvinā bhūtaṃ| yatra duḥkhaṃ tatrasukhamiti vacanāt| atoṃ'dhaṃtamasyapi sukhasadbhāvānna tatrātivairāgyamapekṣitamityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtramāha || || oṃ || na tṛtīye tathopalabdheriti || asyārthaḥ || tṛtīye tiryagyātanātama ityuktādhogatiṣu tṛtīye tamasi| na sukhamastīti śeṣaḥ| kutaḥ| tathopalabdheḥ tathā pratīterityarthaḥ || evaṃcāthāvidvānakarmeti śrutisadbhāvāt| nāṃdhetamasi magnānāmiti smṛteśca| atoṃ'dhetamasi sukhaleśābhāvādbhavitavyaṃ tatra tatsādhane ca virakteriti siddhaṃ || <3-1-20> oṃ || smaryate'pi ca loke || oṃ || etamevārthaṃ smṛtyanumānābhyāṃ ca sādhayatsūtramupanyasyati || || oṃ || smaryate'pi ca loke iti || asyārthaḥ || aṃdhe tamasi sukharāhityaṃ nāṃdhetamasīti smṛtikartrā smaryate ca smṛtyā ca pratipādyate| kiṃcaitat loke'pi lokadṛṣṭavyāptikānumānenāpi siddhamityarthaḥ || evaṃca tiryakṣviti smṛteḥ vimatāḥ na sukhavaṃtaḥ| īśvareṇa tathāniṣṭatvāt| yo yathā neśvareṇeṣṭaḥ tathā| śṛṃgitvenāniṣṭaḥ śikhī na śṛṃgītyanumānasya ca sadbhāvāt| īśvareṇa tathāniṣṭhatvaṃ ca tadapriyatvahetusiddhaṃ| atoṃ'dhe tamasi sukhaleśābhāva iti siddhaṃ || <3-1-21> oṃ || darśanācca || pratyakṣeṇāpyetamarthaṃ sādhayatsūtramāha || || oṃ || darśanācceti || asyārthaḥ || tṛtīye sukharāhityaṃ hiraṇyagarbhapratyakṣācca siddhamityarthaḥ || evaṃca nārāyaṇaprasādena samṛddhajñānacakṣuṣā paramukhamaṃtareṇa svayameva sukhābhāvasya caturmukhadarśanavacanāt | atoṃ'dhe tamasi sukhaleśābhāva iti siddhaṃ || <3-1-22> oṃ || tṛtīye śabdāvarodhaḥ saṃśokajasya || oṃ || arthāpattyāpyetamarthaṃ samarthayatsūtramupanyasyati || || oṃ || tṛtīye śabdāvarodhaḥ saṃśokajasyeti || asyārthaḥ || tṛtīya ityāvartate| tṛtīye tamasi| tatrāpi tṛtīye aṃdhe tamasi tadviṣaye| yaḥ śabdaḥ| tena saṃśokajasya samyak śokajasya| mohasyāvarodhaḥ prāptirbhavatītyarthaḥ || evaṃcādharaṃtamaśravaṇamātreṇa tacchrāviṇāṃ mohaprāptyanyathā'nupapattyā tatratyaduḥkhasya niravadhikatvavat sukhaleśāsāmānādhikaraṇyātiśayasiddheśca| atoṃ'dhe tamasi sukhaleśābhāva iti siddhaṃ || <3-1-23> oṃ || smaraṇācca || oṃ || nanu tṛtīyatamaḥsvarūpaśravaṇe śrotṝṇāṃ mohaprāptirityetatkuto'vagamyate| yadanyathā'nupapattyā tatra sukhābhāvāvagama ityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || oṃ || smaraṇācceti || asyārthaḥ|| tamastraividhyasya tṛtīyatamasaḥ śravaṇe śrotṛmohaprāptiśca mahātama iti smṛtyā tadubhayaṃ siddhamityarthaḥ || evaṃ na ca śravaṇamātreṇa tacchrāviṇāṃ mohaprāptirasiddheti| mahātamastridheti smaraṇāt| atoṃ'dhe tamasi sukhaleśābhādbhavitavyaṃ tatra tatsādhane ca virakteriti siddhaṃ || || iti na tṛtīyādhikaraṇaṃ || atra karmiṇi dhūmādibhāvo nivāryate || <3-1-24> oṃ || tatsāvābhāvyāpattirupapatteḥ || oṃ || nanu karmiṇo dhūmādiprāptirvā tadaikyaṃ vā bhavatītyabhyupeyaṃ| dhūmo bhūtveti vacanāt| anena vākyena sāmānādhikaraṇyabalāddhūmādibhāvatadaprāptyoḥ pratīteḥ| snehavaśādrajaputrasya rājapadaprāptivat| arjunasyeṃdratādāmyavaccobhayorapyupapannatvāt| ataḥ prakāradvaye'pi sakṛdanuṣṭhitayajñānāmākalpasamāptiramasukhasaṃbhavād‌vyarthaṃ karmaṇi tatphale ca vairāgyamiti prāpte sūtrakṛdāha || || oṃ || tatsvābhāvyāpattirupapatteriti || asyārthaḥ || karmaṇi tatsvābhāvyāpattiḥ| tasya dhūmādidevasya| svabhāvasya svabhāvasadṛśasvabhāvasya| prāptireva| na tadaikyaṃ tatpada prāptirvā| kutaḥ| upapatteḥ| anyasyānyaikyādṛṣṭasyāsyaivārthasya yuktatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃcānyasyānyābhāvāsaṃbhavāt| tatpadasya niyatādhikāribhirjñānenaiva prāpyatvāt| yugapadanekakarmisamavāye'nekeṣāmekapadaprāptyayogācca| tasmāttadgatau gatistatsthitau sthitirityādirūpatatsvābhāvyāpattireveti śrutyarthaḥ| ato dhūmādyaikyābhāvādyuktaṃ tatkarmatatphalayorvairāgyamiti siddhaṃ || || iti tatsvābhāvyādhikaraṇaṃ || atra svargādavarūḍhasya karmiṇo'cireṇa garbhavāsādiprāptiḥ samarthyate| <3-1-25> oṃ || nāticireṇa viśeṣāt || oṃ || nanu karmo svargānnirgataḥ kalpāṃtare dehaṃ prāpnoti| yathetamākāśamityādāvāgamanavelāyāṃ bahusthānaprāptiśravaṇāt| tadgamanaṃ ca nācireṇa saṃbhavati| tatra tatra tattatsvābhāvyenātimahāsukhe saṃbhavati tadvihāyāgamane prayojanābhāvāt| na ca puṇyālpatvādbahukālāvasthānānupapattiḥ| devatāsāṃnidhyasadbhāvena tatrāvasthānakāraṇadevatāprasādārjanopapatteḥ| na hi prekṣāvān vadānyamahāprabhusāṃnidhye satyanārādhya svābhīṣṭaṃ na prāpnotīti saṃbhavati| na ca tathā sati kalpāṃte'pi na śarīraprāptiriti vācyaṃ| kalpāṃte svaparicitadevatāyā muktatvena devatāṃtarasya paricayābhāvenārādhanāyogāt| tataśca kāmānuṣṭhānenaivākalpasukhasadbhāvātkiṃkarmaṇi tatphale ca vairāgyeṇeti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati || || oṃ || nāticireṇa viśeṣāditi || asyārthaḥ || svargānnirgataḥ karmī nāticireṇa acireṇaiva| bhūmāvāgatya brāhmaṇādiyoniṃ prāpnoti| na cireṇa| kutaḥ| viśeṣāt| tadya iheti viśeṣacanādityarthaḥ || evaṃca nirdiṣṭaśruteḥ svargāditi smṛteśca sadbhāvāt| karmaphalasya klaptakālatvenādhikakālasthāyitvānupapatteḥ| iha loka eva ca puṇyārjanamiti bhagavatā klaptatvena tatraiva punardevatārādhānānupapatteśca| ataḥ karmaṇo'cireṇaiva garbhavāsādiduḥkhasadbhāvādbhavitavyaṃ karmādau viraktiriti siddhaṃ || || iti nāticireṇādhikaraṇaṃ || atra karmiṇāṃ vrīhyādibhāvanimittakaduḥkhābhāvaḥ samarthyate| <3-1-26> oṃ || anyādhiṣṭhite pūrvavadabhilāpāt || oṃ || nanvastyeva karmiṇāṃ dṛṣṭotpattirāṃtarīyakaduḥkhātiriktabalavad‌duḥkhaṃ teṣāṃ| ta iheti vrīhyādibhāvaśravaṇāt| tadbhāve tacchedanādinā duḥkhāvaśyaṃbhāvāt| taccāyuktaṃ| yajñādināceyaṃ śrutirvrīhipraveśamātraparā na tadbhāvapareti vācyaṃ| bādhakābhāve mukhyārthatyāgāyogāt| vrīhyādipraveśamātrāṃgīkāreṃ duḥkhānivāraṇāt| duḥkhisahavāsthāne'pi duḥkhābhoge kāraṇaṃ yajñādikarmaphalameva| ato duḥkhasādhanatayā vedopadiṣṭakarmaṇo duḥkhajanakatve mokṣahetutvenopadiṣṭavairāgyādāvapyanāśvāsādananuṣṭheyatvaṃ tasyeti prāpte sūtramācaṣṭe || || oṃ || anyādhiṣṭhite pūrvavadabhilāpāditi || asyārthaḥ || karmiṇo anyādhiṣṭhite anyajīvābhimanyamāna vrīhyādiśarīre praveśa eva na tu na tadabhimānitvaṃ| yena duḥkhaṃ syāt| tarhi brīhiyavāityabhedoktiḥ kathamityata uktaṃ| pūrvavaditi| yathā dhūmo bhūtvetyādau dhūmādibhāvoktiḥ tathā| kuta etat| abhilāpāt| so'vāggata iti śrutau tathā'bhidhānādityarthaḥ || evaṃca mānābhāvena na karmiṇāṃ vrīhyādibhāvena duḥkhaṃ maṃtavyaṃ| asyāṃ śrutau karmiṇo vrīhyādiśarīrapraveśamātrābhidhānāt| na ca duḥkhasahāvasthānena duḥkhaprāptiḥ sahāvasthānasya prayojakatvāt| tatprayojakasyābhāvāt| na tu vrīhyādiśarīrapraveśa eva śrutyarthaḥ| na tadbhāva iti| kuto niścaya iti ceti| so'vāggataḥ| sthāvarānpraviśyeti samākhyānāditi grahaṇāt| ato yajñādeḥ sukhasādhanatvenopadiṣṭatvādyuktaṃ vairāgyānuṣṭhānamiti siddhaṃ || <3-1-27> oṃ || aśuddhamiti cenna śabdāt || oṃ || nanu jyotiṣṭomāderhisāviśiṣṭatvena pāpāśrayatvād‌vrīhyādibhāvena duḥkhamavarjanīyamityākṣipya samādadhatsūtramāha || || oṃ || aśuddhamiti cenna śabdāditi || asyārthaḥ || hiṃsārūpatvādyajñasya karmāśuddhaṃ duḥkhasādhanamiti cenna| kutaḥ| śabdāt śrītavākyavihitatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca bāhyāyāḥ pāpahetutve'pi vāyavyaṃ śvetamālabhetetyādinā vihitahiṃsāyāḥ puṇyahetutvena yajñādeḥ pāpamiśratvābhāvāt| hiṃsātvavaidiketi smṛteḥ| ato yajñādeḥ sukhasādhanatayopadiṣṭasya duḥkhakāraṇatvābhāvādyuktaṃ vairāgyānuṣṭhānamiti siddhaṃ || || iti anyādhikaraṇaṃ || atra svargādavatīrṇasya pitṛpraveśaḥ samarthyate| <3-1-28> oṃ || retaḥsigyogo'tha || oṃ || nanu na jīvasya pitṛpraveśo'sti| mātureveti vacanāt| na ca ya eva gṛhī bhavatīti śruterbādhaḥ| prayojanābhāvayuktiyuktatayā balavadetchrutiviruddhatvena tacchruteḥ kākusvareṇāpi pitṛpraveśaniṣedhaparatvāt| tataścātyāyāsābhāvena nātivairāgyaṃ karmādāvapekṣitamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || oṃ || retaḥ sigyogo'theti || asyārthaḥ || karmiṇaḥ prathamaṃ retaḥ sigyogaḥ retaḥ sicā pitrā yogaḥ saṃbaṃdhaḥ tatpraveśa iti yāvat| atha anaṃtaraṃ| mātṛpreveśo bhavati na tu prathamamevetyarthaḥ || evaṃcāstyeva pitṛpraveśo jīvasya tato reta iti śruteḥ| na ca pitṛpraveśo netyarthaḥ| pitṛpraveśasyotpatsyamānasādhāraṇajīvasaṃbhavāt| īśaklaptyā tasya saṃskārārthatvāt| na ca māturevodaramiti śrutyaprāmāṇyaṃ| pitṛpraveśānaṃtaraṃ mātṛpraveśasyāpyaṃgīkārāt| na ca māturevetyavadhāraṇānupapattiḥ| smṛteḥ sādhāraṇajīvaparatādaśāyāmavadhāraṇasyāyogavyavacchedārthatvāṃgīkārāt| garbhasthasiddhaśarīrapraveśajīvaparatādaśāyāṃ tu anyayogavyavacchedasyāpi bhāvāt| ataḥ pitṛprāptervidyamānatvādbhavitavyaṃ karmādāvativairāgyamiti siddhaṃ || || iti reto'dhikaraṇaṃ || atra jīvasya pitṛdvārā yoniṃ praviśya śarīraprāptiḥ samarthyate| <3-1-29> oṃ || yoneḥ śarīraṃ || oṃ || nanu svargādāgatasya vā pitṛvanmātaraṃ yonidvārā praviśya kalalabud‌budādikrameṇa dehaprāptirnāsti| kiṃtu kasyacitsvargādāgatasya pitaraṃ praviṣṭasya puṇyavaśena yonipraveśamaṃtarāsaṃsparśadvāreṇa mātṛpraveśena dehalābhaḥ| aparasya tu pitṛpraveśaṃ vinaivānnādidvārā mātṛpraveśaena tallābhaḥ| tato'pyatiśayitapuṇyavattvāt| pakṣadvaye'pi kalalādikramaṃ vinā mātṛdehasthajarāyugatasiddhadehaprāptiḥ| anyasya tu bahirnirgatasiddhadehaprāptiḥ| paraṃtu kasyāpi svargādāgatasya pāpivaccharīrādyonidvārā mātṛśarīraṃ prāpta kalalabud‌budādikrameṇa dehaprāptiriti niyamo nāsti| tataścātyāyāsābhāvānnātivairāgyeṇa kṛtyamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || oṃ || yoneḥ śarīramiti || asyārthaḥ || lyablope paṃcamī| karmī pitṛdvārā mātṛyoniṃ praviśyaivātha tatra śarīraṃ labhate na tadvinetyarthaḥ || evaṃca svargādāgatasyāpi pitṛpraveśastato yonidvārā mātṛpraveśastataḥ kalalādikrameṇa dehaprāptiścetyādiniyamasya sadbhāvāt| divaḥ sthāsnūniti vacanāt| na ca dehaṃ garbhāsthitamiti vākyavirodhaḥ| keṣāṃcittathābhāvasyāpi sattvena tadvacanānāṃ tanmātraviṣayatvena yāvatsvargiviṣayatvābhāvāt| ataḥ sāmānyajanmani pitrādipraveśasya niyamenāpasvargādiratra sarvatrāpi mahāduḥkhāvinā'bhāvāt| viraktena bhagavān bhajanīya iti siddhaṃ || || iti yonyadhikaraṇaṃ || || iti tṛtīyādhyāyasya prathamaḥ pādaḥ samāptaḥ || <3.2> || śrīḥ || || hariḥ || || atha dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ || bhaktirasmin pāda ucyate| atra bhagavatprāptisādhanabhaktyarthamarthajñānātmakasya svāpnaprapaṃcasya bhagavadadhīnatvamahimā varṇyate| <3-2-1> || saṃdhye sṛṣṭirāha hi || nanu svapnaviṣayo neśvarādhīnaḥ| asattvāt| na cāsiddho hetuḥ| prāgūrdhvamanupalaṃbhāt| na ca tatkālasūṣṭivirodhāṃgīkārātprāgūrdhvamupalaṃbhābhāvo na doṣāyeti vācyaṃ| pramāṇābhāvāditi prāpte sūtramāha || || saṃdhye sṛṣṭirāha hīti || asyārthaḥ || hi yasmāt| atha rathāniti śrutiḥ saṃdhye jāgratsuṣuptisaṃdhau bhavatīti svapne bhagavataḥ sṛṣṭimāha| ataḥ sṛṣṭiḥ| svapnapadārthasṛṣṭiḥ| bhagavata eva jāyata ityarthaḥ || evaṃceśvarādhīna eva svapnaviṣayaḥ| sattvāt| na ca prāguttarakālamupalaṃbhaprasaṃgaḥ| tatkāla eva sṛṣṭivirodhāṃgīkārāt| na ca tatra pramāṇābhāvaḥ| atha rathāniti śruteḥ| ataḥ svapnaviṣayasya bhagavadadhīnatvasiddhermahāmāhātmyaṃ tasyeti yuktā tatra bhaktiriti siddhaṃ || <3-2-2> || nirmātāraṃ caike putrādayaśca || nanu karturabhāvānna svapnakālīnasṛṣṭiryuktā| na hi jīvastatkartā| suptatvāttasya| nāpīśvaraḥ| tatpramāṇābhāvāt| na ca pakṣadvaye'pi sṛṣṭirupapannā| tatkāla evotpattivināśakarturadarśanādityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || nirmātāraṃ caike putrādayaśceti || asyārthaḥ || co yataḥ| eke śākhinaḥ| enaṃ bhagavaṃtaṃ| ya eṣu supteṣviti svāpnapadārthanirmātāramāmanaṃti| apare ca putrādayaḥ| tasmādviṣṇoreva jāyaṃta iti vadaṃti| tasmādviṣṇoreva svāpnasṛṣṭirityarthaḥ || evaṃca na ca karturabhāvātsṛṣṭyayogaḥ| ya eṣviti etasmāddheveti śrutibhyāmīsvarasyaiva kartṛtvāṃgīkārāt| tathā ca viṣṇoreva svāpnasṛṣṭiriti tatra yuktā bhaktiriti siddhaṃ || <3-2-3> || māyāmāṃ tu kārtsnyenānabhivyaktasvarūpatvāt || nanu brāhya eva svapna upalabhyaṃte| te ca sarvaiḥ prāgūrdhvaṃ upalabhyaṃta eveti cet| bāhyārthān śarīre sthitvā paśyatītyaṃgīkāre vyavahita merumaṃdārādidarśanābhāvaprasaṃgāt| bahirnirgatyetyabhyupagame kuruṣu suptasya pāṃcālān paśyataḥ prabodhe śarīrapraveśo'sya paścādeveti prāpteḥ| kiṃca hemaṃte suptasya vasaṃtapratītistāvadasti| na ca vasaṃtasattā tadā'sti| yena śarīre sthitvā bahirnirgatya vā paśyet| nāpi bāhyārthapratītikāraṇamasti| iṃdriyāṇāmuparatatvāt| manaso bāhyārtheṣvasvātaṃtryāditi prāpte sūtramāha || || māyāmātraṃ tu kārtsnyenānabhivyaktasvarūpatvāditi || asyārthaḥ || turevārthe saṃdhyaṃ māyāmātraṃ nimittopādānabhūtābhyāṃ māyaśabditecchāvāsanābhyāmeva nirmitaṃ na bāhyakāraṇakaṃ| kutaḥ| kārtsnyenānabhivyaktasvarūpatvāt bāhyavatsamyaganabhivyaktasvarūpatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃcopādānanimittasadbhāvāt| manogatāṃśca saṃskārāniti smṛtibalena vāsanāyā upādānatveneśvarecchāyāśca nimittatvenāṃgīkārāt| vāsanāmayānāṃ mervādīnāṃ manasaiva darśanasaṃbhavāt| bāhyakāraṇābhāvāt| prāk‌piṃḍādīnāmūrdhvaṃ kapālādīnāṃ pratīteraprasaṃgāt| ataḥ svapnaviṣayasya bhagavadadhīnatvasiddhestatra bhaktiryukteti siddhaṃ || <3-2-4> || sūcakaśca hi śruterācakṣate ca tadvidaḥ || nanu yadi svāpnaviṣayā bāhyārthajanyāstarhi sattvaṃ na prāpnoti| śuktirajatavadityāśaṃkāṃ parākurvatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || sūcakaśca hi śruterācakṣate ca tadvida iti || asyārthaḥ || co yataḥ| svāpnapadārthaḥ sūcakaḥ śubhāśubhajñāpakaḥ| ato'pi nāsatyaḥ| tatkutaḥ| yadeti śruteḥ| pratyakṣataḥ phaladarśanācceti hi śabdaḥ| kiṃca tadvidaḥ svapnavido vyāsādayaḥ ācakṣate ca| yadeti śrutau svāpnāmarthakriyākāritvaṃ vadaṃtyo'pītyarthaḥ || evaṃca śubhāśubhakāraṇatvena satyasyaiva niścitatvāt| yadā karmasviti puruṣamiti ca śratibhyāmanvayavyatirekasadhrīcīnapratyakṣeṇa ca kāraṇatvasiddheḥ| api caivaṃ vyāsādayo manyaṃte| yadvā brāhmaṇo brūyāddevateti vacanabalāditi| ataḥ svapnaviṣayasya bhagavadadhīnatvasiddhermāhātmyaṃ tasyeti yuktā tatra bhaktiriti siddhaṃ || || iti saṃdhyādhikaraṇaṃ || atra bhagavataḥ svapnatirodhāyakatvamahimā varṇyate| <3-2-5> || parābhighyānāttu tirohitaṃ tato hyasya baṃdhaviparyayau || nanu na svapnatirobhāva īśvarādhīnaḥ| tasya bāhyajñānajanyatvenājñānanāśe saṃtatyanusaṃbhavāt| tathā ca jñānājñānavināśadvārā svapnatirobhāvasaṃbhavānna tasyeśvarādhīnatvamiti na tasya mahāmahimatvamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || parābhidhyānāttu tirohitaṃ tato hyasya baṃdhaviparyayau iti || asyārthaḥ || hi yasmāt| tataḥ paramātmanaḥ sakāśāt| asya jīvasya| baṃdhaviparyayau baṃdhamokṣau bhavataḥ| tasmātparābhidhyānāttu paramātmecchayaiva| saṃdhyaṃ tirohitaṃ līnaṃ bhavati| na kāraṇāṃtarādityarthaḥ || evaṃca jñānājñānayoracetanatvena svātaṃtryābhāvāt| tayorapi baṃdhamokṣayorīśvarādhīnatvavat svapnanirodhasyāpi tadadhīnatvena tasya mahāmahimatvādyuktā tatra bhaktiriti siddhaṃ || || iti parābidhyānādhikaraṇaṃ || atra viṣṇorjagatpravartakatvamahimā varṇyate| <3-2-6> || dehayogādvāso'pi || nanu na jāgaraṇaṃ bhagavadadhīnaṃ| tasya kāladhīnatvāt| na cācetanatvāttadadhīnatvānupapattiḥ| kālādhīnatvasyānubhavasiddhatvenācetanatvānumānasya bādhitaviṣayatvāt| na cānubhavo bhramaḥ| bādhakābhāvāt| ato jāgradavasthāyā bhagavadadhīnatvābhāvānnāsya mahāmahimatvamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || deha yogādvāso'pīti || asyārthaḥ || deha yogādvāso'pi dehābhimānenāvasthitirūpajāgradavasthā'pi parābhidhyānādeva bhavati nānyata ityarthaḥ || evaṃca sa eva jāgarite iti śruteḥ| ata evācetanatvānuṃmānamapi kālādhīnatvanivartakaṃ| śrutivirodhena pratyakṣasyāprāmāṇyāt| kālasya nimittamātraviṣayakaṃ pratyakṣaṃ bādhābhāvātpramāṇameva| ato harerjāgratpravartakatvena mahāmahimatvādyuktā bhaktiriti siddhaṃ || || iti dehayogādhikaraṇaṃ || atra suptaprāpyatvamahimā varṇyate| <3-2-7> || tadabhāvo nāḍīṣu tacchruterātmani ha || nanu na kevale paramātmanyeva svāpo na nāḍyavasthānaviśiṣṭe nāḍīsaṃbaṃdhe| duḥkhaprasaṃgāt| jāgradādyavasthāsu cakṣurādisthitabhagavadgatasyāpi jīvasya dehasaṃbaṃdhena duḥkhadarśanāt| na ceṣṭāpattiḥ| suptikāle sukhaikānubhavasya uttarakālīnānusmṛtisiddhatvāditi prāpte sūtramāha || || tadabhāvo nāḍīṣu tacchruterātmani heti || asyārthaḥ || asya jīvasya nāḍīṣu ātmani nāḍīsthite paramātmanyeva| tadabhāvaḥ jāgratsvapnayorabhāvaḥ| suṣuptirjāyate| tasya tadā tatpraveśo bhavati| kutaḥ| tachruteḥ āsu tadā nāḍīṣviti śruteḥ tathā śravaṇādityarthaḥ || hetyasyārthasya yuktatāmāha || evaṃca nāḍīsthita eva paramātmani suptiḥ| anyathā āsviti satā saumyeti ca śrutyoranyatarā prāmāṇyaprasaṃgāt| na ca duḥkhaprāptiḥ| paramātmana eva nāḍīsaṃbaṃdhāṃgīkāreṇa jīvasya tadanaṃgākārāt| ato bhagavato nāḍasthisya suptaprāpyatvamahāmāhātmyaktvādyuktā tatra bhaktiriti siddhaṃ || || iti tadabhāvādhikaraṇaṃ || atra hareḥ suptaprabodhakatvamāhātmyaṃ varṇyate || <3-2-8> || ataḥ prabodho'smāt || nanu na sarvo'pi suptaprabodha īśvarādhīnaḥ| kvacidbherītāḍanādīnāṃ kāraṇatvadarśanāt| ataḥ sarvaprabodhakatvābhāvānna mahaiśvaryamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || ataḥ prabodho'smāditi || asyārthaḥ || asya jīvasya prabodhaḥ supterutthānaṃ| asmāt paramātmana eva bhavati| nānyataḥ| kutaḥ| eṣa eveti śrutatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca bhagavatyeva jīvānāṃ suptatvena tadājñayā vinā'vabodhāyogāt| bherītāḍanādīnāṃ svataṃtrakāraṇatāgrāhipratitereṣa eveti śrutiviruddhatvenāprāmāṇyāt| atastasyaiva sarvaprabodhahetutvānmahāmahimni yuktā niratiśayā bhaktiriti siddhaṃ || || iti prabodhādhikaraṇaṃ || atra sarvapuruṣīyasārvakālikasarvāvasthānāṃ bhagavadadhīnatvamahimā varṇyate| <3-2-9> || sa eva ca karmānusmṛtiśabdavidhibhyaḥ || nanu neśvaraḥ sarveṣāṃ sarvakālīnasarvāvasthāprerakaḥ| adhipatitvāt| rājavat| yatkiṃcinniyāmakaparatvenāpi yojayituṃ śakyatvenaiṣa hyeveti śruteravirodhāt| na ca vispaṣṭasamākhyā śrutyabhāve yuktiviruddhaṃ sarvaniyāmakatvaṃ śrutyarthatayā pratipattuṃ śakyate| ataḥ sarvāvasthāprerakatvābhāvena na sarvaiśvaryaṃ hareriti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati || || sa eva ca karmānusmṛtiśabdavidhibhya iti|| asyārthaḥ || ca śabdo'pyarthe| sa eva īśvara eva| sarveṣāmapi sarvadā sarvāvasthāprerakaḥ| na deśakālāṃtare'nyaḥ| kutaḥ| karmānusmṛtiśabdavidhibhyaḥ| eṣa hyeveti karmaṇāmīśādhīnatvaśruteḥ| pradarśaka ityanukūlasmṛteśca| eṣa iti śabdāccātmānamiti vidheścetyarthaḥ || evaṃca sarvakarmaniyāmakatvāt| suptyādīnāṃ ca tadaṃtarbhāvāt| nirdiṣṭaśrutismṛyoḥ pramāṇatvena sadbhāvāt| eṣa svapnāniti vidheśca| anyasya svapnādipravartakatve paramātmana evopāsyatvāsaṃbhavāt| ataḥ sarvāvasthāprerake mahāmahimnīśvare bhaktiryukteti siddhaṃ || || iti karmānusmṛtyadhikaraṇaṃ || atreśvarasyāvāṃtarāvasthāsaṃsthitajīvaprāpyatvamahimā nirūpyate| <3-2-10> || mugdhe'rdhasaṃpattiḥ pariśeṣāt || nanu na moho jīvasya bhagavaditaratra kiṃtu paramātmanyeva jāgratsvapnāvasthāvilakṣaṇatvādanyathā tatsaṃkīrṇatāpātāt| na ca paramātmani mohāṃgīkāre suptaikadeśatvaprasaṃgaḥ| bāhyārthaviṣayatvena tadekadeśasyeṣṭatvāt| ataḥ paramātmanyeva moho jīvasyeti prāpte sūtramāha || || mugdhe'rdhasaṃpatti pariśeṣāditi || asyārthaḥ || mugdhe mūrcchāyāṃ| jīvasyārdhasaṃpattiḥ paramātmanyardhapraveśaḥ| kutaḥ| pariśeṣāt| prasaktapratiṣedhapūrvakānumānādityarthaḥ || evaṃca bhagavati ardhapraveśa eva jīvasya mohe na samagrapraveśaḥ| pariśeṣāt| tathāhi| mohe tāvatparamātmavidūratvasāmīpyapraveśārdhapraveśaḥ| na tāvatrayaḥ kalpāḥ saṃbhavati| teṣāṃ jāgradādyavasthādharmatvāt| evaṃca prataktapratiṣedhe'nyasyāprasaṃgāt pariśiṣṭo'rdhapraveśo mohe jīvasya| mohasyāvasthātrayātiriktatve bhavedetat| tadeva kuta iti cet| atra vaktavyaṃ| kiṃ mohasya suptāvaṃtarbhāva ucyate| uta jāgratsvapnayoḥ| nādyaḥ| vailakṣaṇyāt| tathāhi| mugdhaḥ kadāciducchvasati| savepadhuścāsya deho bhavati| bhayānakaṃ cāsya vadanaṃ bhavati| visphurite cāsya netre bhavataḥ| suptastu prasaṃnavadanaḥ tulyakālaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ucchvasiti| nimīlite'sya netre bhavataḥ| na cāsya deho vepate| pāṇipeṣaṇamātreṇa ca suptamutthāpayaṃti| na tu mugdhaṃ| mud‌garaghātenāpi nimittabhedasya bhavati mohasvāpayoḥ| musalaghātādinimittatvānmohasya succhāyānimittatvātsvāpasya ca na vadaṃti mugdhaṃ suptamiti| nāpi svāpnayoraṃtarbhāvaḥ| duḥkhātmakālātiriktaviṣayādarśanāt| ato moho'vasthāṃtarameva| tataśca mugdhaprāpyatvena mahāmāhātmyādbhagavati bhaktiryukteti siddhaṃ || || iti saṃpattyadhikaraṇaṃ || atreśvarasya sarvarūpeṣu nirdoṣāśeṣaguṇatvaṃ samarthyate| <3-2-11> || na sthānato'pi parasyobhayaliṃgaṃ sarvatra hi || nanu sarvaśarīrāsthito viśvādirūpo hariḥ parasparaṃ bhinna eva| bhinnasthānatvāt| paṭādivāt| na cābhodepyākāśavadbhinnasthānatvopapatteriti vācyaṃ| kārtsnyena bhinnasthānatvasya hetutvena vivakṣitatvāt| ato'tsyeva viśvādīnāṃ bhedaḥ| tataścānugrāhyānugrāhakabhāvasyāvarjanīyatvānniratiśayaiśvaryābhāvena na tatra bhaktiryukteti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || na sthānato'pi parasyobhayaliṃgaṃ sarvatra hīti || asyārthaḥ || parasya paramātmanaḥ| sthānato'pi akṣyādisthānabhedādapi| ubhayaliṃgaṃ bhinnarūpaṃ| nāsti| kiṃtu sarvatra sarvasthāneṣu sthitaṃ rūpamekameva| kutaḥ| hi yasmāt sarveṣviti śrutiratrāsti| ata ityarthaḥ || evaṃca viśvādirūpo harirbhinnasthāno'pi abhinna eveti pratipattavyaḥ| bhedasādhakabhinnasthānatvānumānasya sarveṣviti śrutibādhitatvāt| ato hareḥ svagatabhedaśūnyatevana sarvatra guṇapūrṇatvādyuktā tatra bhaktiriti siddhaṃ || <3-2-12> || na bhedāditi cenna pratyekamatadvacanāt || nanu na viśvādīnāmabhedo yuktaḥ| kāryakāraṇamiti śrutau bhedakadharmavyapadeśādityādinoktamākṣipya samādadhatsūtramupanyasyati || || na bhedāditi cenna pratyekamatadvacanāditi || asyārthaḥ || bhedāt kāryakāraṇabaddhāviti svapnajāgradanubhavajanakatvarūpabhedakatvadharmaśravaṇāt viśvādirūpāṇāṃ nābheda iti cenna| kutaḥ| pratyekaṃ parasparaṃ| teṣāṃ rūpāṇāṃ| atadvacanāt| ya eta ātmetyabhedaśruterityarthaḥ || evaṃcaiṣata ātmetyayameva sa ityayaṃ vai haraya ityādi śrutīnāmabhedabodhakatvāt| api cāmātro'naṃtamātreti śrutau viśvādyanaṃtarūpeṇa mūlarūpasya cābhedasyoktatvāt| ato hareḥ svagatabhedarahitatvena tasminbhaktiḥ kāryeti siddhaṃ || <3-2-13> || api caivameke || nanu nābhedaśrutibhirbhedaśruterbādho yuktaḥ tāsāṃ katipayarūpaviṣayatvena sāvakāśatvāt| nāpyayaṃ vai haraya iti śrutivirodhaḥ| tatra parasparamabhedānuktermularūpeṇāpi| eṣa ta ātmeti śrutivatspaṣṭamabhedāpratīteḥ| ato bhedaśrutibalādviśvādīnāṃ bheda evetyāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || api caivameka iti|| yataḥ evamabhedaṃ ca śabdādanaṃtarūpatvaṃ caike śākhinaḥ amātra iti śrutau paṭhaṃti| api abhede'pi bhedavyapadeśaḥ sthānabhedādyajyata ityarthaḥ || evaṃcaike śākhino viśvādyanaṃtarūpeṇa cābhedaṃ paṭhaṃti| ato hareḥ svagatabhedaśūnyatvena sarvaguṇāpūrṇatvādyuktā tatra bhaktiriti siddhaṃ || || iti na sthānato'pyadhikaraṇaṃ || atra viṣṇoraprākṛtarūpaṃ samarthyate| <3-2-14> || arūpavadeva hi tatpradhānatvāt || nanu nāṃgīkartavyā'tiśayā bhaktirbhagavati| bhagavato rūpitvāṃgīkāre'nityatvaprasaṃgāt| tadarūpamiti śrutyapramāṇyaprasaṃgācca| tataśca bhaktivilopaḥ| na hyanityaśarīre niratiśayā bhaktirupapadyate| nāpyarūpitvaśrutyaprāmāṇye sā yujyate| arūpitvaśrutyaprāmāṇye'viśeṣāt| śrutimātrāprāmāṇyāpattyā bhaktiprayojakaguṇasiddheḥ| tataśca bhakteranupapannatvād‌vyartho'yaṃ pāda iti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || arūpavadeva hi tatpradhānatvāditi || asyārthaḥ || brahma arūpavadeva prākṛtarūparahitameva| kutaḥ| tatpradhānatvāt prakṛtyādyuttamatvāt| hi śabdasūcitāsthūlamiti śruteścetyarthaḥ || evaṃcāpekṣitaiva bhagavadbhaktiḥ| tasyārūpitve nānityatvarūpitvaśrutyapramāṇyalakṣaṇadoṣarahitatvāt| na cārūpitvamasiddhaṃ| prakṛtyuttamatvena prākṛtarūpavaidhuryasiddheḥ| tadevaṃ bhakterupapannatvātsārthako'yaṃ pāda iti siddhaṃ || <3-2-15> || prakāśavaccāvaiyarthyaṃ || nanu brahmaṇo rūpābhāve rukmavarṇamityādirūpitvaśrutivaiyarthyaṃ syāt| api ca sauṃdaryasaulakṣaṇyādyabhāvāpatteścetyāśaṃkāṃ parākurvatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || prakāśavaccāvaiyarthyamiti || asyārthaḥ || co hetusūcakaḥ| prakāśavat lokavilakṣaṇacakṣurādiprakāśe nāsti prakāśa iti vyavahārasyeva| avaiyarthyaṃ na brahmaṇo rūpitvaśrutīnāmaprāmāṇyaṃ| kutaḥ tasyārūpitve'pi vilakṣaṇarūpitvābhyupagamādityarthaḥ || evaṃca rukmavarṇamityādiśrutervaiyarthyābhāvaḥ sauṃdaryādyabhāvaśca| aprākṛtaśarīrasyāṃgīkārāt| ato'pekṣitaiva bhagavadbhaktiriti siddhaṃ || <3-2-16> || āha ca tanmātraṃ || nanu kathaṃ brahmaṇo lokavilakṣaṇarūpatvaṃ| yenānityatvādidoṣābhāvaḥ| sarvarūpāṇāṃ prakṛtyādyātmakatvaniyamāt| itararūpāpekṣayā tadrūpasya vailakṣaṇyānukteriti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati || || āha ca tanmātramiti || asyārthaḥ || yataḥ ekātmyamiti śrutiḥ brahmaṇaḥ tanmātraṃ vijñānānaṃdaikasvarūpamāha vaktītyarthaḥ| ato navailakṣaṇyāniruktiriti ca śabdārthaḥ || evaṃca nirdiṣṭaśrutipramāṇasadbhāvād‌brahmaṇo vilakṣaṇarūpatvamanityatvādidoṣābhāvaśceti siddhaṃ || <3-2-17> || darśayati cātho api smaryate || nanūktaśrutidvaye brahmaṇo jñānānaṃdādyātmakatvamevocyate natvānaṃdāderbrahmaśarīratvaṃ| ato rūpipadoktadehitvaśruterlokavilakṣaṇarūpaviṣayatvābhāvādvaiyarthyaṃ sauṃdaryābhāvaścāparihṛtaḥ| na ca rūparūpiṇorabhedāditi tattvapradīpe tadapi śrutyabhipretamityuktamiti vācyaṃ| spaṣṭoktyabhāvenānirṇayādityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || darśayati cātho api smaryata iti || asyārthaḥ || co yataḥ caḥ samuccaye| na kevalaṃ brahmaṇaḥ ānaṃdādyātmakatvaṃ darśayati| kiṃtu tadvijñāneneti śrutirjñānasya brahmātmakatvamapi darśayati pratipādayati| atho ityarthāṃtaravāci| atho vijñānasyāpi brahmarūpatvaṃ smaryate| vyāsādibhiḥ śuddhasphaṭikamityādinā| ato na jñānānaṃdayorbrahmarūpatvamaprāmāṇikamityarthaḥ || evaṃca brahmaṇo vilakṣaṇarūpatvasya tadrūpāṇāṃ parasparamabhedasya ca siddhatvāt| śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśamiti smṛteḥ| tadeva bhakterupapannatvātsārthako'yaṃ pāda iti siddhaṃ || || iti arūpādhikaraṇaṃ || atreśvarasya jīvādbhedābhedo nirākriyate| <3-2-18> || ata eva copamā sūryakādivat || nanu jīvastāvatparamātmano bhidyata iti śrutyādisiddhaṃ| anumataṃ bhavatāṃ| evaṃ sati prayujyate| jīvaḥ paramātmābhinnaḥ| cetanatvāt| tadaṃśatvāt| matsyādivat| evaṃceśvarasya jīvena bhinnatvepyabhedasyāpi bhāvāt| doṣeṇaikye ca duṣṭatvāvaśyaṃ bhāvānna paramātmani bhaktiryukteti prāpte sūtramāha || || ataeva copamā sūrya kādivaditi || asyārthaḥ || ataeva īśatadrūpāṇāmabedoktereva| atae cetanatvādihetoreva| upamā jīvasya matsyādisāmyaṃ| matsyādivadīśvarābheda iti cennetiśeṣaḥ| ca śabdena bhinnatvasāmyaṃ samuccinoti| kutaḥ| yataḥ sūryakādivat yathā jalapratibiṃbitasūryakādeḥ sūryādipratibiṃbādbhinnatvaṃ tathā jīvasya pratibiṃbatvāt bhinnatvamityarthaḥ || yadvā || ataeva matsyādīnāṃ brahmaṇo jñānādi guṇairaviśeṣoktereva| ataeva sūryakādivat| upamā sūryakādyupamā| jīvasya matsyāditulyāṃśatve tadaviśeṣāpattereva upamā brahmapratibiṃbatetyarthaḥ| ataeva brahmapratibiṃbatvādeva sūryakādivanna brahmābhinno jīva iti ca śabdārthaḥ || athavā || ataeva prakṛtābhyāṃ tadadhīnatvatatsadṛśatvābhyāmeva| upamā sūryakādivadityupamā dīveśvarapratibiṃbatvāt nopādhyadhīnatvādinā na tannivṛttyā pratibiṃbatānivṛttirityarthaḥ || evaṃca jīvaḥ paramātmanā bhinnaḥ| tatpratibiṃbatvāt| yo yatpratibiṃbaḥ ca cāsau tadabhinnaḥ| yathā sūryakādiḥ| nanūpādhyāyattaḥ pratibiṃba ucyate| na ca sa upādhyāyattaḥ| tathātve'nityatvaprasaṃgāt| tataścāsiddhaṃ pratibiṃbatvaṃ| atha paramātmādhīnatve sati cetanatvena tatsādṛśyaṃ hetutayā vivakṣitaṃ| tarhanupapanno dṛṣṭāṃtaḥ prāpnotīti cenna| cetanatvādiviśeṣarūpamavivakṣitvā tadadhīnatvatatsādṛśyayoreva hetutayā vivakṣitatvāt| ata evopamāpyupapannā| biṃbādhīnatvamiva biṃbasādṛśyasyāpi tatra sattvāt| nanvevamapi pakṣe sarvadṛṣṭāṃtadharmābhāvāt| tatā cāyamityupanayo na saṃbhavatīti cenna| yathā dṛṣṭāṃtaḥ sādhyavyāpyasādhanavān tathā pakṣepītyetāvanmātrasyopanaye vivakṣitatvena yāvatsādharmyasyāvivakṣitatvāt| anyathā'numānamātrocchoccheprasaṃga iti| ato jīvaparamātmanorabhedābhāvādyukta bhagavati bhaktiriti tanmahimāvarṇanamupapannamiti siddhaṃ || || iti upamādhikaraṇaṃ || atreśvare bhaktyarthaṃ tasyā jīvasvarūpābhivyaktirūpaphalaṃ nirūpyate| <3-2-19> || aṃbuvadagrahaṇāttu na tathātvaṃ || nanu na mokṣo bhaktiphalaṃ| anādisiddhatvāt| nityānaṃdajñānādimattvaṃ hi mokṣaḥ| tacca svarūpameva| na ca svarūpamāgaṃtukaṃ ceti saṃbhavati| tataśca mokṣasya bhaktiphalatvābhāvānna tadarthaṃ bhaktiḥ kartavyā| nāpi prayojanāṃtaramastītyakartavyaiva bhaktiriti prāpte sūtramāha || || aṃbuvadagrahaṇāttu na tathātvamiti || asyārthaḥ || sādṛśyārthe vatiḥ| sādṛśyaṃ snehākhyaviśeṣaṇena vivakṣitaṃ| tathā ca yataḥ aṃbuvadagrahaṇāt snehasahitamāhātmyajñānābhāvāt| bhaktiṃ vineti yāvat| tathātvaṃ sukhādyātmakatvarūpeśvarasādṛśyaṃ| na tu samyagvyajyate| ato bhaktireva samyak svarūpābhivyaktijaniketi tadarthaṃ sā kartavyetyarthaḥ || evaṃca bhaktiphalameva mokṣaḥ| jñānānaṃdāderjīvasvarūpatvena nityasiddhatve'pi tadāvirbhāvasya bhaktisādhyatvāt| bhaktyabhāve tadabhāva iti niyamāt| suptau bhaktyabhāvena jñānānaṃdādyāvirbhāvamātrasadbhāve'pi samyagāvirbhāvābhāvāt| tathā ca samyagāvirbhāva eva mokṣa śabdārtho bhaktyā sādhyo nāvirbhāvamātraṃ| yamaiveṣa iti śrutermahitvabuddhiriti smṛteśca| atau mokṣasya bhaktisādhyatvātkartavyaiva tadarthaṃ bhaktistanmahimāvarṇana ca sārthakamiti siddhaṃ || || iti aṃbuvadadhikaraṇaṃ || atra puruṣeṣu bhaktestāratamyena vṛttitvaṃ tadanusṛtya bhagavatā phaladātṛtvaṃ ca nirūpyate | <3-2-20> || vṛddhihrāsabhāktvamaṃtarbhāvādubhayasāmaṃjasyādevaṃ || nanu brahmādīnāṃ manuṣyottamānāṃ ca bhaktirekaprakāraiva| mokṣaikarūpaphalabhāgitvāt| na hi yāvatyā bhaktyā manuṣyottamānāṃ mokṣastāvatyā bhrahmādīnāṃ mokṣasaṃbhave'dhikānuṣṭhānāya prekṣāvatpravṛttiḥ saṃbhavati| atha na tāvatā bhaktisteṣāṃ mokṣasādhanatayā'laṃ| haṃta tarhi manuṣyottamānāmapi bhaktirna syāt| paryāptasādhanābhāvāt| na hi duḥkhābhāvarūpamokṣe tāratamyamasti yena bhaktitāratamyumupapannaṃ syāt| ato bhaktirekaprakāraiveti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || vṛddhihrāsabhākttvāmaṃtarbhāvādubhayasāmaṃjasyādevamiti || asyārthaḥ || vṛddhihrāsabhāktvaṃ bhaktyādeḥ sādhakeṣvādhikyanyūnatā na tāvadatrāṃgīkāryaṃ| kutaḥ| aṃtarbhāvāt mahadalpaphalavatāṃ brahmādīnāmanyeṣāṃ ca bhāktatveṃ'tarbhāvāt| tathā'pi kuto vṛddhihrāsabhāktvaṃ| evaṃ bhaktitāratamye satyeva| ubhayasāmaṃjasyāt ubhayān mahadalpaphalān brahmādijīvānprati phaladāturīśvarasya sāmaṃjasyāt vaiṣamyena phaladānasya bhaktitāratamyena yuktatvāt| anyathā'yuktatvāt| atastadaṃgīkāryamityarthaḥ || evaṃca naikaprakārā sarveṣāṃ bhaktiḥ| kiṃtu vṛddhihrāsavatī| anyathā pramāṇasiddhaṃ sarvabhaktānprati parameśvare sāmaṃjasyaṃ na syāt| sādhanasyottamatveneti tataśca bhakteḥ phalānusāreṇa tāratamyasadbhāvena yuktā tatra bhaktiriti siddhaṃ || <3-2-21> || darśanācca || nanu bhavetsādhanatāratamyaṃ yadānaṃdatāratamyaṃ syāt| tadeva kuta iti hetvasiddhimākṣipya pariharatsūtramācaṣṭe || || darśanācceti || asyārthaḥ || athāta iti śrutau yatheti smṛtau ca phalatāratamyadarśanāt uktatvāccoktaṃ yuktamityarthaḥ || evaṃca nirdiṣṭaśrutismṛtibhyāṃ bhakteḥ phalānusāreṇa tāratamyasadbhāveneśvarasya viṣamatvābhāvādyuktā tatra bhaktiriti siddhaṃ || || iti vṛddhihrāsādhikaraṇaṃ || atra viśvapālakatvaṃ samarthyate| <3-2-22> || prakṛtaitāvattvaṃ hi pratiṣedhati tato bravīti ca bhūyaḥ || nanu neśvaraḥ pālakaḥ| jagatsṛṣṭ‌vā sthitasyeśvarasya vināśapravṛtyabhāvamātreaiṇa kāliviśeṣasaṃbaṃdharūpasthitisaṃbhavena pālanarūpatad‌vyāpārānapekṣatvāt| na cāvāṃtaropadravanirāsāyeśvaravyāpāro'pekṣita iti vācyaṃ| īśvarasyaivāvāṃtaropadravakartṛtvena tadakaraṇamātreṇa samīhitasiddheḥ| yadyanyasyopadravakartṛtve tannirāsakavyāpārarūpatvaṃ pālakatvamanyasya syāt| na ceśvarādanyasaṃhartā yena tannirāseneśvarasya pālakatvaṃ syāt| virodhābhāvena svasya svanivārakatvāyogāt| tataśca pālakatvābhāvena mahāmahimatvābhāvānna tatra bhaktiriti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || prakṛtaitāvattvaṃ hi pratiṣedhati tato bravīti ca bhūya iti || asyārthaḥ || hi yataḥ| naitāvadeneti śrutiḥ prakṛtaitāvatvaṃ| prakṛtasya sṛṣṭyādikartṛtvasya| etāvattvaṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakartṛtvamātraparyavasitatvaṃ| pratiṣedhati nirācaṣṭe| tataḥ sṛṣṭyādikartṛtvāt| bhūyaḥ adhikaṃ| pālakatvaṃ ca bravīti| ataḥ pālakatvāt| sṛṣṭiṃ ceti būcitapālakatvākhyaṃ mahimāṃtaramapi harestīti jñāpayatītyarthaḥ || ca śabdena sṛṣṭiṃ ceti smṛtiḥ sūcitā || evaṃca bhavatyeveśvaraḥ pālakaḥ| naitāvadenāpara iti śrutyā sṛṣṭisaṃhāramātrakartṛtvaṃ pratiṣidhya pālakatvasyāpyabhidhānāt| na copadravasaṃhāravilaṃbamātreṇaiva sthitisiddherna tadarthamīśvarāpekṣeti vācyaṃ| sarvasya dhāraṇārthaṃ cetanānāmannapānadyarthaṃ tad‌vyāpārasyāvaśyakatvāt| ataḥ pālanādimahāmahimni harau bhaktaryukteti siddhaṃ || || iti prakṛtyadhikaraṇaṃ || atra bhagavadbhakteḥ kartavyatā marthanāya tasyopalabdhiyogyatvaṃ samarthyate| <3-2-23> || tadavyaktamāha hi || nanu vyaktamevāyamīśvaraḥ| mahattvasamānādhikaraṇodbhūtarūpatvāt| yadā paśya iti śruteśca| na hyavyaktasvabhāvatve sādhanaśatenāpi darśanamupapadyate| svabhāvasyānapāyāt| tataśca staṃbhādivatpuruṣaprayatnenaiva pratyakṣasaṃbhavād‌vyarthaiva tadbhaktiriti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || tadavyaktamāha hīti || asyārthaḥ || tat brahmā| avyaktaṃ puruṣaprayatnena draṣṭumaśakyasvabhāvaṃ| kutaḥ| hi yasmāt | avyaktaṃca niṣphalamiti śrutisthathā''ha tasmādityarthaḥ || evaṃcāvyaktamevāyamīśvaraḥ| arūpamiti śruteḥ| ata eva pratyakṣatāprayojakaprākṛtarūpattvamasiddhaṃ| tataśca svato'vyaktasyāpi īśvarasya bhaktisādhyaprasādādāparokṣyasaṃbhavātsaphalatvādbhakti kartavyeti siddhaṃ || <3-2-24> || api saṃrādhane pratyakṣānumānābhyāṃ || nanvastu svato'vyaktaṃ brahma| tathā'pi saṃrādhanena puruṣaprayatnena yakṣādivad‌vyaktaṃ bhaviṣyati| evaṃ cet kiṃ bhaktyetyāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtramupanyasyati || || api saṃrādhane pratyakṣānumānābhyāmiti || asyārthaḥ || api bhaktirahitārādhanenāpi na brahma vyaktīkartuṃ śakyaḥ| kutaḥ| saṃrādhane'pi saṃpūjane'pi| avyaktatvasya pratyakṣānumānābhyāṃ jñānipratyakṣasūkṣmatvahetukānumānābhyāṃ| siddhatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca bhaktyabhāve satyapi samārādhane brahmāpratyakṣatvasya jñānipratyakṣasiddhatvena samārādhanasya brahmapratyakṣahetutvābhāvāt| yakṣasyātisūkṣmatvābhāvena samārādhanasahakṛtoṃdriyagrāhyatvepyatisūkṣmatvena brahmaṇo yakṣādivattadayogāt| tataśca bhakteḥ saphalatvamiti siddhaṃ || <3-2-25> || prakāśavaccāvaiśeṣyaṃ || nanvastu mūlarūpeṇāvyaktaṃ brahma| anutpannatvāt| avatārarūpeṇa vyaktībhaviṣyati| utpannatvāt| mūlarūpeṇāvyaktānāmapyanalajalabhuvāmutpannarūpeṇa vyaktatvadarśanāt| na ca mūlarūpameva dṛṣṭaṃ mokṣasādhanaṃ tāvatā rūpamiti śakyate vaktuṃ| līlāvigrahasya gṛhītatvenotpattyādoṣatvāt| mūlarūpeṇa samaśaktimattvāt| pūrṇamada iti vacanācca| tato vyarthā bhaktiriti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || prakāśavaccāvaiśeṣyamiti || asyārthaḥ || co nañarthaḥ || prakāśavat yathā'gneḥ sthūlasūkṣmābhyāṃ vyaktāvyaktatve| tathā brahma na kiṃtu svato'vyaktameva| kutaḥ| yataḥ avaiśeṣyaṃ brahmaṇi sthūlasūkṣmatvaviśeṣo nāsti| ata ityarthaḥ || evaṃca mūlarūpāvatārarūpayorubhayorapyavyaktatvena vyaktatvāvyaktatvaviśeṣābhāvāt| sthūlasūkṣmaviśeṣa iti vacanāt| ato bhakteḥ saphalatvamiti siddhaṃ || <3-2-26> || prakāśaśca karmaṇyabhyāsāt || nanu brahmāvyaktamave| tathā ca vyarthaiva tadbhaktiḥ| avyaktasvabhāvasya sādhanaśatenāpi vyaktīkartumaśakyatvāditi prāpte sūtramupanyasyati || || prakāśaśca karmaṇyabhyāsāditi || asyārthaḥ || prakāśaśca aparokṣajñānaṃ ca| karmaṇi viṣayabhūte brahmaṇi| abhyāsāt śravaṇāderāvartanāt| bhavatītyarthaḥ || evaṃca bhaktipūrvakaśravaṇādyabhyāsena tatprasāde jāte tadāparokṣyāṃgīkārāt| tathā ca bhakteḥ saphalatvamiti siddhaṃ || <3-2-27> || ato'naṃtena tathā hi liṃgaṃ || nanvavyaktasvabhāvasya śravaṇādyabhyāsenāpyāparokṣyāṃgīkāro na yuktaḥ| avyaktasvabhāvatvarūpayuktivirodhāparihārāditi cet samādadhatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || ato'naṃtena tathā hi liṃgamiti || asyārthaḥ || ataḥ avyaktatve pratyakṣe ca| pramāṇasadbhāvāt| tadanyathā'nupapattyā| anaṃtena aparicchinnena brahmaṇā| tatprasādenāvyaktasyāparokṣyaṃ bhavatīti jñāyate| na kevalamanupapattimātrāt ki tarhi| hi yasmāt| tathā liṃgaṃ tasyābhidhyānādityuktamīśaprasādasya baṃdhanivṛttihetutvarūpaṃ| prasādasya darśanahetutvajñāpakamasti| tasmādityarthaḥ || evaṃcāvyaktasvabhāvasya sādhanasāmarthyena grahaṇāsaṃbhave'pi tatprasādenāparokṣyāṃgīkāre bādhakābhāvāt| īśvarasyāghaṭitaghaṭakatvena siddhatvāt| yaddhi yuktyeti vacanāt| bhagavatprasādastadaparokṣasādhanaṃ mokṣasādhanatvādityanumānasiddhatvāt| ato bhakteḥ saphalatvāttadarthe tanmahimāvarṇanaṃ sārthakamiti siddhaṃ || || iti avyaktatvādhikaraṇaṃ || atra bhagavato guṇitvaṃ samarthyate| <3-2-28> || ubhayavyapadeśāttvahikuṃḍalavat || nanu na bhagavadbhaktiryuktā| tasyānaṃdādyātmakatvenānaṃdatvādiśūnyatvāt| na cānaṃdādibhoktṛtvaṃ vinā tatsvarūpatvaṃ mahimā| ato guṇitvābhāvena tatra bhaktyayogād‌vyarthaṃ tanmāhātmyavarṇanamiti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati || || ubhayavyapadeśāttvahikuṃḍalavaditi || asyārthaḥ || brahma ānaṃdaguṇakaṃ tadrūpaṃ ca bhavati kutaḥ| ubhayavyapadeśāt| ānaṃdo brahma | ānaṃdaṃ brahmaṇa ityādiśratiṣu guṇātmakatvena guṇitvena ca brahmaṇa uktatvāt| tadapi kathaṃ| ahikuṃḍalavat| yathā'heḥ sarpasya| kuṃḍalatvaṃ kuṃḍalitvaṃca| viśeṣāttathetyarthaḥ || evaṃcoktaśrutiṣūbhayavyapadeśabalena guṇātmakasyāpi| ahikuṃḍalavat prakāśavat pūrvakālavat| bhagavatastaddharmāṇāṃ ca bhedapratinidhiviśeṣāṃgīkārāt| neśvaro guṇavān guṇātmakatvāt yathā'śvo'naśvavān| ānaṃdādyā na brahmaguṇāḥ tatsvarūpatvād‌brahmavadityādyuktīnāṃ bādhābhāvāt| tasya śrutyaikasamadhigamyatvokteḥ| ato guṇagiṇini harau bhaktisaṃbhavādyuktaṃ tanmāhātmyavarṇanamiti siddhaṃ || <3-2-29> || prakāśāśrayavadvā tejastvāt || dṛṣṭāṃtāṃtareṇaitadeva sādhayatsūtramupanyasyati || || prakāśāśrayavadvā tejastvāditi || asyārthaḥ || yathā prakāśāśrayasyādityasya prakāśarūpatvaṃ tadāśrayatvaṃ ca tadvad‌brahmaṇo'pi anyaparityāgenādityadṛṣṭāṃ te ko heturityata uktaṃ| tejastvāditi| brahmādityayorubhayorapi tejorūpatvāttadabhiprāyeṇa tadṛṣṭāṃtīkaraṇamityarthaḥ || evaṃca bhedapratinidhiviśeṣabalādeva guṇaguṇibhāvasya yuktatvāt| yāvad‌dravyabhāviguṇābhinnānāṃ ghaṭādīnāmatejorūpatvena teṣāṃ parityāgena tejorūpatvasādharmyavivakṣayā''dityadṛṣṭāṃtasyoktatvāt| ato brahmaṇi guṇaguṇibhāvo yujyata iti siddhaṃ || <3-2-30> || pūrvavadvā || dṛṣṭāṃtāṃtareṇa brahmaṇo guṇaguṇirūpatvaṃ sādhayat sūtramupanyasyati || || pūrvavadveti || asyārthaḥ || yathākālaḥ pūrveṇābhinno'pi pūrvakāla iti pūrvapadena viśiṣyate tathā brahma ānaṃdena viśiṣyata ityarthaḥ || ādarārthaṃ sūkṣmasthūlabuddhivivakṣayā vā| dṛṣṭāṃtatrayoktiḥ || evaṃca yathā pūrvaḥ kāla iti prayoge pūrveṇābhinno'pi kālaḥ pūrva iti viśeṣyaśca viśeṣabalādbhavatyeva| yathā cāṃge śayanamiti prayorge'gābhinnamapi śayanaṃ yathāṃ'gaṃ śayanaviśeṣaṇakaṃ bhavatyeva| ityādi dṛṣṭāṃtānāṃ sadbhāvāt| teṣāṃ caikasminneva viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvasya sūkṣmasthūlamatīnāṃ pradarśanārthamuktatvāt| ato harau guṇaguṇibhāvo yujyata iti siddhaṃ || <3-2-31> || pratiṣedhācca || nanu viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvāṃgīkāreṇa guṇitvasaṃbhavāt| kimanena guṇaguṇinorabhedamaṃgīkṛtya guṇaguṇibhāvāṃgīkāreṇa bheda eva kiṃ na syādityāśaṃkāṃ parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || pratiṣadhedhācceti || asyārthaḥ || brahmaguṇānāṃ brahmaṇaśca neha nāneti bhedasya| pratiṣedhācca brahma guṇātmakamityarthaḥ || evaṃca neha nānetyekamevādvitīyamityādiśrutiṣu bhagavato jñānānaṃdādiguṇairavayavaiścābhinnamiti samābhyadhikaśūnyamiti coktvā hīnādhikabhāvasyānyonyābhāvasya pṛthaktvarūpasya ca bhedasya niṣiddhatvāt| ato guṇaguṇini harau bhaktisaṃbhavādyuktaṃ tanmāhātmyavarṇanamiti siddhaṃ || || iti ahikuṃḍalādhikaraṇaṃ || atra bhagavadguṇānāṃ lokavilakṣaṇatvaṃ samarthyate| <3-2-32> || paramataḥ setūnmānasaṃbaṃdhabhedavyapadeśebhyaḥ || nanvīśvarānaṃdādirlaukikānaṃdādivadānaṃdādireva| na punarjñānādirapi| ānaṃdaśabdavācyatvāt| na hi jñānātmaka ānaṃdaśabdo yujyate| paṭe'pi ṭaśabdaprayogaprasaṃgāt| tataśceśvarānaṃdasya lokavilakṣaṇatvābhāvānna tatra niratiśayābhaktirita prāpte sūtritaṃ || || paramataḥ setūnmānasaṃbaṃdhabhedavyapadeśebhya iti || asyārthaḥ || brahmaguṇajātaṃ paraṃ lokavilakṣaṇaṃ| kutaḥ| setūnmānasaṃbaṃdhavyapadeśebhyaḥ| eṣa seturiti setutvokteḥ| yato vāca ityunmānaśabditapūrṇatvokteḥ| etasyaivānaṃdasyeti biṃbapratibiṃbabhāvasaṃbaṃdhokteḥ| anyajñānaṃtviti laukikānaṃdādbhedokteścetyarthaḥ || evaṃca nirdiṣṭaśrutyādibhirbrahmānaṃdādisetutvapūrṇatvabiṃbatvādīnāṃ vailakṣaṇyasyoktatvādalaukikaguṇe harau bhaktiḥ kartavyeti siddhaṃ || <3-2-33> || darśanāt || nanvanyānaṃdādīnāṃ manovāggocaratvādbhavatu laukikatvaṃ| tāvatā brahmānaṃdādeḥ kathamalaukikatvasiddhiḥ| mānābhāvādityatastatpramāṇatvena darśanapadoktāṃ śrutiṃ hetvaṃtareṇānaṃdāderalaukikatvaṃ samarthayatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || darśanācceti || asyārthaḥ || anyānaṃdādīnāṃ pratyakṣasiddhatvānmanovāgviṣayatvācca brahmānaṃdasyātathātvādeva lokavilakṣaṇatvamityarthaḥ || evaṃca laukikānaṃdādikaṃ hi darśanayogyaṃ| īśvarānaṃdādi tu `adṛṣṭamavyavahāryaṃ' ityādinā darśanāyogyamityucyate| tataśca tallokavilakṣaṇameveti tasminbhaktiḥ kartavyeti siddhaṃ || <3-2-34> || budhyarthaḥ pādavat || nanu yadīśvarānaṃdādirlokānaṃdādivilakṣaṇaḥ| kathaṃ tarhi lokānaṃdādiḥ śrutipurāṇādau gṛhītasaṃgatikasyānaṃdādiśabdasya tatra prayogaḥ| na hi lavaṇegṛhītasaṃgatikaḥ saiṃdhavaśabdo'śve pṛthak saṃgatigrahaṃ vinā yujyate| yenehāpi tatra saṃgatigrahābhāve'pi laukikeṣu saṃgatigrahaṇamātreṇa tatra prayujyata iti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || budhyarthaḥ pādavaditi || asyārthaḥ || yathā lokapādavilakṣaṇeṣu jīvākhyabhūteṣu pādo'sya viśvā būtānīti pādapadaprayogaḥ| budhyarthaḥ bhūtānāṃ īśāṃśatvajñāpanārthaḥ| tathā'laukike'pi brahmānaṃdādāvānaṃdapadaprayogaḥ| budhyarthaḥ anukūlatayā vedanīyatvādidharmajñāpanārtha ityarthaḥ || evaṃca laukikapādasvarūpāṃśābhyāṃ vilakṣaṇeṣu bhinnāṃśeṣu jīveṣu pādo'syeti pādaśabdaprayogavat laukikānāṃ budhyarthameva loke gṛhītasaṃgatikasyānaṃdādi śabdasya kiṃcitsādṛśyamātreṇa bhagavadānaṃdādau prayogopapatteḥ| jñātatāvanmātrasya pramāṇāṃtaravaśāt vailakṣaṇye jñāte śabdānāṃ tatra paramamukhyavṛttigraho'pi bhavati| ato'laukikaguṇe harau bhaktiḥ kāryeti siddhaṃ || || iti paramatādhikaraṇaṃ || atra brahmādyānaṃdādīnāṃ bhagavadānaṃdādipratibiṃbatvaṃ pūrvanayoktaṃ samarthyate| <3-2-35> || sthānaviśeṣātprakāśādivat || nanu na brahmādyānaṃdādayo bhagavadānaṃdādipratibiṃbabhūtāḥ| tathātve vaicitryābhāvaprasaṃgāt| pratibiṃbaivacitrye hi kāraṇadvayaṃ| biṃbavaicitryaṃ sthānavaicitryaṃ ceti| na cātra brahmādisthānavaicitryaṃ pratibiṃbavaicitryopapādakaṃ saṃbhavati| tasyāpi bhagavaddharmapratibiṃbatvena vaicitryasiddhaye sthānaguṇāṃtaravaicitryānusaraṇe'navasthānāt| nāpi biṃbānaṃdādivaicitryaṃ| bhaktyabhāvaprasaṃgāt| tataśca kāraṇābhāvena vaicitryāsaṃbhavāt| na brahmānaṃdādirbhagavadānaṃdādipratibiṃba iti tasyālaukikatvābhāvānna tatra niratiśayābhaktiriti prāpte sūtramāha || || sthānaviśeṣātprakāśādivaditi || asyārthaḥ || prakāśādivat| yathā sūryakāṃtādigatasūryādipratibiṃbe'gnijanakatvādivaicitryaṃ| sthānaviśeṣāt| sūryakāṃtādisthānaguṇavaicitryādupapadyate tathā brahmādisthānagatabhaktyādiguṇavaicitryādbhagavadānaṃdapratibiṃbeṣu brahmādyānaṃdeṣvapi vaicitryamupapadyata ityarthaḥ || evaṃca pratibiṃba eva brahmādyānaṃdādiḥ| bhagavadānaṃdāderbrahmādīnāmanādikālīnabhaktyādiguṇavaicitryaparamaiśvaryābhyāṃ sūryapratibiṃbavaicitryavat ānaṃdādivaicitryasaṃbhavāt| brahmādiguṇeti smṛteḥ| ato brahmādiguṇabiṃbālaukikaguṇe harau bhaktiryukteti siddhaṃ || <3-2-36> || upapatteśca || yuktyaṃtareṇabiṃvānaṃdādyavaicitrye'pi pratibiṃbavaicitryamupapādayatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || upapatteśceti || asyārthaḥ ||
