biṃbabhūtabhagavadaiśvaryavaśādeva pratibiṃbabhūtabrahmādyānaṃdavaicitryopapatteśca tatpratibiṃbatvamitareṣāṃ yuktamityarthaḥ || evaṃca bhaktyādivaicitryānupapattyabhāvāt| tasya parameśvaraiśvaryādevopapatteḥ| parameśvarohi vedāprāmāṇyakāraṇavaiṣamyādiparihārāya bhaktyādivaicitryamapekṣyaiva vicitrānaṃdādīn dadāti| anādikālīnabhaktyādivicitraguṇāṃstu svaicchayaivaiśvaryavaśāddadāti| tatra vaiṣamyāderadoṣatvāt| aiśvaryātparamāditi smṛteḥ| ato brahmādiguṇabiṃbālaukikaguṇe harau yuktaiva bhaktiriti siddhaṃ || || iti sthānaviśeṣādhikaraṇaṃ || atra brahmaṇo dhyānapratītādanyatvoktyā punaravyaktatva samarthyate| <3-2-37> || tathā'nyatpratiṣedhāt || nanu vyaktameva brahma| dhyānakāle pratīyamānatvāt| na ca dhyeyānāṃ bahutvena brahmabhedāpattiḥ| viśeṣabalenaiva bahutvopapatteḥ| dhyeyasyābrahmatve ca brahmadhyānābhāvena phalaṃ na syāt| ato dhyānakāle pratītasya brahmatvenāvyaktatvābhāvād‌vyarthā bhaktiriti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || tathā'nyatpratiṣedhāditi || asyārthaḥ || yathā jīvānaṃdādi brahmānaṃdādervilakṣaṇaṃ| tathā dhyānakāle pratītaṃ vāsanātmakaṃ vastu| brahmaṇo'nyat tadbhinnaṃ| kutaḥ| yanmanaseti śrutāvanyasya brahmatvapratiṣedhādityarthaḥ || evaṃcāvyaktameva brahma| jīvānaṃdād‌brahmānaṃdasya bhinnatvavatdhyeyasya durlakṣaṇatvena brahmaṇastadanyatvāt| tadeveti dhyeyasya brahmatvaniṣedhācca| pratimopāsanavatpratibiṃbopāsanasyāpi brahmopāsanatvena dhyānakālānupapattyabhāvāt| ato dhyānakāle pratītasyābrahmatvenāvyaktatvātkartavyaiva tadbhaktiriti siddhaṃ || || iti tathā'nyatvādhikaraṇaṃ || atra bhagavata eva sarvakartṛtvādi samarthyate| <3-2-38> || anena sarvagatatvamāyāmayaśapabdādibhyaḥ || nanu na bhagavata eva sarvasṛṣṭyādikriyā yujyate| kiṃtu deśakālāṃtare'nyatopi jagataḥ sā bhavati| rājādau tathā darśanāt| tathā ca na brahmaṇaḥ sakāśādeva sarvasṛṣṭyādikaṃ yuktamiti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati || || anena sarvagatatvamāyāmayaśabdādibhya iti || asyārthaḥ || anena bhagavataiva| sarvadeśakālayoḥ sṛṣṭyādirbhavati| na tu deśakālāṃtarayoranyena| kutaḥ| sarvagatatvamāyāmayaśabdādibhyaḥ| eṣa sarvagata iti sarvagatatvaśruteḥ| tasya ca sṛṣṭyādyarthatvāt| viṣṇau prayuktamāyāmayaśabdavyākhyānarūpasarvatretyādi śruteścetyarthaḥ| anyatra prāmāṇābhāvāccetyādi śabdārthaḥ || evaṃca bhagavataiva sarvadeśakālīnasṛṣṭyādi| anupraviśyeti śrutisiddhasṛṣṭyupayogisarvagatatvasyaiṣa sarvagata iti śrutau viṣṇorabhidhānāt| māyāmayaśabdavyākhyānarūpasarvatra sarvametasmāditi caturvedaśikhokteśca| kālato'nyasya jagatkāraṇatve pramāṇābhāvāt| tadabhāve saṃbhāvanāmātrasyāprayojakatvāt| ataḥ sarvajagajanmādikartari brahmaṇi bhaktiḥ kāryaiveti siddhaṃ || || iti phalādhikaraṇaṃ || atra bhagavataḥ svargādikarmaphaladātṛtvaṃ sādhyate| <3-2-39> || phalamata upapatteḥ || nanvīśvaro na phaladātā| avaśyaklṛptaniyatapūrvavṛttinā karmaṇaiva phalasaṃbhavenānyathāsiddhatvāt| tataśca na tadbhaktiḥ kāryeti prāpte sūtramāha || || phalamata upapatteriti || asyārthaḥ || phalaṃ svargādi| ataḥ īśvarādeva bhavati| na karmataḥ| kutaḥ| upapatteḥ| īśvarasya cetanatvena phaladātṛtvasya yuktatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃcācetanatvātkarmaṇaiva phalasaṃbhavābhāvenānyathāsiddhatvahetorasiddhatvena bādhakābhāvāt| ataḥ parameśvara eva karmaphaladāteti tasminbhaktiḥ kāryeti siddhaṃ || <3-2-40> || śrutatvācca || nanvīśvarasya cetanatvena phaladātṛtvasaṃbhāvanaiva bhavet| na niścayaḥ| ataḥ kuto'sau niścaya ityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || śrutatvācceti || asyārthaḥ || śratatvācca| ratiriti śrutyuktatvācceśvarasyaiva phaladārtṛtvamityarthaḥ || evaṃca na kevalaṃ cetanatvādyupapatteḥ kiṃtu śrutyuktatvācceśvarasya phaladātṛtvena niścitatvāttasminbhaktiḥ kāryeti siddhaṃ || <3-2-41> || dharmaṃ jaiminirata eva || nanu naitacchrutibaleneśvarasya phaladātṛtvamaṃgīkāryaṃ| kāraṇasya karmaṇa īśvarajanyatvena śrutāvīśvarasya phaladātṛtvasyopācāreṇaivoktatvāt| kiṃcaivamāptatamo jaimanirācāryo manyata iticettatpariharatsūtramupanyasyati || || dharmaṃ jaiminirata eveti || asyārthaḥ || jaiminirācāryaḥ dharmaṃ phalapradamāha| taṃ ca dharmaṃ| ata eva īśvarādeva janyaṃ manyate| kutaḥ| ata eva eṣa hyeveti śruterevetyarthaḥ || evaṃcoktaśrutyā jaiminyācāryābhiprāyeṇa yataḥ phalaṃ tasmādīśvarādeva karma bhavatīti siddhaṃ || <3-2-42> || pūrvaṃ tu bādarāyaṇo hetuvyapadeśāt || etatparihārāya sūtramupanyasyati || || pūrvaṃ tu bādarāyaṇo hetuvyapadeśāt iti || asyārthaḥ || bādarāyaṇācāryastu| pūrvaṃ pūrvoktaṃ| brahma dharmaṃ cobhayaṃ phalahetuṃ manyate| tatra brahma kartṛtvena karmakaraṇatvena heturiti viśeṣastu śabdārthaḥ| kutaḥ| hetuvyapadeśāt puṇyeneti śrutau brahmakarmaṇoḥ kartṛtvakaraṇatvarūpahetutvasyoktatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca śruteraupacārikatvakalpanaṃ bhavet| yadīśvaraṃ vinā kevalena karmaṇā phalaṃ bhavet| na ca tatsaṃbhavati| acetanasya svataḥ pravṛttyayogāt| evaṃca śrutyanvayavyatirekabalādubhayorapi kāraṇatve siddhe karmaiveśvaraprayojyamabhyupagaṃtavyaṃ| puṇyena puṇyaṃ pāpena pāpamiti hetuvyapadeśāt| jaiminirapi karmādirīśvarādhīnakāraṇatvamabhimatamiti na tanmatamapramāṇaṃ| ataḥ paramesvarasyaiva karmaphaladātṛtvānniratiśayamahimni tasminbhaktiḥ kartavyeti siddhaṃ || || iti phalādhikaraṇaṃ || || iti tṛtīyādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ || <3.3> || śrīḥ || || hariḥ || || atha tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ || upāsanā'sminpāda ucyate| atra sarvaparijñānaṃ samarthyate| <3-3-1> || sarvavedāṃtapratyayaṃ codanādyaviśeṣāt || nanu svasvaśākhoktamevāṃtena jñeyaṃ na sarvaśākhoktaṃ| śākhāpratipādyānāṃ nānātvāt| na ca nānātve'pi sarveṣāmekopāsyatā| anekaprāguktanyāyena mokṣāsiddhiprasaṃgāt| tataśca sarvaśākhānirṇāyakaṃ brahmamīmāṃsāśāstramanupādeyamiti prāpte parākurvatsūtramāha || || sarvavedāṃtapratyayaṃ codanādyaviśeṣāditi || asyārthaḥ || pūrvasūtre pūrvapadoditaṃ brahma sarvavedāṃtapratyayaṃ| bahuvrīhiḥ| yathāśakti sarvavedaviṣayakaśravaṇādyutpannanirṇayajanyajñānaviṣayaṃ| kutaḥ| codanādyaviśeṣāt ātmetyādi vidhīnāmādipadoditānāmatra hyeta ityādivākyoktayuktīnāṃ cāviśeṣāt| sarvādhikārikasādharaṇatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca sarvavedaśravaṇamananādyutpādyajñānameva brahma sarvairupāsyaṃ| śrotavyo maṃtavya ityādividhīnāṃ sarvasādhāraṇatvāt| na hi kāṇvādiśākhāsu tairevedaṃ jñeyaṃ nānyairityucyate yena sādhāraṇyaṃ na syāt| ato bhagavatdhyānārthaṃ sarvavedoktaṃ jñeyamiti sarvopādeyaṃ sāstramiti siddhaṃ || <3-3-2> || bhedānneti cedakasyāmapi || nanvekasyāṃ śākhāyāmanaṃtaṃ brahmetyucyate| aparasyāṃ vijñānamiti sattvānvayaparityāgenocyate| satyatvabhāvābhāvābhyāṃ pratipādyaṃ bhidyate| kiṃ ca vastvaikyeṃ'śe paunaruktyaṃ syāt| śākhāṃtaroktasyaiva jñānarūpatvādeḥ śākhāṃtare'bhidhānāt| tataśca sarvaśākhānirṇāyakaṃ brahmamīmāṃsāśāstramanupādeyamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || bhedānneti cedakasyāmapīti || asyārthaḥ || cediti neti bhedāditi apīti cāvartate| tarhīti śākhāyāmiti ca labhyate| tathā ca cedyadi sarvaśākhoktārthānāṃ bhedāt pṛthaktvāt| ekaikena sarvaśākhoktaṃ jñeyaṃ na| kiṃtu svasvaśākhoktamevetyucyate| tarhi api svasvaśākhoktamapi| na jñeyaṃ syāt| kutaḥ| ekasyāmapi bhedāt arthabhedadarśanāt| atha yadi tatra dharmabhedādekasmin dharmiṇi bhinnadharmavidhānāt| prasaṃgabhedācceti parihāra ucyate tasya sarvaśākhoktaparijñāne'pi sama ityarthaḥ || evaṃca vādinā'pyekatvenābhyupagate ekaśākhāpratipādyepyupadeśādibhedadarśanena vyabhicārāt| yadapi vastvaikyeṃ'śepaunaruktyamiti| tanna| ekasyāmapi śākhāyāmuktānāmeva guṇānāṃ punarabhidhānena samānaṃ| yadi tatra dharmyanuvādena dharmavidhānānnopadeśabedaḥ| nāpi paunaruktyaṃ| prasaṃgabhedānuvādakatvādvocyate| tacchākhāṃtare'pi samānaṃ| tataśca sarvaśākhāpratipādyamekameva vastviti siddhaṃ || <3-3-3> || svādhyāyasya tathātvena hi samācāre'dhikārācca || nanu loke śākhābhedasya prasiddhatvādvidherapi viśeṣaniṣṭhatā''vaśyakītyatrasūtroktahetorasiddheḥ| kiṃcānuṣṭhānāpekṣayā jñānamātrasya sulabhatvāt yadā sarvavedoktaśakyakarmānuṣṭhāne sarveṣāmadhikārasadbhāvastadā taduktabrahmajñāne sutarāmityāśaṃkāyāṃ prathamasūtrasyaiva hetvaṃtarābhidhāyakasūtramāha || || svādhyāyasya tathātvena hi samācāre'dhikārācceti || asyārthaḥ || svādhyāyasya svādhyāyo'dhyetavya iti vidheḥ| tathātvena sarvasādhāraṇyenādhyayanavidhāyakatvena| samācāre sarvavaidikakarmakaraṇe| adhikārāt sarveṣāmadhikārasadbhāvācca| hīti sūcitāyāḥ vedaḥ kṛtsno'dhigaṃtavya iti smṛteśca ekaikenāpi sarvaśākhādhyayanena brahma jñātavyamityarthaḥ || evaṃca svādhyāyo'dhyetavya ityadhyayanavidheḥ sāmānyāt| adhyayanasya ca jñānārthatvāt| tataśca sarveṣāṃ sarvavedoktajñāne'dhikāra iti siddhaṃ || <3-3-4> || salilavacca tanniyamaḥ || nanu yadi sarvaśākhoktaprakāreṇa jānato dhyānādhikārastarhyadhamādhikāriṇāṃ dhyānābhāvaḥ prāpta ityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtramupanyasyati || || salilavacca tanniyama iti || asyārthaḥ || co'vadhāraṇe| tanniyama ityatra paṃcamī tatpuruṣakarmadhārayau| salilavat salilamiva| tanniyamaḥ yathā sarveṣāṃ salilānāṃ pratibaṃdhābhāvamapekṣyaiva samudraikāśrayatvaniyamaḥ| tathā'trāpi tasyāḥ puruṣaśaktimapekṣyaiva tanniyamaḥ| sarvavedoktaprakāreṇa dhyānena brahma jñātavyamiti niyama ityarthaḥ || evaṃca sarveṣāṃ sarvavedoktakarmādhikārastāvaddṛśyate| tato jñānādhikāro'pi maṃtavyaḥ| viśeṣābhāvāt| yāni cemāni viruddhakarmāṇi sāmago baṭurmuḍo'nyaḥ śikhītyādīni tāni caikaśākhāgataviruddhadharmavadvikatpena bhavaṃti| na ca maṃdānāṃ jñānābhāvaḥ| yathā nadīnāmityādivākyānāṃ bādhakābhāve samudrāyatanatvaniyamatātparyavacchravaṇādividhīnāmapi yathāśakti sarvaśravaṇavidhau tātparyāṃgīkārāt| tataścoktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <3-3-5> || darśayati ca || codanādyaviśeṣādityuktisamarthitārthaṃ śrutismṛtibhyāṃca sādhayatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || darśayati ceti || asyārthaḥ || śrutiḥ smṛtiśca sarvaśākhoktamārgeṇa brahma jñātavyamityarthaṃ| darśayati jñāpayatītyarthaḥ || evaṃca sarvaiśca vedairiti sarvānvedāniti ca śrutismṛtyorbhagavataḥ sarvaireva vedairna tvalpavedairjijñāsyatvena viṣṇumaparokṣato jñātuṃ mumukṣoḥ sarvavedānāṃ śravaṇamananādinā jñātavyatvasyoktatvāt| ato bhagavatjñānārthaṃ sarvavedoktaṃ jñeyamiti sarvopādeyaṃ śāstramiti siddhaṃ || || iti sarvavedādhikaraṇaṃ || atra jñānārthaṃ sārvatrikaguṇopasaṃhāraḥ samarthyate| <3-3-6> || upasaṃhāro'rthābhedādvidhiśeṣatvasamāne ca || nanvīśvaraḥ sarvavedoktaguṇopasaṃhāreṇa jñeya eva| na tu dhyātavyaḥ| aśakyatvāt| anaṃtavedoditānaṃtaguṇānāṃ svabhujavadyugapadvuddhāvāroharūpopasaṃhārasyāśakyatvena tatpūrvakopāsanasyāpyaśakyatvāt| tataśca tadarthamāpādyaṃ sarvajñānaṃ vyarthamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || upasaṃhāro'rthabhedādvidhiśeṣatvasamāne ceti || asyārthaḥ || vidhiśeṣavat vidhivihitasyeva| yathā vidhivihitatvātsaṃdhyāvaṃdanādikamavaśyaṃ kartavyaṃ tathā| arthābhedāt| bhedo vibhāgaḥ| sarvavedārthabhūtānāmānaṃdādiguṇānāmaṇhatapāpmatvādidoṣābhāvānāṃ cābhedāt avibhāgāt| tānavibhajyeti yāvat| upasaṃhāraḥ sarvaguṇānāmapyekabudhyārohaṇarūpopasaṃhāraḥ| upāsya eka iti śrutau vihitatvātkartavyaḥ| so'pi samāne ca samānaviṣaya eva| ye brahmaṇi yogyāḥ pūrṇatvāvirodhino guṇāḥ| tadviṣaya eva| na tvayogyarodanādau| tathā satyanarthaprāpterityarthaḥ || evaṃca sarvavedārthānāmānaṃdādiguṇānāmapahatapāpmatvādidoṣābhāvānāṃ ca keṣāṃcidupasaṃhāraḥ keṣāṃcinneti vibhāgamakṛtvopasaṃhāreṇa paramātmā dhyātavyaḥ| sarve guṇā eva hyupāsyā iti vihitatvāt| anyathā vihitasaṃdhyāvaṃdanādyakaraṇe pratyavāyaḥ syāt| api ca tātparyaviṣayībhūtā dharmā evopāsyā natvatātparyaviṣayībhūtāḥ| so'rodīdityādinā pratītā rodanādayo duḥkhakāryāṇāṃ teṣāṃ parameśvare'yogāt| ayogyopāsanasyānarthahetutvāt| ataḥ sarvaguṇopasaṃhārasya kartavyatvātsārthakameva sarvaparijñānamiti siddhaṃ || <3-3-7> || anyathātvaṃ ca śabdāditi cennāviśeṣāt || nanvātmetyevopāsīteti guṇāṃtaropasaṃhāraniṣedhenātmatvamātropāsanasya vihitatvāt| sarvaguṇopasaṃhāre vihitakriyālopaprasaṃga iti prāpte sūtramāha || || anyathātvaṃ ca śabdāditi cennāviśeṣāditi || asyārthaḥ || anyathātvaṃ sarvaguṇopasaṃhāraḥ kārya ityuktasyānyathābhāvaḥ| tasyākartavyatvamevāvaśyamaṃgīkāryaṃ| kutaḥ| śabdāt ātmetyevopāsītetyanupasaṃhāra śruteriti cenna| aviśeṣāt ete guṇā nopasaṃhāryā iti viśeṣapramāṇābhāvāt| sarvairguṇairityaviśeṣeṇopasaṃhāre tu viśeṣapramāṇasadbhāvāccetyarthaḥ| ātmetyevetyevakārastvayoga vyavacchedaga iti bhāvaḥ || evaṃcaite guṇā nopasaṃhartavyā iti pramāṇābhāvāt| sarvairguṇaireka eveśitopāsitavyo na tu doṣaiḥ kathaṃciditi viśeṣavacanācca| niravakāśaitacchrutivirodhādevātmetyevopāsītetyavadhāraṇasyānātmatvarūpadoṣavyavacchedakatvameva na tu guṇāṃtaravyavacchedakatvamiti tadapi nānupasaṃhāre pramāṇaṃ ataḥ sarvaguṇopasaṃhāraḥ kartavya iti siddhaṃ || <3-3-8> || na vā prakaraṇabhedātparovarīyastvādivat || nanu nāyaṃ sarvaguṇopasaṃhāro yukto'śakyatvādityāśaṃkāmabhyupagamavādena pariharan na veti sūtramupasaṃhāraḥ kāryaittyetayoranuvṛtyadhyāhārābhyāṃ vyācaṣṭe || || na vā prakaraṇabhedātparovarīyastvādivaditi || asyārthaḥ || parovarīyastvādivat yathā sa eṣa ityuktānāṃ niravadhikasarvottamatvarūpaparovarīyastvādiguṇānāmevopāsanārthamupasaṃhāro na sarvaguṇānāṃ| tadvatsarvaguṇopasaṃhāro na kartavyo vā| kutaḥ| prakaraṇabhedāt parovarīyo vaiśvānarādiprakāraṇabhedāt| anyathā tanna syādityarthaḥ || evaṃcāstvanupasaṃhāra eva sarvaguṇānāṃ| prakaraṇabhedāt| anyathā prakaraṇāni na bhidyeran| sarvāṇyapi prakaraṇānyupalakṣaṇatayā sarvaguṇaparāṇīti sarvopasaṃhṛtiḥ kāryaiveti na maṃtavyaṃ| parovarīyastvādiprakaraṇasya śrūyamāṇaguṇamātraparatvāt| anyataikenaiva śabdena sarvaguṇopalakṣaṇasaṃbhavenodgīthādiśabdavaiyarthyaṃ syāt| ata uktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <3-3-9> || saṃjñātaścettaduktamasti tu tadapi || nanu kartavya eva sarvaguṇopasaṃhāraḥ| sarvavedānāṃ bhagavannāmatvena guṇābhidhāyitvāt| guṇābhidhānasyaiva dhyānārthatvāditi prāpte pariharatsūtramāha || || saṃjñātaścettaduktamasti tu tadapīti || asyārthaḥ || saṃjñātaḥ sarvavidyānāṃ bhagavannāmatvena tadguṇoktirūpatvāt| sarvavidyoktaguṇopasaṃhāraḥ kārya iti cet| taduktaṃ tatra codye tadiṣṭameveti samādhānaṃ tenopasaṃhārasūtreṇoktamityarthaḥ || na kevalaṃ yuktisiddhametat| kiṃtu tadapi tasminnarthe nāma vā etā iti pramāṇamapyasti| tu astyevetyarthaḥ || evaṃ cāstu| asmābhirapi sarvaguṇopasaṃhārasyoktatveneṣṭatvāt| nāma veti kauṃḍinyaśrutau vihitatvena prāmāṇikavācca| ataḥ sarvaguṇopasaṃhārasya kartavyatvātsārthakameva sarvaparijñānamiti siddhaṃ || || iti upasaṃhārādhikaraṇaṃ || atra prāguktopasaṃhārānupasaṃhārayoḥ puruṣabhedena kartavyatvaṃ samarthyate| <3-3-10> || prāpteśca saṃmajasaṃ || nanu na yuktau prāguktopasaṃhārānupasaṃhārau| virodhāt| viruddhayoryugapadanuṣṭhānamekena na saṃbhavati| na cādhikāribhedādubhayopapattiḥ| niyāmakābhāvāditi prāpte sūtramāha || || prāpteśca samaṃjasamiti || asyārthaḥ || upasaṃhārānupasaṃhārayoḥ kartavyatvaṃ| samaṃjasaṃ yuktaṃ| kutaḥ| prāpteḥ tattadyogyapuruṣabhedena tayorvyavasthitatvādavirodhaprāpteścetyarthaḥ || evaṃcopapannāvevopasaṃhārānupasaṃhārau| yasya yugapatsvabhujāviva yāvaṃto guṇā spaṣṭaṃ pratibhāsaṃte| rudrādīnāṃ tu tattadyogyatānusāreṇeti vivekaḥ| atastayoḥ sāmaṃjasyādyuktaṃ pūrvoktamiti siddhaṃ || || iti prāptyīdhakaraṇaṃ || atra bahuguṇopasaṃhārasya phalātiśayoktyā kartavyatā samarthyate || <3-3-11> || sarvābhedādanyatreme || nanu na bahuguṇopasaṃhāraḥ kartavyaḥ| upāsanātāratamyānusāriphalatāratamye pramāṇābhāvāditi prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati || || sarvābhedādanyatreṇe iti || asyārthaḥ || ime sarvaguṇopasaṃhārakartṛbrahmādayaḥ| anyatra tadanupasaṃhartṛbhyo'nyatra| tatphalavilakṣaṇamahāphale bhavaṃti tadbhājo bhavaṃti| kutaḥ| sarvābhedāt| sarvavedoktaguṇānāṃ avibhāgenopasahaṃrtṛtvenopāsanādityarthaḥ || evaṃca kartavya eva bahuguṇopasaṃhāraḥ| sādhanatāratamye phalatāratamyaniyamāt| vedoktamahopāsanavatāmatiśayaphalābhāvāyogāt| ato bahuguṇopasaṃhāraḥ kartavya iti siddhaṃ || || iti sarvābhedādhikaraṇaṃ || atra sarvamumukṣusādhāraṇopāsyaguṇā nirṇīyaṃte| <3-3-12> || ānaṃdādayaḥ pradhānasya || nanu na saṃtyeva sādhāraṇatayopāsyā guṇāḥ klṛptāḥ| niyāmakābhāvāt| tataśca klṛptyabhāvena prāthamikopāsanāsaṃbhavāt| upāsanāmātrāsaṃbhava iti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || ānaṃdādayaḥ pradhānasyeti || asyārthaḥ || ānaṃdādayaḥ ānaṃdo jñānaṃ sacchabdoditaṃ nirdoṣatvaṃ ātmapadoditasvāmitvamityete catvāro guṇāḥ| pradhānasya mokṣasyārthe sarvamumukṣubhiḥ upāsyā ityarthaḥ || evaṃca klṛptā eva sarvamumukṣūpāsyā guṇāḥ| sarveṣāṃ muktāvānaṃdajñānaduḥkhābhāvānāmapekṣitatvāt| tatsiddhaye tattvavidā tāvadupāsyāḥ| yattvātmatvāparyāyaṃ svāmitvaṃ svayaṃ baṃdhānusmaraṇasya bhagavatprītisādhanatvāttadapyupāsyaṃ| evaṃca prāthamikopāsyanirṇayātsarvāpyupāsanā yuktaiveti siddhaṃ || || iti ānaṃdādhikaraṇaṃ || atra brahmopāsane priyaśirastvādiguṇānāṃ sarvādhikārisādhāraṇyanirāsena sarveṣāṃ caturguṇaniyamaḥ samarthyate| <3-3-13> || priyaśirastvādyaprāptirupacayāpacayau hi bhede || nanu priyaśirastvādayo'pi sarvopāsyāḥ| ānaṃdādighaṭitatvāt| anyathā''naṃdādeḥ samyaganupāsitatvena mokṣāsiddhiḥ syāt| tataśca catvāra eva guṇāḥ sarvopāsyā ityayuktamiti prāpte sūtramupanyasyati || || priyaśirastvādyaprāptirupavayāpacayau hi bheda iti || asyārthaḥ || sarveṣāmadhikāriṇāṃ| priyaśirastvādyaprāptiḥ| tasya priyameva śira ityādi śrutyukta priyaśirastvādiguṇopāsanayogyatā nāsti| kiṃtu keṣāṃcideva| kutaḥ| hi yasmāt| teṣāṃ bhede phalabhede phalatāratamye hi prasiddhā| naiva sarveti smṛtirasti| yasmācca bhede phalabhedasitdhyarthaṃ upacayāpacayau upāsane vṛddhihrāsau| tāratamyamiti yāvat apekṣitau tasmādityarthaḥ || evaṃca na priyaśirastvādayaḥ sarvopāsyāḥ| ānaṃdādiviśeṣatvāvalaṃbanena teṣāmupāsane sarveṣāṃ sarvaguṇopāstiprasaṃgāt| sarvaguṇānāmapyānaṃdādicatuṣṭayaviśeṣatvasya vaktuṃ śakyatvāt| na ca priyaśirastvādyanupāsane mokṣābhāvaḥ| yathā yogyān guṇapūgāniti śruterviśeṣānupāsane'pi yogyaguṇopāsanāmātreṇa phalaprāptisaṃbhavāt| ataḥ priyaśirastvādīnāmasādhāraṇyāccatvāra eva sarvopāsyā iti siddhaṃ || || iti priyaśirastvādhikaraṇaṃ || atra devagaṃdharvaparyaṃtānāṃ brahmavāṇītaradevādīnāṃ priyaśirastvādibahugumopāsanaṃ samarthyate| <3-3-14> || itare tvarthasāmānyāt || nanu viriṃcetaradevatādibhiścatvāra eva guṇā upāsyā nādhikāḥ| sarvamumukṣuṇā caturguṇopāsanayogyatāyā nirṇītatvāt| adhikasyānirṇayāt| ato madhyamaguṇānāmanupāsyatvāt| tadupasaṃhārānupapattiriti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || itare tvarthasāmānyāditi || asyārthaḥ || tu śabda evārthe| arthasāmānyāt| lyab‌lopanimittāṃ paṃcamī| upāsanasya svasvaprāpyaphalasāmyamapekṣya itare caturbhyaḥ sarvebhyaścetare madhyamāḥ guṇāḥ devādibhirupasahartavyā evetyarthaḥ || evaṃca caturguṇādhikā guṇā devādibhirupāsyā eva| tadapekṣitaprāpyaphalanirṇayaṃ prathamataḥ kṛtvā paścātsādhananirṇayaṃ vidhāya brahmaṇo'nyasya vā sarvajñasya gurorupadeśena yogyatānirṇayopapatteḥ| ato madhyamaguṇānāmapi devādyupāsyatvādyuktaṃ tadupasaṃhārābhidhānamiti siddhaṃ || || ici itarādhikaraṇaṃ || atra sarvaguṇopasaṃhārānupasaṃhārayoḥ kartavyatve pramāṇamucyate| <3-3-15> || ādhyānāya prayojanābhāvāt || nanu na sarvaguṇopasaṃhāro kartavyaḥ| pramāṇābhāvāt| anupasaṃhāriṇāmapi caturguṇopāsakānāṃ mokṣasya jāyamānatvenaikaḥ parata iti śrutyavirodhāt| vyabicāriṇaśca sādhanatvāyogena asādhanaṃ| sādhanatayā pratipādayato vākyasyāprāmāṇyāt| na ca sarvavidyānāṃ bhagavadguṇābhidhāyakatvena tadupasaṃhāraḥ kartavya iti vācyaṃ| guṇānāṃ nānāsthāneṣūktatvena tadabhidhānasyopasaṃhārārthatvābhāvenopasaṃhārasya niṣphalatvena bhagavadguṇābhidhānasya tadarthatvāyotatrāprāmāṇyāt| tathā ca nopāsanaṃ yuktamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || ādhyānāya prayojanābhāvāditi || asyārtha || vedeṣu sarvaguṇoktirupasaṃhāraśca ādhyānāya samyagjñānadhyānārthaṃ| klṛpto bhavet| kutaḥ| prayojanābhāvāt| guṇoktestadupasaṃhārasyaca dhyānaṃvinā prayojanābhāvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca kartavya evopasaṃhāraḥ| sarvavidyānāṃ bhagavannāmatvena tadguṇābhidhāyakatvāt| tasya ca prayojanāṃtarābhāvenopasaṃhārapūrvakādhyānārthatvāt| na copasaṃhāro niṣphalaḥ| ānaṃdātiśayalakṣaṇaphalasadbhāvāt| tathā ca viriṃcetaraiḥ katipayaguṇānupasaṃhāreṇa katipayaguṇopasaṃhāraḥ kāryaḥ| ātmetyevopāsīte tyādyanupasaṃhārapramāṇasya vidyamānatvāt| ata upāsanaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <3-3-16> || ātmaśabdācca || evaṃ sarvaguṇopasaṃhāraṃ pramāṇena samarthyānupasaṃhāraṃ ca samarthayatsūtramupanyasyati || || ātmaśabdācceti || asyārthaḥ || ātmetyevopāsītetyatrātmeti bhāvapradhānaṃ sāvadhāraṇaṃ ca| ātmatvamātropāstividhāyakaḥ śabda ātmaśabdaḥ| ātmetyevopāsīteti śabdaḥ| tasmādguṇāṃtaravyāvṛttipūrvamātmatvopāstividhāyakaśabdādanupasaṃhāraśca sidhyatīti cārthaḥ || evaṃcopāsanākṣiptālpaguṇopasaṃhāre nirdiṣṭaśruteḥ pramāṇatvāt| anyathā guṇāṃtaravyāvṛttipūrvakamātmātvopāsanasyaivātra vidhānādasaṃgateḥ| na cāvadhāraṇasyānyathātvamiti sūtre'yogavyavacchedakatvasyoktatvātkathamanyayogavyavacchedakatvamucyata iti vācyaṃ| upasaṃhārānupasaṃhāravad‌brahmādīn uttamādhikāriṇaḥ pratyayogavyavacchedakatvamadhamādhikāriṇaḥ pratyanyayogavyavacchedakatvamityadhikāribhedenāvirodhakatvāt| ata upasaṃhārānupasaṃhārayoḥ kartavyatvādupāsanaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || || iti ādhyānādhikaraṇaṃ || atropāsanāyāmānaṃdādicaturguṇaniyamaḥ samarthyate| <3-3-17> || ātmagṛhītiritaravaduttarāt || nanvātmatvameva sarvopāsyaṃ nānaṃdādayaścatvāraḥ| ātmetyeveti sāvadhāraṇavacanāt| itaraguṇahānenātmatvamātropāsanasya suśakatvāt| śoghreṇeśvarāparokṣyasiddhiguṇalābhācca| ata ātmatvasyaiva sarvopāsyatvādānaṃdādayaḥ pradhānasyetyuktamayuktaṃ cedityāsaṃkāṃ pāreratsūtraṃ paṭhati || || ātmagṛhītiritaravaduttarāditi || asyārthaḥ || yataḥ itaravat satyaṃ jñānādi vākye satyādipadairanyeṣāṃ guṇānāmivātmagṛhītiḥ ātmaiveti vākyepyātmaśabdena caturṇāṃ guṇānāṃ grahaṇaṃ saṃbhavati| kutaḥ| uttarāt atrahyeta ityuttaravākyācca| ato na caturguṇopāstyuktestadvirodha ityarthaḥ || evāṃcānaṃdādayaścatvāro'pyupāsyā eva| ātmaśabdasya satyādiśabdavadatra hyete sarva ityuttaravākyabalādbavharthakatvenānaṃdādyabhidhāyakatvāt| ato virodhābhāvāduktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || || iti ātmagṛhītyadhikaraṇaṃ || atrātmaśabdasya pūrvoktamanupasaṃhāramānatvamākṣipya samādhīyate| <3-3-18> || anvayāditi cetsyādavadhāraṇāt || nanu sarvopāsyā guṇāḥ| nāsādhāraṇyenātmaśabdoktāḥ| tasya sarvaguṇābhidhāyakatvāt| tataśca nāsyānupasaṃhārapramāṇatvamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || anvayāditi cetsyādavadhāraṇāditi || asyārthaḥ || nanvātmeti vākyasyānupasaṃhāramānatvamayuktaṃ| kutaḥ| anvayāt| ātmaśabde sarvaguṇānāmanvayāt| iti cet syāt yatparoktaṃ tattathāsyādeva| tathā'pi nānupapattiḥ| kutaḥ| avadhāraṇāt ātmetyevetyavadhāraṇāt| na cānirṇayaḥ| ātmaśabdo hi brahmādīnpratyeva sarvaguṇānvadati nānyānpratīti nirṇayopapatterityarthaḥ || evaṃca satyamātmaśabdaḥ sarvaguṇābhidhāyakaḥ| tathā'pi na sarvanprati| kiṃ nāma tattadyogyatānusāreṇa tāṃstānprati guṇābhidhāyakaḥ| tataścātmaśabdena yasya yāvaṃto guṇāḥ pratibhāsaṃte tena tāvaṃto guṇā upāsyā ityāmaśabdokta guṇānāṃ sarvopāsyatvāduktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || || iti anvayādhikaraṇaṃ || atrālaukikaguṇānāmevopasaṃhāryatvaṃ samarthyate| <3-3-19> || kāryākhyānādapūrvaṃ || nanu bhagavadguṇā laukikatvenaiva dhyātavyāḥ| anyathā'laukikānāmananubhūtatvāt| vāsanābhāvena smṛtirūpadhyānātrabhāvaprasaṃgāt| kartavyaṃ ca dhyānaṃ| ato laukikā eva bhagavadguṇā iti prāpte sūtramāha || || kāryākhyānādapūrvamiti || asyārthaḥ || kāryākhyānāt dhyānakāryasya mokṣasyālaukikatvokteḥ| apūrvaṃ alaukikaṃ guṇajātaṃ| dhyātavyamityarthaḥ || evaṃcālaukikā eva bhagavadguṇā dhyātavyāḥ| tatdhyānakāryasya mokṣasyālaukikatvāt| na cālaukikaguṇāpratītestatdhyānābhāvaprasaṃgaḥ| lakṣaṇamukheneṃdrādirivopadeśena tatpratītyupapatteḥ| ato'laukikā eva dhyātavyā iti yuktaṃ pūrvoktaṃ bhagavadguṇānāmalaukikatvamiti siddhaṃ || || iti kāryādhikaraṇaṃ || atropāsanasya svasadṛśaphalapradatvasidhyarthaṃ brahmāṇībrahmaṇorupāsanasya samaviṣamatvaṃ samarthyate| <3-3-20> || samāna evaṃ cābhedāt || nanu bhagavadupāsanaṃ na svānusāriphalapradasvabhāvaṃ| brahmāṇībrahmopāsane svānusāriphalajanakatvābhāvāt| na hi yajjātīyaṃ yajjanakaṃ na bhavati tajjātīyaṃ tajjanakasvabhāvavaditi kyate vaktuṃ| vetrabījasya kadalīkāṃḍajananasvābhāvyāpātāt| na ca hetoḥ samucitadeśasidhyabhāvaḥ saṃkanīyaḥ| tayorhyupāsanaṃ samaṃ viṣamaṃ vā bhavet| na tu samaviṣamaṃ| viruddhatvāt| phalaṃ tu samaviṣamaṃ| sthānasāmye'pi guṇatāratamyasadbhāvāt| ata upāsanānusāriphalaniyamābhāvāditaretvarthasāmānyādityuktamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || samāna evaṃ cābhedāditi || asyārthaḥ || evaṃ ca evamapi| brahmaguṇānāmalaukikatve'pi| vāṇyāḥ samāne yogyaguṇaviṣaya evopasaṃhāraḥ na tvayogyakriyāsu| tatratvabhedāt abhedamapekṣya trivikramatvādikādācitkakriyāstatsajātīyanityavikrāṃtyādiṣvaṃtarbhāvyopasaṃhāro bhave dityarthaḥ || evaṃcopāsanaṃ svānusāriphalapradameva| brahmāṇībrahmaṇorupāsanatvasya samaviṣamatvena tayorupāsanānusāriphalasyaivabhāvāt| tathā ca yathopāsanaṃ muktau phalasadbhāvāduktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <3-3-21> || saṃbaṃdhādevamanyatrāpi || nanu na viriṃcasyāpi sadā trivikamatvādiviśeṣakriyopasaṃhāro yujyate| tāsāmanityatvena dhyānakāle'bhāvādityāśaṃkāṃ parākurvaṃtsūtramāha || || saṃbaṃdhādevamanyatrāpīti || asyārthaḥ || hiraṇyagarbhasya tu anyatrāpi trivikramatvādikriyāviśeṣe'pi| evaṃ sarvadopasaṃhāro yujyate| kutaḥ| saṃbaṃdhāt kriyāṇāṃ brahmaṇā tādātmyarūpasaṃbaṃdhena nityatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca brahmāṇī hi brahmavatsarvānguṇānupasaṃhṛtyevopāste| trivikramādīṃstu nityavikrāṃtyādikriyāsvaṃtarbhāvyaiva na tu pṛthak| yogyatāvirahāt| brahmā tu trivikramādīṃstu sadopasaṃhṛtyopāste| trivikramatvādirapi brahmasvarūpatvānnitya eva| ato yathopāsanaṃ muktau phalasadbhāvāduktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || || iti samānādhikaraṇaṃ || atrātmaśabdoktaguṇopāsanasya sarvaiḥ kartavyatvaṃ samarthyate| <3-3-22> || na vā viśeṣāt || nanu nātmetyevopāsīteti vidhiḥ sarvādhikārisādhāraṇaḥ| anaṃtaguṇābhidhāyakātmaśabdaghaṭitatvāt| na cātmaśabdasyottamānprati sarvaguṇābhidhāyakatve'pi taditarānprati tadabhāvena tattadyogyaguṇābhidhāyakatvāditi sarvasādhāraṇamupapannamiti vācyaṃ| asaṃbhavāt| na hi śabdo buddhimān| yenottamatvādhikāriviśeṣaṃ prati sarvaguṇānbodhayitvā'nuttamatvādaparaṃ pratyalpāneva bodhayatīti syāt| tataścānupasaṃhārapramāṇatvoktirayukteti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || na vā viśeṣāditi || asyārthaḥ || ātmeti vākyasthātmaśabdena sarvaguṇānāṃ grahaṇaṃ na vā'bhyupagamyate| kutaḥ| viśeṣāt adhikāriyogyatāviśeṣamapekṣya tasya tadyogyaguṇābhidhāyakatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca vidhirayaṃ sarvādhikārisādhāraṇaḥ| tāṃstānprati tattadyogyaguṇābhidhāyakatvāt| na cāsaṃbhavaḥ| adhikāramapekṣya tattvamasyādivākyasya pramā'pramājanakatvavatsarvaguṇābhidhāyakasyāpyātmaśabdasya tadyogyatāmapekṣyaiva guṇabodhakatvasaṃbhavāt| tasmādātmaśabdoktasarvaguṇānāṃ sarvopāsyatvamiti siddhaṃ || <3-3-23> || darśayati ca || nanu caturguṇopāsakasyāpyātmaśabdātpaṃcaguṇānamapyevaṃ bodhasaṃbhavena na prātisvikaniyamāyogāt| upāsanānupapattiriti prāpte viśeṣāditi yuktisiddhārthaṃ śrutyā'pi samarthayatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || darśayati ceti || asyārthaḥ || sarvāniti śrutiḥ svoktārthaṃ pratipādayatītyarthaḥ || evaṃca yasya yugapatsvabhujāvivātmaśabdena yāvaṃto guṇāḥ pratīyaṃte tāvaṃta evopāsyā iti niyamasaṃbhavāt| sarvān guṇāniti śruteḥ| tasmādātmaśabdoktaguṇānāṃ sarvopāsyatvāduktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || || iti na vā'dhikaraṇaṃ || atra saṃbhṛtyādiguṇasya sarvopāsyatvaṃ netyucyate| <3-3-24> || saṃbhṛtidyuvyāptyapi cātaḥ || nanu saṃbhṛtidyuvyāptī sarveṣāṃ manuṣyādīnāmupāsye mumukṣutvāt devādivat| tatphalayoḥ svādhamaphalabharaṇaprakāśavyāptyorbhāvyatvāt| na caivaṃ sarvaguṇopāstiprasaṃgaḥ| tatphalānicchutvāt| tataśca caturguṇopāsananiyamabhaṃga iti || yadvā || devādayo na saṃbhṛtidyuvyāptyupāsanāyogyāḥ| pramāṇābhāvāt| na ca mumukṣutvāttadupāsanādhikārasiddhiriti vācyaṃ| yadi mumukṣutvāddevāḥ saṃbhṛtyādyupāsanādhikāriṇaḥ syustarhi manuṣyā api tathā syuraviśeṣāditi tarkabādhāt| ata eva na tatphalecchutvāddevānāmadhikārasiddhiḥ| tataśca devānāṃ manuṣyebhyo'tiśayāsiddhiriti| evaṃ pūrvapakṣadvikaprāpte samādadhatsūtramāha || || saṃbhṛti dyuvyāptyapi cāta iti || asyārthaḥ || api padena nañaḥ samākarṣaḥ| ca śabda evārthaḥ| saṃbhṛtidyuvyāptī samyagbharaṇaprakāśavyāptī| na sarvasyopāsye| kiṃtu devādyupāsye eva| kutaḥ| ata evādhikāriyogyatāyāṃ viśeṣasadbhāvādevetyarthaḥ || evaṃca saṃbhṛtidyuvyāptī na sarvopāsye| manuṣyāṇāṃ tata upāsanāyogyatāvirahāt| na ca muktāvapekṣitaprakāśādyasiddhiḥ| bhagavadrūpapratītiviṣayīkṛtaprakāśādinaiva tatsiddheḥ| tataśca noktacaturguṇopāsananiyamabhaṃgaḥ || yadvā || devādayaḥ saṃbhṛtādyupāsanāvaṃtaḥ| devādhikāre'nyādhikārādviśeṣasadbhāvāt| devādīnāmupāsyāstu saṃbhṛtidyupāsanāsadbhāvānnātiśayabhaṃga iti siddhāṃtadvayamuktaṃ bhavati || || iti saṃbhṛtyadhikaraṇaṃ || atra sarvavidyāto guṇopasaṃhāraḥ kartavya iti sādhyate| <3-3-25> || puruṣavidyāyāmapi cetareṣāmanāmnānāt || nanu na viprakīrṇaguṇopasaṃhṛtiḥ kāryā| prayojanābhāvāt| na ca svayogyaguṇopāsanāyopasaṃhṛtiriti vācyaṃ| uttamānāṃ bahuguṇābidāyakaikavidyoktaguṇopasaṃhāramātreṇa maṃdānāmalpaguṇābhidhāyakaikavidyoktaguṇopasaṃhāramātreṇaiva tatsiddheḥ| ata upasaṃhāravaiyarthyānna sarvajñānopayoga iti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || puruṣavidyāyāmapi cetareṣāmanānmānāditi || asyārthaḥ || puruṣavidyāyāmapi sarvavidyottamatvena pratijñātāyāmapi| puruṣasūktākhyavidyāyāṃ keṣāṃcidevoktatvāditareṣāṃ tatroktebhyo'nyeṣāṃ ca guṇānāmanāmnānāt| kartavya eva sarvavidyāguṇopasaṃhāra ityarthaḥ || evaṃca kāryā eva viprakīrṇaguṇopasaṃhṛtiḥ| sarvaguṇopāsakānāmuttamānāṃ bhāvāt| sarvottamāyāmapi puruṣasūktākhyavidyāyāṃ sarvaguṇānāmanāmnānāt| maṃdāpekṣitanāmapyekatroktiniyamābhāvācca| ato sarvato guṇopasaṃhārasya kartavyatvāduktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || || iti puruṣādhikaraṇaṃ || atra bhedanādiguṇānāṃ sarvopāsyatvaṃ nirasyate| <3-3-26> || vedhādyarthabhedāt || nanvagne tvacaṃ yātudhānasya bhiṃdhītyādinoktā bhedanādiguṇāḥ sarvopāsyāḥ| tatphalasya duṣṭanigrahasya sarvāpekṣitatvāt| ato vedhādīnāṃ sarvopāsyatvānna caturguṇopāsananiyama iti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || vedhādyarthabhedāditi || asyārthaḥ || arthabhedāt vedhādyupāsaphalasya hiṃsāderyatyādiyogyaphalādvilakṣaṇatvāt vedhādi bhiṃdhi vitvi śṛṇīhītyuktavedhādikaṃ na sarvopāsyamityarthaḥ || evaṃca navedhādayaḥ sarvopāsyāḥ| tatphale bhedanādau yatyādīnāmanadhikārāt| ato vedhādīnāṃ sarvopāsyatvābhāvānnābhihitaniyamo bhajyata iti siddhaṃ || || iti vedhādhikaraṇaṃ || atropāsanasya muktāvapyanuvṛttiḥ samarthyate| <3-3-27> || hānau tūpāyanaśabdaśeṣatvātkuśācchaṃdastutyupagānavattaduktaṃ || nanu na muktenopāsanā kriyate| muktasyopāsanavidhyaṃgīkāre phalaprāptiprasaṃgāt| muktatvābhāvaprasaṃgācca| tadanaṃgīkāre ca prāptavyaphalaprasaṃgāt| prāptavyamaṃtarāpekṣāvatpravṛtyanupapatteḥ| tataśca sopādhikamevopāsanamiti muktisādhanatvādevopāsanaṃ kāryaṃ na tūpāsane ādarātiśaya iti prāpte sūtramāha || || hānau tūpāyanaśabdaśeṣatvātkuśācchaṃdastyutyupagānavattaduktamiti || asyārthāḥ || turavadhāraṇe yataḥ hānau baṃdhahānirūpamuktau| taduktaṃ muktānāmetatsāmeti śrutā vupāsanamuktaṃ| ato mokṣe'pi teṣāmupāsanamastyeva| tadapi kaśācchaṃdastutyupagānavadeva na vidhitaḥ| yathā niyatabrahmayajñānāṃ niyatasaṃdhyopāsanānaṃtaramapi kuśairācchaṃdena svecchayaiva stutyupagāna ivobhayatra nāmnoradhyayanaṃ| tathā svecchayaiva na vidhitaḥ| kutaḥ| upāyanaśabdaśeṣatvāt| upāyanaṃ mokṣaḥ| upāsanavidhīnāṃ mokṣavākyaśeṣatvādityarthaḥ| tathā ca mokṣārthopāsanāvidhayaḥ kathaṃ tatrāpi tā vidadhyurityarthaḥ || evaṃcānuṣṭheyameva muktāvupāsanaṃ| etatsāmeti vacanāt| na ca vidhibaddhatvena saṃsārasamānadharmatvaṃ mukteḥ| vinā'pi vidhiṃ svecchayaivopāsanamityaṃgīkārāt| dṛśyate ca niyatabrahmayajñaśabdasvādhyāyānaṃtaramapi svecchayaiva kuśairācchādanenaiva dvijanmanāmadhyayanādi| ata uktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <3-3-28> || sāṃparāye tartavyābhāvāttathā hyanye || nanu muktasyopāsanaṃ na svecchayā kiṃtu mokṣe tadā tadā prāptāniṣṭaparihārārthameva| kasyāpi niṣphalapravṛtteradarśanādityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || sāṃparāye tartavyābhāvāttathā hyanya iti || asyārthaḥ || sāṃparāye mokṣe| upāsanaṃ svecchayaivetyaṃgīkāryaṃ| natvaniṣṭanivṛttyarthaṃ| kutaḥ| tartavyābhāvāt| muktaiḥ parihartavyāniṣṭasyaivābhāvāt| tadapi kutaḥ| hi yasmāt| anye śākinaḥ tathā tīrṇohīti śrutiṃ paṭhaṃti| tasmādityarthaḥ || evaṃca sāṃparāye tartavyābhāvāt| api ca muktairyogādyapyanuṣṭhīyate| kimutopāsanaṃ| kṛṣṇau muktairiti bhāratavacanāt| ato muktāvapyupāsanānuvṛttairnirūpādhikaṃ tatsaṃsāre kartavyamiti siddhaṃ || || iti hānyadhikaraṇaṃ || atra muktānāṃ karmaṇi niyamābhāvaḥ samarthyate| <3-3-29> || chaṃdata ubhayāvirodhāt || nanu muktā niyamenānuṣṭhānavaṃtaḥ| viṣṇupūjātmakatvātkarmaṇi śaktatvācca teṣāṃ| anyathā niyamenopāsanamapi na te kuryuḥ| aviśeṣāt| ato muktānāṃ karmopāsanayoḥ sāmyātprāk na karmaṇo'tiśayopāsanaṃ kāryamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || chaṃdata ubhayāvirodhāditi || asyārthaḥ || muktāḥ chaṃdataḥ svecchāmanusṛtyaiva karma kurvaṃti na vidhitaḥ| kutaḥ| ubhayāvirodhāt| karmakaraṇākaraṇayoḥ vidhibaṃdhapratyavāyayoḥ abhāvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca na muktānāṃ karmaṇi niyamaḥ| api tu svecchayā kadācitkurvaṃti kadācinna kurvaṃti| niyamenānuṣṭhānaprayojakayorvidhibaṃdhapratyavāyayorābhāvāt| ato muktasya karmaniyamābhāvātsaṃsārepyupāsanamādhikyena kartavyamiti siddhaṃ || <3-3-30> || gaterarthavattvamubhayathā'nyathā hi virodhaḥ || nanu muktānāṃ vidhibaṃdhapratyavāyābhāva eva kuto yena karmaṇyaniyama ityataḥ samādadhatsūtramāha || || gaterarthavattvamubhayathā'nyathā hi virodha iti || asyārthaḥ || hirhetau| ubhayathā hi baṃdhapratyavāyayorabhāvādeva| gateḥ mukteḥ| puruṣārthatvaṃ| anyathā muktau baṃdhapratyavāyayorbhāve| virodhaḥ mukteḥ saṃsārasamatvenāpuruṣārthatvarūpavirodhaḥ syādityarthaḥ || evaṃca mukteḥ karmaniyamābhāvāṃgīkāra eva mukteḥ puruṣārthatvādanyathā tanna syāt| ataḥ saṃsārepyupāsanamādhikyena kāryamiti siddhaṃ || <3-3-31> || upapannastallakṣaṇārthopalabdherlokavat || nanu vidhyādyabhāvo muktānāṃ karmaniyamasaṃbhāvanāyaiva bhavati| na tūpapādanāya| īśvarakarmaṇi vyabhicārāt| ata upapādakābhāvādanupapanna evāsau niyama iti prāpte sūtramāha || || upapannastallakṣaṇārthopalabdherlokavaditi || asyārthaḥ || yathā loke yāgāṃgaviṣṇukramaṇasya kriyānuṣṭhānaniyamaḥ na yāgasaṃpūrttyanaṃtaramapi asti| kiṃtu kadācideva| tathā muktānāṃ kadācitkarma kurvaṃti na vetyevaṃ tāvadupapannaḥ yuktaḥ| kuta etat| tallakṣaṇārthopalabdheḥ tallakṣaṇasya paraṃparayā karmasādhyasyārthasya mokṣasya| upalabdheḥ prāptatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃcopapanna eva svecchayā kadācitkarma kurvaṃti kadācinnetyevaṃ bhāvaḥ| tatphalasya mokṣasya prāptatvāt| tatphalasya ca prāptyanaṃtaramapravartakatvāt| yathā loke yāgapūrtilakṣaṇaphalasya yāgapūrtyanaṃtaraṃ viṣṇukramaṇādau na pravartakatvaṃ kiṃtvicchayaiva pravartakatvaṃ| atra prayogaḥ| muktā na karmānuṣṭhānaniyamavaṃtaḥ| viśeṣahetvabhāve sati prāptatatphalatvāt| yajamānavaditi| ato muktasya karmaniyamābhāvena saṃsārepyupāsanamādhikyena kāryamiti siddhaṃ || || iti chaṃdādhikaraṇaṃ || atropāsanotpannabrahmajñānānāṃ sarveṣāṃ mokṣanaiyatyaṃ sādhyate| <3-3-32> || aniyamaḥ sarveṣāmavirodācchabdānumānābhyāṃ || nanu na sarveṣāṃ jñānināṃ mokṣaḥ| keṣāṃcitjñānināṃ svottamadrohaśāpābhyāmayogyatotpādāt| na hyayogyānāṃ tatprāptiḥ saṃbhavati| tathā satyayogyānāmapi sarvaguṇopasaṃhāraprasaṃgāt| ataḥ sarveṣāṃ jñānināṃ mokṣābhāvena na niḥśaṃkopāsanaṃ kartavyamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || aniyamaḥ sarveṣāmavirodhācchabdānumānābhyāmiti || asyārthaḥ || aniyamaḥ aparokṣajñānināṃ madhye keṣāṃcinmokṣaḥ keṣāṃcinnetyevaṃrūpavyavasthā'bhāvo jñāyate| kutaḥ| sarveṣāmapi mokṣe| avirodhāt niṣedhakābhāvāt| kiṃca śabdānumānābhyāṃ na kaściditi śruteḥ tanmūlakānumānāccetyarthaḥ || evaṃcātsyeva sarveṣāṃ jñānināṃ mokṣaḥ| keṣāṃcideva mokṣo na sarveṣāmiti vadan praṣṭavyaḥ| kiṃ bādhakasadbhāvānna sarveṣāṃ mokṣa uta sādhakābhāvāt| nādyaḥ| tadabhāvāt| na cāyogyatotpādako bādhakaḥ| ye jñānaviṣayā iti vacanādayogyatotpādānaṃgīkārāt| na dvitīyaḥ| na kaściditi śrutivirodhāpatteḥ| vipratipannā jñānino mokṣavaṃtaḥ jñānitvātsaṃmatavadityanumānācca| bādhakābhāvena śrutimūlakatvena copasaṃhārānumānābādhāt| ato jñānināṃ mokṣasya niyatatvānniḥśaṃkamupāsanaṃ kāryamiti siddhaṃ || || iti aniyamādhikaraṇaṃ || atropāsane'dhikāraniyamaḥ samarthyate| <3-3-33> || yāvadadhikāramavasthitirādhikārikāṇāṃ || nanu nopāsanāvaṃto'dhikāraniyamavaṃtaḥ| pramāṇābhāvāt| na ca muktāvānaṃdatāratamyānyathānupapattiḥ pramāṇaṃ| tāratamyaprāmāṇikatvepyupāsanāprayatnatāratamyenaivānyathāsiddheḥ| ata upātsyadhikāraniyamābhāveneti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || yāvadadhikāramavasthitirādhikārikāṇāmiti || asyārthaḥ || ādhikārikāṇāṃ yogyatānusāryupāsanaśīlānāṃ brahmādīnāṃ svasvādhikārānusāreṇaiva muktau| avasthitiḥ avasthitānāmupāsanāvattāratamyenaiva muktau teṣāṃ phalamityarthaḥ || evaṃcātsyeva niyamaḥ| ayametadguṇopāsane yogyo'yaṃ neti tena vinā śrutyuktānaṃdatāratamyakathanasyāpyayogāt| prayatnatāratamyasyāpi yogyatātāratamyādhīnatvāt| adhikārādhiko yatna iti vacanāt| tataścopāsanādhikāre niyamāduktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <3-3-34> || akṣaradhiyāṃ tvavirodhaḥ sāmānyatadbhāvābhyāmaupasadavattaduktaṃ || nanu muktāvānaṃdatāratamyameva nopapadyate| asamatve muktānāṃ parasparavirodhaprāpteḥ| loke tathā darśanāt| tāratamyaśrutīnāṃ tu saṃsāraviṣayatvāt| tadaṃgīkāre muktau dveṣerṣyādiprasakteśca| ata upātsyadhikāraniyamābhāvena prāpteśca samaṃjasamityādyayuktamiti prāpte siddhāṃtitaṃ || || akṣaradhiyāṃ tvavirodhaḥ sāmānyatadbhāvābhyāmaupasadavattaduktamiti || asyārthaḥ || tu śabdo'pyarthaḥ| akṣaradhiyāṃ brahmajñānināṃ| viṣamatvepyavirodhaḥ virodho nāsti| kutaḥ| brahmadhītvāt| kiṃca sāmānyatadbhāvābhyāṃ sarveṣāṃ doṣābhāvāt uttamebhyaḥ adhamānāṃ upakārābhāvācca| kathaṃ| aupasadavat sacchiṣyavat| kiṃca taduktaṃ| tat asamatve'pi virodho nāstītyetannāneti turaśrutāvuktamato'pyavirodha ityarthaḥ || evaṃca virodhāprasaṃgāt| virodhe hi viṣayalaṃpaṭyāṃ mātsaryādayo'nupakāritvaṃ ca hetavaḥ| na ca mukteṣu saṃbhavaṃti| brahmadhītvāt| nirdoṣatvācca| anupakāritvamapi nāstīti pratiyogisatvasya pramāṇasiddhatvāt| tasmādupāsanādhikāre niyamāduktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || || iti yāvadadhikaraṇaṃ || atropāsanādhikāriṇāṃ prāṇāvasānatvaṃ samarthyate| <3-3-35> || iyadāmananāt || nanu nādhikāriṇaḥ prāṇāvasānāḥ| prāṇaḥ svottamādhikāriniyamyaḥ| adhikāritvāt| nāmādivat| ityanumānavirodhāt| ato'dhikāriṇāṃ prāṇāvasānātvābhāvena hiraṇyagarbha eva sarvaguṇopāstiyogya ityuktamayuktamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || iyadāmananāditi || asyārthaḥ || adhikāritāratamyaṃ iyadeva prāṇāvadhikameva| kutaḥ| āmananāt| prāṇo vāveti śruterityarthaḥ || evaṃca prāṇāvasānatvamevādhikāriṇaḥ| nirdiṣṭaśruteḥ| anumānasya ca bādhitaviṣayatvena bādhābhāvāt| tataścādhikāriṇāṃ prāṇāvasānatvena sa eva sarvaguṇopāstiyogya iti siddhaṃ || <3-3-36> || aṃtarā bhūtagrāmavaditi cettaduktaṃ || uktamākṣipya samādadhatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || aṃtarā bhūtagrāmavaditi cettaduktamiti || asyārthaḥ || bhūtagrāmavat yathā nāmādiprāṇasamūhe ekasbhādeka uttamo dṛṣṭaḥ| tathā aṃtarā paramātmānaṃ śriyaṃ ca vinā prāṇāduttamostviti cenneti śeṣaḥ| yatastaduktaṃ| tatra prāṇāduttamābhāve| nahīti pramāṇamuktaṃ| ata ityarthaḥ || evaṃcoktānumānasya prāṇo vāveti śrutibādhitatvenāvirodhāt| ata uktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <3-3-37> || anyathā bhedānupapattiriti cennopadeśavat || nanu prāṇo vāveti śrutibalena na prāṇasya sarvottamatvaṃ vaktuṃ śakyaṃ| tathā satīśvaradvayāyogena prāṇa paramātmanoraikyaprasaṃgāditi prāpte sūtramāha || || anyathā bhedānupapattiriti cennopadeśavaditi || asyārthaḥ || anyathā prāṇādapyuttamatvābhāve| prāṇaparamātmanorbhedānupapattiriti cenna| kutaḥ| yataḥ upadeśavat yathā śrutāvuktaṃ tathāṃ'gīkriyate| ato noktadoṣa ityarthaḥ || evaṃca chaṃdogaśrutyuktaprakāreṇa sarvaśabdasya saṃkocamaṃgīkṛtya prāṇasya sarvādhikāryuttamatvaṃ tato mahālakṣmyāstataḥ paramātmana uttamatvāṃgīkārāt| ato'dhikāriṇāṃ prāṇāvasānatvena sa eva sarvaguṇopāstiyogya iti siddhaṃ || || iti iyadāmananādhikaraṇaṃ || atropāsanādhikāriṇaḥ prāṇātparameśvarasyottamatvaṃ prasādhyate| <3-3-38> || vyatihāro viśiṃṣaṃti hītaravat || nanu na viṣṇoḥ sarvottamatvaṃ yuktaṃ| prāṇasyottamatvamuktvā taduttamatvānabhidhānāt| na hi satyapi prāṇāduttametadanabhidhāne kāraṇamasti| yenānuktimagaṇyya prāṇāduttamatvaṃ viṣṇoḥ pratīmaḥ| na ca satyapadoditasya viṣṇoḥ prāṇāduttamatvaṃ yuktamiti vācyaṃ| prakaraṇabhedakābhāvena satyatvasya prāṇaviśeṣaṇatvāt| tataśca na viṣṇoḥ sarvopāsyatvamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || vyatihāro viśiṃṣaṃti hītaravaditi || asyārthaḥ || vyatihāraḥ prāṇaprakaraṇādanaṃtaraṃ viṣṇoḥ prakaraṇāt prāk praśnaprativacanayoradhyāhāraḥ kāryaḥ| kutaḥ| hi yasmāt| itaravat nāmādito vāgādikamivaprāṇavādinaḥ sakāśāt satyākhyaviṣṇuvādinaḥ chaṃdogā eṣa tu veti tu śabdena viśiṃṣaṃti vyāvartayaṃti| tasmādityarthaḥ || evaṃca yuktameva viṣṇoḥ sarvottamatvaṃ| na ca nāmādāviva praśnaprativacanābhāvātprāṇāduttamābhāve tātparyamiti vācyaṃ| prāyapāṭhabalena praśnaprativacanasyānumātuṃ śakyatvāt| na ca prakaraṇabhedakābhāvānna praśnaprativacanādhyāhāra iti vācyaṃ| tu śabdasya prakaraṇabhedakasya sadbhāvāt| tataśca praśnaprativacanasaṃdhānapūrvakaṃ maṃtradraṣṭrā viṣṇoḥ prāṇāduttamatvasyoktatvāttasya sarvopāsyatvaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || || iti vyatihārādhikaraṇaṃ || atra prāṇādviṣṇorevottamatvaṃ sādhyate| <3-3-39> || saiva hi satyādayaḥ || nanu na kevalaṃ prāṇātsatyapadokto viṣṇurevottamaḥ| api tu bahavaḥ| satyādapyupari vijñānamiti śraddhāniṣṭhākṛtisukhabhūmāhaṃkārātmanāmuktatvāt| satyādīnāmabhede pramāṇābhāvāt| ataḥ prāṇādapi bahūnāmuttamatvāttasya viṣṇuṃ vinā sarvottamatvaṃ viṣṇornirupacaritasarvottamatvaṃ na yuktamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || saiva hi satyādaya iti || asyārthaḥ || hi yasmāt| satyādyāḥ aha mātmāṃtā padārthāḥ| saiva īśvarākhya paradevataiva| tasmātprāṇādhikāḥ bahavaḥ na| kiṃtu śrīstadīśāvevetyarthaḥ || evaṃca satyādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ paradevatātvāt| na cābhedoktyabhāvaḥ| satyamiti praśne yathā vai iti tad‌vyāptārthāṃtaropadeśasya kathamapyayogena vijñānasya satyaguṇatvābhidhāyakatvāt| guṇasya ca guṇyabhinnatvāt| sa vā eṣa ityādinā'haṃkārātmajñānānmokṣābhidhānāt| sa evādhāstāditi pūrṇatvābhidhānācca| kiṃca sarveṣāṃ satyādīnāṃ śrutyaṃtare satyaṃ pūrṇamityādinā pūrṇatvasya bhagavallakṣaṇatvoktyā tato'pi sarveṣāṃ tadaikyaṃ| ataḥ satyādīnāmātmāṃtānāṃ bhagavatsvarūpatvena sa eva prāṇāduttama ityuktamupapannamiti siddhaṃ || || iti satyādhikaraṇaṃ || atra śriya upāsanānadhikāritvaṃ sādhyate| <3-3-40> || kāmāditaratra tatra cāyatanādibhyaḥ || nanu bhavatyeva prakṛtiradhikāriṇī| na ca nāmādiṣvapaṭhitatvāditi vācyaṃ| asiddheḥ| na ca śravaṇaprasaṃgaḥ| anuccāritameva tadvākyaṃ ṛṣyabhipretamastītyaṃgīkārāt| na ca saṃsāritvāsiddhiḥ| sītārugmiṇyadirjananamaraṇādidarśanena tatsiddheḥ| tataśca nādhikāriṇāṃ prāṇāvasānatvamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || kāmāditaratra tatra cāyatanādibhya iti || asyārthaḥ || lakṣmīḥ tatra bhagavatsamīpe sthitā satī| itaratraca bhūmyādāvapi| kāmāt īśvarecchayaivāvatārānkaroti| kutaḥ| āyatanādibhyaḥ sarvagatatvapratipādaka sarvāyatanetyādiśrutyādibya ityarthaḥ || evaṃca prakṛtirnādhikāriṇī| abaddhatvāt| na ca jananādinā tatsiddhiḥ| sītārugmiṇyādeḥ prādurbhūtatvenotpatterabhāvāt| sarvāyatanā sarvakāleti vatsaśruteḥ| ataḥ prakṛteradhikāritvābhāvādyuktaṃ prāṇāvasānatvamiti siddhaṃ || <3-3-41> || ādarādalopaḥ || nanu ramāyā asaṃsāritve kṛtakṛtyatvena bhagavadupāsanādyabhāvaḥ syāt| na cāsau yuktaḥ| yadarcitaṃ brahmetyādipramāṇaviruddhatvāt| ātrārcitamupāsitaṃ pūjitaṃ cetyukterityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtramupanyasyati || || ādarādalopa iti || asyārthaḥ || ādarāt bhagavati nirupādhikabhaktyatiśayāt| alopaḥ śriyo bhagavadupāsanābhāvo netyarthaḥ || evaṃca śrīrnityamuktā'baddhā'pi nirupādhikasarvātiśayitabhaktivaśānniyamena tasyā bhagavadupāsanopapatteḥ| yathā śrīriti vacanāt| ata uktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <3-3-42> || upasthitestadvacanāt || nanu na ramāyā nityamuktatvaṃ yuktaṃ| kāraṇābhāvāt| na ca svata eva tat| tasyā asvātaṃtryāditi prāpte pariharatsūtramupanyasyati || || upasthitestadvacanāditi || asyārthaḥ || śriyo nityamuktatvaṃ yujyate| kutaḥ| upasthiteḥ harisamīpe sadā sthiteḥ| śriyo nityasamīpasthatvaṃ ca| tadvacanāt dvāvetāviti nityasaṃbaṃdhitvavacanāt| jñāyata ityarthaḥ || evaṃca dvāviti śrutivacanādramāyāḥ samīpasthiteḥ siddhatvāt| atiśayitabhagavatprasādākhyakāraṇasadbhāvāt| atastasyā nityamuktatvenādhikārikatvābhāvādyuktaṃ prāṇāvasānatvamiti siddhaṃ || || iti kāmādhikaraṇaṃ || atra śravaṇamanananididhyāsanarūpasya samastasyāpyupāsanasya kartavyatvaṃ samarthyate| <3-3-43> || tannirdhāraṇārthaniyamastadṛṣṭeḥ pṛthagghyapratibaṃdhaḥ phalaṃ || nanu śravaṇamanane eva kārye| tābhyāmevājñānasaṃśayaviparyanivṛttau svakāraṇādeva darśanasaṃbhavāt| athocyeta| ajñānapratibaṃdhakānāṃ dṛḍhatvātdhyānenaiva pratibaṃdhakanivṛttiriti| tarhi dhyānenaiva jñānamastu| na jñānārthaṃ śravaṇamanane| na ca samucitānāṃ jñānahetutve mānamasti| na ca jñānotpāde śravaṇamananayorupayogo'sti| ataḥ samastopāsanasyāvaśyākartavyatvena tadvidhānavaiyarthyamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || tannirdhāraṇārthaniyamastaddṛṣṭeḥ pṛthagghyapratibaṃdhaḥ phalamiti || asyārthaḥ || yatastannardhāraṇārthaniyamaḥ vedārthaniścayo vedārthaniyamaścetyetadrūpaṃ| śravaṇamananaphalaṃ dhyānaphalabhūtāyāḥ| taddṛṣṭeḥ brahmadarśanāt| pṛthagena bhinnameva| ato na brahmadṛṣṭiḥ śravaṇādinā bhavatītyarthaḥ| tathāpi na śravaṇamananavaiyarthyaṃ| kutaḥ| hi yasmāt| apratibaṃdhaḥ brahmadṛṣṭipratibaṃdhakanivṛttiḥ| tannaścayaḥ tanniyamadvārā śravaṇamananayoḥ phalaṃ| ato dhyānasādhyāpi dṛṣṭiḥ pratibaṃdhakanivṛttidvārā śravaṇādisādhyā bhavati| tadarthaṃ śravaṇādikamapi kāryamevetyarthaḥ| hi śabdena ātmā vā'ra iti śrutiḥ sūcitā || evaṃca kartavyameva samastopāsanaṃ| na śravaṇamananamātraṃ| tayostattvajñānavedārthanirṇayarūpadarśanātiriktaphalahetutvenadarśanahetutvābhāvāt| dhyānasya ca darśanahetutvenāvaśyakatvāt| na caivaṃ śravaṇamananābhāvaprasaṃgaḥ| tayoḥ sākṣāddarśanahetutvābhāve'pi pratibaṃdhakībhūtājñānasaṃśayaviparyayanivṛttidvārā darśanopayogitvenāvaśyakatvāt| na ca tatra pramāṇābhāvaḥ| darśanārtha śrotavya iti vihitatvāt| śrutvā matveti smṛteśca| ataḥ samastopāsanasya kartavyatvādyuktaṃ tadvidhānamiti siddhaṃ || || iti nirdhāraṇādhikaraṇaṃ || atra bhagavatjñānasādhanaśravaṇādyupāsanasya setikartavyatākatvaṃ sādhyate| <3-3-44> || pradānavadeva hi taduktaṃ || nanu śravaṇādikameva jñānasādhanaṃ| na gurupradānapūrvakaṃ| ātmāveti śrutau śravaṇādīnāmeva jñānatvābhidhānāt| na hi śravaṇāditrayamuktvāviśiṣyagurupradānasyānuktau kāraṇamasti| kiṃca guruprasādasya śravaṇādyaṃgatve'nuṣṭhitaśravaṇāderapi gurukopena jñānābhāvaḥ syāt| tathā ca jātāparokṣasya mokṣābhāvaḥ syādaviśeṣāditi prāpte sūtritaṃ || || pradānavadeva hi taduktamiti || asyārthaḥ || pradānavat prītipūrvakaṃ gurupadeśayuktameva śravaṇādikaṃ jñānasādhanaṃ na kevalaṃ| kutaḥ| hi yataḥ| taduktaṃ tasya jñānasya guruprasādārdhānatvaṃ ācāryavāniti śrutāvuktamata ityarthaḥ || evaṃca gurupradānayuktameva śravaṇādikaṃ mokṣasādhanaṃ| ācāryavānpuruṣo vedeti vacanāt| na cātmāveti śrutau śravaṇāderiva gurupradānasyāpyuktiprasaṃgaḥ| gurupradānasya śravaṇādyaṃgatvena tatsamakakṣitvābhāvāt| na cānuṣṭhitaśravaṇāderapi jñānābhāvo jñānino'pi mokṣābhāvo gurukopena syāditi vācyaṃ| tatjñānamokṣayorīśvarakalpitatvāt| na caivaṃ guruśāpo viphalaḥ| jñānādihrāsahetutvāt| jñānino guruśāpopīti ye jñānaviṣayā iti cokteḥ| ato gurupradānasyāvaśyakatvādyuktameva śravaṇādikaṃ kartavyamiti siddhaṃ || || iti pradānādhikaraṇaṃ || atretikartavyatārūpaguruprasādasya balīyastvaṃ samarthyate| <3-3-45> || liṃgabhūyastvāttaddhi balīyastadapi || nanu viśiṣṭaśiṣyaprayatna eva balavān| pradhānatvāt| na guruprasādaḥ| itikartavyatārūpatvāt| mābhūdvā''dhikyaṃ sāmyaṃ tu syāt| na śiṣyaprayatnasya daurbalyaṃ| guruśiṣyayoḥ| puruṣatvasāmyāt| ato guruprasādasyāprābalyānnāvaśyakatvamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || liṃgabhūyastvāttaddhi balīyastadapīti || asyārthaḥ || tat guruprasādapūrvakapradānamātraṃ| balīyaḥ atiśayena balavat| kutaḥ| liṃgabhūyastvāt vṛṣabhahaṃsajalavāyasarūpebhyo vāyvagnivaruṇebhyo śrutavidyenāpi satyakāmena gurupradānādirūpaliṃgabāhulyadarśanāt tathā'pi tadapi śravaṇādikamapi kāryaṃ| kutaḥ| śretavya iti śruterityarthaḥ| hi śabdaḥ śrutisūcakaḥ || evaṃca guruprasādo balavāneva na durbalaḥ| nāpi samaḥ| liṃgabhūyastvāt| daurbalyamanumātuṃ na śakyaṃ| na ca guruprasādasya prābalyābhāve tadyujyate na cetikartavyatātvāddaurbalyamanumātuṃ śakyaṃ| liṃgabhūyastvena bādhitaviṣayatvāt| tathopakosalopyagnyādibhyo vidyāṃ śrutvā'pi guruṃ prārthayate| tathā ṛṣabhādibhyo vidyāṃ śrutvā'pi satyakāmo guruṃ prārthayate| yāgīyahiṃsāṃge tu vyabhicārācca| na ca tāvatā'lamiti naṃ maṃtavyaṃ| api vā''tmeti vacanena tasyānuṣṭheyatvāt| ato guruprasādapūrvakaṃ pradānasya prābalyāttadapekṣitamiti siddhaṃ || || iti liṃgabhūyastvādhikaraṇaṃ || atra pūrvaprāptādanyo'pi guruḥ svīkārya eveti samarthyate| <3-3-46> || pūrvavikalpaḥ prakaraṇātsyātkriyāmānasavata || nanu prathama prāpta eva guruḥ svīkāryo na tu tatparityāgenānyaḥ| parityāga kāraṇībhūtapātityādidoṣābhāvāt| na ca prathamaprāptagurvasādhyaphalalābhāyānyaḥ svīkārya iti vācyaṃ| gurusvīkāryeṇaiva tadupapatteḥ| na hi gurusvīkārasyāsādhyaṃ nāsti yenānyaḥ svīkāryaḥ syāt| anyathaikalavyasya vidyāprāptirna syāt| pātityādidoṣaṃ vināpi guruparityāge ca doṣaprāpteśca| ataḥ pūrvaprāpta eva gururiti niyamātkvacitsarvajñaguroḥ prathama prāptatvābhāve prāguktaṃ na yujyata iti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || pūrvavikalpaḥ prakaraṇātsyātkriyāmānasavāditi || asyārthaḥ || kriyāmānasavat mānasakriyārūpadhyāne vikalpaḥ tathā pūrvavikalpaḥ pūrvaprāptena guruṇā samasya paścātprāptasya guroḥ| vikalpaḥ grāhye vā naveti vikalpaḥ syāt| na tu svīkārya eveti vidhiḥ| kutaḥ| prakaraṇāt| prakṛṣṭānugrahamapekṣya guroḥ svīkāryatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca na pūrva prāpta eva gururiti niyamaḥ| paścāttanaḥ samagrānugrahaṃ karoti cetso'pi grāhyaḥ| guruparigrahasya samagrānugrahārthatvāt| guruprasādamaṃtarā gurusvīkārādimātreṇa mokṣādilakṣaṇamahāphalābhāvāt| samagrānugrahaṃ kartā pūrvasmāduttamaścetpūrvānujñāṃ vinā niḥsaṃśayaṃ svīkārya eva| samaścetpūrvānujñayā svīkāryaḥ| nocenna svīkāryaḥ| iti vikalpaḥ syāt| mānasakriyāvat| adhamaścenna svīkārya eva pūrvasmāduttama iti śruteḥ| ataḥ sarvajñagurusvīkārasyopapannatvena taduktaprakāreṇopāsanaṃ kartavyamiti siddhaṃ || <3-3-47> || atideśācca || hetvaṃtareṇa samottamagurusvīkāraṃ samarthayatsūtramāha || || atideśācceti || asyārthaḥ || pūrvaguruṇaiva svasamottamagurusvīkārāyātideśāt| yathetyātidiśyamānatvāt| yuktameva paścāttanasvīkaraṇamityarthaḥ || evaṃcācāryopāsanaṃ nāma savinayamaṃte sthitiḥ| tasyopacāro nāmābhīṣṭakaraṇādirityarthakatvāt| brahmopāsva brahmopacarasveti pauṣyāyaṇaśrutāvatideśāt| ataḥ sarvajñagurusvīkārasyopapannatvena taduktaprakāreṇopāsanaṃ kāryamiti siddhaṃ || || iti vikalpādhikaraṇaṃ || atropāsanasya kartavyatāsamarthanāya jñānameva muktiheturiti samarthyate| <3-3-48> || vidyaiva tu nirdhāraṇāt || nanu na bhagavata upāsanaṃ kāryaṃ| vyarthatvāt| na ca jñānārthamupāsanaṃ| tasyāpi vyarthatvāt| na ca mokṣārthaṃ jñānaṃ| jñānasya mokṣasādhanatvāniścayāt| yathā jñānasya mokṣasādhanatvaṃ śrūyate tathā karmaṇo'pi karmaṇaiva hītyādi mokṣasādhanatvaṃ smaryate| na ca puruṣārthasādhanatvasaṃdehe'pi kṛṣyādāviva jñānopāsanādau pravṛttiḥ saṃbhavatīti vācyaṃ| alpavittavyayāyāsasādhye tatra tathā saṃbhave'pi bahuvittavyayāyāsasādhyapāratrikapravṛtteḥ saṃdehamātreṇāyogāt| tato jñānasya mokṣasādhanatvānirṇayānna jñānopāsanaṃ kāryamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || vidyaiva tu nirdhāraṇāditi || asyārthaḥ || nānyaḥpaṃthā iti nirdhāraṇāt anyaniṣedhena jñānasyaiva mokṣasādhanatvaniścayāt| vidyaiva mokṣasādhanaṃ na karmādikamityarthaḥ| śruteḥ prābalyadyotakastu śabda || evaṃca kāryameva jñānārthamupāsanaṃ| tamevaṃ viditveti śruteḥ| karmavacanādapi prābalyena vidyaiva mokṣa ityavadhāraṇa saṃbhavāt| ato jñānasya muktisādhanatvāttadarthamupāsanaṃ kartavyamiti siddhaṃ || <3-3-49> || darśanācca || nanvevaṃ tarhi dhyānavaiyarthyaṃ bhavet| śravaṇenaiva mananarūpavicārasaṃbhavāt| tanmātreṇa mokṣasaṃbhavādityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtramupanyasyati || || darśanācceti || asyārthaḥ || na kevalaṃ parokṣajñāptirūpavidyaiva mokṣaḥ| kiṃtu darjñanācca brahmasākṣātkārādapi| ato na dhyānavaiyarthyamityarthaḥ || evaṃca parokṣajñānena mokṣānukteryena mananenaiva kṛtatvātdhyānavaiyarthyaṃ syāt| kiṃnāmopāsanājanitenāparokṣajñānenetyabhyupagamāt| na ca tamevaṃ viditveti sāmānyaśrutisadbhāvena jñānameva mokṣasādhanaṃ tattvaparokṣajñānameveti niyamo niyāmakābhāvāditi vācyaṃ| dṛṣṭ‌vaiveti śrutibalena sādhāraṇaśruterapyaparokṣajñānaparatayā vyākhye yatvāt| ato jñānasya mokṣasādhanatvena tadarthamupāsanaṃ kartavyamiti siddhaṃ || || iti vidyādhikaraṇaṃ || atra yatsādhanaṃ bhagavadupāstiḥ tasya jñānasya mokṣasādhanatvaṃ samarthyate| <3-3-50> || śrutyādibalīyastvācca na bādhaḥ || nanu karmasādhya eva mokṣaḥ| karmaṇaiva saṃsiddhiriti vacanāt| śrutismṛtyoḥ sāvadhāraṇatve'pi bhagavadvākyatvena smṛterevabalavattvāt| tataḥ śruteḥ smṛtibādhitatvena jñānasya mokṣasādhanatvābhāvena na tadarthamupāsanaṃ kāryamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || śrutyādibalīyastvācca na bādha iti || asyārthaḥ || mokṣasya jñānasādhyatve'bādhaḥ karmaṇaiveti smṛtivirodho nāsti| kutaḥ| śrutyādibalīyastvāt| jñānasya mokṣasādhakatvopapādakatvamevaṃ viditvetyādi śrutiliṃgāderatibalatvena smṛtigataiva śabdasyāyogavyavacchedārthatvopapatterityarthaḥ || etatsūcanāya ca śabdaḥ || evaṃca vidyaiva mokṣaḥ| tamevaṃ viditveti nānyaḥ paṃthā iti nirdhāraṇāt| tamevaṃ viditveti vacanātparokṣajñānenaiva mokṣa iti na maṃtavyaṃ| dṛṣṭ‌vaiva taṃ mucyata iti vacanādviditveti śruterapyaparokṣajñānaparatāyā eva grāhyatvāt| na ca karmaṇaiveti sāvadhāraṇāyā īsvaravacanena balavatyā smṛtyā bādhaḥ| tamevaṃ viditveti śruterna karmabhiriti tattvajñānaprārthanarligasya karmaṇā badhyata iti yuktimadbhagavadvacanasya ca tato balavattvāt| na ca karmaṇaiveti smṛtyaprāmāṇyaṃ| avadhāraṇasya karmayogāvyavacchedārthakatvāt| ato jñānasyaiva mokṣahetutvena kartavyaivopāsaneti siddhaṃ || || iti śrutyadhikaraṇaṃ || atra brahmajñānasādhanopāsanasya bhaktipūrvakatvaṃ samarthyate| <3-3-51> || anubaṃdhādibhyaśca || nanu na jñānārthaṃ bhaktirapekṣitā| prasādasya jñānahetutve sahāyānapekṣatvāt| sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpanna iti vacanāt| na caivamupāsanābhāvaḥ jñānasyopāsanā'nvayavyatirekadarśanena prasādasyopāsanātiriktāpekṣatvasya pramāṇārthatvāt| na copāsanā bhaktimaṃtareṇa saṃbhavatīti vācyaṃ| dveṣeṇāpi dhyānasaṃbhavāt| dveṣāccaidyādaya iti vacanāt| ato dveṣeṇa vā bhaktyā votpannenopāsanena guruprasādalakṣaṇasahakārivāśātjñānasaṃbhavena na tadarthaṃ bhaktyādikamāvaśyakamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || anubaṃdhādibhyaśceti || asyārthaḥ || na kevalaṃ śravaṇādinā| nāpi prabalaguruprasādena brahmadarśanaṃ bhavati| kiṃtvanubaṃdhaśabditaharigurubhaktiśamādibhyaścetyarthaḥ || evaṃca na kevalaṃ jñānārthaṃ śravaṇādikaṃ guruprasādaścāpekṣitaḥ| kiṃtu bhaktyādikamapi prasādārthaṃ jñānārthaṃ cāpekṣitaṃ| sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpanna iti vacanāt| ato bhaktyāderjñānārthamapekṣitatvāduktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || || iti anubaṃdhādhikaraṇaṃ || atropāsanāsādhyajñāne viśeṣatāratamyaṃ samarthyate| <3-3-52> || prajñāṃtarapṛthaktvavadṛṣṭiśca taduktaṃ || nanu sarveṣāmekaprakāramevāparokṣajñānaṃ| bhaktyā māmabhijānātītyanena sarveṣāṃ pūrṇajñānena mokṣasya cābhidhānāt| ataḥ sarveṣāṃ darśanasāmyāduktaṃ muktatāratamyamayuktamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || prajñāṃtara pṛthaktvavaddṛṣṭiśca taduktamiti || asyārthaḥ || prajñāṃtaraṃ prajñāviśeṣaḥ| dhyānamiti yāvat| tasya pṛthaktvavat anekaprakārattvavat| tadanusāreṇa dṛṣṭiśca brahmadṛṣṭirapi anekaprakārā na srevaṣāmekavidhā| kiṃca taduktaṃ dṛṣṭeranekavidhatvaṃ aṃtardṛṣṭaya iti śrutāvuktaṃcetyarthaḥ || evaṃcānekaprakāramevādhikāriṇāṃ bhagavaddarśanaṃ| tatsādhanasyopāsanasyānekaprakāratvāt| phalasya ca sādhanānusāritvāt| na caivaṃ saṃpūrṇadarśanābhāvādviriṃcetareṣāṃ mokṣābhāvaḥ| yathāyogya dṛṣṭereva mokṣahetutvena svayogyadarśanena sarveṣāṃ mokṣasaṃbhavāt| ato jñānaviśeṣasadbhāvādyuktaṃ mokṣatāratamyamiti siddhaṃ || || iti prajñāṃtarādhikaraṇaṃ || atropāsanasya biṃbaśabditayogyātmarūpaviṣayakasyaiva muktisādhanatvaṃ samarthyate| <3-3-53> || na sāmānyādapyupalabdhermṛtyuvanna hi lokāpattiḥ || nanu yatkiṃcidrūpadarśanameva mokṣasādhanaṃ| bhagavataḥ pūrvarūpeṣvapi sāmyāt| ato yatkiṃcidrūpadarśanasya mokṣasādhanatvānna biṃbopāsanāniyatirapekṣitā sidyatīti prāpte parākurvatsūtramāha || || nā sāmānyāpapyupalabdhermṛtyuvanna hi lokāpattiriti || asyārthaḥ || mṛtyuvat mṛtyumātrānaṃtaraṃ yathā na muktiḥ| kiṃtu caramamṛtiviśeṣānaṃtarameva| tadvadatrāpi bhagavadrūpāṇāṃ sāmye'pi upalabdheḥ| bhagavaddaṣṭisāmānyāt sādhāraṇarūpāparokṣajñānāt| na sarveṣāṃ muktiḥ kiṃtu svasvabiṃbadarśanādeva| na caivaṃ sāmānyadarśanasya vaiphalyaṃ| tasya maharādilokaprāptisādhanatvāt| na caitāvatā tasya mokṣahetutvaṃ prāpneti| hi yataḥ| lokapattiḥ lokaprāptimātraṃ na muktiḥ| tasmādityarthaḥ || hītyanena sanmānyadarśanetyādipramāṇaprasiddhiśca sūcitā || evaṃca bhagavadrūpāṇāṃ sāmānyena sāmānyato darśanena na sarveṣāṃ muktiḥ| kiṃ nāma svabiṃbadarśanādeva| darśanenātmayogyeneti vacanāt| na ca darśanāṃtaravaiyarthyaṃ| sāmānyadarśanāditivacanabalena teṣāṃ maharādilokaprāptihetutvāt| svayogyajñānasyaiva mokṣahetutvāt| mṛtyutvasāmye'pi liṃgabhaṃgasyaivānaṃdāvirbhāvahetutvāt| na ca lokaprāptireva mokṣaḥ| maharādilokaṃ gatānāṃ prayalānaṃtaraṃ mokṣaśravaṇāt| ato biṃbadarśanasyaiva mokṣasādhanatvāttadevopāsyamiti siddhaṃ || || iti na sāmānyādhikaraṇaṃ || atrānubaṃdhādibhya ityatra darśanasādhanatayopāsanāsāhityenoktabhakteḥ svātaṃtryaṃ nirasyate| <3-3-54> || pareṇa ca śabdasya tādvidhyaṃ bhūyastvāttvanubaṃdhaḥ || nanu bhaktyaivāparokṣajānaṃ| na paramātmaprasādena| bhaktirevainaṃ mocayatīti śruteḥ| tataḥ sādhanasāmarthyenaiva darśanasaṃbhavānna tasyāvyaktatvamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || pareṇa ca śabdasya tādvidhyaṃ bhūyastvāttvanubaṃdha iti || asyārthaḥ || turapi yadyapi| pareṇa ca paramātmanaiva| brahmadarśanaṃ tathā'pi śabdasya bhaktirevainamiti śruteḥ| tadvidhyaṃ paramātmana iva bhakteḥ svātaṃtryeṇa brahmadarśanahetutvavācitvaṃ yujyate| kutaḥ| darśanādau karaṇatvāditi heturupaskartavyaḥ| yadvā| pareṇa vācyena nimittena śabdasya bhaktiriti śruteḥ| tādvidhyaṃ yuktamityarthaḥ| tarhi kathaṃ bhaktiriti vākyena satsvapyanyasādhaneṣu anubaṃdho bhaktiḥ viśiṣyocyata ityata uktaṃ| bhūyastvāditi| tasyāḥ sādhaneṣu| bhūyastvāt prādhānyāt| tadabhiprāyeṇānubaṃdho bhaktirviśiṣyocyata ityarthaḥ || evaṃca bhaktyā prasannaparamātmanaivāparokṣajñānaṃ| etairupāyairiti śrutyā svecchayaiva bhaktāparokṣasidhyarthaṃ brahmadhāmaśabdavācyavāyupraveśokteḥ| na ca pūrvaśrutivirodhaḥ| bhagavatprasādasādhaneṣu bhakteḥ prādhānyābhiprāyeṇa bhaktirevainaṃ mocayatītyabhidhānāt| ato darśanādeḥ puruṣasādhyatvābhāvādyuktamavyaktatvaṃ brahmaṇa iti siddhaṃ || || iti pareṇādhikaraṇaṃ || atropāsanasyānādiyogyatāsāpekṣatvaṃ samarthyate| <3-3-55> || eka ātmanaḥ śarīre bhāvāt || nanu nopāsanā'nādiyogyatāsāpekṣā| iṃdrādyaṃśajīvānāmutpattimattvena tadyogyatāyā anādinityatvābhāvāt| na ceṃdrādiyogyataivārjunādīnāṃ yogyatā| aṃśasyaṃśimārgavṛttitvābhāvāt| jñānādibhedena tayorbhinnatvāt| tataścopāsanasyānādiyogyatānapekṣatvāttadavyavasthitamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || eka ātmanaḥ śarīre bhāvāditi || asyārthaḥ || aṃśāṃśīti padayorartha eka eva aṃśāṃśinoraikyameva| kutaḥ| ātmanaḥ aṃśinaḥ| iṃdrādiśarīre karmanirmitaśarīre| aṃśasyārjunādeḥ| bhāvāt tadabhimānitayā satvādityarthaḥ || evaṃcātsyeva sarveṣāmupāsanādāvanādiyogyatāsāpekṣā| na cārjunādīnāmutpattimattvenānādiyogyatābhāvaḥ| teṣāmaṃśyabhinnatvena tadyogyatāyā eva tadyogyatātvāt| tadaikyaṃ cāṃśoṃśyabhinnaḥ| tatkarmanirmitaśarīravṛttitvādityanumānasiddhaṃ || ataḥ sarveṣāmupāsanādāvanādiyogyatā'pekṣiteti yuktā tad‌vyavastheti siddhaṃ || <3-3-56> || vyatirekastadbhāvabhāvitvānna tūpalabdhivat || nanu jñānādibhedādaṃśāṃśinorbheda eva yukto nābheda ityātśaṃkāṃ parihartuṃ sūtramupanyasyati || || vyatirekastadbhāvabhāvitvānna tūpalabdhivaditi || asyārthaḥ || upalabdhivat jñānasukhādau parasparaṃ bheda iva| aṃśāṃśinorapi| vyateriko bheda iti tu na| kutaḥ| tadbhāvabhāvitvāt aśaṃsyāṃśikṛtabhāvaśabditopasanājanyaphalānubhavitvāt| anyathā tanna syādityarthaḥ || evaṃcāṃśini sukhini duḥkhinyaṃśasya tadanusaṃdhānābhāvādbheda iti śaṃkāyā anudayāt| anyathā'siddheḥ| aṃśinyaṃśagatasarvānusaṃdhānabhāvāt| aṃśasyāciṃtyeśvaraśaktivaśātsarvānusaṃdhānābhāve'pi pradhānasādhanopāsanādiphalānusaṃdhānāt| ataḥ sarveṣāmupāsanādāvanādiyogyatāsāpekṣateti siddhaṃ || || iti ekādhikaraṇaṃ || atra bhagavadupāsteryathāyogyaṃ brahmādyaṃgadevatopāsteryuktatvena kartavyatā pratipādyate| <3-3-57> || aṃgāvabaddhāstu na śākhāsu hi prativedaṃ || nanu kevalameva brahmopāsanaṃ kāryaṃ| tamevaikaṃ jānatheti vacanāt| tataścānyadevānāmanupāsyatvāt| tadabhidhāyakavedavaiyarthyamiti || yadvā || kāryaivāṃgadevatopāsanā| paraṃtu brahmādiṣu ye guṇāste sarvadeveṣūpasaṃhartavyāḥ| ye cāgnyādiṣu pratītā guṇāste'pi sarveṣu deveṣūpasaṃhartavyāḥ| tataśca tāratamyābhāva iti| prāpte sūtritaṃ || || aṃgāvabaddhastu na śākhāsu hi prativedamiti || asyārthaḥ || tu śabdo viśeṣe| aṃgāvabaddhāḥ hareraṃgāśritāḥ| devā api tatparivāratvena devairupāsyāḥ| tadupasaṃhāre tu viśeṣo'sti| kaḥ| devānāṃ prativedaṃ sarvavedagatāsu śākhāsu uktaṃ yad‌brahmādyaṃgadevatāvabaddhagumajātaṃ tatsarvaṃ rudrādiṣu nopasaṃhāryaṃ| kiṃtu yogyamevetyevaṃ rūpa ityarthaḥ || hītyanena samatvādveti smṛtiprasiddhiḥ sūcitā evaṃca kāryamevāṃgadevatopāsanaṃ| na ca śrutyādivirodhaḥ| prādhānye tadupāsanasya niṣiddhatvāt| tataśca na tadvidhāyakavedavaiyarthyaṃ| api ca| kāryaivāṃgadevatopāsanā| paraṃtu brahmādyuttameṣu pratītā guṇā nādhameṣūpasaṃhartavyāḥ| ayogyatvāt| tataśca na tāratamyahāniriti siddhaṃ || <3-3-58> || maṃtrādivadvā'virodha || evamekatra pratītānāṃ sarvaguṇānāmanyatropasaṃhārābhāva uktaḥ| idānīmupasaṃhārābhyupagame'pi na virodha ityāha sūtrakṛt || || maṃtrādivadvā'virodhāditi || asyārthaḥ || maṃtrādivat yathā'gnyādyadhamadevatāvācimaṃtravidyānāṃ brahmādyattamadevatāvācitvaṃ tathā'virodhaḥ adhamaguṇānāmuttameṣūpasaṃhāre'pi virodho nāstīti vā'bhyupagamyata ityarthaḥ || evaṃca kāryamevāṃgadevatopāsanaṃ| adhamaguṇānāmuttameṣu sadbhāvepyuttamaguṇānāmadhameṣvabhāvāt| ato yathāyogyamaṃgadevatānāmupāsyatvātsarvaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || || iti aṃgāvabaddhādhikaraṇaṃ || atra bhūmaguṇasya sarvopāsakasādhāraṇatvaṃ samarthyate| <3-3-59> || bhūmnaḥ krutavajjyāyastvaṃ tathā ca darśayati || nanu na bhūmaguṇaḥ sarvopāsyaḥ| vaiyarthyāt| na hi kasyāpi niratiśayaparyāyaṃ bhūmatvaniṣṭhaṃ| na cānaṃdaviśeṣaṇatvādupāsyatvaṃ| priyaśirastvādau vyabhicārāt| ato bhūmatvasya sarvopāsyatvābhāvāllaukikatayopāsanamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || bhūmnaḥ kratuvajjyāyastvaṃ tathā ca darśayatīti || asyārthaḥ || kratuvta yathā kratuśabditaprāyaṇīyādyaṃgajātasya| vikṛtikṛtiṣu anuvṛttiṃ anuṣṭheyatvaṃ ca| tathā bhūmnaḥ pūrṇatvaguṇasyetaraguṇebhyo| jāyastvaṃ viśiṣṭatvaṃ| ānaṃdādiguṇeṣvanuvṛttitayopāsanasya saphalatvaṃ sarvopāsyatvaṃ cetyevaṃ rūpaṃ yujyate| kuta etat| hi yasmāt| bhūmaiva deva iti śrutiḥ| tathā darśayati pratipādayati| tasmādityarthaḥ || evaṃca sarvairapyupāsyo bhūmaguṇaḥ| yathā khalu dīkṣāprāyaṇīyodayanīyasavanatrayāvabhṛthātmakasya kratoḥ sarvayāgeṣvanuvartana eva sāphalyāt| anyathā vaiphalyāt| jyāyastvaṃ| tathā bhūmatvasya sarvajñatrānaṃdādiṣu sahabhāvenopāsana eveṣṭaphalasiddherjyāyastvāt| ataḥ sarvairānaṃdādyāḥ purṇaguṇatvenopāsyā iti na laukikatayopāsanamiti siddhaṃ || || iti bhūmādhikaraṇaṃ || atrādhikāriṇāṃ bhūmaguṇasya nānāprakāreṇa pratīteḥ samarthyate| <3-3-60> || nānā śabdādibhedāt || nanu sarveṣāṃ bhūmatvamekaprakāreṇaiva pratīyate| bhūmatve viśeṣābhāvāt| viśeṣābhāve'pi tāratamyena pratītyaṃgīkāre mithyopāsanaprasaṃga ityekaprakāreṇopāsyatvānnoktatāratamyamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || nānāśabdādibhedāditi || asyārthaḥ || bhūmaguṇaḥ sarvairyathāyogyaṃ nānāprākareṇopāsyaḥ| natvekaprakāreṇa| kutaḥ| śabdādibhedāt śabdādipramāṇairadhikāribhedāt| bhūmaguṇasya nānāprakāreṇa pratīterityarthaḥ || evaṃca nānāprakāreṇaiva bhūmatvasya pratīteḥ| śabdādibhiḥ pramāṇaistatpratītereveṣṭavyatvāt| śabdādīnāṃ ca tattadyogyatānusāreṇārthapratyāyakatvāt| na ca bhūmatve viśeṣānupapattiḥ| ānaṃtye tāratamyavadbhūmatve tāratamyopapatteḥ| ato bhūmatvadṛṣṭāvadhikāriṇāṃ viśeṣasadbhāvādyuktaṃ tāratamyamiti siddhaṃ || || iti nānāśabdādhikaraṇaṃ || atra biṃbātiriktarūpopāsanasyākartavyatā nirasyate| <3-3-61> || vikalpo viśiṣṭaphalatvāt || nanu nādhikāriṇā nṛsiṃhādyupāsanaṃ kāryaṃ| tasya mokṣahetutvābhāvāt| phalāṃtarasyānapekṣitatvāt| pratyuta biṃbopāsanavirodhitvācca| tataśca tatpratipādakavidyāvairthyamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || vikalpo viśiṣṭaphalatvāditi || asyārthaḥ || vikalpaḥ svasvamokṣasādhanānyanṛsiṃhādyupāsanaṃ kāryaṃ na veti dvividhaprakāraḥ syāt| kutaḥ| viśiṣṭaphalatvāt| tathopāsanasya duritanivṛttirūpaphalaviśeṣamapekṣya kartavyatvena tadanusāreṇa vikalpasyaiva yuktatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca nṛsiṃhādyupāsanasya na kartavyeti na bhavati kiṃtu biṃbopāsanamanuṣṭhāya viśiṣṭaphalāpekṣācetkartavyaṃ| na cenna kartavyamiti vikalpaḥ| na ca nṛsiṃhādyupāsanābhāve duritanivṛttyasiddhiḥ| dvitīyayā svabiṃbopāsanayā'pi duritanivṛttisiddheḥ| tataścānyopāsanasyāpi kartavyatvānna tadvidyāyā vaiyarthyamiti siddhaṃ || || iti vikalpādhikaraṇaṃ || atra jñānasādhanopāsanasyaivāvaśyakatvaṃ na kāmasādhanabhagavadrūpaguṇaviṣayopāsanasyeti sādhyate| <3-3-62> || kāmyāstu yathākāmaṃ samuccīyeranna vā pūrvahetvabhāvāt || nanu kāmasādhanabhagavadrūpopāsanaṃ tadanuguṇopasaṃhāreṇāvaśyakaṃ| tatsādhyasya dhanāderjñānahetutvāt| ataḥ kāmyopāsanasyāvaśyakatvād‌vyarthaḥ prathama pāda iti prāpte sūtramupanyasyati || || kāmyāstu yathākāmaṃ samuccīyeranna vā pūrvahetvabhāvāditi || asyārtha || kāmyāstu kāmyarūpe kāmitasādhanabhagavadguṇāstu| yathākāmaṃ svasvaphale kāmānusāreṇa| samuccīyeranna vā amumukṣubhirupasaṃhartavyāḥ mumukṣubhistu nopasaṃhartavyā iti| vā vyavasthitavikalpaḥ syāt| kutaḥ| pūrvahetvabhāvāt mumukṣūṇāṃ mokṣecchāpūrvakālīnapūrvasūtroktānyakāmākhyahetvabhāvāt| evaṃ mumukṣubhireveśvaraprītyarthamupasaṃhāryā phalārthaṃ nopasaṃhāryā iti vā vikalpaḥ syādityarthaḥ || evaṃca kāmasādhanarūpe kāmasādhanaguṇāḥ svasvakāmānusāreṇopasaṃhartavyā na veti vikalpa eva na tu niyatiḥ| vikalpaścāmumukṣubhiḥ kāryaṃ mumukṣubhirneti| mumukṣūṇāṃ ca kāmanāvirahāt| athavā mumukṣuṣvevāyaṃ vikalpaḥ| phalārthaṃ na kāryaṃ| īśvaraprasādārthaṃ kāryamiti| ataḥ kāmanopāsanasya vaikalpikatvena sārthakyaṃ vairāgyapādasyeti siddhaṃ || || iti kāmādhikaraṇaṃ || atrāṃgāśritatvena devatopāsteḥ kartavyatā samarthyate| <3-3-63> || aṃgeṣu yathā''śrayabhāvaḥ || nanu nāṃgāśritadevatopāsanaṃ mumukṣuṇā kartavyaṃ| adhikāriviśeṣaṃ lakṣīkṛtya tatphaloddeśenānabhihitatvāt| na caivamapyadhikāriviśeṣaḥ kalpayituṃ śakyaḥ| kalpakābhāvāt| na ca kalpakābhāve'pi kalpanā yuktā| codanādyaviśeṣādityuktavyāghātāt| tataśca niradhikārikatvādaṃgāśritatvena devatopāsanaṃ na kartavyamiti prāpte pariharatsūtramāha || || aṃgeṣu yathā''śrayabhāva iti || asyārthaḥ || aṃgeṣu bhagavadaṃgeṣu| yathā''śrayabhāvaḥ cakṣoḥ sūryo'jāyatetyādau yathā yathā''śrayatvamuktaṃ tathā tairupāsanaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ || evaṃca cakṣoḥ sūryo'jāyatetyādinā yathā yathā bhagavadaṃgāśrayatvamuktaṃ tathopāsanaṃ kāryaṃ| anyathā taduktivaiyarthyāt| ato devānāmaṃgāśritatvenopāsyatvātsārthakyaṃ tadvidhānamiti siddhaṃ || <3-3-64> || śiṣṭeśca || yuktyaṃtareṇa devānāmaṃgāśritatvenopāstimabhidadhatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || śiṣṭeśceti || asyārthaḥ || yasminniti śrutivihitatvācca tathopāsanaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ || evaṃca na kevalaṃ cakṣorityādāvaṃgāśrayatvenoktyanyathā'nupapattyāṃ'gāśritatvenopāstiḥ kāryā| kiṃtu śikṣāvidhāyaka yasminneti śrutau tathā vidhānātkāryā| ata uktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <3-3-65> || samāhārāt || nanu niradhikārikatvāttadvidhānādivaiyarthyasyaivocitatvācca nāṃgadevatopāsanaṃ yuktamityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtramupanyasyati || || samāhārāditi || asyārthaḥ || samāhāraśabdenopasaṃhāraphalaśrutirgṛhyate| devānāṃ svasvajanakāṃgatvarūpaguṇopasaṃhāre phalavacanācca| taistathopasaṃhṛtyopāsanaṃ kartavyamityarthaḥ || evaṃca kāṣāyaṇānāṃ samāharaśrutivacanātsaṃhareteti samāhārapadaghaṭitaśruteraṃgadevatopāsanasya paramasthānarūpasāyujyaprāptilakatvāvagamāt| niradhikārikatvābhāvena tadvidhānādivaiyrathyakalpanāyā abhāvena ca devairevāṃgadevatopāstiḥ kāryeti siddhaṃ || <3-3-66> || guṇasādhāraṇyaśruteśca || hetvaṃtareṇāṃgadevatopāsanasya kartavyatāṃ samarthayatsūtramupanyasyati || || guṇasādhāraṇyaśruteśceti || asyārthaḥ || guṇānāṃ bhagavad‌guṇānāṃ| sādhāraṇyasya sarvopāsyatvasya| śruteḥ sādhāraṇyāditi śrutyuktatvācca| devaistathopāsanaṃ kāryamityarthaḥ || evaṃca jñānānaṃdādiguṇānāṃ sūryādyāśrayacakṣuṣṭ‌vādīnāṃ bhagavadguṇatvāt| bhagavadguṇānāṃ copāsyatvenaite upāsyā ete tu neti vibhāgaṃ vihāya yogyānāṃ sarveṣāmupāsyatvasya nirdiṣṭaśrutāvuktatvāt| atrāṃgāśritatvena devatopāsanaṃ| devatāśrayatvena tadguṇabiṃbaguṇatvena ca paramātmopāsanaṃ| tayoḥ samaniyatatvāt| samāhārāt, guṇasādhāraṇyaśruteḥ, darśanācca, ityeteṣāṃ virodhābhāvāt| devairāṃgāśritatvenāṃgadavatābhāvanāyāḥ kartavyatvāt| ato devānāṃ bhagavadaṃgāśritatvenopāsanamuktamupapannamiti siddhaṃ || || iti aṃgādhikaraṇaṃ || atrāṃgadevatopāsteḥ sarvaśākhānuktatvena prāptakartavyatvaśaṃkānirāsena kartavyatā samarthyate| <3-3-67> || na vā'tatsahabhāvaśruteḥ || nanu bhagavadaṃgāśrayatvenopāsanaṃ na kenāpi kartavyaṃ| tathopāsanasya tattadyogyaguṇopāsananirūpaṇaparāsu sarvaśākhāsu tattadyogyaguṇopāsanaiḥ sahānuktatvāt| atoṃ'gadevatopāsanasyākartavyatvāduktamayuktamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || na vā'tatsahabhāvaśruteriti || asyārthaḥ || aṃgadevatopāsanaṃ devānyairna kāryaṃ| kiṃtu devaireveti vā vyavasthitavikalpaḥ syāt| kutaḥ| atatsahabhāvaśruteḥ| tatsaha śruterabhāvāt| sarvaśākhāgataguṇopāsanena sahāṃgadevatopāsanasya śravaṇādityarthaḥ || evaṃca na kartavya eva sarvairbhagavadaṃgeṣu aṃgadevatopasaṃhāraḥ| kiṃ nāma devaireva kartavyaḥ| sarvaśākhāsvanukteḥ kvacidevokteḥ| ato devānāṃ bhagavadaṃgāśritatvenopāsanamuktamupapannamiti siddhaṃ || <3-3-68> || darśanācca || devaireva bhagavadaṃgāśritatvenopāsanaṃ kartavyaṃ nānyairityetamevārthaṃ yuktisiddhaṃ śrutyā'pi samarthayatsūtraṃ paṭhitvā tāṃ śrutimudāharati sūtrakṛt || || darśanācceti || asyārthaḥ || satyo jñāna iti śrutau asyārthasya darśanāt uktatvācca devairevāṃgadevatopāstiḥ kāryā nānyairityarthaḥ || evaṃca na kevalaṃ yukteḥ kiṃtu satyo jñāna iti śruteścāṃgadevatopasaṃhāro devetarairna kiṃtu deveraiva kāryaḥ| ato devānāṃ bhagavadaṃgāśritatvenopāsanamuktamupapannameveti siddhaṃ || || iti na vā'dhikaraṇaṃ || || iti tṛtīyādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ || <3.4> || śrīḥ || || hariḥ || || ata caturthaḥ pādaḥ || jñānasāmarthyamasminpāda ucyate || atra jñānasya sarvapuruṣārthasādhanatvamahimā varṇyate| <3-4-1> || puruṣārtho'taḥ śabdāditi bādarāyaṇaḥ || nanu jñānaṃ mokṣamātrasādhanaṃ| na svargādipuruṣārthāṃtarasya| jñānino mokṣetarapuruṣārthe kāmanāviruddhatvāt| akāmitapuruṣārthatve cāniṣṭapuṇyavanmokṣavilaṃbahetutvena puruṣārthatvameva na syāt| ato jñānasya mokṣamātrahetutvātsarvapuruṣārthasādhanatvabudhdyā na tadāpādyamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || puruṣārtho'taḥ śabdāditi bādarāyaṇaḥ iti || asyārthaḥ || puruṣairarthyamānaṃ yacchubhaphalaṃ tatsarvamapi| ataḥ brahmadarśanādbhavati| na tu mokṣamātraṃ| kutaḥ| śabdāt yaṃ yamiti śruteriti bhagavān bādarāyaṇo manyata ityarthaḥ || evaṃca jñānena yāvadapekṣitaṃ bhavati tatsarvamāpyate| na tu mokṣamātraṃ| yaṃ yaṃ lokamiti śruteḥ| na ca parīśya lokāniti prajahāti yadeti ca śrutibhyāṃ jñānināṃ kāmābhāvasyoktatvena kāmitaṃ jñānena bhavatītyuktamiti vācyaṃ| prāyaḥ kāmābhāvasya śrutyādyurthatvena sarvathā kāmābhāvasyātadarthatvāt| iti bādarāyaṇo manyate| ato jñānasya sarvapuruṣārthasādhanatvādatyaṃtāpekṣitaṃ taditi siddhaṃ || <3-4-2> || śeṣatvātpuruṣārthavādo yathā'nyeṣviti jaiminiḥ || nanu karmaiva puruṣārthasādhanaṃ na jñānamityākṣipya samādadhatsūtramāha || || śeṣatvātpuruṣārthavādo yathā'nyeṣviti jaiminiriti || asyārthaḥ || śeṣatvāt jñānasya karmāṃgatvāt| nimittādeva puruṣārthavādaḥ yaṃ yamiti śrutau jñānasya svargādipuruṣārthasādhanatvavādaḥ na tu mokṣa iva svargādau prādhānyāt| tatakthaṃ| yathā anyeṣu svargasādhanakarmaśeṣabhūteṣu dhanādiṣu| yathā svargaṃ dhanāditi prādhānyavādaḥ| tatheti naiminirācāryo manyata ityarthaḥ || evaṃca brahmadarśanasya mokṣasādhanatvasadbhāvena svargādiṣu sādhanatvābhāvāt| yaṃ yaṃ lokamiti śruteḥ karmaṇaiva sidhyati svarge'tiśayādhāyakatvarūpataccheṣārthatvena puruṣārathavādāvirodhāt| iti jaiminirācāryo manyate| ato jñānasya sarvapuruṣārthasādhanatvamiti siddhaṃ || <3-4-3> || ācāradarśanāt || nanu śrutibalātjñānasyaiva sarvapuruṣārthasādhanatvaṃ yuktaṃ| tataśca jñānasyaiva sarvapuruṣārthasādhanatvena kutaḥ śruterarthāṃtaraparikalpanetyāśaṃkāṃ parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || ācāra darśanāditi || asyārthaḥ || yajñena yajñamiti devānāmapi karmānuṣṭhānaśruteśca na jñānādeva sarvapuruṣārthaprāptirityarthaḥ || evaṃca jñānināmeva na tu jñānarahitānāṃ devāditvaprāptānāṃ karmānuṣṭhānasya śravaṇāt| devādikarmānuṣṭhānavaiyarthyaprasaṃgāt| ato na jñānādeva sarvapuruṣārthaprāptiriti siddhaṃ || <3-4-4> || tacchruteḥ || nanvevamastu jñānakarmaṇorubhayorapi svargasādhanatvaṃ| jñānasya karmaśeṣatvaṃ tu kuta ityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || tacchruteriti || asyārthaḥ || yadeva vidyayeti jñānasya karmaśeṣatvaśruterna tatpradhānamityarthaḥ || evaṃca nirdiṣṭā śrutirbādarāyaṇamate mānuṣaviṣayā tatkartṛkajñānaśeṣatvavādinī pratibaṃdhakayuktadevatāviṣayā cetītyabhiprāyakatvāt| jñāninā jñānena kṛtakarmaṇo'dhikaphalasādhanatvāt| ataḥ karmaśeṣatvaśruterna pradhānamiti siddhaṃ || <3-4-5> || samanvāraṃbhaṇāt || nanu yathā jñānasya yaṃ yamiti śrutamapi prādhānyaṃ na svīkriyate| kiṃtu śeṣatvameva| tathā yadeva vidyayeti śrutamapi karmaṇaḥ prādhānyaṃ nāṃgīkāryaṃ! kiṃ nāma jñānaśeṣatvaṃ karmaṇaḥ sāmyaṃ vā bhavet| viśeṣapramāṇābhāvādityāśaṃkāṃ parākurvatsūtramāha || || samanvāraṃbhaṇāditi || asyārthaḥ || na karmaṇaḥ jñānaśeṣatvaṃ| tatsāmyaṃ ca| kiṃtu prādhānyaṃ| kutaḥ| samanvāraṃbhaṇāt| karmaiveti prādhānyena svargādyāraṃbhakatvaśruterityarthaḥ || evaṃca jñānottarakālīnaṃ śubhāśubhaṃ karmaiva manuṣyāṇāmeva devaloke jyotirmayadehaṃ mānuṣaṃ vā dehaṃ pratibaṃdhakayuktadevānāṃ cobhayaṃ dehamanvārabhet| karmātiriktajñānādiḥ śarīrādyutpādane prādhānyena kāraṇaṃ na bhavati| kiṃtu karmaśeṣatayaiva kāraṇaṃ bhavati| ato na karmaṇo jñānaśeṣatvaṃ kiṃtu prādhānyamiti siddhaṃ || <3-4-6> || tadvato vidhānāt || nanu tathā'pi na jñānasya karmaśeṣatvaṃ yuktaṃ| kiṃtu svayameva puruṣārtha hetuḥ| kasmāt| karmaṇāṃ phalābhāvāt| phalābhāvepyācārastu muktavallīlayā bhavedityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtraṃ vyācaṣṭe || || tadvato vidhānāditi || asyārthaḥ || tadvataḥ vidhānāt jñānī ca karmāṇīti karmavidhānāt na jñānikarma līlārūpamityarthaḥ || evaṃca jñānau ca karmāṇīti jñānino'pi karmavidhānena phalasiddheḥ| jñānikṛtakarmaphalābhāvaśrutistu duṣkarmaviṣayā| evameva viditi vacanāt| ato jñānikṛtakarma na līlārūpamiti siddhaṃ || <3-4-7> || niyamācca || itaśca jñānikṛtakarma na līlāmātrīmatyabhidadhatsūtramupanyasyati || || niyamācceti || asyārthaḥ || jñānino'pi karmaniyamākaraṇe pratyavāyasya ca kurvanniti śruteśca| na jñānikarma līlārūpamityarthaḥ || evaṃca karmakaraṇena pāpalepābhāvena bhagavatpūjātvena karmakaraṇasyāvaśyakatvāt| api ca karmākaraṇe evaṃ tvayīti vacanātpratyavāyaśravaṇāt| ato jñānikarma na līlāmātramiti siddhaṃ || <3-4-8> || adhikopadeśāttu bādarāyaṇasyaivaṃ taddarśanāt || evaṃ jaiminimatāvalaṃbena ccedite svamataṃ samarthayatsūtramupanyasyati || || adhikopadeśāttu bādarāyaṇasyaivaṃ taddarśanāditi || asyārthaḥ || tu śabdo vyāsamataviśeṣadyotakaḥ| bādarāyaṇasya tvevaṃ jñānādeva sarvapuruṣārthaprāptirityevaṃ mataṃ| kutaḥ| adhikopadeśāt| adhikasya jñānajanyamokṣe karmādhīnātiśayasya| jñānādeveti śrutāvuktatvāt| kiṃca taddarśanācca| tasya jñānajanyaphale karmajanyātiśayasya rājasūyādinā yudhiṣṭhirādāvupalaṃbhāccetyarthaḥ| atra bhagavanmataṃ devatāniṣṭhajñānaviṣayaṃ| daiminyādimataṃ tadyamanuṣyaniṣṭhajñānaviṣayaṃ| ato na virodha iti jñeyaṃ || evaṃca jñānasyaiva sarvapuruṣārthasādhanatvāt| jñānādeveti śrutau tathābhidhānāt| yudhiṣṭhirādīnāṃ jñānenaiva sidhyati puruṣārthe karmaṇātiśayadarśanāt| ato jñānādeva devānāṃ svargādiphalasya karmaṇastu tatrātiśayādhāyakatvena jñānaśeṣatvasya siddhatvenācārādervaiyarthyābhāvādvidhyanupapatterabhāvāt| jñānādeva sarvapuruṣārthaprāptiriti bādarāyaṇamatasya sadbhāvāt| ato jñānasya sarvapuruṣārthasādhanatvenātyaṃtāpekṣitaṃ taditi siddhaṃ || <3-4-9> || tulyaṃ tu darśanaṃ || nanvastu jñānasya sarvapuruṣārthahetutvaṃ karmaṇastu taccheṣatvaṃ| śeṣatvaṃ ca na jñānaphale'tiśayādhāyakatvena| nāpi tadutpattyupayogitvena taduttarabhāvitvāt| kiṃtu jñānena phale sādhayitavye sāmarthyasaṃpādakatayā jñāne'tiśayādhāyakatveneti kiṃ na syādityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || tulyaṃ tu darśanamiti || asyārthaḥ || jñānikarma na jñāne'tiśayakṛt| kiṃtu jñānaphala eva| kutaḥ| yato darśanaṃ jñānaṃ| tulyaṃ tu karmakaraṇākaraṇayoḥ samānameva| ata itvarthaḥ || evaṃca jñānikarma na jñāne'tiśayādhāyakaṃ| kiṃtu jñānaphala eva| karmakaraṇākaraṇayorjñānasya samatvāt| anyathā karmābhāve jñānasya puruṣārthahetutvaṃ na syāt| nāpi jaiminimatasthāprāmāṇyaṃ| tasya bhagavanmataikadeśatvena prāmāṇyāt| na ca visaṃvādidvayoḥ prāmāṇyāyogaḥ| bhagavanmatasya devatāviṣayatvāt| jaiminimatasya pratibaddhadevatāviṣayatvena mānuṣaviṣayatvena vā'virodhāt| ato jñānasya sarvapuruṣārthasādhanatvādatyaṃtāpekṣitaṃ taditi siddhaṃ || || iti puruṣārthādhikaraṇaṃ || atra jñāne sarveṣāmadhikārābhāvo varṇyate| <3-4-10> || asārvatrikī || nanvasti sarveṣāmapi jñāne'dhikāraḥ| tadupayogino'rthitvādeḥ sarvatra saulabhyāt| satyapyadhikāraprayojake kasyacidadhikāre kasyāpi na syāditi niradhikāritāprasaṃgaḥ| athavā| puruṣairarthyamānajñānasādhyasya mokṣasya tadapekṣitatvāt| sarveṣāṃ jñānasādhane śravaṇādau sāmarthyāttadupayogividvattāsadbhāvāt| ataḥ sarveṣāṃ jñānādhikāritvānnatadatiśayavaditi prāpte sūtritaṃ || || asārvatrikīti || asyārthaḥ || jñānādhikaritā sarvajanasthitānetyarthaḥ || evaṃca na sarveṣāṃ jñānādhikāra iti siddhaṃ || <3-4-11> || vibhāgaḥ śatavat || nanvarthitvādeḥ sarveṣāṃ sadbhāvātkathaṃ nādhikāritetyāśaṃkāṃ parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || vibhāgaḥ śatavaditi || asyārthaḥ || vibhāgaḥ keṣāṃcitjñānādhikāritā anyevāṃ neti vibhāgaḥ| śatavat parāparabrahmādhikadevatāśatasyaiva somādhikāraḥ nānyeṣāmiti vibhāgavat nava kāṭyo hītyādāvuktatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca satyapi devatve brahmadvayādhikaśatānāmeva somādhikāra iti vibhāgaḥ| tathā satyapyārthatve keṣāṃcidadhikāro na sarveṣāmityabhiprāyakatvāt| ato jñāne sarveṣāmadhikārābhāvenātiśayitaṃ taditi siddhaṃ || <3-4-12> || adhyayanamātravataḥ || nanu yadyarthitvādisāmye'pi na sarveṣāmadhikārastarhi kasyāpyasau na syāt| yadi keṣāṃcidadhikāro'sti tarhyarthitvād‌vyatiriktādhikāraprayojakaviśeṣaṇasya vaktavyatvāt| na ca tastīti sarveṣāṃ jñānādhikāritvānna tadatiśayavaditi prāpte sūtramāha || || adhyayanamātravata iti || asyārthaḥ || yathāśakti sarvavedādhyayanavato brahmavidyādhikāritā nānvasyetyarthaḥ || evaṃca haribhaktipūrvakādhyayanavatāmeva grahaṇāt| na cābhaktasyānadhikāritve caturmukhasya virocanādhyāpane kathaṃ pravṛttiriti na śaṃkyaṃ| abhaktānāmanadhikāritayā tadadhyayanasya vaiphalyameveti jñāpanāyādhyāpanopapatteḥ| paṭhedvedāniti śruteśca| ato jñāne sarveṣāmadikārābhāvādatiśayitaṃ taditi siddhaṃ || || iti asārvatrikādhikaraṇaṃ || atra jñānādhikāre tāratamyaṃ samarthyate| <3-4-13> || nāviśeṣāt || nanu sarveṣāmekaprakāreṇaiva jñānādhikāraḥ| adhikāratāratamyakalpanābhāvāt| na ca jñānatāratamyānyathā'nupapattyā tatsiddhiḥ| adhikārasāmye'pi prayatnatāratamyādeva tatsiddheḥ| ato na jñānaṃ karmaṇaḥ sakāśādatiśayavaditi prāpte sūtritaṃ || || nāviśeṣāditi || asyārthaḥ || devādīnāṃ jñānādhikāritā| aviśeṣāt sāmyāt| na| kiṃtu tāratamyādinetyarthaḥ || evaṃca devādīnāṃ sāmye na jñānādhikārābhāvaḥ| anyathā jñānasāmyaprasaṃgāt| na ca śaktitāratamyena jñānatāratamyamupapannaṃ| adhikāratāratamyābhāve bhaktitāratamyasyaivāyogāt| ataḥ saṃpūrṇajñānādhikārasya sarvasulabhatvābhāvena sātiśayaṃ jñānamiti siddhaṃ || || iti aviśeṣādhikaraṇaṃ || atra jñānināṃ sadasatpravṛttyorviśeṣaḥ sādhyate| <3-4-14> || stutaye'numatirvā || nanu na sadasatpravṛttibhyāṃ jñānino viśeṣo'sti kena syādyena syāditi yatheṣṭhapravṛttividhānāt| na hi mokṣādatiśayitaṃ phalamasti| yatsatpravṛttyā bhavet| nāpi mokṣe duḥkhamasti| yadasatpravṛttyā bhavet| ataḥ sadasatpravṛttibhyāṃ jñānino viśeṣābhāvenādyādhikāriṇoktaṃ karmaṇo jñānaviśeṣatvamayuktamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || stutaye'numativeti || asyārthaḥ || jñāninaḥ sadasatpravṛttyorviśeṣo'styeva| kutaḥ| yataḥ yatheṣṭhācāro jñānī mucyata eveti jñānistutaya eva yena syātkena syādityucyate| anumatirvā jñānināṃ yatheṣṭhācāre'bhyanujñāmātraṃ vā na tvatra yatheṣṭhācāravidhirata ityarthaḥ || evaṃca kena syādyena syādityasya niṣedhaśāstrābaddhatayā jñāninaḥ stutitvenāvidhitvāt| athavā'numatimātrametat| ato'styeva jñānināṃ sadasatpravṛttibhyāṃ viśeṣa iti siddhaṃ || <3-4-15> || kāmakāreṇa caike || nanu sadasatpravṛttibhyāṃ jñānino viśeṣāṃgīkāro na yujyate| tathā satyasatpravṛttyā kuṃṭhitaśakterjñānasya mokṣasādhanatvābhāvaprasaṃgāt| tathā ca sadasatpravṛttibhyāṃ kathaṃ viśeṣo yujyata iti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || kāmakāreṇa caika iti || asyārthaḥ || eke śākhinaḥ| kāmakāreṇa ca yatheṣṭhācāreṇāpi jñānināṃ mokṣaṃ kāmacārā iti śrutau paṭhaṃti| ato na jñāninaḥ sadasatpravṛttyormokṣahāniḥ kiṃtu phale viśeṣamātramastītyarthaḥ || evaṃca kāmacārā iti vacanātjñānināṃ yatheṣṭhācāre'pi mokṣābhidhānenāsatpravṛtterapratibaṃdhakatvātteṣāṃ sadasatpravṛttibhyāṃ viśeṣo'stīti siddhaṃ || <3-4-16> || upamardaṃ ca || sadasatpravṛttibhyāṃ jñānino viśeṣo'stītīdameva sādhyaṃ kaimutyena sādhayatsūtraṃ paṭhitvā ca śabdasya viṣabhakṣānmṛterivānivāryatayā prāptasya prārabdhakarmaṇo'pītyevamapyarthatvena kaimutyadyotakatvamabhipretyavyācaṣṭe || || upamardaṃ ceti || ca śabdo'pyarthaḥ || yadā jñāninaḥ prārabdhakarmaṇo'pi kiṃcid‌bhuktasya jñāninopamardaṃ īṣatphalahrāsaṃ| omityuccāryeti śrutāveke sākhinaḥ paṭhaṃti tadā jñānottara kālonāsatkarma na mokṣapratibaṃdhakamiti kiṃ varṇanāyamityarthaḥ || evaṃca prārabdhasyāpi pāpasyopamardenomityuccāryeti śrutau mokṣaḥ śrūyate| tataśca jñānikṛtapāpasya mokṣāpratibaṃdhakatvamityanāyāsena siddhaṃ || <3-4-17> || ūrdhvaretaḥsu ca śabde hi || nanu yadikāmacārāṇāmapi jñānināṃ muktiyogyatā tarhi tadvajjijñāsūnāmapi kāmacārāṇāṃ jñānādhikāraḥ sthāt| aviśeṣāt| tathā cādhyayanamātravata ityuktasya viṣṇubhaktiśamadamādivatāmevādhikāra ityasya bādhaḥ syādityāśaṃkāmapākurvatsūtraṃ
