paṭhati || || ūrdhvaretaḥ su ca śabde hīti || asyārthaḥ || kāmacārāṇāmapi jñānināṃ muktyādhikāravatkāmacārāṇāṃ jijñāsūnāṃ na jñānādhikāraḥ| kutaḥ| hi yasmāt| śabde ya imamivi śrutāvūrdhvaretatsvādi guṇavatsveva jñānopadeśo vihitaḥ| tasmādityarthaḥ || evaṃca nirdiṣṭaśrutyā gurukulavāsabrahmacaryāparaparyāyordhvaretastvādi guṇavatsveva jñānopadeśasya vihitatvātkāmacārāṇāṃ jijñāsūnāṃ sutarāmaparokṣajñānādhikārābhāvena teṣāmaparokṣajñānādhikārābhāvatvamiti siddhaṃ || <3-4-18> || parāmarśaṃ jaiminiracodanā cāpavadati hi || evaṃ kenasyādityasya yatheṣṭhācāravidhitvamanaṃgīkṛtya stutyanumatirūpārthāvuktau| adhunā yatheṣṭhācāravidhitvānaṃgīkāreṇaiva yajjaimininā'rthāṃtaramuktaṃ tatpratipādayatsūtramupanyasyati || || parāmarśaṃ jaiminiracodanā cāpavadati hīti || asyārthaḥ || jaiminiḥ parāmarśaṃ yena syāditi vākye prātarutthāyetyādiśrutyuktasadācārasyaiva grahaṇamabhyupetyātra sadācārasyaiva svecchayā niyamenācaraṇaṃ pratipādyaṃ| na tu niṣiddhasya karaṇamiti manyate| kutaḥ| hi yasmāt| acodanā aniṣiddhaṃ jñāninā kāryamiti vidhyabhāvaḥ apavadati ca pratyuta brāhmaṇo na haṃtavya iti śrutiḥ vikarma niṣedhati ca iti| tasmādityarthaḥ || evaṃca prātarutthāyātha saṃdhyāmupāsītetyādinā jñānino saṃdhyāvaṃdanādyacāraparāmarśādvidhibaṃdhavarjitvena kāmacāraṇameva yena syāditi śrutyā cocyate| na tu niṣiddhaṃ kartavyameveti vidhīyate| brahmaṇo na haṃtavya ityapavāda śravaṇāt| ato jñānināṃ sadasatpravṛttibhyāṃ viśeṣa iti siddhaṃ || <3-4-19> || anuṣṭheyaṃ bādarāyaṇaḥ sāmyaśruteḥ || evaṃ yena syāditi vākyasya jaiminimatānusāreṇa svecchayā sadācāravidhitvamevoktvā yatstutaye'numatirvetyuktamabhyanujñānaṃ tadeva kāmacāraśrutyarthatayā pratipādayatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || anuṣṭheyaṃ bādarāyaṇaḥ sāmyaśruteriti || asyārthaḥ || bādarāyaṇaḥ bhagavān bādarāyaṇastu| anuṣṭheyaṃ svecchayā śrutyādyuktānuṣṭhānayogyakiṃcitkarmācaraṇābhyanujñānameva yena syāditi śruterarthaḥ| natu sarvakarmakaraṇāya yatheṣṭhācāravidhireveti manyate| kutaḥ| sāmyuteḥ| kenāpi prakāreṇa pravṛttāvapi īdṛśa eveti jñāninaḥ sāmyokteḥ || evaṃcānuṣṭheyānāṃ madhye kāmacāro yasminkaravāṇīti kāmastasyānucaraṇaṃ yasminna karavāṇīti kāmastasyānācaraṇamityevānuṣṭheye kāmacārānumatereva na tu sarveṣāṃ kāmacārasya yena syāditi śrutāvuktatvāt| jñāninaḥ karaṇākaraṇayoryena syāditi sāmyaśruteḥ | iti bādarāyaṇo manyate| ato jñāninaḥ sadasatpravṛttibhyāṃ viśeṣa iti siddhaṃ || <3-4-20> || vidhirvā dhāraṇavat || evaṃ kena syāditi vākyasya yatheṣṭhācāravidhitvābhāvamabhyupetya niyamena sarvadācāravidhitvamanuṣṭheyānāṃ madhye kāmacārābhyanujñānamityarthadvayaṃ stutyanumatirūpārthadvayaṃ coktaṃ| adhunā svecchācāraṇavidhirvā bhavatītyarthapratipādakaṃ sūtramupanyasyati || || vidhirvā dhāraṇavaditi || asyārthaḥ || yathā veda dhāraṇavidheḥ traivarṇikādhikārikatvameva na tu sarvādhikārikatvaṃ| tathā vidhiḥ jñānināmeva yena syāditi svecchācāravidhiḥ natvajñānināmityarthaḥ| vā śabdaḥ prāguktapakṣadvayāt asya pakṣāṃtarāvadyotakaḥ || evaṃca traivarṇikānāṃ vedavidhidhāraṇavadyena syāditi svecchācāravidherjñānināmeva sadbhāvāt| tataścoktaṃ yuktameveti siddhaṃ || <3-4-21> || stutimātramupādānāditi cennāpūrvatvāt || uktamākṣipya samādadhatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || stutimātramupādānamiti cennāpūrvatvāditi || asyārthaḥ || kena syāditi vākyaṃ pūrvoktamtutireva na svecchācaraṇavidhiḥ| kutaḥ| upādānāt jñānibhirapi saṃdhyāmupāsītetyādisādhāraṇavidhasvīkārāditi cenna| kutaḥ| apūrvatvāt a śabdavācyaparamātmādhīnatvādityarthaḥ || tathā ca jñāninaḥ svecchācaraṇavidherapyabhāve sarvavidhyatidūratvaprasaṃgena paramātmādhīnatvaṃ na syāditi bhāvaḥ || evaṃca viriṃcasya pūrvamanādibrahmatvābhāvena parabrahmaṇo vaśagatvāt| anādibhinnasya kasmāccidutpatterāvaśyakatve tasya tadadhīnatvāt| sarvavidhiniṣedhagocaratvena vidhiviṣayatvaṃ vinā stumimātraviṣayatvasya brahmaṇyeva sattvāt| vidhīnāṃ viṣayā iti vacanāt| ata uktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || || <3-4-22> || bhāvaśabdācca || nanu jñānināṃ svecchācaraṇavidheḥ sphuṭapramāṇasiddhatve bhavet yena syāditi vākyaṃ svecchācaraṇavidhyarthakaṃ| vidheḥ sphuṭapramāṇasiddhatvameva kuta ityāśaṃkāyāṃ sūtramupanyasyati || || bhāvaśabdāccetina || asyārthaḥ || bhāvaḥ icchābhāvaśabdaghaṭita yathā vidhānamiti śruteśca kena syādityayaṃ kāmacāra vidhirityarthaḥ || evaṃca kena syādityasya vidhyati dūratvena jñāninaḥ stutitve saṃdhyāvaṃdanādisāmānyavidhyabhāvasyānane vākyenoktatvāt| svecchācaraṇavidheśca vādinā'naṃgīkārāt| sarvavidhyatidūratvena stutitvaprasaṃgāt| na ca tadiṣṭaṃ| tasyeśvaradharmatvāt| ata uktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <3-4-23> || pāriplavārthā iti cenna viśeṣitatvāt || nanu kena syāditi vākyasya prātarutthāyeti vākyānusāreṇa jaiminimatamavalaṃbya jñānibhiḥ samastaṃ kāryamityuktaṃ| tathā ca yastvātmaratiriti vākyānusāreṇa svecchācaraṇānujñānamartha uktaḥ| punaśca yathāpi vidhānamityādyanusāreṇa svecchācaraṇavidhāyakatvamuktaṃ| tataścaivaṃ vākyaṃ na kasyāpyarthasya niścāyakaṃ syāditi prāpte sūtritaṃ || || pāriplavārthā iti cenna viśeṣitatvāditi || asyārthaḥ || niyamena sarvadharmācaraṇavidhipakṣasyānuṣṭheyānāṃ madhye svecchayā katipayadharmācaraṇābhyanujñānapakṣasya svecchācaraṇavidhipakṣasya ca parasparaviruddhatvāt| yenasyādityādayaḥ pāriplavārthāḥ avyavasthitārthakā iti cenna| kutaḥ| viśeṣitatvāt tredhā hi jñāninā iti śrutau jñānināṃ vidhiniyatādi padairviśeṣitatvena teṣāmanekaprakāratvasyoktatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca jñānināṃ trividhatvena tadadhikārānusāreṇa tattanniścāyakatvasaṃbhavāt| tatra vidhiniyatāmanuṣyā aniyatā devāḥ svecchāniyatastu caturmukha iti vivekaḥ| ata uktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <3-4-24> || tathā caikavākyopabaṃdhāt || nanu jñānināmanekaprakāratvoktyā kathaṃ parihāro jāta ityāśaṃkāṃ parākurvatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || tathā caikavākyopabaṃdhāditi || asyārthaḥ || uktapakṣatrayānusārivākyānāṃ adhikāribhedamāśrityāvirodhonaikavākyatāyāḥ yuktatvāt| tathā ca śrutīnāmekavākyatve siddhe yena syāditi vākyasyāpi ekavākyopabaṃdhāt adhikāribhedena vyavasthitārthakatvopapatteḥ na pāriplavārthatvamityarthaḥ || tathā ca jaiminimataṃ manuṣyajñāniviṣayaṃ| vyāsamataṃ devatāviṣayaṃ| vidhirveti mataṃ vidhivettaviṣayamiti na virodha iti bhāvaḥ || evaṃca prātarutthāyetyādīnāṃ tathā yathā vidhānamapara iti vākyasya cāvirodhenoktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <3-4-25> || ata eva cāgnīṃdhanādyanapekṣā || evaṃ jñāninaḥ kena syāditi śrutibalena sadasatpravṛttyoḥ śaṃkito viśeṣaḥ śruterarthāṃtaroktyā parāmarśamityādinā parihṛtaḥ| tatroktaṃ jñāninaḥ sadasatpravṛttyorviśeṣe jñānasyāsatpravṛttikuṃṭhitaśaktermokṣasādhanavidhuratvaṃ kāmakāreṇa caika ityādinā parihṛtaṃ| atra tu satpravṛttyā jñānināṃ viśeṣasyāsatpravṛttisamucitameva jñānaṃ mokṣasādhanamiti tadvidhurāṇāṃ jñānināṃ mokṣo na syādityāśaṃkāṃ parākurvatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || ata evacāgnīṃdhanādyanapekṣeti || asyārthaḥ || jñānasya mokṣasādhanatve agnīṃdhanādyanapekṣā agnihotrādisatkarmasāpekṣitatvaṃ nāsti| kutaḥ| ata eva kāmacārāṇāmapi mokṣasya pramāṇasiddhatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca na brūmo vayamagnihotrādisamucitasyaiva jñānasya mokṣasādhanatvaṃ yenoktadoṣaḥ syāt| na caivaṃ| kiṃ nāma kevalasyaiva mokṣahetutvaṃ| kāmacārāṇamapi mokṣaśravaṇāt| ato jñānināṃ sadasatpravṛttibhyāṃ viśeṣasadbhāvena mokṣo niyata eveti siddhaṃ || <3-4-26> || sarvāpekṣā ca yajñādiśruterasvavat || nanvastu jñāninaḥ satpravṛttyā viśeṣaḥ| sa ca mokṣaprāptirūpa eva| nādhikyarūpaḥ| na caivaṃ jñānināṃ sukṛtau kṛtāvakṛtau ca mokṣaśrutivirodhaḥ| tatpravṛttermokṣahetutvepyasatpravṛtterapratibaṃdhakatvena tadupapatterityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtramupanyasyati || || sarvāpekṣā ca yajñādiśruterasvavaditi || asyārthaḥ || aśvavat yathā gatisādhanāśvādayaḥ gatiniṣpatyarthamevāpekṣaṃte na tatphalagrāmādiprāptyartha| tathā mokṣasādhanajñānotpattāveva| sarvāpekṣā sarvadharmāpekṣā| na tu jñānaphalamokṣe'pi| kutaḥ| yajñādiśrateḥ vivadiṣyaṃti yajñeneti śruterityarthaḥ || evaṃca jñānārthaṃ tāvatsarvakarmaṇo'pekṣitatvena teṣāṃ niṣpannajñānasya mokṣaprāptyarthamanapekṣaṇāt| tatra nirdiṣṭanidarśanasadbhāvāt| ataḥ sadasatpravṛttibhyāṃ jñānināṃ viśeṣa iti siddhaṃ || <3-4-27> || śamadamādyupetaḥ syāttathā'pi tu tadvidhestadaṃgatayā teṣāmavaśyānuṣṭheyatvāt || nanu yadi sadasatpravṛttibhyāṃ mokṣatadabhāvayorabhāvastarhi jñāninastābhyāṃ viśeṣo nāstīti na tena satkarma kāryamasatkāryaṃ tyājyaṃ| na ca tābhyāṃ mokṣe ādhikyādi bhavatītyuktamiti vācyaṃ| jñānādeveti śruterjñānādeva tadupapatterityāśaṃkāṃ parākurvatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || śamadamādyupetaḥ syāttathā'pi tu tadvidhastadaṃgatayā teṣāmavaśyānuṣṭheyatvāditi || asyārthaḥ || yadyapi jñānenaiva mokṣo niyataḥ| tathā'pi jñānī śamadamādyapetaḥ syāt śamadamādiyukto bhavet| kutaḥ| tadvidheḥ ācāryāditi śrutyā tasya jñāninaḥ śamadamādervidhānāt| tathā'pi na jñāninaḥ śamadamādivaiyarthyaṃ| kutaḥ| tadaṃgatayā jñānagaṃtayā teṣāṃ śamadamādīnāmavaśyānuṣṭheyatvāt| avaśyamanuṣṭānārhatvāt | tu śabdaḥ śamadamādeḥ pūrṇaphalārthatvaṃ sūcayati || evaṃca na ca jñānināṃ satkāryamasattyājyamityaniyamaḥ sadasadanuṣṭhānaparityāgābhyāṃ viśeṣābhāvāditi vācyaṃ| acāryādvidyāmiti māṭhara śrutau jñānino'pi tadvidhānāt| brāhmī vāveti śrutau śamadamādīnāmaṃgatvābhidhānācca| ato jñānināṃ sadasatpravṛttibhyāṃ viśeṣa iti siddhaṃ || <3-4-28> || sarvānnānumatiśca prāṇātyaye taddarśanāt || nanu yadi sadasatpravṛttibhyāṃ jñānino viśeṣaḥ| kathaṃ tarhyevaṃ vinnikhilaṃ bhakṣayīteti tasya niṣiddhānna bhojane'pihrāsābhāvoktiḥ saṃbhavati| tasmānana viśeṣaḥ syāditi pūrvoktasya tarkaparāhatimāśaṃkya pariharatsūtramācaṣṭe || || sarvānnānumatiśca prāṇātyaye taddarśanāditi || asyārthaḥ || ca śabda evārthe| jñāninaḥ sarvānnānumatiḥ yadi ha vā apyevaṃ viditi niṣiddhāniṣiddhabhakṣaṇasyābhyanujñānaśrutiḥ| prāṇātyaye prāṇatyāgakālaviṣayaiva na tu sarvakālaviṣayā| kutaḥ| taddarśanāt tasminnarthe na vā'jīviṣyamiti śrutestadartharūpaliṃgadarśanāccetyarthaḥ || evaṃca jīvanopāyayuktaniṣiddha bhakṣaṇānumatistato'dhikarāgaprāptānupānapratyākhyānarūpaliṃgapratipādakavacanāt| ato hrāsābhāvokteranyathopapannatvena na tadbalājjñāninaḥ sadasatpravṛttyoraviśeṣaḥ śaṃkanīya iti jñāninā'pi niṣiddhaṃ na kāryameva| jñāninaḥ sadasatpravṛttyorviśeṣāmyupagame yadi ha vā iti sarvānnānumatiśruteḥ prāṇātyayakālaviṣayatvena tadbādhābhāvāt| ataḥ sadasatpravṛttibhyāṃ jñānino viśeṣa iti siddhaṃ || <3-4-29> || abādhācca || nanu yadatroktaṃ jñānināṃ na niṣiddhaṃ tyājyamiti tatra kiṃ niṣiddhākaraṇe bādhakasadbhāvānniṣiddhaṃ na kartavyamityucyate uta vidhisadbhāvāditi prāpte satramupanyasyati || || abādhācceti || asyārthaḥ || jñānināṃ niṣiddhākaraṇe bādhakābhāvācca niṣiddhaṃ na kāryamityarthaḥ || evaṃca na kevalaṃ niṣiddhakaraṇe sādhakapramāṇābhāvātjñāninaḥ sadasatpravṛttyorapiśeṣo na yuktaḥ| kiṃtu niṣiddhākaraṇe bādhakābhāvāt| anyāyyacaraṇābhāva iti vacanāduktahetvorasiddheḥ tataśca jñāninaḥ sadasatpravṛttibhyāṃ viśeṣo'stīti siddhaṃ || <3-4-30> || api smaryate || nanu jñānino niṣiddhakaraṇaniṣedhakapramāṇābhāvānna sadasatpravṛttyorviśeṣo yukta ityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtramupanyasyati || || api smaryata iti || asyārthaḥ || tatkaraṇe'lpaphalatā ca atītetyādinā kṛṣṇādibhiḥ smṛtibhirniṣiddhaṃ na kāryamiti smaryate ca| ato'pi na niṣiddhaṃ jñānibhiḥ kāryamityarthaḥ || evaṃca jñāninastrailokyasya pāpoddharaṇakṣamatvāt| atītānāgateti harivaṃśavacanātsatkarmakaraṇasya niṣiddhākaramasya ca parityāgaṃ na kāryamityuktatvāt| ato'pi na jñānibhirniṣiddhaṃ kāryamiti siddhaṃ || <3-4-31> || śabdaścā'to'kāmacāre || jñāninā niṣiddhakaraṇe na kevalaṃ smṛtireva niṣedhikā kiṃtu śrutirapītyāha sūtrakṛt || || śabdaścā'to'kāmacāra iti || asyārthaḥ || co yataḥ akāmacāre niṣiddha karmābhāve| śabdaḥ sa ya etadevaṃ viditi śrutirasti| ato'pi na niṣiddhaṃ jñāninā kāryamityarthaḥ || evaṃca nirdiṣṭaśrutyā kāmacārasyālpaphalatvokteḥ| satpravṛtteḥ pūrṇaphalakatvasūcanenāsatpravṛtteralpaphalatvasyārthādāgatatvāt| ataḥ pūrṇaṃ yatjñānaphalaṃ tadicchuḥ san niṣiddhāni karmāṇi nānuvarteteti siddhaṃ || <3-4-32> || vihitatvāccāśramakarmā'pi || nanvastu niṣiddhācaraṇe palahrāsādibādhakasadbhāvāttatparityāgastathā'pi na hānirvarṇāśramocitaṃ kāryaṃ| hrāsakāraṇābhāve jñānādeva pūrṇaphalasiddherityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || || vihitatvāccāśramakarmā'pīti || asyārthaḥ || caḥ kāraṇasamuccaye| api varṇāśramadharmasamuccaye jñāninā na kevalaṃ niṣiddhamakāryaṃ| kiṃtvāśramadharmo'pi varṇāśramocitakarmā'pi saṃpūrṇaphalārthaṃ kāryaṃ| kutaḥ| vihitatvāt| paśyannapīti śrutivihitatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca nirdiṣṭaśrutyā jñānināṃ saṃpūrṇaphalārthaṃ varṇāśramocitamapi na kāryamiti siddhaṃ || <3-4-33> || sahakāritvena ca || nanu vihitatve'pi na jñāninā satkarmānuṣṭheyaṃ| phalābhāvāt| hrāsakāraṇābhāve jñānādeva pūrṇaphalasiddheḥ| anyathā samuccayavādāpattirityāśaṃkāmapākurvatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || sahakāritvena ceti || asyārthaḥ || jñāninā phalasaṃpūrṇasidhyai satkarma kāryameva kutaḥ| yathā rājña iti śrutau mokṣaphalātiśayakarmaṇo jñānasahakāritvenoktatvāccetyarthaḥ || evaṃca yathā maṃtriṇaṃ vinā'pi kāryakaraṇasamarthasya rājñaḥ phalātiśayahetutvena maṃtrīsahakāryevaṃ sadācāraṃ vinā'pi mokṣadānasamarthasya phalātiśayahetutvena sahakāriṇaḥ sadācārasyāvaśyakatvāt| ato jñānināṃ sadasatpravṛttibhyāṃ viśeṣasadbhāve'pi mokṣo niyata eveti siddhaṃ || || iti stutyadhikaraṇaṃ || atra brahmajñānasyādhikārimātraprāpyatvaṃ varṇyate| <3-4-34> || sarvathā'pi tu ta evobhayaliṃgāt || nanvanadhikāribhirapi jñānamāpyate| asurāṇāmapi pralhādādīnāṃ jñānasmṛteḥ| na ca smṛtyuktamapyasaṃbhāvitatvānna sidhyatīti vācyaṃ| vedānadhikāre'pi śūdrāṇāṃ vedaprāpterdṛṣṭatvena tadanadhikāriṇāṃ tatprāpteḥ saṃbhāvitatvātma| ato'yogyairapi jñānasya prāptuṃ śakyatvenāyogyānāmapi mokṣa iti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || sarvathā'pi tu ta evobhayaliṃgāditi || asyārthaḥ || sarvathā'pi deśakālagurūpadeśādyanekasādhanasaṃpattāvapi ye jñānayogyāḥ ta eva jñānamāpnuvaṃti| nāyogyāḥ| kutaḥ| ubhayaliṃgāt| ubhayoḥ yogyāyogyayoḥ iṃdravirocanayoḥ| viriṃcopadeśasāmye'pi samyagviparītajñānaprāptirūpajñā pakādevetyarthaḥ || evaṃca gurūpasattyādyanekotsāhe'pi yogyānāmeva jñānaprāptirnāyogyānāṃ| ya ātmetī dravirocanayorekaprakāreṇa caturmukhopadeśe'padri eva samyagjñānamāpa| virocanastu viparītajñānamāpetyubhayavidhaliṃgāt| ato bhagavatjñānasya yogyaikasādhyatvena yogyānāmeva mokṣa iti siddhaṃ || <3-4-35> || anabhibhavaṃ ca darśayati || nanu mahatāprayatnenāyogyatāyā abhibhāvayituṃ śakyatvādayogyānāmapi jñānaprāptirbhavet| dṛṣṭaṃ hi viśvāmitrasya mahatāprayatnena vipratvamityāśaṃkāmapākurvatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || anabhibhavaṃ ca darśayatīti || asyārthaḥ || co yataḥ| daivīmeveti śrutiḥ| na kevalaṃ yogyāyogyasvarūpaṃ darśayati| kiṃtvanābhibhavaṃ ca| darśayati pratipādayati| ato nāyogyānāṃ jñānaprāptirityarthaḥ || evaṃca nirdiṣṭaśrutyā devāsurasvabhāvasya yogyāyogyatvayoḥ pratipāditatvādyogyānāmeva mokṣa iti siddhaṃ || <3-4-36> || aṃtarā cāpi tu taddṛṣṭeḥ || nanu māstu tamoyogyānāṃ muktiyogyānāṃ cātidārḍhyena svabhāvābhibhavāyogena samyagviparītajñānaprāptiḥ| tathā'pi sā madhyamamanuṣyāṇāṃ bhavatu| koṭidvayaviṣayakatayā tatjñānasya dārḍhyābhāvena tatsvabhāvābhibhavasya kartuṃ śakyatvādityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtramupanyasyati || || aṃtarā cāpitu taddṛṣṭeriti || asyārthaḥ || ca śabdastu śabdo'vadhāraṇe| aṃtarā samyagjñānaviparītajñānayormadhye| sthitānāṃ nityasaṃsāriṇāmapi miśrasvabhāvānabhibhava eva kutaḥ| taddṛṣṭeḥ teṣāṃ tasminmiśrajñāna eva tasyodāhṛtasya dṛṣṭerdarśanādityarthaḥ || evaṃca miśrajñānaṃ eva teṣāṃ dārḍhyadṛṣṭestatsvabhāvābhibhavābhāvānmokṣo yogyānāmeveti siddhaṃ || <3-4-37> || api smaryate || nanu devānāṃ mānavānāṃ samyagjñānādisvabhāvatve tadyogyatāsvabhāvatve ca bhavedabhibhavābhāvaḥ| tadeva kutaḥ| tādṛśasvabhāvatve ca tathā phalena bhāvyaṃ| tadapi kuta ityāśaṃkāṃ smṛtyā pariharatsūtramupanyasyati || || api smaryata iti || asyārthaḥ || kṛṣṇādibhiḥ svabhāvānabhibhavaḥ asurā iti smaryate ca ato'pi devadānavamānavasvabhāvānāṃ nābhibhava ityarthaḥ || evaṃcāsurā āsureṇaiveti skāṃdavacanāddevādīnāṃ tattatsvabhāvānusāriṇā karmaṇā jñānena ca tattatsvabhāvasya tādṛśa phalasya ca tathā tattatphalasvabhāvāyorvyatyāsābhāvasya coktatvenoktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <3-4-38> || viśeṣānugrahaṃ ca || hetvaṃtareṇa devānāmeva samyagjñāna tatphale nānyeṣāmityarthapratipādakasūtramupanyasya tadapekṣitaṃ pūrayati || || viśeṣānugrahaṃ ceti || asyārthaḥ || ca śabdo yuktisamuccaye| yataḥ śṛṇve vīra iti śrutiḥ parameśvarasya viśeṣānugrahaṃ ca| darśayati pratipādayati| ato devānāmeva samyak jñānatatphale nānyeṣāmityarthaḥ || evaṃca śṛṇve vīra ityasurāndamayanniti ca śrutismṛtyordeveṣu viśeṣānugrāhakayoḥ pramāṇatvena devānāmeva nānyeṣāṃ samyajñānaphale bhavata iti siddhaṃ || <3-4-39> || atastvitarajjyāyo liṃgācca || nanu yaduktaṃ śrutismṛtibhyāṃ na daityānāṃ tatsvabhāvābhibhavena devatvaprāptiriti tadeva yuktyā'pi samarthayatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || atastvitarajjyāyo liṃgācceti || asyārthaḥ || tu śabdo'vadhāraṇe| ato devabhāgādasurabhāgasya kadāpyūnatvābhāvāt| itarat asuravṛṃdameva| ato devabhāgājjyāyaḥ bahulaṃ| kutaḥ| liṃgāt tasmājjanatāṃ na yiyāditi janasaṃghapraveśa niṣedhoktyanyathā'nupapattirūpaliṃgāt| ca śabdasūcita tataḥ kanīyasa iti śruteścetyarthaḥ || evaṃcāsurāṇāṃ devatve prāpte daityabhāgasya kālakrameṇa kṣīṇatvamāpannaṃ syāt| pratyahaṃ brāhmaṇāya dīyamānadhānyādirāśeḥ kṣayadarśanāt| na ca tadasti| asurā bahulā iti vacanāt| tena na daityānāṃ svarūpopamardena devatvaṃ bhavatīti siddhaṃ || <3-4-40> || tad‌bhūtasya tu tadbhāvo jaiminerapi niyamāttadrūpābhāvebhyaḥ || jaiminimatenāpi svarūpābhibhavo netyarthaṃ samarthayatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || tad‌bhūtasya tu tad‌bhāvo jaiminirapi niyamāttadrūpābhāvebhya iti || asyārthaḥ || tad‌bhūtasya tu devabhūtasyaiva| tadbhāvaḥ devatābhāvaḥ evamasurasyaivāsurabhāvaḥ jaiminerācāryasyāpi siddha eva| kutaḥ| niyamāttadrūpābhāvebhyaḥ| nāsurā iti ca śabdasūcitaśruteḥ nāsurāṇāmiti atadrūpatvaśruteḥ| abhāvaḥ abhūtiḥ devāsurāṇāṃ| taṃ| bhūriti bhāva śabditaśruterityarthaḥ || evaṃca nirdiṣṭaśrutibhirasurajāterevāsuratvaṃ devajātereva devatvamiti jaiminerācāryasyāpi siddhaṃ || svarapato devānāṃ pralhādādīnāṃ brahmādiśāpena tirohitasvabhāvattvāt| teṣāṃ punarnijasvarūpatvamupapannaṃ| kāraṇāṃtarāduktasyānyathābhāvābhāvāt| ato bhagavatjñānasya yogyaikasādhyatvena yogyānāmeva mokṣa iti siddhaṃ || || iti ubhayaliṃgādhikaraṇaṃ || atra brahmajñānasya devatāpadākāṃkṣāśūnyaireva prāpyatvamahimā varṇyate| <3-4-41> || na cādhikārikamapi patanānumānāttadayogāt || nanu devatāpadamanyaiḥ prāpyaṃ| svadharmaniṣṭhetyādeḥ| ato devatvādikamasvābhāvikaṃ| api tu prayatnādhīnaṃ| tataścāyogyairapi jñānaṃ prāpyamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || na cādhikārikamapi patanānumānāttadayogāditi || asyārthaḥ || ca śabdaḥ jñānārthināṃ ayogyākāṃkṣā varjanarūpetikartavyatāṃtarasūcakaḥ| ādhikārikamapi devatāpadamapītarairnakāṃkṣyaṃ| bhagavadaiśvaryādikaṃ tu sutarāmiti sūcayitumapi śabdaḥ| kutaḥ| patanānumānāt| ayogyecchātvataḥ patanasya smārtayuktisiddhatvāt| ata eva tadayogāt| ayogyākāṃkṣāyāḥ kartumayuktatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca na devapadamanyaiḥ prāpyaṃ| tadākāṃkṣāmātrasya pātahetutvāt| brahmādipadākāṃkṣāvānpatati ayogyavṛttimattvāt| ayogyavṛkṣārohāya prayatamānavadiṃti prayogasaṃbhavāt| devāsureti vacanādyogyatvaviśeṣaṇasiddheḥ| na ca prayatnasya patanakāraṇatve'pi necchāmātraṃ patanakāraṇamiti| svakīyamicchamānamiti vacanāt| ato brahmādipadasya tadyogyaikalabhyatvenoktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <3-4-42> || upapūrvamapītyeke bhāvaśamanavattaduktaṃ || kaimutyenāpi devatāpadākāṃkṣā'yogaṃ sādhanayatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || upapūrvamapītyeke bhāvaśamanavattaduktamiti || asyārthaḥ || bhāvaśamanavat| bhāve citte| śamanaṃ bhagavananiṣṭhā yeṣāṃ te bhāvaśamanaḥ| ṛṣayaḥ| tatpadaṃ yathā nākāṃkṣyaṃ| tathā upapūrvamapi upaśabdapūrvakopadevaśabdoktagaṃdharvapadamapi jñānibhirnā kāṃkṣyaṃ| kimuta sutarāṃ devādipadamiti sūcayitumapi śabdaḥ| ityeke śākhinaḥ manyaṃte| kutaḥ| yato jñānārthinā yathetīṃdradyumnaśrutau| taduktaṃ tathoktaṃ| ata ityarthaḥ || evaṃca brahmādipadasya tadyogyaikalabhyatvāduktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <3-4-43> || bahistūbhayathā'pi smṛterācārācca || jñānārthinā yathā devādipadaṃ nākāṃkṣyamevaṃ jñānabhaktyādikamākāṃkṣyaṃ na veti saṃdehamapākurvatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || bahistubhayathā'pi smṛterācārācceti || asyārthaḥ || bahistu devādipadebhyo'nyatra| jñāne bhaktyādiviṣaye| ubhayathākāṃkṣāyāmanākāṃkṣāyāmapi na doṣaḥ| kutaḥ| devarṣīti smṛterācārācca nānātvamiti śubhācāravidhāyakaśabdāccetyarthaḥ evaṃca na tu devapadādikamiva svargādikamapi nākāṃkṣyamucyate| devarṣigaṃdharvādipadādibhyo'nyatra śubhaviṣaye ākāṃkṣāyāmapi patanābhāvāt| devarṣigaṃdharvāṇāṃ padākāṃkṣiṇaḥ patanaṃ netyubhayathā śruteḥ| ato'viruddhakāmaḥ syādityācārābhidhānāt| tato brahmādipadasya tadyogyaikalabhyatvenoktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || || iti ādhikārikādhikaraṇaṃ || atra brahmajñānasya saṃnidhimātreṇāsvāmino'pi parādhīnasya jñāninaḥ kartuḥ phaladātṛtvamahimā varṇyate| <3-4-44> || svāminaḥ phalaśruterityātreyaḥ || nanu brahmajñānaphalaṃ devānāmeva na manuṣyāṇāmiṃdriyādipravartakatvena teṣāmeva jñānasvāmitvāt| loke ca svāmina eva phaladarśanāt| yadukiṃceti śruteḥ| na ca kartṛtvenākhyāmināmapi phalaṃ| kartṛtvasyāprayojakatvāt| na ca svāmitvātphalaṃ| asiddheḥ| kiṃcaivamāptatama ātreyo manyata iti| tataśca jñānināṃ mokṣaniyamo'yukta iti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || svāminaḥ phalaśruterityātreya iti || asyārthaḥ || samudāyavivakṣayā svāmina ityekavacanaṃ| tathā ca svāmināṃ devānāmeva| jñānaphalaṃ bhavati| na prajānāṃ| kasmāt| teṣāmeva jñānasvāmitvāt| yadukiṃceti teṣāmeva phalaśruteścetyevamātreyācāryo manyata ityarthaḥ || evaṃca devānāmeveṃdriyaprerakatvena svāmitvāt| loke ca svāmina eva phaladarśanāt| yadu kiṃceti śruteśca| ato devānāmeva jñānaphalamityātreyeṇoktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <3-4-45> || ārtvijyamityauḍulomistasmai hi parikriyate || nanvātreyamatavirodho bhavediti tanmatāvalaṃbena pūrvapakṣite siddhāṃtayatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || ārtvijyamitvauḍulomistasmai hi parikriyata iti || asyārthaḥ || hi yasmāt| tasmai prajārthaṃ devaiḥ parikriyate prajādvārā jñānaṃ saṃpādyate| tasmādārtvijyaṃ ārtvijyamiveti śeṣaḥ| ṛtvijāṃ yajñaphalamiva prajānāmapyalpajñānaphalamastītyauḍulomirācāryo manyata ityartha || evaṃca na kevalaṃ devānāmeva phalaṃ kiṃtu prajānāmapi| tāsāṃ devaiḥ kriyamāṇe jñānayajñe ṛtviktena satrayāge ṛtvijāṃ yājamānyamiva devādhīnatvasvāmitvasadbhāvāt| tadarthaṃ devaiḥ kriyamāṇatvācca| atātreyācāryamatāvirodhāt| prajānāmapyalpaphalābhyupagamāttadupapatteḥ| śrutyādestadabhiprāyakatvādityauḍulomirācāryo manyata ityarthaḥ || <3-4-46> || sahakāryaṃtaravidhiḥ pakṣeṇatṛtīyaṃ tadvato vidhyādivat || nanu yadi devaiḥ prajārthaṃ jñānādi sādhyate tarhi tatphalaṃ prajānameva bhavet| na kiṃciddevānāmityāśaṃkāṃ parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || sahakāryaṃtaravidhiḥ pakṣeṇa tṛtīyaṃ tadvato vidhyādivaditi || asyārthaḥ || tadvato prajāvato rājñaḥ śiṣyavato gurośca| vidhyādivat vidhānaphalayoriva| yathā prajānāṃ śiṣyānāṃ pālanavyākhyānayoḥ rājagurusahakāritvena vidhānaṃ phalaṃ ca tayoreva mukhyatayā svavihita jñānadāne prajānāṃ saha kāryaṃtaravidhiḥ devairanugrāhyarūpaviśeṣasahakāryaṃtaratvena karaṇaṃ| pakṣeṇa pakṣatvena| tṛtīyaṃ ātreyauḍulomipakṣāpekṣayā tṛtīyaḥ| ayameva bādarāyaṇīyapakṣaḥ ityarthaḥ || evaṃca prajārthaṃ devaiḥ kriyamāṇatve'pi devānāṃ mukhyasvāmitvena mukhyaṃ phalaṃ| prajānāṃ sahakārimātratvenālpaṃ phalamityaṃgīkārāt| prajānāmapi jñānaphalasadbhāvāt| pūrvoktamatadvayāvirodhenoktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || || iti phalaśrutyadhikaraṇaṃ || atra brahmajñāne viśeṣādhikāriṇāṃ yatīnāṃ sarvāśramibhyo'tiśayasamarthanena jñānamahimā varṇyate| <3-4-47> || kṛtsnabhāvāttu gṛhiṇopasahāraḥ || nanu muktau yatibhyo gṛhastha evottamaḥ| tasya jyotiṣṭomādisarvakarmādhikāritvāt| sarvakarmānuṣṭhānaṃ ca cirakālasādhyaṃ| cirakālasādhya eva hi mokṣa uttamaḥ| kiṃca chaṃdoga ācāryakulādvedamadhītyeti gṛhasthasya mokṣamuktvopasaṃhāraḥ kriyate| na ca gṛhasthāduttamasadbhāve tadanuktopasaṃhāro yujyate| ataḥ karmiṇāmevottatvena na jñānamatiśayamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || kṛtsnabhāvāttu gṛhiṇopasaṃhāra iti || asyārthaḥ || yataḥ kuṭuṃba iti śrutau gṛhīṇo gṛhasthasyaiva mokṣaphaloktyā paryavasyati| kṛtsnabhāvāt saṃpūrṇagṛhasthadharmavato devānapekṣyaiva| ataḥ śrutyavirodhācca yatereva sarvāśramiṣūttamatvamityarthaḥ || evaṃca manuṣyeṣu yatereva sarvāpekṣayottamatvaṃ na gṛhiṇaḥ| gṛhimokṣādyatimokṣasya cirakālasādhyatvāt| gṛhiṇāṃ bahukarmādhikārabhāvo'pi taiḥ sarveṣāmananuṣṭhānena katipayānuṣṭhānenaiva tadaparokṣajñānasiddheḥ| na caivaṃ gṛhiṇopasaṃhāravirodhaḥ| tasya devatāviṣayatvāt| ato dharmādhikāriṣu jñānapracurāṇāṃ yatīnāmevottamatvena yuktaṃ jñānasyātiśayitatvamiti siddhaṃ || <3-4-48> || maunavaditareṣāmapyupadeśāt || yuktyaṃtareṇa mānuṣayatibhyo devānāmuttamattvaṃ samarthayatsūtramupanyasyati || || maunavāditareṣāmapyupadeśāditi || asyārthaḥ || maunavat yatitvasyeva| itareṣāṃ anyāśramadharmāṇāmapi| upadeśāt devā eva brahmacāriṇa iti śratāvuktatvāt| sarvāśramibhyo devānāmuttamatvamityarthaḥ || evaṃca deveṣu saṃpūrṇa yatidharmasya sadbhāvena teṣāṃ yatyuttamatvāt| na ca devānāṃ yatitvābhāvaḥ| kṛtsnā hyeta iti śrutyā devānāṃ yatitvasadbhāvasya pratipāditatvāt| api ca yathā hyete munaya iti śruteryatitvadṛṣṭāṃteva sarvavarṇāśramitvābhidhānāt| ato jñānapracurāṇāṃ yatīnāmevottamatvādyuktaṃ jñānasyātiśayattvamiti siddhaṃ || || iti kṛtsnabhāvādhikaraṇaṃ || atrāparokṣajñānasaṃgataparokṣajñānasyātigopyatvamahimā varṇyate || <3-4-49> || anāviṣkurvannatvayāt || aparokṣa jñānahetuparokṣajñānasiddhaye āviṣkāreṇaiva vedavidyopadeṣṭavyā| sabhācatvarādāvupaviśyavidyopadeśe'pyaśeṣajñānayogyānāṃ jñānalābhasiddheḥ| āvaśyakaśca bahūpadeśaḥ| yathā yatheti śruteḥ| ata āviṣkāreṇaivopadeṣṭavyatvāttasya rahasyatvātiśayo na sidhyediti prāpte sūtramāha || || anāviṣkurvannanvayāditi || asyārthaḥ || guruḥ anāviṣkurvansabhādiṣu āviṣkāramakurvanneva| śiṣyebhyo vidyāmupadiśet| kutaḥ| anvayāt ayogyānāmapi jñānaprāptiprasaṃgarūpayukterityarthaḥ || evaṃcānāviṣkāreṇa svavidyopadeśaḥ kāryaḥ| āviṣkāreṇopadeśe'yogyānāmapi jñānaprasaṃgāt| na ca tadiṣṭaṃ| vidyā havai brāhmaṇamājagāmeti tanniṣedhāt| ato'lpāviṣkāreṇa jñānasyopadeṣṭavyatvena yuktastasyātiśaya iti siddhaṃ || || iti anvayādhikaraṇaṃ || atrāparokṣajñānasya pratibaṃdhabhāve sādhanasaṃpattijanmanyevotpattiḥ samarthyate| <3-4-50> || aihikamaprastutapratibaṃdhe taddarśanāt || nanu jñānasādhanaṃ kṛṣyādivadaihikaphalasyaiva hetuḥ| tataḥ sādhanasaṃpūrtijanmanyevāparokṣajñānaṃ| kasyacitpratibaṃdhakavaśātsādhane duṣṭe naikadāpi phalodayaḥ| ṣaṃḍabījāvāpinā kadāpi phalānudayadarśanāt| na hi duṣṭaṃ bījaṃ kālāṃtare phalaheturiti dṛṣṭaṃ| na ca yāgādivadupapattiḥ| tasyaihikaphalahetutvābhāvena vaiṣamyāt| ato jñānasyaivaihikatvena prāptatvātkasyacitpratibaṃdhakena tadanudayejanmāṃtarepyanudaya eveti prāpte sūtramāha || || aihikamaprastutamapratibaṃdhe taddarśanāditi || asyārthaḥ || aprastutapratibaṃdhe prastutapratibaṃdhaśabdoktaprārabdhakarmābhāve| aparokṣajñānamaihikaṃ śravaṇādīnāṃ saṃpūrtijanmanyeva bhavati| pratibaṃdhe tu janmāṃtare bhavati| kutaḥ| taddarśanāt| śrutveti śratau tathā pratipādanādityarthaḥ || evaṃca śravaṇādikamaihikaheturiti satyaṃ| tathā'pi śravaṇādisaṃpūrtijanmanyeva bhavatīti na niyamaḥ| kiṃtu pratibaṃdhakasadbhāve janmāṃtare'pi bhavati| ataḥ pratibaṃdhakābhāve jñānasyaihikatvānnoktānupapattiriti siddhaṃ || || iti aihikādhikaraṇaṃ || atra brahmajñānasya svotpattijanmānaṃtarameva pratibaṃdhakābhāve muktisādhanatvamahimā varṇyate| <3-4-51> || evaṃ muktiphalāniyamastadavasthāvadhṛtestadavasthāvadhṛteḥ || nanvaparokṣajñānodaye dehapātānaṃtarameva mokṣo bhavatītyaṃgīkāro yuktaḥ| na tu vilaṃbāṃgīkāraḥ| vilaṃbe kāraṇābhāvāt| evameva kasyacinmokṣavilaṃbāṃgīkāre tasya kadā'pi mokṣo na syāt| tatsādhanānāṃ gatavīryatvāt| na hi jīrṇānāṃ dhānyānāmaṃkurakāryakāritā| tataścāniyama ityuktavyāghāta iti prāpte sūtramāha || || evaṃ muktiphalāniyamastadavasthāvadhṛtestadavasthāvadhṛteriti || asyārthaḥ || evaṃ yathā jñāne'niyamaḥ tathā muktiphalāniyamaḥ| mokṣākhyaphale'pi jñāninaḥ taccharīrapātānaṃtarameva mokṣa iti niyamo nāsti| kiṃtu asati prārabdhe taddehapātānaṃtarameva| sati tu taddehāṃtarāvasāne mokṣo bhavati| nanu kuta evaṃ kalpyate| jñānajanmānaṃtaraṃ muktyabhāve kadā'pi muktirnetyevaṃ kuto na kalpyata ityata uktaṃ| taditi| tasyāṃ brahmasaṃsthita iti śratau tasminbrahmaṇi avasthitasya tatjñānina iti yāvat| avadhṛteḥ amṛtatvametītyeveti mokṣaphalāvadhāraṇādityarthaḥ| ataḥ pratibaṃdhakakalpaneti bhāvaḥ| uktasya sarvasyaitadyāyārthasya prasiddhatvasūcanārthā dviruktiḥ || evaṃca jñānodaye dehapātānaṃtarameva mokṣa iti na niyamaḥ| kiṃtu pratibaṃdhakābhāve taddehapātānaṃtaraṃ| anyatha tu janmāṃtaraṃ prāpyetyaniyamaḥ| dharmo svargamiti śruteḥ| vidvānamamṛtamiti smṛteśca| ato jñānināṃ pratibaṃdhakābhāve mokṣasyādūratvenoktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || || iti muktaphalādhikaraṇaṃ || || iti tṛtīyādhyāyasya caturthaḥ pādaḥ samāptaḥ || || iti tṛtīyādhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ || <4> <4.1> || śrīḥ || || hariḥ || || atha caturthādhyāyaḥ || brahmadarśanajanyamokṣarūpākhyaphalaṃ nigadyate'sminnadhyāye| || atha prathamaḥ pādaḥ || mokṣalakṣaṇajñānaphalasya karmakṣayotkrāṃtimārgabhogabhedena cāturvidhyāddarśanapūrvakālīnasaṃcitakarmanāśākhyaphalaṃ nigadyate'sminpāde| atra nityaśaḥ kāryaṃ sarvathābhāvyaṃ sādhanamucyate| prāyikatvāccādhyāyānāṃ pādānāṃ ca na virodhaḥ| <4-1-1> || āvṛttirasakṛdupadeśāt || nanu sakṛdeva śravaṇādikamanuṣṭheyaṃ| tāvataiva vidhiparyavasānāt| anyathā sakṛdeva jyotiṣṭomādikamanuṣṭhāya kṛtī na syāt| evaṃ ca vihitaśravaṇādyanuṣṭhānena jñānadarśanāt| vidheraprāmāṇyāt| pramāṇāṃtarasyāpyabhāvāt| na śravaṇādijñānasādhanamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || āvṛttisakṛdupadeśāditi || asyārthaḥ || jñānārthaṃ śravaṇādīnāmāvṛttiḥ kāryāḥ| kutaḥ| asakṛdupadeśāt| bahuvāraṃ śvetaketuṃ prati uddālakena paratattvasyepadiṣṭatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃcāvṛttereva śravaṇādīnāṃ phalahetutvāt| aparokṣajñānasiddhaye'sakṛdanuṣṭhānasyoddālakenopadeśāt tataśca śravaṇādyāvartau niyamena phalopalaṃbhena tadvidheḥ prāmāṇyācchravaṇādikaṃ jñānasādhanamiti siddhaṃ || <4-1-2> || liṃgācca || hetvaṃtareṇa śravaṇādyāvṛttiṃ sādhayatsūtramupanyasyati || || liṃgācceti || asyārthaḥ || bhṛguṇā śrutasya punarālocanenāparokṣitatvarūpaliṃgadarśanāccāvṛttiḥ kartavyetyarthaḥ || evaṃca sa tapo tapyatetyādyāvartanaliṃgaśravaṇāt | tataśca śravaṇādyāvṛttiḥ kāryeti siddhaṃ || || iti āvṛtyadhikaraṇaṃ || atrātmatvopāsternityaśaḥ kāryatvaṃ samarthyate || <4-1-3> || ātmeti tūpagacchaṃti grāhayaṃti ca || nanu na nityaśa ātmatvasyopadeśa upāsanaṃ ca kāryaṃ| atiprasiddhatvāt| kiṃtvaprasiddhasyaiva| kasyacidguṇasya| tataśca na tatra vedasya mahātātparyaṃ yuktamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || ātmeti tūpagacchaṃti grāhayaṃti ceti || asyārthaḥ || tu śabda evārthe| ātmā viṣṇuḥ| ātmeti mama svāmīti| upāsya eva| kutaḥ| yasmātjñāninaḥ| tathopagacchaṃti jānaṃti upāsate ca| śiṣyānprati grāhayaṃti upadiśaṃti ca| tasmādityarthaḥ || evaṃca mokṣasādhanābhijñairviṣṇorātmetyupadeśasyopāsanasya ca nityaśo'nuṣṭhīyamānatvāt| nānyamiti śruteḥ| ātmetīti smṛteśca| upāsanasya phalahetutāyāḥ prāmāṇikatvena prasiddheraprayojakatvāt| na hi rājaprītisādhanamiti prasiddhatvena rājā prītyarthibhirna varṇyate| yeneha tathā syāt| ato viṣṇoḥ svāmitvasya sadā sarvatopāsyatvādyuktaṃ tatra vedānāṃ tātparyamiti siddhaṃ || || iti ātmādhikaraṇaṃ || atra brahmajñānārthino viṣṇupratīkaikyopāsanavarjanamāvaśyakamiti pratipādyate| <4-1-4> || na pratīke na hi saḥ || nanu pratīkaṃ brahmatayopāsyaṃ| nāmopāsvetyādividhīnāṃ sa yo mano brahmeti paryālocanayā nāma brahmetyupāsīteti śākhāṃtaraparyālocanayā ca pratīke brahmadṛṣṭiriti tātparyāvagamāt| na ca pratīkabrahmaṇorbhedena tathopāsanā saṃbhavaḥ| upāsanāyāṃ phalasyaiva prayojakatvena vastutathātvasyāprayojakatvāt| tataśca pratīke brahmatvenopāsanasya kartavyatvāt| uktaṃ svāmitvopāsanamayuktamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || na pratīke na hi sa iti || asyārthaḥ || pratīke nāmādyadhiṣṭhānaviṣaye| ātmetyupāstirna kāryā| kiṃtu tadgatatayā| kutaḥ saviṣṇuḥ| hi yasmāt| nāmādipratīkaṃ| na bhavati| tasmādityarthaḥ || evaṃcoktavidhīnāṃ pratīke brahmadṛṣṭyabhidhāyakatvāt| pratīkasyābrahmatvena mithyopāsāprasaṃgācca| na hi mithyopāsā phalahetuḥ| mithyopāsāyā anarthahetutvena pramāṇasiddhatvāt| kathaṃ tarhyupāsanā kāryeti cet| tatsthatveneti grahaṇād‌dvitīyāśravaṇāt| mahāvyākaraṇamūlakasupāṃ supo bhavatīti kātyāyanavacanena dvitīyāyāḥ saptamyarthatvāt| tataśca pratīkasthatvenaiva brahmopāsanaṃ kāryamiti siddhaṃ || || iti na pratīkādhikaraṇaṃ || atra brahmatvopāsterāvaśyakatvaṃ samarthyate| <4-1-5> || brahmadṛṣṭirutkarṣāt || nanu brahmatvaṃ sadā sarvathā nopāsyaṃ| upāsanaṃ tu bhagavatprasādārthaṃ| sa ca nityahaṃ vividhaguṇopāsanenaiva bhavediti vyarthaṃ brahmatvopāsanaṃ| ato brahmatvasya sadopāsyatvābhāvāduktamayuktamiti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati || || brahmadṛṣṭirutkarṣāditi || asyārthaḥ || brahmaṇi parameśvare| brahmadṛṣṭiḥ pūrṇatvopāstiḥ kāryā| kutaḥ| utkarṣāt pūrṇasyotkṛṣṭatayā tathopāsterapyutkṛṣṭatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca kāryameva sadā sarvathā brahmatvopāsanaṃ| bhagavata utkṛṣṭatvāt| tathopāstestatprasādajanakatvāt| brahmatvopāsakātiriktacaturguṇopāsakairapyātmatvādiviśeṣaṇatayā brahmatvopāsanasyātmetyeveti vacanātkāryatvāt| tathā ca brahmaṇo viśiṣyopāsyatvāduktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || || iti brahmādhikaraṇaṃ || atra viṣṇvaṃgāśritatvena devatopāsanamāvaśyakamiti sādhyate| <4-1-6> || ādityādimatayaścāṃga upapatteḥ || nanu na sarvadā sarvathā tathopāsanaṃ devaiḥ kāryaṃ| sūryādibhiritastataḥ saṃcaraṇena sadā bhagavadaṃgāśritatvābhāvāt| tathāpyupāsane'nyathopāsanatvenānarthaprasaṃgāt| satsvapi guṇāṃtareṣu svāśrayatvena bhagavadupāsane viśeṣakāraṇābhāvāt| ata āśrayāśrayibhāvasyāsadātanatvena sarvopāsyatvābhāvāttadvatsadātanatvābhāvena nātmatvopāsanamāvaśyakamiti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati || || ādityādimatayaścāṃga upapatteriti || asyārthaḥ || aṃge bhagavadaṃge| ādityādibhirdevaiḥ ādityādimatayaḥ ādityādyāśrayāṃgakatvopāsanā kāryā| kutaḥ| upapatteḥ teṣāṃ tatpraveśāpekṣitatvena tathopāsanasya yuktatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca cakṣoḥ sūryo'jāyatetyādinoktaṃ svāśrayatvena bhagavadaṃgopāsanamādityādidevaiḥ sarvathā kāryameva| muktau tatra layasyāpekṣitatvāt| rūpāṃtareṇāṃgānāṃ svāśrayatvena mithyopāsanāprasaṃgābhāvāt| atastadupāsanasyāvaśyakatvāduktamātmatvopāsanaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || || iti ādityādhikaraṇaṃ || atrāsanādiniyamaḥ sādhyate || <4-1-7> || āsīnaḥ saṃbhavāt || nanu nāsanaṃ sarvāpekṣitaṃ kiṃtu kṛtākṛtaṃ| bhagavaddarśanārthaṃ yadyupāsanādyanveṣṭavyaṃ| upāsanādikaṃ ca vinā'pyāsanaṃ sidhyati| na ca manasaḥ samyak bhagavadviṣayatvasidhyarthamāsanaṃ| tena vinā'pi tatsiddheḥ| kathamanyathāsmartavya iti sarvadopāsanābhidhānaṃ yujyate| tataścāsanasyānāvaśyakatvāttacchāstraṃ pākṣikamanupādānalakṣaṇamaprāmāṇyaṃ prāpnotītyāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtramācaṣṭe || || āsīnaḥ saṃbhavāditi || asyārthaḥ || jijñāsurāsīnaḥ āsane upaviśanneva upāsanaṃ kuryāt| kutaḥ| saṃbhavāt tasyāsane satyevaṃ yuktatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃcāsanayuktenaiva jijñāsunā viśeṣata upāsanaṃ kāryaṃ| satyevāsana upāsanasya samyak saṃbhavāt| dhyānārthamevāsananiyamābhidhānāt| ata āsanasyāvaśyakatvāttadupadeśāvaiyarthyamiti siddhaṃ || <4-1-8> || dhyānācca || nanu sarvadopāsanaṃ kāryamāsanaṃ cāpekṣitamityuktamanupapannaṃ| viruddhatvenobhayorekadā samāveśāyogāt| tatrānyatarasmin tyājye śrutivihitatvātsarvadopāsanamupādāyāsanameva tyajyate| tadvidhāyakaśrutyabhāvādato nāsanamāvaśyakamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || dhyānācceti || asyārthaḥ || avicchinnasmṛtirūpopāsanasyaiva dhyānatvāttadapekṣayaivāsananiyamābhyupagamānna smaraṇopāsanamādāya vyabhicāra ityarthaḥ || evaṃca smaraṇātmakatvaṃ dhyānātmakatvaṃ cetyupāsanasya dvaividhyāt| ādyasya sārvakālikatvenāsananiyamābhāve'pi dvitīyasya yogyavijñeyadhyānatvenāsanasyāvaśyakatvamiti siddhaṃ || <4-1-9> || acalatvaṃ cāpekṣya || nanu dhyānārthamāsananiyamaḥ tatsādhyasya cittavikṣepaparihārasya pratyāhārādinā'pi saṃbhavāditi prāpte samādadhatsūtramāha || || acalatvaṃ cāpekṣeti || asyārthaḥ || na kevalaṃ pratyāhārādinā manovikṣepābhāvo bhavati| kiṃtvacalatvaṃ cāpekṣya śarīrācalatvaṃ cāpekṣya| atastadarthaṃ āsīna eva dhyāyedityarthaḥ || evaṃca cittavikṣepaparihārasyāsanasādhyaśarīrācalatvamapekṣyaiva pratyāhārādinā sādhyatvāt| acalaṃ ceccharīramiti smṛteḥ| tathā cāsanasyāvaśyakatvamiti siddhaṃ || <4-1-10> || smaraṃti ca || smṛtibhirapyāsanasyāvaśyakatvaṃ samarthayatsūtramupanyasyati || || smaraṃti ceti || asyārthaḥ || smṛti kartāraḥ kṛṣṇādayaḥ| āsanāniyamamāvaśyakamityetamarthaṃ samaṃ kāyaśirogrīvamiti smaraṃtītyarthaḥ || evaṃca samaṃ kāyaṃ śirogrīvamiti vacanādāsanasyāvaśyakatvamiti siddhaṃ || <4-1-11> || yatraikāgratā tatrāviśeṣāt || nanvevaṃ tarhi parvatāgre nadītīra ityādi manusmṛtivacanāt| deśakālādiniyamo'pyaṃgīkāryaḥ syādityaśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtramupanyasyati || || yatraikāgratā tatrāviśeṣāditi || asyārthaḥ || yatra yasmindeśe kāle| āsane ca ekāgratā dhyānasyaikaniṣṭhatā bhavati| tatraiva tasmindeśe kāle āsana eva dhyānaṃ kuryāt| kutaḥ| aviśeṣāt| deśakālādinā dhyānajñānayorviśeṣābhāvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca deśakālādiniyamasya manaḥprasādārthatvāt| tasya yatraikāgratā tatraiva sthātavyatvāt| tamevadaśa seveteti vacanāt| tataścāsanasyāvaśyakatvādupadeśāvaiyarthyamiti siddhaṃ || || iti āsānīdhikaraṇaṃ || atra dhyānasya prāyaṇāṃtatvaṃ samarthyate || <4-1-12> || ā prāyaṇāttatrāpi hi dṛṣṭaṃ || nanu mumukṣuṇā na mokṣaparyaṃtaṃ dhyānaṃ kāryaṃ| dhyānasya jñānasādhanatvenābhihitatvāt| na cānaṃdātiśayārthaṃ taditi vācyaṃ| tasya taddhetutvābhāvāt| bhāve'pi na niyamenākāryaṃ| śravaṇādinā'pi tatsaṃbhavāt| tataśca śukādīnāṃ jñānināṃ tadāgrahavaiyarthyamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || ā prāyaṇāttatrāpi hi dṛṣṭamiti || asyārthaḥ || mumukṣuṇā ā prāyaṇāt mokṣaparyaṃtaṃ| dhyānaṃ kartavyameva| kutaḥ| hi yasmāt| tatrāpi mokṣe'pi| dṛṣṭaṃ jñānaṃ śrutaṃ smṛtaṃ ca| tasmādityarthaḥ || evaṃca dhyānasya jñāna ivānaṃdātiśaye'pi pradhānasādhanatvāt| sa yo havai iti śruteḥ | śṛṇuyādityādismṛteśca | ato mokṣaparyaṃta dhyānasya kartavyatvena jñānināmapi tadvicitraphalena muktau tāratamyasatvena ca dhyānaṃ kāryamiti siddhaṃ || || iti ā prāyamādhikaraṇaṃ || atra prāsaṃgikaṃ samāpya karmakṣayākhyaphalasiddhiḥ samarthyate| <4-1-13> || tadadhigama uttarapūrvāghayoraśleṣavināśau tadvyapadeśāt || nanu na jñāne mokṣo nāpi dveṣeṇa tamaḥ| prāgāpādita karmaṇāṃ bhāvāt| na tāni jñānavidveṣajanmani bhujyaṃte| vibhinnānekaśarīrabhogyaphalatvāt| na ca kāyavyūhena yugapadbhogaḥ| vibhinnadeśakālavibhāgatvāt| kiṃ tarhi krameṇa bhogaḥ| na ca krameṇa sarvakarmaṇāṃ bhogena kṣayānaṃtaraṃ sadasanmokṣāvupapadyete| bahukālāṃtaritayorjñānavidveṣayorjīrṇadhānyavatkṣīṇaśaktitvena mokṣajanakatvāsaṃbhavāt| tadbhogasamaye punaranaṃtakarmānuṣṭhānena karmāvasānāsaṃbhavācca| na ca jñānadveṣābhyāmevābhuktānāmeva puṇyapāpānāṃ kṣayaḥ| nābhuktamiti smṛtivirodhāt| na ca prāyaścittena vā bhuktakarmaṇameva jñānena kṣayaḥ saṃbhavaḥ| vipratipatteḥ| sṛhadāhe dagdhadeheṣvadhikāravatkṛtapāpānāmeva dvādaśādbādikarmādhikāritvābhiprāyeṇa brahmahā dvādaśādbamityādivacanānāṃ pravṛttatvena karmakṣayārthamapravṛttatvāt| ato jñānadveṣābhyāṃ sadasanmokṣāsiddheruktamayuktamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || tadadhigama uttarapūrvādhayoraśleṣavināśau tadvyapadeśāditi || asyārthaḥ || tadadhigame tasya brahmaṇaḥ| adhigame aparokṣajñāne sati| uttarapurvāghayoḥ aparokṣajñānottarapūrvakālīnāghayoḥ| aśleṣavināśau uttarasyāśleṣaḥ purvasya vināśaśca| bhavatīti jñāyate| kutaḥ| tadvayapadeśāt| tayoḥ aśleṣavināśayoḥ tadyatheti śrutāvuktatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca nirdiṣṭhaśrutyā jñānadveṣābhyāṃ sadasanmokṣau bhavata iti siddhaṃ || <4-1-14> || itarasyāpyevamasaṃśleṣaḥ pāte tu || evaṃ brahmajñānino muktisidhyarthaṃ jñānādevāghavināśāśleṣāvukatvā tatsamānanyāyatvādbhagavadveṣipumyasyāpimithyājñānādeva vināśāśleṣau tamaḥsidhyarthaṃ vadatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || itarasyāpyevamasaṃśleṣaḥ pāte tviti || asyārthaḥ || tu śabdo'nutthānavācī| itarasya bhagavatjñānītaradveṣiṇaḥ| pāte tu anutthānatamaḥpāte pratyāsanne| tadarthamitarasya pāpetara puṇyasyāpi| evaṃ jñānipāpavat| asaṃśleṣaḥ uttarasyāsaṃśleṣaḥ pūrvasya vināśaśca bhavatītyarthaḥ || evaṃcaivaṃ sukarmaṇaścāpi patatastamasi dhruvamiti dveṣikṛta pūrvottarapuṇyayordveṣeṇa vināśāśleṣau bhavata iti śravaṇāduktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <4-1-15> || anārabdhakārye eva tu pūrveṃ tadavadheḥ || nanu brahmajñānidveṣiṇorjñānādinaiva pāpapuṇyakṣaye jñānādyudaya eva sadyo mokṣādiprasaṃga ityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || anārabdhakārye eva tu pūrve tadavadheriti || asyārthaḥ || tu śabdaścārthaḥ| pūrve viṣṇudveṣajñānapūrvakālīne| anārabdhakārye eva puṇyapāpe vinaśyataḥ| kutaḥ| tadavadheḥ| tasya mokṣasya prārabdhakarmanivṛtyavadhitvaśruteḥ smṛteścetyarthaḥ || evaṃca jñānadveṣodayānaṃtarameva mokṣāpatterabhāvāt| aprārabdhānāmeva prācīnapuṇyapāpānāṃ vināśāṃgīkāreṇa prārabdhabhogāya vilaṃbasya bhāvyatvāduktaṃ yuktameveti siddhaṃ || <4-1-16> || agnihotrādi tu tatkāryāyaiva taddarśanāt || nanu jñānikṛtapūrvottarapuṇyayoraśleṣavināśau vidyete na vā| nādyaḥ| iṣṭavighātino jñānasyāpuruṣārthatvaprasaṃgāt| dvitīye mokṣabhāvaprasaṃgaḥ| prācīnabahupuṇyabogasamaye punaḥ punaḥ puṇyānuṣṭhānasaṃbhavenāparyavasānāditi prāpte samādadhatsūtramāha || || agnihotrādi tu tatkāryāyaiva taddarśanāditi || asyārthaḥ || tu śabdo viśeṣadyotakaḥ| agnihotrādijijñāsubrahmajñānikṛtāgnihotrādyakāmyakarmatatkāryāyaiva jñānamokṣobhayakāryayaiva bhavati| kutaḥ| taddarśanāt| tathā na hāsyeti śrutāvuktatvādityrathaḥ || evaṃcākāmyānāṃ puṇyānāmaśleṣavināśābhāvāt| tāvatā mokṣasyāsaṃbhavābhāvāt| prācīnapuṇyasya jñānajanmanyupayogāt| uttarasya tu jñānakāryamokṣānupraveśāduktaṃ yogyamiti siddhaṃ || <4-1-17> || ato'nyadapītyekeṣāmubhayoḥ || kāmyapuṇyaviṣaya iti dvitīyapakṣaṃ parākurvatsūtramupanyasyati || || ato'nyadapītyekeṣāmubhayoriti || asyārthaḥ || ataḥ prārabdhakarmādanyat bhinnaṃ jñānātpurvottarakāmyaṃ puṇyaṃ aniṣṭaṃ aprārabdhaṃ ca vināśāśleṣau prāpnoti| kutaḥ| yata ityevaṃ prakāreṇaikeṣāṃ śākhināṃ śākhāsūbhayorjñānottarapūrvayoraprārabdhānabhīṣṭayoḥ kāmyapuṇyayoḥ parityāgena pāṭho'sti| ata ityarthaḥ || evaṃca muktāvanubhavakāraṇādanyadaprārabdhamanabhīṣṭaṃ kāmyaṃ puṇyaṃ yattasya vināśatvādalepaśca jñānottaraṃ kriyamāṇasyeti tasya putrā dāyamupayaṃtīti vacanāduktaṃ yogyamiti siddhaṃ || <4-1-18> || yadeva vidyayeti hi || nanu yaduktaṃ jñānikṛtottarakālīnākāmyapuṇyasya kathaṃ mokṣānupraveśaḥ| karmaṇo nāśaśiraskālpaphalartvodityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || yadeva vidyayeti hīti || asyārthaḥ || jñānikṛtamalpamapi puṇyamakṣayaphalaṃ bhavati| kutaḥ| hi yasmāt| yadeva vidyayeti śrutirasti| ata ityarthaḥ || evaṃca jñānikṛtasyānaṃtaphalapratipādakanirdiṣṭaśrutisadbhāvāt| tathā ca jñānikṛtakarmaṇo mokṣānupraveśa iti siddhaṃ || <4-1-19> || bhogena tvitare kṣapayitvā'thasaṃpatsyate || nanvevamapi dveṣijñāninorna mokṣatamasī sidhyataḥ| prārabdhapratibaṃdhasadbhāvāditi prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati || || bhogena tvitare kṣapayitvā'tha saṃpatsyata iti || asyārthaḥ || tu śabdo jñāninaḥ prārabdhabhogopamardarūpaviśeṣadyotakaḥ| jñānī bhogena bhogānuvena| itare prārabdhapuṇyapāpe| kṣapayitvā vināśya| atha anaṃtaraṃ| niyamena saṃpatsyate brahma prāpnoti| evaṃ brahmadvid tamaḥ prāpnotītyarthaḥ || evaṃcobhāvapi jñānidveṣiṇau bhogena prārabdhakarmaṇi kṣapayitvā brahmatamasī prāpnuvataḥ| ārabdheti smṛteḥ ata uktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || || iti tadadhigamādhikaraṇaṃ || || iti caturthādhyāyasya prathamaḥ pādaḥ || <4.2> || śrīḥ || || hariḥ || || atha dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ || devānāṃ mokṣa utkrāṃtiścāsminpāde ucyate| atra vāco manasi layaḥ samarthyate| <4-2-1> || vāṅmanasi darśanācchabdācca || nanu na vāṅmanasi līyate| ubhayoḥ samatvāt| niyāmakābhāvāt| manaḥ pūrvarūpamiti manasaḥ prādhānyamiva vāk pūrvarūpamiti vāco'pi prādhānyaśravaṇāt| ato vāco manasi layābhāvena mokṣābhāvādaniyama ityuktavyādhāta iti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || vāṅmanasi darśanācchabdācceti || asyārthaḥ || vāk vāgabhimāninyumāṣadagṛhītā vāruṇī sauparṇī ca| manasi mano'bhimāni rudraśabditaśeṣagaruḍe ca vilīyate| kutaḥ| vāco mano'dhīnatvāditi śeṣaḥ| tatkathaṃ| darśanāt tasya pratyakṣasiddhatvāt| kiṃca śabdācca tathā śruteścetyarthaḥ || evaṃca tasyeti śabdāt| pratyakṣata eva vāco manovaśatvadarśanena tatra tallayasya saṃbhāvitatvāt| atra pūrvottaravarṇadevatātvaviṣaye guṇapradhānabhāve ca munimatavivāda evocyate na svayaṃ kiṃcidabhidīyata iti vāṅmanasayoḥ sāmyābhāvenobhayorgrāhyatvāt| viśeṣānukteḥ prādhānyaviṣaye tu ṛṣiputramatasyaiva grāhyatvāt| manaseti yuktyā manaḥpūrvakasya viśeṣaśravaṇāt| pratyakṣānusāritvācca| ata eva jñānināṃ mokṣaniyamo yukta iti siddhaṃ || <4-2-2> || ata eva ca sarvāṇyanu || nanu vāco layanirṇaye'pi na sarvadevānāṃ mokṣaḥ| layāniścayādityāśaṃkāṃ samādadhatsūtramāha || || ata eva ca sarvāṇyanviti || asyārthaḥ || ca śabdo'pyarthaḥ || ca sarvāṇi sarvāṇi daivatānyapi| anu yathā'nukūlaṃ| svasvayogyeṣu deveṣu līyaṃte| kutaḥ| ata eva agniviti śruterevetyarthaḥ || evaṃca nirdiṣṭaśrutyā yathā'nukūlaṃ sarvadevānāṃ layanirṇayena yukta eva jñānināṃ mokṣaniyama iti siddhaṃ || || iti vāṅmanodhikaraṇaṃ || atra manasaḥ prāṇe layaḥ samarthyate| <4-2-3> || tanmanaḥ prāma uttarāt || nanu na prāṇe mano līyate| tatsamatvāt| dṛśyate hi prāṇa iva manaso'pi pravartakatvaṃ| na ca tadanupapannatvānna tatra layaḥ| tasya bhagavadutpannatvaśravaṇāt| tataśca bhagavati layasya prativādinā'naṃgīkārāt| aṃgīkṛtasya prāṇe layasyānupapannatvāt iti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati || || tanmanaḥ prāṇa uttarāditi || asyārtha || pūrvoktamanobhimāni śeṣaḥ suparṇaśca| prāṇe tacchabditacaturmukhe| līyate| kutaḥ| uttarāt manaḥ prāṇa ityuttaravākyādityarthaḥ || evaṃca manaḥ prāṇa iti śravaṇāt| na ca samatvācattatra layo'nupapannaḥ| mana utkrāmadityādinā nīcoccabhāvaśravaṇāt| na ca tadanutpannatvāttatra layāsaṃbhavaḥ| vāyoriti rudrasya tasmādutpattiśravaṇena manaḥ prāṇayoḥ sāmyābhāvāt| prāṇadvārā bhagavadutpannatvārthakatvena bhagavata utpannatvoktivirodhābhāvāt| tataśca manaḥ prāṇe līyata iti siddhaṃ || || iti manaḥ prāṇādhikaraṇaṃ || atra prāṇaśabdoktacaturmukhasyeśvare layaḥ samarthyate| <4-2-4> || so'dhyakṣe tadupagamādibhyaḥ || nanu na prāṇo paramātmani līyate| tasyātadadhīnatvāt| tasyānanyādhīnatve bahuśrutisadbhāvena cakṣurādivadityādau tadadhīnatvamuktamiti samādhānāyogāt| bahubādhaviruddhatvena vaiparītyasyaivocitatvāt| mahāṃtamiti tasya layābhāvokteśca| ataḥ prāṇasya layābhāvānna kasyāpi mokṣa iti prāpte sūtramāha || || so'dhyakṣe tadupagamādibhya iti || asyārthaḥ || saḥ caturmukhaḥ| adhyakṣe adhipatau paramātmani līyate| kutaḥ tadupagamādibhyaḥ paramātmaprāptyādipratipādaka sarva iti śrutyādibhya ityarthaḥ || evaṃca hiraṇyagarbhasya bhagavadadhīnatvāt| niravakāśabahuśrutisadbhāvena tadanirṇayābhāvāt| anadhīnatvaśrutīnāṃtvīśvarānyādhīnatvābhāvaparatvena sāvakāśatvāt| prāṇasya tejasītismṛtestejaso dvāramātraparatvena tatra layaparatvābhāvāt| ato viriṃcasya layasadbhāvāduktaḥ sarvajñānināṃ mokṣa iti siddhaṃ || || iti adhyakṣādhikaraṇaṃ || atra prāgviśiṣyoktebhyo'nyeṣāṃ devānāṃ pṛthivyādisamastabhūteṣu layaḥ samarthyate || <4-2-5> nanvagnāveva sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ layo'stu| na tu siddhāṃtyabhimato vibhāgena bhūteṣu layaḥ| agnau sarva iti śruteḥ| viparyaye ca pramāṇābhāvāt| ato'śeṣadevānāmagnau layāduktamayuktamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || bhūteṣu tacchruteriti || asyārthaḥ || viśiṣyoktebhyo'nyebhyo devāḥ| bhūteṣu paṃcabhūteṣu| līyaṃte| kutaḥ| tachruteḥ| bhūteṣu devā iti śrateścetyarthaḥ || evaṃca viśiṣyoktebhyo'nyeṣāṃ yogyatānusāreṇa tattadbhūteṣu layasya bhūteṣviti śrutāvuktatvāt| bhūteṣviti niravakāśabahuvacanaśravaṇābalenāgnāviti śruteḥ saṃkocanīyatvena tadavirodhāt| tataśca sarveṣāmagnau layābhāvena paṃcabhūteṣu devānāṃ laya iti siddhaṃ || || iti bhūtādhikaraṇaṃ || atra devānāṃ sarvabhūteṣu layaḥ samarthyate| <4-2-6> || naikasmin darśayato hi || nanvagnāveva sarveṣāṃ devānāṃ layo bhavet| agnāviti śruteḥ| sarveṣāṃ devānāmnāvagnervāyāviti layāṃgīkāreṇa bhūteṣu layasyāṃgīkṛtatvāt| ato'dhamānāmuttameṣu layābhidhānādityuktavyavasthā'nupapattiriti prāpte sūtramāha || || naikasmin darśa,yota hīti || asyārthaḥ || naikasmin agnāveva sarve devāḥ na līyaṃte| kiṃtu yathāyogaṃ sarvabhūteṣu| kutaḥ| hi yasmāt| darśayataḥ pṛthivyāmṛbhava iti ṛbhavaḥ pṛthivyāmiti mohapaniṣaccaturvedaśikhe ca tathā pratipādayataḥ| tasmādityarthaḥ || evaṃca nirdiṣṭaśrutibhyāṃ paṃcasvapi layābhidhānāt| kā tarhyagnāviti śrutergatiriti cet| etacchrutibalenāgnāviti śrutau sarvaśabdaṃ saṃkucyāgnau sarvadevānāṃ layayogyānāmeva vaktumucitatvāt| ato'gnāveva sarveṣāṃ layābhāvāduktavyavasthā yukteti siddhaṃ || || iti ekasminnadhikaraṇaṃ || atra prakṛterviṣṇau layābhāvaḥ sādhyate| <4-2-7> || samanā cāsṛtyupakramādamṛtatvaṃ cānupoṣya || nanu prakṛtiḥ paramātmani līyate| tejaḥ parasyāṃ devatāyāmiti śruteḥ| uttānā vai iti śrutyā devagavānāmuttānānāṃ vahanāsiddhivatprakṛterlayaśravaṇe'pi tadadhīnatve'saṃbhāvitatvāttadasiddhiḥ || tataśca bhagavati layasadbhāvādadhikāriṇāṃ prāṇāvasānatvoktirayukteti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || samanā cāsṛtyupakramādamṛtvaṃ cānupoṣya || asyārthaḥ || ādyaśco nabhaḥ samākarṣaṇārthaḥ| dvāveti śrutisamuccayo dvitīyaḥ| tathā ca lakṣmīrna līyate| kutaḥ| yatastasyāḥ anupoṣya paramātmānamanupāsyaivāmṛtatvaṃ| nityamuktatvaṃ tatkutaḥ| asṛtyupakramāt kadā'pi saṃsāropakramābhāvāt| so'pi kutaḥ| yataḥsamānā deśataḥ kālataḥsamo nā parama puruṣo yasyāḥsā samanā tasmādityarthaḥ || evaṃca nityamuktatvāt| saṃsārasaṃbaṃdhābhāvāt| vibhutvātparamātmavat| sītārukmiṇyādirūpeṇāpi nityatvāt| dvau vā veti śruteḥ| tataśca prakṛtirna paramātmani līyata iti siddhaṃ || <4-2-8> || tadapīteḥ saṃsāravyapedaśāt || naitāvatā sāmyamityuktasādhye hetutayā sūtraṃ paṭhati || || tadapīteḥ saṃsāravyapadeśāditi || asyārthaḥ || tasyāṃ prakṛtau| apīteḥ layasya| saṃsāravyapadeśāt| vilīna iti saṃsārahetutvaśruterna mocakeśvara sāmyaṃ prakṛterityarthaḥ || evaṃca mūlarūpavatsītādyavatārāṇāmapi nityatvena garbhavāsādirūpasaṃsārasaṃbaṃdhasyāsaṃbhavāt| na caitāvatāsāmyaṃ| prakṛtau līnasya saṃsārābhidhānāt| paramātmani līnasya muktatvābhidhānāt| tathā ca prakṛtirbhagavati na līyata iti siddhaṃ || <4-2-9> || sūkṣmaṃ pramāṇataśca tathopalabdhe || hetvaṃtareṇa prakṛtipuruṣayoḥ sarvasāmamyaṃ pratiṣedhatsūtraṃ vyācaṣṭe || || sūkṣmaṃ pramāṇataśca tathopalabdheriti || asyārthaḥ || prakṛterapi sūkṣmaṃ brahma| pramāṇataḥ jñānānaṃdādiguṇaparimāṇataścādhikaṃ| kutaḥ| tathopalabdheḥ|| sarveta iti tathāśruteḥ| ato'pi prakṛterna brahmasarvasāmyomatyarthaḥ || evaṃca prakṛterapi paramātmanaḥ sūkṣmatvasya jñānānaṃdādiguṇaparimāṇādhikasya cābhidhānāt| tathā ca prakṛterna brahmasarvasāmyamiti siddhaṃ || <4-2-10> || nopamardenātaḥ || nanu yadi prakṛterna puruṣeṇa sarvasāmyaṃ tarhi nityamuktatvādisāmyamapi na syāt| brahmādivat| tataśca tayoḥ sāmyavacanānāmasāmyavacanānāṃ ca sadbhāvena na kiṃcidapi sidhyatīti prāpte sūtramāha || || nopamardenāta iti || asyārthaḥ || ataḥ sāmyatadabhāvayoḥ sādhitatvāt| nopamardena svātaṃtryādiguṇabādhena| prakṛteḥ paramātmanā nityamuktatvādinaiva sāmyamityarthaḥ || evaṃcaitasya viśeṣaguṇā jñānānaṃdādiparamāṇādhikyaguṇādayasteṣāmanupamardena nityamuktatvādinā sāmyāṃgīkāre bādhakābhāvāt| deśataḥ kālataśceti smṛteḥ| tataśca prakṛternityamuktatvādinā bhagavataḥ sāmyamiti siddhaṃ || <4-2-11> || asyaiva copapatterūṣmā || śrutirūpayuktyaṃtareṇa kiṃcitsāmyaṃ pratipādayatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || asyaiva copapatterūṣmeti || asyārthaḥ || uṣmāvattvānuṣmāvattvapratipādikā dvidhāhīdamiti śrutirapyasyaiva kiṃcitsāmyarūpārthasyaivopatatterghaṭanāyopapādikā bhavatītyarthaḥ || evaṃcoṣmā śabdena ghrāṇanādyaviṣayatvādyanukūlasāmarthyasyocyamānatvāt| cetanajātasyoṣmāvadanūṣmāvaditi dvaividyāt| tatra cakṣurādyagocaratvānukūlasāmarthyavattvādbhagavata ūṣmanāmavattvoktatvāt| anūṣmavatprakṛtiḥ| tasyāṃ deśakālavyāptinityamuktatvādisāmyasyopapatteḥ| tathā ca prakṛteḥ kiṃcitsāmyamiti siddhaṃ || <4-2-12> || pratiṣedhāditi cenna śārīrāt || nanvasamo vā eṣa para iti sāmyapratiṣedhāt| na prakṛtestasya kiṃcitsāmyamityākṣipya samādadhatsūtramācaṣṭe || || pratiṣedhāditi cenna śārīrāditi || asyārthaḥ || pratiṣedhāt īśvarasyānyasāmyapratiṣedhāt| prakṛterdeśakālavyāptatyādinā'pi paramātmasāmyaṃ| neti cenna| kutaḥ| yataḥ śārīrāt jīvenaiveśvarasya sāmyaṃ pratiṣidhyate na prakṛtitaḥ| ata ityarthaḥ || evaṃca śārīrādeva tatra sāmyasya pratiṣiddhatvāt| śarīramātramadhikṛtya tadabhimānitayā sthitāccharīrakṛtotpattināśayuktājjīvādīśvarasya sāmyasya pratiṣiddhatvāt| na tu prakṛterityavadhāraṇārthaḥ| tataśca prakṛteḥ kiṃcitsāmyamiti siddhaṃ || <4-2-13> || spaṣṭo hyekeṣāṃ || nanvasamo veti śruteḥ sāmānyarūpatvādatra paramātmanaḥ śārīreṇa sāmyaṃ pratiṣidhyate na prakṛteriti prāpte samādadhatsūtraṃ vyācaṣṭe || || spaṣṭo heyekeṣāmiti || asyārthaḥ || hi yasmāt| ekeṣāṃ śākhāsu prakṛteḥ atheti samā'samātvavādaḥ spaṣṭo'sti tasmādityarthaḥ || evaṃca keciddharmeṇa samāḥ sarvadharmairasamāścetanā iti mādhyaṃdināyanānāṃ samādivādasya spaṣṭatvāt| tataśca śārīrāddhi sāmyaṃ pratiṣidhyata iti siddhaṃ || <4-2-14> || smaryate || na kevalaṃ sāmyaśruterviśeṣaśrutibalācca saṃkocaḥ| kiṃtu viśeṣasmṛtyāpītyāha sūtrakṛt || || smaryata iti || asyārthaḥ || kṛṣṇādibhiruktārthe matsya iti smaryatecetyarthaḥ || evaṃca viṣṇorabhedānmatsyādyāvatarāṇāṃ samatvāt| brahmādicetanānāmasamatvāt| prakṛtestu samā'samātvāt| tathā ca prakṛternityamuktatvādinā layābhāvādyuktaṃ prāṇāvasānatvamadhikāriṇāmiti siddhaṃ || || iti samanādhikaraṇaṃ || atra caturmukhetaradevānāṃ paramātmani layaḥ samarthyate| <4-2-15> || tāni pare tathā hyāha || nanu na devāḥ paramātmani līyaṃte| tatpratibiṃbatvaśūnyatvāt| kiṃtu prāṇe| tatpratibiṃbatvāt| śrūyate hi devānāṃ prāṇapratibiṃbatvaṃ paramātmapratibiṃbābhāvaśca| pratibiṃba ityādinā hiraṇyagarbhetaradevānāṃ tasminpraviṣṭānāmāmātyabhṛtyanyāyena tasya layakāle bahirbhāvaṃ kṛtvā tasyaikasyaiva paramātmani layāt| ato na daivānāṃ mokṣa iti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || tāni pare tathā hyāheti || asyārthaḥ || tāni sarvāṇi daivatāni caturmukhadvārā| pare paramātmani| līyaṃte| kutaḥ| hi yasmāt| tathā''ha sarva iti śrutiḥ tathā''ha| tasmādityarthaḥ || evaṃca prāṇasya bhagavataḥ pratibiṃbatvāt| sarve devā iti śruteḥ| ato devānāṃ prāṇadvārā paramātmani layasadbhāvāduktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || || iti parādhikaraṇaṃ || atra devādimuktānāmīśvarādhīnatvaṃ samarthyate| <4-2-16> || avibhāgo vacanāt || nanu muktāḥ svataṃtrā na parādhīnāḥ| muktatvāt| ete devā iti sāyujyabhājāṃ satyakāmatvaśruteśca| ato muktānāṃ svātaṃtryātparameśvarasya sarvottamatvoktirviruddheti prāpte sūtramāha || || avibhāgo vacanāditi || asyārthaḥ || bhagavadicchā tadbhaktecchānāṃ| avibhāgo viṣayaikyaṃ| na tu virodhaḥ| kutaḥ| vacanāt ete devā iti śraterityarthaḥ || evaṃca parataṃtrā eva muktāḥ| muktatvāt| svataṃtrasya saṃsārāyogāt| nāpi muktau svātaṃtrye muktirnāma ghaṭate| na hi prekṣāpūrvakāriṇo nigaḍabaddhaṃ svādhīnaṃ saṃtaṃ muktau svātaṃtryasaṃbhave mocayaṃti| api tu muktāvapi svādhīnameva| yeneha muktau svataṃtrāt prekṣāpūrvakārī parameśvaro mocayatīti pratidyemahi| na ca śrutivirodhaḥ| śrutyā parameśvarakāmānusārikāmatvarūpapāribhāṣikasatyakāmatvasyaivābhidhānāt| kāmeneti śruteḥ| muktānāmiti smateśca| ato muktānāṃ svātaṃtryābhāvena parameśvarasyaiva sarvottamatvamiti siddhaṃ || || iti vibhāgādhikaraṇaṃ || atra pratīkālaṃbanāpratīkālaṃbanataditaramanuṣyāṇāṃ muktyarthaṃ dehotkramaṇasyājñānimaraṇavilakṣaṇatvaṃ samarthyate| <4-2-17> || tadoko'grajvalanaṃ tatprakāśitadvāro vidyāsāmarthyattaccheṣagatyanusmṛtiyogācca hārdānugṛhītaḥ śatādhikayā || nanu jñānicaramamaraṇaṃ prārabdhanibaṃdhanatvāttatpūrvamaraṇavatpṛthak‌jananamaraṇadarśanasadṛśaṃ| tataśca jñānināṃ dehādutkramaṇasya pāmaramaraṇavadeva vailakṣaṇyābhāvānna jñānamatiśayavaditi prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati || || tadoko'grajvalanaṃ tatprakāśitadvāro vidyāsāmarthyātaccheṣagatyanusmṛtiyogācca hārdānugṛhītaḥ śatādhikayeti || asyārthaḥ || tasminnutkrāṃtikāle| tadoko'grajvalanaṃ| tasya paramātmanaḥ| okasaḥ āśrayabhūtasya hṛdayasyāgre jvalanaṃ bhavati| atha tatprakāsitadvāraḥ tena prakāśena vidyotitamārgaḥ san| dehājjīva utkrāmati| nanu kathametadyajyate| vidyāsāmarthyāt| jñānasāmarthyāt| taccheṣatyanusmṛtiyogācca vidyāṃgaprāpyasmaraṇasāhityācca| kiṃca hārdānugṛhītaḥ hṛdayasthabhagavadanugrahagṛhītaḥ| san yāti| kayā śatādhikayā suṣumnā nāḍyetyarthaḥ || evaṃca jñānasāmarthyāt| tasya hṛdayasyāgraṃ pradyotate| paramātmā tatprakāśītadvāraṃ jīvamādāya suṣumnayā nāḍyā niṣkrāmati| prāṇa enamanuvrajati tasya haitasyeti śruteḥ| na ca jñānasāmarthyātpūrvaṃ maraṇasyāpyevaṃ vidhatvaprasaṃgaḥ| gatyanusmaraṇarūpasahakārivirahāt| ato jñānyutkramaṇasyājñamaraṇavailakṣaṇyena jñānamāhātmyaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <4-2-18> || raśmyanusārīti || nanu yadi prakāśitanāḍīdvāro niṣkrāmati tarhyajñavannāḍyaṃtastamasaiva gamanaṃ syāt| yadyaṃtarapyasti prakāśastarhi dvārapadavaiyarthyamityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtraṃ paṭhitvā taccheṣamātraṃ pūrayati || || raśmyānusārīti || asyārthaḥ || raśmyānusārī aṃtasthitādityaprakāśānusārī sat jīvo niṣkrāmatītyarthaḥ || evaṃca jñānino nāḍyaṃtastu sauraraśmiprakāśeneśvaramanusṛtya dehādgamanāt dvārapadāvaiyarthyāt| sahasraṃ veti śruteḥ| ata uktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <4-2-19> || niśi neti cenna saṃbaṃdhāt || nanu rātrau sauraraśmīnāmabhāvena dehāraṃbhakakarmakṣaye maraṇābhāvāt| tadā paryavasitakarmaṇāṃ keṣāṃcitjñānināmapekṣitotkramaṇasya keṣāṃcitjñānināmevaṃ keṣāṃcidanevamiti vailakṣaṇyasya cāyuktatvādityākṣipya samādadhatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || niśi neti cenna saṃbaṃdhāditi || asyārthaḥ || nanu niśi ādityaraśmīnāmabhāvāt| jñāninaḥ utkramaṇaṃ| neti cenna| nasyāditi cenna| kutaḥ| saṃbaṃdhāt sūryaraśmīnāṃ sarvadā saṃbaṃdādityarthaḥ || evaṃca rātrau bāhyādityābhāve'pi aṃtarādityasya sattvāt| tadraśmisaṃbaṃdhasya sarvadā nāḍīṣu sadbhāvena rātrāveva maraṇopapatteḥ| tathā ca jñānināṃ rātrau maraṇaṃ bhavatīti siddhaṃ || <4-2-20> || yāvaddehabhāvitvāddarśayati ca || nanu nāḍīraśmisaṃbaṃdhaḥ sarvadā'stīti nāma kiṃ| sadātana uta dehapātapūrvakālīnaḥ| āhosvidyāvaddehabhāvī| pakṣatrayasyāpyasaṃbhavaḥ| sadā nāḍīnāmabhāvāt| kadācitjñānino'pi tamasotkrāṃtiprasaṃgāt| tanniyame pramāṇābhāvāt| iti prāpte samāgadadhatsūtramāha || || yāvaddehabhāvitvāddarśayati ceti || asyārthaḥ || yāvaddehabhāvitvāt raśmisaṃbaṃdhasya yāvaccharīrabhāvitvāt| rātrāvapi jñāninaḥ utkramaṇaṃ yuktaṃ| kutaḥ| ca yataḥ| darśayati saṃsṛṣṭa iti śrutiḥ tathā pratipādayati ata ītyarthaḥ || evaṃca nirdiṣṭuśrutyā jñānino rātrau maraṇamastīti siddhaṃ || <4-2-21> || ataścāyane'pi hi dakṣiṇe || nanu vyartho'yaṃ jñānino rātrāvutkramaṇasaṃbhavapratipādanāyāsaḥ| dakṣiṇe maraṇāditi vacanāt| mokṣārthaṃ teṣāṃ dakṣiṇāyanotkrāṃtyayogāt| tadvadrātrāvapyutkrāṃtyabhāvopapatteriti prāpte sūtramāha || || ataścāyane'pi hi dakṣiṇa iti || asyārthaḥ || ca śabdaḥ pratijñādvayasamuccaye| api dakṣiṇe maraṇāditi smṛtisatve'pi| dakṣiṇe ayane| dakṣiṇāyanakāle| jñāninaḥ utkrāṃtiryuktā| kutaḥ| ataḥ sauraraśmisahasranāḍīsaṃbaṃdhasya tadā'pi sattvāt| hi yataḥ| evaṃ ataḥ dakṣiṇāyana dṛṣṭāṃtena rātrāvutkrāṃtyabhāvo na vācya ityarthaḥ || evaṃca dakṣiṇe maraṇāditi smṛterdakṣiṇāyanasaṃjñikanāḍīmaraṇasya| svargahetutvaṃ| uttarāyaṇasaṃjñikanāḍīmaraṇasya janolokādihetutvamityarthatvāt| śataṃ paṃcaiveti vacanāt| ye sādyo viṣṇulokaṃ gacchaṃti te suṣumnayā niṣkrāmaṃti| ta uttarāyaṇaraśmibhirnirgacchaṃtīti vivekasadbhāvāt| ato jñānināmutkramaṇasyājñamaraṇavailakṣaṇyātjñānamāhātmyaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || || iti tadoko'dhikaraṇaṃ || atra gatyanusmaraṇāderāvaśyakatvaṃ samarthyate| <4-2-22> || yoginaḥ prati smaryeti smārte caite || nanu na gatyarthaṃ vidyāgatyanusmṛtī apekṣite| agnirjyotiriti smṛtau kevalakālamaraṇādyadhīnatvasyoktatvāt| loke phalānusmaraṇābhāve'pi phaladarśanena tathaivātrāpi kalpyatvācca| tataśca na jñānaṃ saṃpurṇamokṣasādhanamiti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati || || yoginaḥ prati smaryeti smārte caita iti || asyārthaḥ || co yataḥ| ete brahmacaṃdragatī| yoginaḥ prati jñānakarmayoginaḥ prati smaryete smṛtyā ucyete| smārte ca svānusmṛtisādhye ca| gatītyādinā smaryete| atastayorna kevalaṃ kālādikṛtatvamityarthaḥ || evaṃca smṛtyukte ete gatī jñānakarmayogābhyāmeva smaryete| na kālasmaraṇāt| agnirjyoṃtiriti śloke brahmavida iti viśeṣaṇāt| dhūmo rātririti śloke yogīti viśeṣaṇāt| na ca lokānusāritā| sarvathā lokānusāritvasya chidādāvapyabhāvenādoṣatvāt| kathaṃcitsāmyasyehāpi bhāvāt| ato viśiṣṭotkramaṇasya vidyādisāpekṣatvādyuktaṃ jñānasya saṃpūrṇamokṣasādhanatvamiti siddhaṃ || || iti yogyadhikaraṇa || || iti caturthādhyāyasya dvitīyaḥ pādaḥ || <4.3> || śrīḥ || || hariḥ || || atha tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ || mārgo gamyaṃ cāsminpāda ucyate| atra jñāniprāpyamārgaṃ sādhyate| <4-3-1> || arcirādinā tatprathiteḥ || nanu dvāveva mārgāviti| tatraikasmin mārge'rciṣo lokaḥ prathamaḥ| mārgāṃtare tu vāyulokaḥ| te'rciṣamabhisaṃbhavaṃti sa vāyumāgacchatītyubhayavidhaśrutivirodhaḥ| tataśca gurūpadeśātprāk nirṇayābhāvātsmaraṇānupapattiriti prāpte sūtramāha || || arcirādinā tatprathiteriti || asyārthaḥ || utkrāṃto jñāni arcirādinā mārgeṇa gacchati| kutaḥ| tatprathiteḥ| tasya te'rciṣamabhisaṃbhavaṃtīti śrutau tasyārthasya prasiddhatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca dvāveva mārgau prathitāvarcirādirvipaścitāṃ| dhūmādiḥ karmiṇāṃ caiveti smṛteḥ| tatra dvāvagneḥ sutau ekasminpure saṃsthitau| tatraiko'gnināmako'paro jyotirnāmakaḥ| tadubhayādhiṣṭhitasya lokasya prathamaprāptiḥ| prabalaitacchrutivirodhena sa vāyumiti śruterarciranaṃtarārthatvopapatteḥ| ata eka eva vipaścito mārga iti vinirṇayādanusmṛtisaṃbhava iti siddhaṃ || || iti arcirādyadhikaraṇaṃ || atra vāyordvitīyaprāpyatvaṃ sādhyate| <4-3-2> || vāyuśabdādaviśeṣaviśeṣābhyāṃ || nanvadhikārivibhedena mārgabhedāt| vāyulokasyevāharlokasyāpi dvitīyaprāpyatvaṃ| sa vāyumāgacchati arciṣo'hariti cobhayatrāpi śrutisadbhāvāt| na caikasya pūrvatvaṃ parasyānaṃtaryamiti vyavasthā| viśeṣapramāṇābhāvāt| ato mārganirṇayābhāvādanusmṛtyayoga iti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || vāyuśabdādaviśeṣaviśeṣābhyāmiti || asyārthaḥ || aviśeṣaviśeṣābhyāṃ vāyoḥ prāpyatvaśruteḥ ubhayaparyālocanayā vāyoḥ dvitīya prāpyatvamevetyarthaḥ || evaṃcārciṣa iti vāyoḥ prathama prāpyatvaśruteḥ sāmānyaśruteśca mukhyaprāthamyabādhe'mukhyaprāthamyaparatvāt| tadyathā na hiṃsyāditi niṣedhasya yāgīyapaśuhiṃsāniṣedhaparatvāsaṃbhavena bāhyahiṃsāniṣedhapagtvaṃ| tathā sa ito gata iti viśeṣaśruteśca| ato mārgānirṇayena yuktā tadanusmṛtiriti siddhaṃ || || iti vāyuśabdādhikaraṇaṃ || atra taṭidabhimānilokasya saṃvatsarābhimānilokānaṃtaraprāpyatvaṃ sādhyate| <4-3-3> || taṭito'dhi varuṇaḥ saṃbaṃdhāt || nanu varuṇataṭitorubhayorapi saṃvatsarānaṃtaryaṃ| māsebhyaḥ saṃvatsaramiti tathā saṃvatsarāttaṭitamityubhayathāśrutermārgabhedenobhayorapi saṃvatsarānaṃtaryopapattau anyatarasvīkāre kāraṇābhāvāt| ato mārganirṇayābhāvāttadanusmaraṇānupapattiriti prāpte sūtramāha || || taṭito'dhi varuṇaḥ saṃbaṃdhāditi || asyārthaḥ || taṭito'dhi taṭitprāptyanaṃtaraṃ varuṇaḥ prāpyaḥ| kutaḥ| saṃbaṃdhāt varuṇasya taṭita upari saṃbaṃdhādityarthaḥ || evaṃca varuṇataṭitorubhayorapi saṃvatsarānaṃtaryaṃ na grāhyaṃ| kiṃtveka eva mārgaḥ| tatra saṃvatsarānaṃtaraṃ taṭitameva gacchati| na ca śrutyaṃtaravirodhaḥ| taṭito'naṃtaraṃ varuṇasya prāpyatvena tadarthatvopapatteḥ| tatra taṭita ityuparisaṃbaṃdhaśruteḥ| ato mārgaikyenānusmaraṇamupapadyata iti siddhaṃ || || iti taṭidadhikaraṇaṃ || atrārciranaṃtaraprāpyasya vāyorātivāhikatvaṃ samarthyate| <4-3-4> || ātivāhikastalliṃgāt || nanu sa vāyumāgacchatīti prathamaprāptatayokto vāyurmukhyaḥ| vāyuśabdasya tatraiva mukhyatvāt| bādhakaṃ vinā mukhyārthatyāgāyogāt| mukhyatve'pi prāpyatvāt| ato vāyorarciṣānaṃtaraṃ prāpyatvānna tasyādhikyamiti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati || || ātivāhikastalliṃgāditi || asyārthaḥ || pūrvaṃ dvitīyaprāpyatvenokto vāyurātivāhika eva na mukhyaḥ| kutaḥ| talliṃgāt pūrvaprāpyatvavāyuśabdāt| arciṣaḥ sa iti rūpataddharmāderityarthaḥ || evaṃca pūrvagamanaliṃgāt| pūrvagamanamātrasyārcirādigatatvenātivāhikatvāsādhakatve'pi vāyutvaniścayasahakṛtasya tatsādhakatvamupapannameva| tadyathā trivarṇetaramātrasyāṃtyajādigatatvena śūdratvāsādhakatve'pi varṇaniścayasahakṛtasya śūdratvasādhakatvamupapadyate| tathā cātivāhika evāyaṃ vāyuḥ prathamaprāpya iti mukhyasya mukhyatvamiti siddhaṃ || <4-3-5> || ubhayavyāmohāttatsiddhe || nanvevamapi nāyaṃ pūrvapakṣo'nuvartate| mukhyasya prathamaprāpyatvānaṃgīkāre tadaprāptiprasaṃgarūpabādhakasadbhāvāt| atha mataṃ| dyaurvava vidyuttatpatiṃ vāyumupagamyeti punarapi vāyuprāptiḥ śrūyate| sa mukhyo bhaviṣyatīti na mukhyaprāptiradoṣa iti prāpte sūtraṃ paṭhati || || ubhayavyāmohāttatsiddhoriti || asyārthaḥ || saptamyarthe paṃcamī| ubhayavyā mohāt pūrvoktavāyurātivāhiko mukhyo vā uttaroktavāyurātivāhiko mukhyo veti saṃdehe| tatsiddheḥ tena divaspatitvaviśeṣaṇena tasya uttaroktasya vāyormukhyatvasiddhernānirṇaya ityarthaḥ || evaṃcāsaṃśayānuvṛttidoṣaḥ kiṃ pūrvoktātivāhika utāpara| tathā paratroktātivāhika kiṃvāparaḥ| iti saṃśayanirāse kāraṇābhāvāt| tataścāyamātivāhika iti niścayo na ghaṭata iti cenna| uttare divaspatitvaviśeṣaṇena mukhyavāyutvaniścaye paratra pariśeṣeṇa vā''tivāhikatvaniścayopapatteḥ| utkrāṃtastviti smṛteśca| ataḥ prathama prāpyasyātivāhikatvādyuktaṃ mukhyasya mukhyatvamiti siddhaṃ || || iti ātivāhikādhikaraṇaṃ || atra mukhyavāyoraṃtimatvaṃ samarthyate| <4-3-6> || vaidyutenaiva tatastacchruteḥ || nanu vāyoḥ parato brahmaṇo'rvāggaṃtavyo'sti| tathāṃ'gīkāre bādhakābhāvāt| evaṃ ca na vāyorasti brahmaprāpakatvarūpaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ māhātmyamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || vaidyutenaiva tatastacchruteriti || asyārthaḥ || jñānī vaidyutenaiva vidyutpattinā vāyunaiva brahma gacchati na tu madhye| tataḥ vāyoranyaḥ prāpyo'sti| kutaḥ| tacchruteḥ| tasya vāyoreva sa enān brahmagamayatīti brahmagamayitṛtvaśruterityarthaḥ || evaṃca nāstyeva vāyoranaṃtaraprāpyaḥ| yato vidyutpatināvāyunaiva brahmaprāptiḥ| na tadanyena tasya brahmaprāpaṇasāmarthyābhāvāt| vāyoḥ sāmarthye pramāṇatvena sa enāniti śrutisadbhāvāt| vidyutpatiriti smṛteśca| ato vāyorevāṃtimaprāpyatvādyuktaṃ tasyātiśayena prādhānyamiti siddhaṃ || || iti vaidyutādhikaraṇaṃ || atra pūrvaṃ vicāritenārcirādinā mārgeṇa gatānāmalpādhikāriṇāṃ devānāṃ ca gamyaṃ nirūpyate| <4-3-7> || kāryaṃ bādarirasya gatyupapatteḥ || nanvarcirādimārgeṇa gatānāṃ sarveṣāṃ kāryabrahmaprāptireva na paraprāptiḥ| tatprāpterevopapannatvāt| devavyatiriktānāṃ paraprāptyayogyatvasya ṛte devāniti vacanātsiddhatvāditi prāpte sūtramāha || || kāryaṃ bādarirasya gatyupapateriti || asyārthaḥ || kāryaṃ utpattimaccaturmukhākhyaṃ| brahma| vāyurgamayatīti sa iti śrutyartha iti vādarirācāryo manyate| kutaḥ| asya caturmukhasyaiva| gatyupapatteḥ prāpyatvopapattirityarthaḥ || evaṃcotkrāṃtānāṃ paraprāptyanupapattau devabhinnatve sati baddhatvāditi yuktibalena brahmaśruteramukhyārthatvāṃgīkārāt| devānāṃ sākṣād‌brahmaprāpterdehalayānaṃtaraṃ muktidaśāyāṃ vā tataḥ pūrvaṃ mānuṣatvena jātānāṃ devānāmutkrāṃtyanaṃtaraṃ baṃdhadaśāyāmevetyabhyupagamāt| caturmukhamukterarvāgarcirādimārgeṇa gatānāṃ kāryaṃ brahma gamayatīti bādirirmanyata iti siddhaṃ || <4-3-8> || viśeṣitatvācca || kāryasyaiva prāptau na kevalaṃ yuktirnāpi smṛtiḥ sādhikā kiṃtu viśeṣaśrutirapītyāha sūtrakṛt || || viśeṣitatvācceti || asyārthaḥ || yadīti śrutau prāptavyabrahmaṇaścaturmukhapadena viśeṣitatvāccoktaṃ yuktamityarthaḥ || evaṃca yadi havāveti śrutyā paramātmānamabhipaśyannapi devabhinnajñānino baṃdhakāle caturmukhākhyameva brahmaprāpyatvārthakatvena pramāṇabalādanyajñānādanyaprāpteruktatvācca| nirdiṣṭaviśeṣaṇasadbhāvāt| ata uktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <4-3-9> || sāmīpyāttu tadvyapadeśaḥ || nanu brahmavidāpnoti paramiti sākṣād‌brahmapraptyuktivirodho bhavet| tasyāḥ kāryabrahmaprāptyanaṃtaraṃ samīpa eva paraprāptyarthakatvāditi prāpte parākurvatsūtramāha || || sāmīpyāttu tadvyapadeśa iti || asyārthaḥ || yatastadvyapadeśaḥ brahmaviditi parabrahmaprāptiśrutiḥ| sāmīpyāt caturmukhaṃ prāpyācireṇa paraṃ prāpnotīti kālasāmīpyādeva| tadanusṛtyaiva pravartate| ato na tadvirodha ityarthaḥ || evaṃca nirdiṣṭaśruteḥ kāryaparaprāptyoḥ kālasāmīpyānnimittādeva pravṛttatvena jñāninaḥ samīpakāla eva kāryaṃ prāpyācireṇaiva parasyāpi prāpterityarthakatvāt| avadhāraṇaśūnyatvena kāryaprāpterniṣedhābhāvāt| sāmānyaśruteśca viśeṣaśrutyā bādhopapatteḥ| ato jñānināṃ pralaye pūrvaprāptisadbhāvena tasya kāryaprāptiriti siddhaṃ || <4-3-10> || kāryātyaye tadadhyakṣeṇa sahātaḥ paramabhidhānāt || nanu samīpata eva paraṃ brahma prāpnotīti ko'rthaḥ| pralayādarvāk uta pralaya eva| nādyaḥ| prathamaṃ paraprāptau bādhakatvenoktasya baddhatvasyātrāpi bādhakatvasāmyāt| tathātve vā prathamameva paraprāptyupapatteḥ| na dvitīyaḥ| viśeṣapramāṇābhāvāditi prāpte pariharatsūtramupanyasyati || || kāryātyayetadadhyakṣeṇa sahātaḥ paramabhidhānāditi || asyārthaḥ || kāryātyaye mahāpralaye| tadadhyakṣeṇa saha kāryasvāminā caturmukhena saha| ataḥ caturmukhāt| paraṃ uttamaṃ brahma| jñānī gacchati| kutaḥ| abhidhānāt tathā śruterityarthaḥ || evaṃca sakalakāryavilayānaṃtaraṃ kāryādhipatinā caturmukhena saha tatprasādānmumukṣoḥ paraprāpterabhyupagamāt| pralaye jñānināṃ liṃgaśarīrānmuktatvena tadabhāvena baddhatvāvirodhāt| tatra pramāṇatvena te heti śrutisadbhāvāt| ataścaturmukhasya kāryaprapaṃcādhikṛtatvāttad‌brahmajigamiṣūṇāṃ tenaiva saha gamanaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <4-3-11> || smṛteśca || smṛtyāpyetamarthaṃ sādhayatsūtramupanyasyatāṃ smṛtimudāharati || || smṛteśceti || asyārthaḥ || brahmaṇeti smṛtervidyamānatvācca jñānī caturmukhena saha paraṃ prāpnotīti sidhyatītyarthaḥ || evaṃca nirdiṣṭaśrutyā parātmāno jñānino brahmaṇāṃ saṃvatsaraśatānaṃtaraṃ pralaye saṃprāpte sati caturmukhena saha brahma praviśaṃtīti kāryabrahmaṇā sahagamanaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || <4-3-12> || paraṃ jaiminirmukhyatvāt || pūrvapakṣāṃtaraṃ sūcayatsūtramupanyasyati || || paraṃ jaiminirmukhyatvāditi || asyārthaḥ || jñānī paraṃ brahmaiva prāpnoti| na tu kāryabrahma| kutaḥ| mukhyatvāt brahmaśabdasya parabrahmaṇyeva mukhyatvāditi jaiminirācāryo manyata ityarthaḥ || evaṃca sa enāniti śrutivākye brahmaśabdasya parabrahmaṇyeva mukhyatvena vāyurenān paraṃ brahmagamayati na kāryamiti jaiminyācāryo manyata iti sthitaṃ || <4-3-13> || darśanācca || nanu brahmaśabdasya parabrahmaṇi mukhyatve'pi prāguktopapattiśrutismṛtivirodhāttad‌grahaṇānupapatteramukhyārthakalpanā yuktetyāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtramupanyasyati || || darśanācceti || asyārthaḥ || jñānī paraṃ brahmaiva gacchati| kutaḥ| tena śravaṇādibhiḥ parabrahmaṇa eva dṛṣṭatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca jñānibhiḥ śravaṇādisādhanairaparokṣatayā parabrahmaṇa eva jñātatvenānyasyādṛṣṭatvena vāyustān paraṃ gamayatītyupapannamiti siddhaṃ || <4-3-14> || na ca kārye pratipatyabhisaṃdhiḥ || hetvaṃtareṇa paraprāptirevopapannetyetamarthaṃ pratipādayatsūtramupanyasyati || || na ca kārye pratipattyabhisaṃdhiriti || asyārthaḥ || ito'pi jñāninaḥ kāryabrahmaprāptiranupapannā| kutaḥ| co yataḥ| kārye brahmaṇi viṣaye| jñāninaḥ pratipattyabhisaṃdhiḥ| pratipattiḥ upāstiḥ| abhisaṃdhiḥ prāpnuvānītīcchā| nāsti| ata ityarthaḥ || evaṃca jñānināṃ kārya eva pratipattyabhisaṃdhyorabhāvāt| paraviṣaye tu tayorabhāvābhāvāt| yadupāste pumāniti smṛteḥ| tataśca vāyuḥ parameva tān gamayati na kāryamiti siddhaṃ || <4-3-15> || apratīkālaṃbanānnayatīti bādarāyaṇa ubhayathā ca doṣāttatkratuśca || adhikāribhedenobhayaprāptiriti siddhāṃtayatsūtramupanyasyati || || apratīkālaṃbanānnayatīti bādarāyaṇa ubhayathā ca doṣāttatkratuśceti ||asyārthaḥ || vāyurapratīkālaṃbanān vyāptopāsakānadhikāriṇaḥ nayati paraṃ brahma gamayati| anyān pratīkālaṃbanān pratikaśabditadehāṃta upāsakān kāryabrahma nayatīti| sa enān iti śrutyartha iti bādarāyaṇācāryo manyate| kutaḥ| ubhayathā ca doṣāt| enāṃ vyavasthāmanaṃgīkṛtya sarveṣāṃ ekaikaprāptyaṃgīkāre kāryabrahmaparabrahmapāptyaṃgīkāre kāryaparabrahmaprāptipakṣadvayoktadoṣatvaprāpteḥ| nanu yatprāptumabhivāṃchaṃti tatprāpnotīti vacanāttattadicchāmātreṇa tattatprāptisaṃbhavānnoktavyavasthāṃgīkāryetyata āha| tatkratuśceti| anena sa yathā kāmo bhavati tatkraturbhavatītyādi śrutirgṛhyate| ca śabdo yata ityarthe| yataḥ sa yatheti śrutistattatprāptīcchāmātreṇa tattatprāptiṃ pratiṣidhya tatjñānopāsanāparokṣaireva tatprāptiṃ vakti| atastattadicchāmātreṇaiva na tatprāptiryujyata ityarthaḥ || evaṃca vāyuḥ pratīkālaṃbanānmanuṣyāṃśca kāryaṃ nayati| apratīkālaṃbaneṣu ṛṣīṇāṃ śataṃ rājñāṃ śataṃ ca paraṃ nyatīti śrutyarthatvāt| sarvānkāryaṃ nayatītyarthatve sarvānparameva nayatītyarthatve ca doṣasadbhāvāt| na cecchāvaśenaiva kāryaparaprāptyorasaṃbhavenāpratīkālaṃbanatvādiviśeṣāṃgīkāro vyartha iti vācyaṃ| sa yathā kāma iti śrutau tatprāptīcchūnāmicchānusāreṇa tatprāptipratiṣedhāt| pratīkālaṃbanatvādivibhāge pratīkamiti smṛteḥ pramāṇatvena sadbhāvāt| ato jñānināmadhikāribhedenobhayaprāptiriti bhagavānbādarāyaṇo manyata iti siddhaṃ || <4-3-16> || viśeṣaṃ ca darśayati || yaduktaṃ necchānusāreṇa prāptirapi tu pratīkālaṃbanādikrameṇaiveti na tadyuktaṃ| kecidapratīkālaṃbanāḥ kecitpratīkālaṃbanā iti niyame pramāṇābhāvena yatheṣṭamapratīkālaṃbanatvāpādanasyāpi saṃbhavādityāśaṃkāṃ pariharatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || viśeṣaṃ ca darśayatīti || asyārthaḥ || co yataḥ| aṃtaḥ prakāśā iti śrutiḥ kecanāpratīkālaṃbanāḥ kecanapratīkālaṃbanāḥ iti viśeṣaṃ bhedaṃ darśayati pratipādayati| tasmāccoktaṃ yuktamirtyathaḥ || evaṃcāṃtaḥ prakāśā iti śrutyā pratīkāpratīkalaṃbanayorviśeṣabhedasya pratipāditvāt| ato'pratīkālaṃbanānityādyuktaṃ yuktamiti siddhaṃ || || iti kāryādhikaraṇaṃ || || iti caturthādhyāyasya tṛtīyaḥ pādaḥ || <4.4> || śrīḥ || || hariḥ || || atha caturthaḥ pādaḥ || || bhogamāhāsminpāde || atra muktasya brahmānatikrameṇaiva bhogyānubhavaḥ sādhyate || <4-4-1> || saṃpadyāvihāya svena śabdāt || nanu mukto brahmātikramya muktau bhogānbhuṃkte| etaṃ setuṃ tīrtveti brahmātikramānaṃtaraṃ rūpāvirbhāvasyoktatvenānatikramya sthitasya svarūpānubhavāyogāt| ato muktasya brah‌mātikramaniyamānna tadgamyamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || saṃpādyāvihāya svena śabdāditi || asyārthaḥ || jñānī saṃpadya brahma prāpya| avihāya brahmānatikramya| svena āvirbhūtasvarūpeṇāvasthitaḥ san bhogānbhuṃkte| kutaḥ| śabdāt sa evaṃ viditi śruterityarthaḥ || evaṃca brahma saṃpadyāvihāyaiva bhogānbhuṃkte| sa evamiti śruteḥ| paraṃjyotiriti śruteśca| etamiti śruterbrahmaprāptayenyataraṇasyaiva tadarthatvanāvirodhāt| ato muktasya brahmādikramābhāvāttadeva gamyamiti siddhaṃ || || iti saṃpadyādhikaraṇaṃ || atra brahma prāpya tadavihāyaiva bhogabhokturmuktatvaṃ sādhyate| <4-4-2> || muktaḥ pratijñānāt || nanu sa tatra paryetīti śrutyukto na muktaḥ| paryetīti kriyāpratīteḥ| muktasya kṛtakṛtyārthatvena kriyā'saṃbhavāt| na cāmuktasyaivaṃ vidhabhogāsaṃbhavaḥ| prāgasaṃbhave'pi gavatprāptyanaṃtaraṃ saṃbhavāt| na ca śrutyuktasyāmukttve svena rūpeṇeti vākyavirodhaḥ| tatra nirguṇopāsakasya svarūpāvirbhāvābhidhānāt| sa tatreti daharavidyopāsasyāmuktasyaiva bhogābhidhānāt| ataḥ śrutyuktasyāmuktatvānna muktasya bhoga iti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || muktaḥ pratijñānāditi || asyārthaḥ || sa tatra paryetīti śrutau mukta evocyate| kutaḥ| pratijñānāt muktādanyasya divyabhogaṃ pratiṣidhyāharaha iti śrutau muktasyaiva brahmaprāptyā divyabhogokterityarthaḥ || evaṃca nirdiṣṭaśrutau muktasyaivoktatvāt| muktatvaṃ vinaitadbhogāsaṃbhavāt| svarūpāvirbhāvokteśca| ekaprakaraṇatvasaṃbhave bhinnaprakāraṇatvakalpanā'yogāt| anyathā'tiprasaṃgāt| ato yukta eva muktasya bhoga iti siddhaṃ || || iti muktādhikaraṇaṃ || atra muktaprāpyasya jyotiṣo brahmatvaṃ sādhyate| <4-4-3> || ātmā prakaraṇāt || nanu paraṃjyoti śabdokto na viṣṇuḥ| kiṃtvādityo bhavet| sa tejasīti śrutyā samākhyānāt| evaṃca na muktasya brahmasamīpe bhoga iti prāpte sūtramāha || || ātmā prakaraṇāditi || asyārthaḥ || paraṃjyotiḥ śabdena ātmā paramātmaivocyate na sūryaḥ| kutaḥ| prakaraṇāt asya vākyasya paramātmaprakaraṇatvādityarthaḥ || evaṃca ya ātmeti bhagavata evārabhyādhītatvenāsya tatprakaraṇātvāt| prakaraṇasya samākhyāto balavattvāt| sūryamaṃḍalaprāptyanaṃtaraṃ pāpakarmavināśāṃgīkāreṇa sa tejasīti vākyasya kiṃstudhnaprāptipūrvakālikasūryaprāptiparatvena sāvakāśatvāt| paraṃjyotiḥśabdasyānyatrābhāvācca| ataḥ paraṃ jyotirbrahmaiveti tatprāptyāvihāyaiva mukto bhogānbhuṃkta iti siddhaṃ || || iti ātmādhikaraṇaṃ || atra sāyujyabhājāṃ bhagavadbhuktabhogabhoktṛtvaṃ samarthyate | <4-4-4> || avibhāgena dṛṣṭatvāt || nanu muktāḥ paramātmanā'bhuktabhogān bhuṃjate| avāptamahāpuruṣārthatvāt| anyathā kadācinmuktānāṃ bhogecchāyāmapyavāptakāmatvena paramātmanastadanicchāyāṃ muktānāṃ bhogo na syāt| paramātmabhogaṃ vinā teṣāṃ bhogāyogāt| tataśca bhagavadabhuktabhogabhoktṛtvānna tasya sarvabhoktṛtvamiti prāpte sūtramāha || || avibhāgena dṛṣṭatvāditi| asyārthaḥ || avibhāgena paramātmabhuktāḥ krameṇaiva muktaiḥ bhogāḥ bhujyaṃte| kutaḥ| dṛṣṭatvāt yānevāhamiti śruterityarthaḥ || evaṃca bhuktāneva bhogānbhuṃjaṃte muktāḥ| yānevāhaṃ śṛṇomīti śruteḥ| muktāḥ prāpyeti smṛteśca| ato muktānāṃ bhagavadbhuktabhogabhoktṛtvādyuktaṃ tasya sarvabhoktṛtvamiti siddhaṃ || || iti avibhāgādhikaraṇaṃ || atra brahmaprāptasya sāyujyamuktasya bhogaḥ samarthyate| <4-4-5> || brāhmeṇa jaiminirupanyāsādibhyaḥ || nanu na muktānāṃ bhogo yuktaḥ| śarīrābhāvāt| teṣāṃ dehasadbhāvāṃgīkāre muktatvavyāghātāt| ato muktau bhogāsaṃbhavādapuruṣārthatvamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || brāhmeṇa jaiminirupanyāsādibhya iti || asyārthaḥ || brāhmeṇa brahmasaṃbaṃdhidehenaiva| mukto bhogānbhuṃkte| kutaḥ| upanyāsādibhyaḥ brahmaṇeti śruteḥ| ādi padoktādatta iti smṛteryukteśceti jaiminyācāryo manyata ityarthaḥ || evaṃca muktānāṃ dehābhāve'pi brāhmeṇa dehena bhogasya yuktatvāt| nirdiṣṭaśrutismṛtyośca| jaiminyuktasyāpi prāmāṇikatvena bādarāyaṇokteravirodhāt| ato muktau bhogasaṃbhavādyuktaṃ mukteḥ puruṣārthatvamiti siddhaṃ || <4-4-6> || citimātreṇa tadātmakatvādityauḍulomiḥ || evaṃ dehābhāvamabhyupagamya muktasya bhogaṃ samarthya dehasadbhāvamabhyupagamya tatsamarthayatsūtramupanyasyati || || citimātreṇa tadātmakatvādityauḍulomiriti || asyārthaḥ || citimātreṇa jñānaikasvarūpadehena| mukto bhogānbhuṃkte tadātmakatvāt| cinmātradehasyaiva muktasvarūpatvāt| tasya ca saṃsṛtyahetutvādityauḍulomirācāryo manyata ityarthaḥ || evaṃca muktānāṃ cinmātreṇa pṛthagvidyamānatvāt| teṣāṃ śarīrasya caitanyasvarūpeṇa pṛthagvidyamānatvāt| teṣāṃ cidātmakatvāccitimātraśarīrasya ca muktasvarūpatvātsvarūpasya cākṛtrimattvena saṃsārānāpādakatvāt| sarvadehaparityāgena brahmadehādbhinnacitimātreṇa muktā bhujyaṃte| sarvaṃ veti śruteḥ| ityauḍulomirācāryo manyate| ato muktau bhogaḥ saṃbhavatīti siddhaṃ | <4-4-7> || evamupanyāsātpūrvabhāvādavirodhaṃ bādarāyaṇaḥ || nanu na sūtradvayoktaparihārau yujyete| dehābhāvābhāvayorviruddhatvādityāśaṃkāṃ parākurvatsūtraṃ paṭhati || || evamupanyāsātpūrvabhāvādavirodhaṃ bādarāyaṇa iti || asyārthaḥ || evamauḍulomyuktaprakārāsyopanyāsāt sa va eṣa iti śratau uktatvāt| pūrvabhāvāt pūrvasmin jaiminyuktapakṣe'pi bhāvāt pramāṇasadbhāvāt| avirodhaṃ pakṣadvayasyāvirodhaṃ| bādarāyaṇācāryo manyata ityarthaḥ || evaṃca bādarāyaṇācārya ubhayamatayoravirodhaṃ manyate| sarvaṃ vā iti śrutau muktasya ciccharīramātroktāvapi sa vā eṣa iti śrutau auḍulomyuktaciccharīrabhogasyāpyupanyāsāt| cinmātrasya brāhmeṇa bhoga iti jaiminyuktasya ca pramāṇeṣu bhāvena pramite ca virodhābhāvāt| prathamasya cinmātradehaviṣayatvāt| dvitīyasya tu jaḍadehābhāvaviṣayatvāt| ato muktau bhogasaṃbhavādyuktaṃ mukteḥ puruṣārthatvamiti siddhaṃ || || iti brāhmādhikaraṇaṃ || atra muktasya saṃkalpamātrasādhyabhogaḥ samarthyate || <4-4-8> || saṃkalpādeva ca tacchruteḥ || nanu tattadupāyasādhyasādhanasādhyo muktabhegaḥ| okasi sthitabhogatvāt| pṛthivyādyokasi sthitasaṃsāribhogavat| anyathā lokavirodhāt| tataśca saṃkalpasādhyatvābhāvānmukterapuruṣārthatvamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || saṃkalpādeva ca tacachruteriti || asyārthaḥ || co viruddhapakṣavyāvṛtyarthaḥ| saṃkalpādeva svecchānusāreṇaiva muktā bhogān bhuṃjate| kutaḥ| tacchruteḥ| tasminnarthe sa yadīti śruterityarthaḥ || evaṃca muktānāṃ bhogādiṣu prayatnanirapekṣatvāt| sa yadi …lokakāma iti śruteḥ| na ca lokavirodhaḥ| nirdeṣe bhagavadokasi tathātvasyaiva yuktatvāt| ato muktabhogasya saṃkalpamātrasādhyatvādyuktaṃ mukteḥ puruṣārthatvamiti siddhaṃ || || iti saṃkalpādhikaraṇaṃ || atra brahmaprāptimatāṃ muktānāṃ svādhamaniyamyatvarāhityena bhogaḥ sādhyate| <4-4-9> || ata eva cānanyādhipatiḥ || nanu muktāḥ svāvaraniyamyāḥ| sarvādhipatisadananiviṣṭatvāt| rājasadananiviṣṭāmātyādivat| dṛśyaṃte hyamātyā api rājaśāsananiviṣṭā nīcairapi pratihārairniyamyamānāḥ| anyathā lokavirodhaḥ syāt| ato muktasyādhamaniyamyatvānmukteḥ saṃsārasamānadharmatvamiti prāpte sūtritaṃ || || ata eva cānanyādhipatiriti || || asyārthaḥ || ca śabdo viruddhasaṃkāvyāvartakaḥ| ananyādhipatiḥ muktaḥ svottamasvakīyānyādhipatiyukto na| kutaḥ| ata eva satyasaṃkalpādevetyarthaḥ || evaṃca sarveṣāṃ paramātmādhipatitvāt| prāṇādināmaparyaṃtadevānāṃ krameṇādhipatitvāt| yairjñānaṃ supratiṣṭhitaṃ teṣāmācāryāṇāmapyadhipatitvāt| tato'nyasya nīcādhipatitvābhāvāt| satyasaṃkalpāt| loke hyanapekṣitasyaiva bhāvāt| tacca muktasya satyasaṃkalpādevāyuktatvāt| paramo'dhipatiriti smṛteḥ| ato muktasyādhamādhipatiśūnyatvādyuktaṃ mukteḥ saṃsāravailakṣaṇyamiti siddhaṃ || || iti ananyādhipatyadhikaraṇaṃ || atra parameśvaraṃ prāptānāṃ bhogānupapattiḥ parihriyate || <4-4-10> || abhāvaṃ bādarirāha hyevaṃ || nanu na muktānāṃ bhogo yujyate| dehabhāvābhāvayorvirodhāt| muktasya bāhyadehāṃgīkāre duḥkhaprasaṃgāt| tadanaṃgīkāre bhogāsaṃbhavaḥ| aśarīreṇa bhogāyogāt| na ca ciccharīreṇa bhogopapattiḥ| suptyādau vidyamānasya tasyāpi bhogāyatanatvādarśanāt| na brāhmeṇa dehena tadupapattiḥ| paradehasya paraṃ prati bhogāyatanatvāyogāt| ataḥ kathamapi muktānāṃ nirduḥkhabhogāyogādapuruṣārthatvaṃ mukteriti prāpte sūtramāha || || abhāvaṃ bādarirāha hyevamiti || asyārthaḥ || prākṛtadehābhāvamaṃgīkṛtya cinmātradehena muktasya bhogo'sti| evaṃ bādarirācāryo manyate| kutaḥ| hi yasmāt| abhāvaṃ prākṛtaśarīrābhāvaṃ| aśarīro vāveti śrutirāha| tasmādityarthaḥ || evaṃca cinmātradehasadbhāvāt| suptyādau vidyamānasyājñānādyāvṛtatvena tadā bhogāyatanatvābhāvepyajñānanivṛttyanaṃtaraṃ tatsaṃbhavāt| na hi pratibaddhakāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ na janayatītyetāvatā taduparame'pi kāryaṃ na janayatīti sāṃprataṃ| na ca duḥkhaprasaṃgaḥ| bāhyadehābhāvāt| aśarīro vāvetyāmnānāditi bādarirācāryo manyate| tathā ca yukta eva muktāna āṃ bhoga iti siddhaṃ || <4-4-11> || bhāvaṃ jauminirvikalpāmnānāt || muktānāṃdehasadbhāvamabhyupagacchatsūkṣamupanyasyaṃti || || bhāvaṃ jaiminirvikalpāmnānāditi || asyārthaḥ || jaiminiḥ muktānāṃ bhāva cinmātrātiriktadehasadbhāvaṃ manyate| kutaḥ| vikalpāmnānāt
